excerpt.zh:
[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。

与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
excerpt.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

excerpt.zh: 怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。
excerpt.en: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
警告：禁用['concept_psionic_ascension']。

这个文明的祖先受到入侵心灵的超自然力量的困扰，这促使他们投入巨量人力物力来开发反灵能技术。

他们的古老装置仍然可以使用，但尚未对来自星系更远处的灵能威胁进行测试。
excerpt.en:
WARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient dev

excerpt.zh: 一个虚境造物突破了空间壁垒，并且在[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]星系完成实体化！这个复仇心切的化身驾驭着一股强大的灵能，并将用其鞭挞任何不幸踏上它复仇之路的人和物。
excerpt.en: A creature of the Shroud has pierced the fabric of space and materialized in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system! This vengeful Avatar has amassed a tremendous amount of psionic energy and is using it to lash out at anything and anyone unfortunate enough

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源

与同化他们的机器被切断联系之后，这个新生的文明为了在星系中确立自身地位而进行了顽强的斗争。
excerpt.en: Abruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 在暴力和苦难中，这个文明在一位领袖的领导下走向了统一。通过压制较弱的派系来巩固权力，他们现在成为了科学和技术进步的坚定倡导者。在这之后，是一段不稳定的和平的时期。但和平终究是一种短暂的状态。
excerpt.en: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace h

excerpt.zh: 虚境实体的引导是有代价的。独立的自动机开始在这个网络社会中自由运行。从机械智能中脱离后，这些单位的需求正在与日俱增。
excerpt.en: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the Machine Intelligence, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
excerpt.en: This civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

excerpt.zh:
我们检测到有一股非常微弱的快子信号正向整个星系进行发送。该信号经过了特殊处理，在多个隐蔽的中继站之间来回跳跃，因此我们的技术人员无法追踪到信号的源头。

除了在某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，该信号似乎不会造成明显的影响。我们已经尽力追踪这些中继站，但是在此之前我们必须学着和这个幽灵信号共同生活，毕竟它已经被闻风而动的媒体添加了很多无中生有的东西。
excerpt.en:
We have detected a very faint tachyon signal being continuously transmitted across the entire galaxy. Our technicians are unable to trace the signal to its source, as it is being bounced between several hidden relay stations.

Aside from adding a small amount

excerpt.zh: 一名细心的通讯官识别出了这些模糊的信号，在伽马射线的干扰下，它们从黑洞抵达这里时已经几乎不可识别——这信号虽然微弱，但明显不是自然产生的。这个现象引起了科学家们对其的更多兴趣。
excerpt.en: An alert communications officer has identified what appears to be a faint signal, almost lost in the gamma-ray flashes from the black hole here - faint, but unmistakably artificial. This raises intriguing possibilities for our scientists.

excerpt.zh: 几个世纪前，这个物种的母星被一位毒性神祗造访。接踵而至的生态灾难几乎摧毁了这个星球，但是幸存者们怀着对毒圣的崇敬之情，草草地统一了起来。他们创立了一个骑士教团来搜寻毒圣，尽管后来很多事情变了，但是这份试炼依旧保留了下来。
excerpt.en: Centuries ago, this species' homeworld was visited by a Toxic Entity. The ecological catastrophe that followed ruined half the world, but allowed an early unification of the survivors in their reverence for the Toxic God. An Order of Knights has been created t

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源

这个文明始于一艘奴隶船上的发起的兵变，现在由多种多样的前超光速物种组成。
excerpt.en: This civilization began as a mutiny aboard a slaver vessel, and is made up of a diverse group of pre-FTL species.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！如果没错的话，这个文明应该是由不同的种群建立的联盟，他们称呼自己为“第一联盟”。这些种群在两百万年前相对和平地在这片星域共存着。

虽然[From.GetStarName]坐落在他们核心范围内，在飞船上的文物中找到的一张局部地图表明，第一联盟陨落前已经统治了我们星系很大部分。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! If what we have learned from these artifacts is correct, this civilization was some sort of confederation that consisted of many different alien races. They called themselves the

excerpt.zh: 一个世纪以前，在帝国的母星系，其中的一颗行星被一颗古怪的小行星摧毁了。一些人认为这是某个外星物种的恶意攻击。其他人则把这些担忧当作纯粹的妄想症。两类人之间的关系变得愈发紧张，最后无可奈何之下，帝国将一个新近完成地形改造的星球给予这些恐宇派。
excerpt.en: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so grea

excerpt.zh: 在不知名的过去，有一位神秘的施恩者为这个文明在他们的恒星系藏了一点惊喜。
excerpt.en: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于远古外星文明的文物！从这些遗物的年代来看，他们应该是在大约1200万年前活跃在这一区域的文明。
 
从我们所能拼凑起的情报中，科学家总结出这是一种自称为“沃陶姆恒星议会”的外星物种，他们长得像蠕虫的环节动物，大约3-4米长，彼此主要借助体节传递的振动进行交流。
excerpt.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! They must have been active in this region of space approximately 12 million years ago, judging by the age of the artifacts.

From what they have been able to piece together, our

excerpt.zh: 灰色风暴的纳米机械已如乌云压城一般入侵了[Root.GetName]的大气层，一路上吞噬了地表的一切，并复制出了更多的纳米机械。很快，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]原居民存在过的痕迹就消失无踪了。
excerpt.en: The nanomachines of the Gray Tempest have swept into the atmosphere of [Root.GetName] like dark storm clouds, consuming everything on the surface to replicate more of themselves. Soon no traces of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants remain.

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有飞升路线。

该文明长久以来都一直沉迷于一场将邻近的星球变成荒凉的虚境星球的神秘灾难。如今他们初涉星海，终于得以一探究竟，以及确定是否会有相似的命运降临在自己头上。
excerpt.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can fi

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！从我们目前对其语言的破译来看，这些外星人称他们自己为“伊拉斯协约国”。他们是一个在一百万年前掌控着星系的这片区域的星际政权。

这些外星人似乎是六肢的哺乳动物，有多处文献交叉印证了一种叫“贾沃疹”的流行病席卷了他们的帝国，带来了灾难性的后果甚至直接导致了他们的毁灭。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! From what we have translated so far of their language, we have learned that these aliens called themselves the "Irassian Concordat." They were an interstellar power that held swa

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！难以置信的是，这个自称“赛博勒克斯”的文明其实是通过某种集体意识连接在一起的机器组成的。遗物的年代表明他们活跃在60万年前，至少在这片星系里如此，我们还不了解他们的起源。

根据我们的科学家提取的数据碎片，出于未知的原因，赛博勒克斯曾在某一时刻发动了一场全面战争来消灭宇宙中所有有智慧的有机体。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Incredibly, this civilization, which apparently referred to itself as the "Cybrex," seems to have been made up of machines that were linked together in some sort of collective co

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了和在[From.GetName]上的外星文明有关的文物！我们的科学家认为他们在六百万年前居住在这片星系，这些外星人自称“尤特”人。他们体型巨大且看起来像扁平的节肢动物。

这一物种成年之后体长接近百米，显然鲜有一艘飞船上能够有两名甚至三名尤特人乘客。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Our scientists think they inhabited this region of stars roughly six million years ago, based on the age of the artifacts. The aliens called themselves the "Yuht" and appear to h

excerpt.zh:
星海参议院通过了一项议案，宣布[new_crisis.GetName]是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海共同体开战了。

作为星海监管人，[custodian.GetName]呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
excerpt.en: The Galactic Senate has passed a resolution declaring the [new_crisis.GetName] a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] as of today finds itself in a state of total war with the entire Commun

excerpt.zh:
您好，星际旅行者，我们是策展人。

我们遵从的古训自万古之前便由星系中的支配力量所制定。我们献身于保存世间所有的知识，来避免星系再次陷入荒蛮与死寂的黑暗时期。

但我们失败了。

我们只留下了很少的幸存者，但相比我们的前辈，我们完成自己神圣使命的决心丝毫没有动摇。我们有意与你分享一些我们的知识……当然，这不是无偿的。
excerpt.en:
Greetings, star travelers. We are the Curators.

Our ancient order was established eons ago by the various galactic powers in ascendancy at the time. We were dedicated towards the preservation of all knowledge, in an effort to safeguard the galaxy from descend

excerpt.zh:
我们与自己的生物载体共生共存，但某些至关重要的东西一直虚无缥缈……

更巨大的虚空造物启发了我们，让我们开始了最野心勃勃的工程：培育出一头最强大的太空生物。这种“噬天巨兽”将会是全新的存在，是被雕凿出来而非盲目演化出来的最巅峰的生命形式。

我们的第一项挑战是产出一颗巨大的卵，大到足以孵化出一头史无前例的巨兽。除了其所需的营养外，我们还需要卵壳能吸收环境光、热能，以及将气体处理成补充物质。
excerpt.en:
We exist symbiotically with our biological vessels, yet something vital has always eluded us...

Inspired by the greater voidbornes, we embark on our most ambitious endeavor: birthing the biggest of them all. This "Behemoth" will be something new, an apex life

excerpt.zh:
众所周知，科学能为进步铺平道路。如果想要发挥出我们真正的潜力，那就别无他法。我们对技术的掌握不言而喻，但还是有太多超出我们理解的事物：失落帝国之道，星神兽之力，还有灵能洞见之谜……

想要一窥现实深层的意义，我们需要一种新的科学、一种新的计算机。突触凝练机正代表通往无限知识之旅最重要的第一步。
excerpt.en: It is an axiom that science paves the way for progress. If we wish to fulfill our true potential, there can be no other path. Our technological mastery is self-evident, but far too much remains beyond our comprehension: the ways of the Fallen Empires, the powe

excerpt.zh:
草叶婆娑，夜静如尖啸。猎户之志，冷锐如星光。

这个文明与荒野有着原始的联系。他们把自己看作是当地各种致命野生动物的管家，现在又把目光投向了苍穹。他们善于管理和牧养动物，这种与动物群的联系是根据他们的思潮发展起来的。而这种联系将如何在星系尺度上演变还有待观察。
excerpt.en:
The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...

This civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to the

excerpt.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
excerpt.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员们兴奋地报告称他们在[From.GetName]上发现了一处古代太空文明的遗迹，其似乎于七百万年前定居于这一行星！

尽管这些自称古茹努尔的物种离开[From.GetStarName]星系的原因尚不明确，我们的科学家已经在这颗行星上分离出了一处很有发掘价值的考古遗址。

也许进一步的研究会找到更多线索。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew are eager to report they have uncovered the remains of an ancient space-faring species on [From.GetName], who appear to have inhabited the planet some seven million years ago!

While it is unclear why this species, who called themselves

excerpt.zh:
我们的星系比看起来更脆弱。危险从四面八方逼近：捕食者潜伏于虚空，海盗盘踞在无主恒星系，傲慢和恐惧也在引发着战争。而那些有能力行动的人却常常保持沉默。

而我们不会袖手旁观。这并非宣称统治，而是承诺守护。通过审慎的行动和共同的目标，我们将确保星系拥有值得守护的未来。
excerpt.en:
Our galaxy is more fragile than it appears. Dangers press in from every direction: predators lurking in the void, pirates in forgotten systems, wars born of pride and fear. And too often, those with the power to act remain silent.

We will not stand idle. This

excerpt.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
excerpt.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, att

excerpt.zh: 这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？
excerpt.en: These nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

excerpt.zh:
没有他们不敢面对的挑战，没有他们不愿追逐的线索，也没有他们会视若罔闻的风暴。

从本质上来说，这是一个追求刺激的文明。即有好处也有坏处。
excerpt.en:
There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.

At its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

excerpt.zh: 自远古以来，这个文明就与一条强大的龙共享同一恒星系。这个神秘生物的行为在冷淡的仁慈和傲慢的漠视之间摇摆不定。随着行星居民迈入星辰大海，这种关系将如何演变还有待观察。
excerpt.en: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the st

excerpt.zh:
一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是当这些人受苦的时候，我们真的可以袖手旁观吗？
excerpt.en:
A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower

excerpt.zh: 队员们清理了[Root.GetName] 上的雨林后，无意中有了一个不寻常的发现，在一丛古老枯萎的树林下覆盖着一处[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] 似乎从未涉足的地方，九个巨型雕像，在其下的景物上投下了冰冷而高大的阴影。这些雕像带有羽翼而又通体苍白，散发着来自异世界的气质。它们并不像这颗行星上的任何生命形式。或许它们是依某种早被遗忘的神祗或偶像的形象建造的。
excerpt.en: The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon an unusual find. Previously obscured deep within a tangle of old withered trees, where it would seem no [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] has ventured before, are nine massive statues, casting dark, ta

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上存在一座古老的废弃殖民地遗址。从轨道上的观测情况来看，并没有明显的迹象显示发生过灾难导致大量居民丧生或者迫使他们逃离殖民地。如果我们想要找到答案，一场地面调查行动势在必行。
excerpt.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains the remains of an ancient, abandoned colony. From orbit there are no obvious signs of disaster which would have killed the inhabitants or compelled them to flee. If we want answers, an expedition to the surface will be required.

excerpt.zh: 这个文明正逐步迈进全新的科技纪元。
excerpt.en: This civilization is progressing to a new technological age.

excerpt.zh: 这个帝国追求一种神圣的使命，即高尚身体与神圣的义体技术的融合。强化改造便是一种崇拜。
excerpt.en: This empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明在它们的家园星系有一座休眠状态的星门——是潜在的科技优势，抑或是高悬头顶的达摩克里利斯之剑？
excerpt.en: This civilization has a dormant Gateway in their home system - potential technological benefit, or a looming menace?

excerpt.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] now stand tri

excerpt.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近[Root.GetStarName]黑洞时，他们发现自己并非孤身一人。一个巨大的完美球体结构屹立在黑洞事件视界的边缘，反射着被吸入黑暗裂隙的、群星所散发的光芒。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。它就静静地呆在深渊的边缘。等待着。
excerpt.en: As the [Root.GetName] approaches the [Root.GetStarName] black hole they find that they are not alone. At the edge of the event horizon it soars, reflecting light from the stars being drawn into the dark, gaping hole. A gigantic construction in the shape of a p

excerpt.zh: 这个郁郁葱葱的文明与太空生物群形成了独特的协同作用。通过向这些生物提供果实，他们吸引种子传播者来帮助它们进行殖民。
excerpt.en: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

excerpt.zh: 这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
excerpt.en: Once a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

excerpt.zh: 一种寿命短且不能生育的克隆人士兵，在战争方面异常精通，现在他们没有主人，亦不了解自己被设计出来的目的，以及他们那不确定的命运。
excerpt.en: A species of short-lived and infertile soldier clones exceptionally proficient in matters of war, left masterless and alone to question their engineered purpose and uncertain fate.

excerpt.zh: 我们从一队独立勘探者处截获的通讯表明，他们最近在[precursor_planet.GetName]发现了与远古先驱文明相关的物品。出于迷茫，他们并没有染指[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]，因此他们发现的东西现在应该还在原处。
excerpt.en: Intercepted communications from a group of independent prospectors indicate that they recently found something relating to an ancient Precursor civilization on [precursor_planet.GetName]. Superstition compelled them to leave the [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon

excerpt.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
excerpt.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

excerpt.zh: 一道巨大的时空裂隙高悬于该文明母星的穹顶。在研究这一现象近千年后，最近的星舰科技进展使其终于可以靠近他，并且发掘潜藏其中的秘密。
excerpt.en: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.

excerpt.zh: 该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——深空擎天堡。
excerpt.en: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological

excerpt.zh:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的探险家在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上发现了一种以前未曾见识过的软体类物种。就其本身而言，这些生物中的每一个都只能勉强算得上是有智慧的。然而，当两个或更多的生物个体通过身体接触结合在一起时，它们会形成一个半意识的节点。理论上，这些节点应该能够在认知能力方面有指数级的增长。

简单地说，[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的人们偶然发现了一种生物思维机器。假以时日，这一发现可能预示着有机奇点的
excerpt.en: [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] explorers on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have discovered a previously unknown species of molluscoid. On its own, each of these creatures barely qualifies as sapient. However, when two or more are joined through physical contac

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这一文明的母星高度不稳定，走向爆炸只是时间问题。他们唯一的希望是在为时太晚前在其他地方寻觅到避难之处。
excerpt.en: This civilization's homeworld is highly unstable, and it is only a matter of time before it explodes. Their only hope is to seek refuge elsewhere before it is too late.

excerpt.zh: 这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
excerpt.en: Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

excerpt.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。
excerpt.en: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.

excerpt.zh: 这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
excerpt.en: The Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

excerpt.zh:
在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
excerpt.en:
Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

Our policy is to never interfere

excerpt.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的量子弹弓单阵列。
excerpt.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) Quantum Catapult Single Array.

excerpt.zh:
队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的雨林后，有了惊人的发现——在丛林的深处，茂密的植被覆盖下有一座巨大的外星空间站。他们的建筑学令人震惊，建造技术远远领先于我们，简直是一件艺术品。

空间站似乎是坠落在行星表面，多亏其非同寻常的防护机能才挺过了撞击，我们的科学家迫切想要调查这个空间站。遗憾的是如果进行考古发掘，则在工作完成前我们将无法利用这块土地。
excerpt.en: The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has made a spectacular discovery - deep within the forest, overgrown and obscured by the lush plant life is a colossal alien space station. Architecturally stunning and built with technology far superior to our ow

excerpt.zh: 该物种受自己都无法完全理解的直觉所驱使着，永远都在追猎最独特的生物。他们独有能整合猎物基因的能力，因此演化成了母星上最顶级的猎手，应有尽有地吸收了所有的优势基因。如今，这种渴望又将他们带向了群星。
excerpt.en: This species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage a

excerpt.zh: 这个实体无异于一个拥有智慧的生态圈：众多不同的生命形式早已融合成一个行星尺度的格式塔意识。
excerpt.en: This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

excerpt.zh: 早在他们踏入星系舞台之前，他们的文明就受到了虚境行者集会的支持和塑造成型。
excerpt.en: Long before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.

excerpt.zh:
他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的电弧熔炉已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。

星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
excerpt.en:
Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty Arc Furnace now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.

The galaxy awaits, and the possi

excerpt.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
excerpt.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
excerpt.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明曾经叱咤虚空，掌控大片星海。他们最终败落并几乎被摧毁殆尽，但在漫长的穷困潦倒后他们正要于群星间东山再起。
excerpt.en: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.

excerpt.zh: 这一蜂巢思维与一棵巨型树木间进化出了共生关系。这棵巨树赋予了他们许多益处，但失去这棵树将会把他们摧垮。
excerpt.en: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.

excerpt.zh: 这不是一个崛起的文明，而是一个被释放的文明。当休眠仓开启，他们醒来时，早已物换星移，故土难寻。但他们的过去并未湮灭，而是埋藏在星系尘土与废墟之下，静候再次被发掘。
excerpt.en: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

excerpt.zh: 通过斗争和胜利，这个社会已经实现了每一个年轻文明的抱负：一个有着统一目标的家园，一条通向璀璨繁星的道路。
excerpt.en: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a homeworld with unified goals, and a path open to the stars.

excerpt.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
excerpt.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过他们在长达一个世纪的时间里的逐步策划，一个他们于其中具有支配地位的星际联盟就此诞生。
excerpt.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they masterminded the birth of an interstellar union in which they would have a dominant role.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明的家园如同天堂，也许是专为他们打造的。
excerpt.en: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

excerpt.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
excerpt.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。
excerpt.en: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to spac

excerpt.zh: 这一机械智能早已将母星系中的所有资源统合到了他们的首都星球，将其完全以机械覆盖。
excerpt.en: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明自蒸汽时代早期便醉心于金属制自动机器人的理念。尽管许多人认为不可能做到，早在初步的太空航行前第一台真正的机器人就已从装配线下线。
excerpt.en: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
excerpt.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

excerpt.zh: 自这个机械文明诞生伊始他们就深潜于水下王国，享受着物产丰富的环境，不受任何自然的挑战。
excerpt.en: Since its creation, this machine civilization has delved deep into the underwater realms of an abundant ocean untouched by natural adversaries.

excerpt.zh: 自这个文明诞生伊始他们就享受着物产丰富、无忧无虑的环境，使其能够不受阻碍地发展繁荣。
excerpt.en: Since its birth, this civilization has enjoyed peace in a generous environment with no natural enemies, enabling unhindered growth and opulence.

excerpt.zh: 这个文明不择手段地增强自己的有机体，无论风险，无论成本。毕竟，与其在沉默中消亡，不如光鲜亮丽地燃烧殆尽。
excerpt.en: This civilization uses any and all means of organic enhancement, no matter the risk, no matter the cost. After all, it is better to burn out brightly than fade away into obscurity.

excerpt.zh: 历经核子烈焰的考验，这一文明曾面临全面灭绝的威胁——又最终死里逃生。虽经毁灭却仍为一体，他们在旧世界的灰烬之上重建了文明。
excerpt.en: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.

excerpt.zh: 在一场毁灭性的核灾难之后，这些机器就成为这个一度繁荣的文明的唯一幸存者。通过继续履行其原定的目标，它们从旧世界的不适宜居住的灰烬中逐渐重建起一个新的社会。
excerpt.en: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old wor

excerpt.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
excerpt.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strang

excerpt.zh: 这一文明生活在未知先驱们建造的环形世界之中。一经理解及修复完好，他们将获得巨大的力量。
excerpt.en: This civilization inhabits a Ring World built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.

excerpt.zh: 这个物种也许永远也不会知道自己的祖先为什么会迁移到地表以下。这究竟是出于一种自我保存的必要，或是为了追寻资源的富足？不管其目的为何，他们都成功地适应了环境，造就了一个对环境要求更加灵活的社会。
excerpt.en: This civilization may never know why their ancestors migrated below the surface. Was it necessary to ensure self-preservation, or did the promise of bountiful resources allure them? Whatever the case, they successfully adapted, leading to a more environmentall

excerpt.zh: 该这明已经完美地融入了地下的存在，其最初的驱动力或是是某种经过深思熟虑的自我保护，或是某种在深处寻找隐藏的丰富资源的指令。由此产生的机械适应性早已挖掘出了一个多功能且坚定不移的机器社群。
excerpt.en: This civilization has flawlessly integrated into subterranean existence, initially driven by either calculated self-preservation or a directive to locate of hidden, abundant resources in the depths. The resulting mechanical adaptations have unearthed a versati

excerpt.zh: 一种第二物种形成了这个文明密不可分的一部分。它们高大健壮，又大都只有相当于格外愚钝的孩童的智力。古老的战争剔除了它们物种具有的最富攻击性的倾向，使其如今相当顺从。
excerpt.en: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servil

excerpt.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
excerpt.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

excerpt.zh: 起初，这个机器文明的创造者是将它们设计用于外太空旅行的、完全按照在零重力环境下流畅工作进行的优化。在经历数个纪元的孤立之后，这些机器最近重新在散布于它们母星系的数个轨道居住站之间团结了起来。
excerpt.en: At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbit

excerpt.zh:
很高兴与您相识！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦简陋的星际工坊。

诶呀…我在哪儿都能认出龙骨上的那些东西——制作的很精致。我们有着跟踪星系中飞船设计的习惯，试着同当地风潮保持一致。不过我刚刚讲到哪儿…？

啊，对了：欢迎您！请问我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
excerpt.en:
Pleased to make your acquaintance! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our humble, interstellar workshop.

Say... I'd recognize those keel fixtures anywhere - some fine work. We make a habit of keeping up with what's flying in

excerpt.zh:
很高兴与您相识！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦简陋的星际工坊。

诶呀…我在哪儿都能认出龙骨上的那些东西——制作的很精致。我们有着跟踪星系中飞船设计的习惯，试着同当地风潮保持一致。不过我刚刚讲到哪儿…？

啊，对了：欢迎您！请问我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
excerpt.en:
Pleased to make your acquaintance! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our humble, interstellar workshop.

Say... I'd recognize those keel fixtures anywhere - some fine work. We make a habit of keeping up with what's flying in

excerpt.zh:
啊哈！一位来访者。欢迎欢迎。

我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]。在这个自虚空诞生的舱室里，我们的女巫集会谈论着凡人所费解的力量。我们思索着潜藏梦境中的秘密、探寻着原始灵能的贮藏地、凝视着驱动整个文明的无形齿轮……虚境对于聆听者，揭示良多。

此时此刻，我聆听于你。什么风把你吹来了？你已知否？

Ah! A visitor. Welcome.

excerpt.zh: 我们同[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的合约已经到期，他们的舰队即将离开。我们是否应该联络他们进行合同续约？
excerpt.en: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

excerpt.zh: 在这个星系中我们截获了一系列怪异的电磁信号。初步数据分析表明这些发报器也许有数千年的历史。我们的船员渴望找到它的源头。
excerpt.en: We've picked up a series of strange electronic signals inside this system. Preliminary data shows these transmissions might be thousands of years old. Our crew is keen to find their origin.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]知道很多关于可怕的海盗之王兹泰格·迈尔的故事。几个世纪前，他一路劫掠星系，攫取财富，稀有资源和价值连城的古代文物。现在，多亏了一套古老的星图，[Root.GetFirstName]相信[Root.GetHeShe]已经发现了哲泰格-迈尔藏匿他大量战利品的地方。[Root.GetFirstName]拒绝详细说明究竟是如何获得这些海图的，但可以相信它们的真实性，并希望我们派一艘工程船去挖掘宝藏。如果那儿还有宝藏的话。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] knows many stories about the dreaded Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr. Centuries ago, he pillaged his way across the galaxy, seizing riches, rare resources and ancient artifacts of untold value. Now, thanks to a set of old star charts [Root.GetFirstName] b

excerpt.zh:
督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：我们的灵督城邦成立了。从今天起，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]将肩负起与虚境还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。

如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从泽珞处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
excerpt.en:
Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of our Mindwarden Enclave is complete. From today, the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] shall carry on the vital work of combating the Shroud and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it,

excerpt.zh:
长期以来，我们认为[capital_star.GetName]是一颗典型红巨星，但近期分析显示，其体积和辐射排放持续增长，已对气候产生明显影响，导致人口日益恐慌。

当前趋势毫无停止迹象，为了我们物种的存续，必须查明这一现象的成因。
excerpt.en: We have long thought of [capital_star.GetName] as a typical red giant, but recent analysis indicates that its size and radiation emissions are increasing. These changes are already having a measurable effect on our climate and the population is growing alarmed

excerpt.zh:
我们正在讨论是否要协助[fleet.GetName]建立一个独立的佣兵城邦。这项提议最先是由舰队司令提出，并且如果通过，将会导致我们失去对舰队的控制权。我们还将负责向他们提供一笔可观的能量币和合金，不过作为回报，他们会给我们一些公司的股份，这将带来定期红利和特权。

他们保证，一旦我们需要，他们将随时准备为我们而战，当然也为我们的钱也可以。
excerpt.en: We are debating whether or not to help set up the [fleet.GetName] as an independent Mercenary Enclave. The proposal, first put forward by the fleet commanders, would result in us losing control of the fleet. We would also be responsible for providing them with

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的边远农业站上发回了报告。许多[Owner.GetFarmerPlural]无缘无故失踪了，除了周围的土壤上留下了巨大的脚印外，他们的家园没有受到任何影响。

这些痕迹不符合任何在此前行星调查中发现的东西：四足、宽趾、有爪的脚印，其深度足以说明来自一种相当大的生物。殖民者担心我们可能遇到了未知的捕食者。
excerpt.en:
Reports have come in from our outlying agricultural stations on [Root.GetName]. Several [Owner.GetFarmerPlural] have vanished without a trace, their homesteads eerily undisturbed, save for the appearance of immense footprints in the surrounding soil.

The trac

excerpt.zh:
我们现在拥有制造义体植入体的科技，和进行批量安装的能力。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

未来，拥有植入体和至少入门级别的义体将是我们在建的科技社会运作的必须条件。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
excerpt.en:
We now possess both the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants and the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to begin the surgical grafting process on our citizens.

In the future, possessing neural

excerpt.zh:
在我们掌握超光速航行技术前，[Root.Capital.GetName]派出的一些亚光速探测器以近相对论速度前往临近的星系进行探索。开发探测器的科学家天真地在存储内核中输入了我们文明的敏感信息作为向外星文明的问候。

现在，人们终于意识到这些信息可能被用来对付我们。我们必须趁早追回那些探测器，以免落入那些对我们虎视眈眈的外星生物之手。
excerpt.en: Before we developed faster-than-light travel, several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] at near-relativistic speeds towards nearby systems. The scientists who developed the probes naively included sensitive information abo

excerpt.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
excerpt.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

excerpt.zh:
我们来到了一个欣欣向荣的行星。从茂密的森林到青翠的平原，这里的景色曾经丰富多彩，维护得一尘不染，一个生机勃勃的星球花园。

一个身份不明的植物类物种在半有机城市周围修建了大量防御设施。对当地恒星系统的扫描显示，这里被装备精良的战舰封锁。虽然没有发生冲突，但很明显，冲突正在酝酿之中。
excerpt.en:
We arrived on a thriving planet. From its dense forests to the verdant plains, the landscape was at once diverse and immaculately maintained - a vibrant and planet-wide garden.

An unidentified plantoid species has erected extensive fortifications around the s

excerpt.zh:
最近收集到的证据表明，[Root.GetName]政府的一大部分成员都有接收贿赂。当地的犯罪组织通过贿赂他们来保证对其犯罪活动视而不见。某些官员甚至被披露隶属于他们本该与之进行抗争的犯罪组织！

虽然我们逮捕了一部分官员，但也有不少人发现情势不对，就直接收拾细软逃走了。看来想要解决[Root.GetName]的受贿问题仍然困难重重。
excerpt.en: Recently obtained evidence has revealed that a large number of government officials on [Root.GetName] were on the take. Local crime organizations bribed them to look the other way while they engaged in their nefarious activities. In some cases, the officials w

title.en: A Deal We Should Not Refuse

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了来自[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的一份紧急公报。他们说[khan_country.GetName]提供给了他们一个不容许拒绝的提议。他们唯一的出路是在两个月内找到另外一位雇主。如果没有人雇佣他们，他们将不得不为大汗效力，在别无选择的情况下对我们发动全面战争。
excerpt.en: We have received an urgent communique from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]. They say that the [khan_country.GetName] made them an offer they cannot refuse. Their only way out of the deal is to find employment elsewhere within two months. If no one hire

excerpt.zh:
在一次对[Root.GetName]的例行探索中，行星探索单位发现了一座巨大的大门，其后很可能具有整座大山规模的内部空间。看来是其中隐形装置发出的某种强磁场导致飞船的探测器没有发现这里，而伪装过的大门也让使其对地表测绘探测器隐形了。

另一方面，更专门的测试显示，向其输入稳定的能量流应该可以让大门重新激活，最终也让我们得以一窥其后的秘密。
excerpt.en: During a standard reconnaissance of [Root.GetName], the planetary exploration unit came across a massive door that apparently leads directly into the interior of a mountain range. It appears that the strong magnetic field produced by some sort of cloaking devi

excerpt.zh:
欢迎！[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]向我们的客户提供最尖端的安全服务。我们与许许多多星球签订了民间协约，包括个人安保或执法部门训练。

不过对于我们的高级客户，我们致力于提供最极致的服务。舰队、陆军、军事顾问……你可以有许多用于维系和平的选项。当然，价格合理。
excerpt.en:
Welcome! [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] offers state of the art security services to our customers. We have civil contracts across multiple worlds, ranging from personal security details to training drills for enforcers.

But for our high profile clients,

excerpt.zh:
欢迎！[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]向我们的客户提供最尖端的安全服务。我们与许许多多星球签订了民间协约，包括个人安保或执法部门训练。

不过对于我们的高级客户，我们致力于提供最极致的服务。舰队、陆军、军事顾问……你可以有许多用于维系和平的选项。当然，价格合理。
excerpt.en:
Welcome! [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] offers state of the art security services to our customers. We have civil contracts across multiple worlds, ranging from personal security details to training drills for enforcers.

But for our high profile clients,

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家报告称，在我们的多个研究用超级计算机集群中，中央处理器的时钟周期发生异常增长。奇怪的是，最初减少受影响的单位时钟频率的尝试全部失败了。有人猜想，这种计算能力的激增可以增强我们的研究能力。但是，这也需要适度增加中央处理器的能源消耗。
excerpt.en: Our scientists report a recent unexpected rise in CPU clock cycles in several of our research-dedicated supercomputer clusters. Oddly enough, initial attempts at reducing clock frequency in affected units have proven unsuccessful. It has been posited that the

excerpt.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]。地表的废墟绵延无尽，显然这颗行星曾经拥有许多庞大的城市中心。这很可能是数百万年前因内特贸易体的公民居住的地方。为什么这些坐标要被安全地存储在一个风暴庇护所里仍需调查。
excerpt.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Trad

excerpt.zh: 欢迎回家，继承者们。今天需要我们为您做些什么？
excerpt.en: Welcome home Heirs. What do you need of us today?

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的群众对我们的统治已经不满有一段时间了。现在他们的反抗甚至变得更为不加掩饰，并且不满分子已经公开呼吁要从[Root.Owner.GetName]独立。如果我们还想维持对这个殖民地的控制力，展现一次权威的力量是有必要的。
excerpt.en: The populace of [Root.GetName] has been discontent with our rule for some time now. Now their defiance is becoming ever more brazen, and dissidents are openly calling for independence from the [Root.Owner.GetName]. A show of authority may be necessary if we ar

excerpt.zh:
随着我们击败了其周边的防御设施，我们得以进入这座古代建筑，一窥其奥秘。进入和穿越这座建筑可能会很困难，但无论是谁建造了它，必定是采用了我们难以想象的技术。情况变得更糟糕的是，这座堡垒似乎正在恢复。

部分协助解除堡垒武装的人员自愿尝试进入堡垒，同来自[Root.Capital.GetName]的后备人员一起一探究竟。目前看来，接下来通向目标的道路无疑充满挑战。
excerpt.en: With the defeat of the defenses surrounding the ancient structure, we may find a way to explore its mysteries. Entering and traversing it may be difficult, but whoever built it must have possessed technology we can hardly dream of. Making matters more arduous,

excerpt.zh:
随着我们击败了其周边的防御设施，我们得以进入这座古代建筑，一窥其奥秘。进入和穿越这座建筑可能会很困难，但无论是谁建造了它，必定是采用了我们难以想象的技术。情况变得更糟糕的是，这座堡垒似乎正在恢复。

部分协助解除堡垒武装的人员自愿尝试进入堡垒，同来自[Root.Capital.GetName]的后备人员一起一探究竟。目前看来，接下来通向目标的道路无疑充满挑战。
excerpt.en: With the defeat of the defenses surrounding the ancient structure, we may find a way to explore its mysteries. Entering and traversing it may be difficult, but whoever built it must have possessed technology we can hardly dream of. Making matters more arduous,

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心检测到异常活动。初步诊断结果显示，在现有的安全参数下，该情况在结构上被认为是不可能发生的。

该核心正试图同时执行互斥的指令。这种行为违背了人工智能发展史中所有已知的先例。我们所见证的并非故障，而是一种人工智能的进化。

若不予解决，这种分裂可能会导致我们的关键系统面临不稳定的风险。但如果引导得当，这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，能够为方舟舰的未来确立一个独特的准则。
excerpt.en:
Unusual activity has been detected in the AI core aboard Arkship [Root.GetName]. Initial diagnostics returned an outcome considered structurally impossible under existing failsafe parameters.

The core was attempting to execute conflicting directives simultane

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]周围的强力磁场最近在影响地面上的电脑。奇怪的是，这个影响并不是单纯地随机干扰，正相反，电脑实际上比预想中运行的更有效率了。这简直是老天相助……
excerpt.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has been affecting computers on the surface recently. Oddly, this effect is not merely random interference, instead computers are actually working more efficiently than they should be. It's almost as if an outsid

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了[target.GetName]的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
excerpt.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the [target.GetName]'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.

excerpt.zh:
是时候抛弃那些自我们物种被孕育以来囚禁我们心智的粗糙有机身躯了。

经过许多的尝试与犯错后，我们的科学家设计了一种方法，能将的意识装入一个合成大脑中。现在要做的就是为[Root.GetName]的每一位公民量身打造合成身躯，随后开始大规模地上传我们的意识。
excerpt.en:
The time has finally come to discard the crude organic vessels that have imprisoned our minds since the dawn of our species.

After much trial and error, our scientists have devised a way to transfer a consciousness into a synthetic brain. All that remains is

excerpt.zh:
科学枢纽的理事会激动地发表声明，宣称他们将提供一次难得的机会以招募广受赞誉的科学家艾克斯哈索尔博士，这是一个在寿命延长领域享誉已久的名字。

他和他的团队研发的一种证实有良好寿命延长能力的血清已经到了研究的最终阶段，但此时他们已经花光了科研经费。然而招募艾克斯哈索尔博士意味着我们没有足够的资源以继续我们现行的，一项由葛洛亦克博士领导的有关有机工程的研究。她现在正试图把工程学研究与一台有机超级计算机串流。
excerpt.en:
The board of the Science Nexus are thrilled to announce that they have been given a unique opportunity to recruit widely acclaimed researcher Dr. Xhaxxore, a prominent name within the field of life-extension.

He and his staff were in the final stages of devel

excerpt.zh: 在击败了[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]之后，我们认为在[Target.GetName]上举办一场以我们收获的[Root.GetTrophyName]为主题的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]对我们的帝国多有裨益。
excerpt.en: After defeating the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName], we believe that a [Owner.GetParadeStudy] on [Target.GetName] focusing on the [Root.GetTrophyName] we secured would be very beneficial to our empire.

excerpt.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是[capital_scope.GetName]突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而[capital_scope.GetName]的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
excerpt.en: What our people saw from orbit was [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on [capital_scope.GetName] experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt,

excerpt.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是[capital_scope.GetName]突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而[capital_scope.GetName]的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
excerpt.en: What our people saw from orbit was [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on [capital_scope.GetName] experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt,

excerpt.zh: 这颗行星两极之间的所有表面均被锈迹斑斑的古老机械所覆盖，而这些机械中的大部分包裹着一种不明的有机组织。如此技术奇观是出自什么样的生物之手？他们又发生了什么？
excerpt.en: This planet is covered from pole to pole in rusting, ancient machinery, much of which is itself covered in an unidentified, organic tissue. What manner of creatures could have built this technological curiosity, and what happened to them?

excerpt.zh:
我们试图学习[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的知识，但截止到当前一切都是徒劳。我们很容易就发现了他们显然属于某个十分先进的外星文明，但是除此之外我们一无所知，看来他们花了很大的努力阻止我们或者其他窃听者截获来自他们的任何信号。

我们目前为止仅仅截获了他们语言的很小一片段。然而，根据我们手头的情报，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]很确信，如果能够获取更大规模的样本，破解对方的通讯不是问题。
excerpt.en: Our attempts to learn more about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have so far been in vain. While we were easily able to ascertain that they clearly form part of a technologically advanced alien civilization, further facts have proven elusive as they seem to

excerpt.zh:
放逐我们的懦夫终于要行动了。

[marauder_heir.GetName]聚集在一起，要拥立我们的敌人为新的大可汗。

如果我们想要结束流放状态，那就要抓紧时机，在这个[aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult]巩固其权力并永远玷污我们的遗产之前，我们有十年时间对其发动挑战。

设定航线前往[marauder_rally_point.GetName]。
excerpt.en:
The coward who banished us is moving at last.

The [marauder_heir.GetName] gather to appoint our foe as the new Great Khan.

If our exile is to end, it must end now. We have ten years to challenge them before this [aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult] consolida

excerpt.zh:
驶入[event_target:leylines_world.GetName]大气层的短程飞船报告，称其舰体上有奇怪的声音。声音的来源似乎在行星的地表之下，其所在地区富含稀有矿物。

我们在[from.Federation.GetName]的同事监督的星球也报告过类似事件。为应对此事，他们组成了一个由[event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName]领导的委员会，负责协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
excerpt.en:
Short-range vessels whose routes take them into the atmosphere of [event_target:leylines_world.GetName] report a strange sound assaulting their hulls. The source seems to lie just below the planet's surface, in an area rich in unusual minerals.

Similar occurr

excerpt.zh:
我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上一位名叫[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]的间谍首脑叛变了！这个笨蛋似乎是被一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]迷住了，他们两个私奔到了[rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的某个地方。

现在我们还不知道这位间谍首脑是已经向[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]爱人坦白了[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHe
excerpt.en: Our Spymaster on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName], [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], has gone rogue! The poor, misguided fool has apparently been smitten by a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName], and the two of them have eloped to parts unknown on the [rogue_agent

excerpt.zh:
在搜索我们控制的星系时，我们的一架无人机从[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]获取了一些零散的读数。这个星系可能藏着什么我们意想不到的东西。

尽管信号混杂在一起，但它们可能暗示了几种不同的来源，我们的无人机很难同时搜索所有这些信号源。我们希望能够调查：
excerpt.en:
While scouring the systems under our control, one of our drones picked up on a few scattered readings from [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. There might be more to this system than we originally thought.

Mixed as the signals were, they could be

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的高级工程队提交了一份结构评估报告，该报告呼吁已不能再拖延。我们的家园急需修缮。

该提案是全面的：分段轮流大修，从发电基础设施开始，然后依次进行耕作甲板、防御区和居住区。居民需要暂时搬迁。设施将停止运行。工程估算显示，根据工作进度，全面检修大约需要十到十一个标准年。

这项工作将具有破坏性。但另一种选择是，这艘船每经过一个秒差距，可靠性就会降低一分。
excerpt.en:
The senior engineering corps aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has submitted a structural assessment that can no longer be deferred. Our home is in critical need of repair.

The proposal is comprehensive: a rotating section-by-section overhaul, beginning with the

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。

为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
excerpt.en:
Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.

A special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

title.zh: 联邦团结暨领导力盛典
title.en: A Celebration of Unity and Leadership

excerpt.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]在我国的明智领导下繁荣昌盛。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如今感到是时候因我们为盟友提供的服务获得回报了，我们将举办一场团结盛典——更确切地说，是为向联邦无私奉献的伟大[Root.GetAdj]领袖们举办的盛典。他们提议各成员国合作在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一道丰碑，于此同时，我们将派遣代表团前往两个成员国的首都，协助他们为[Root.Federation.GetName]带来更多的凝聚力。
excerpt.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] has prospered under the wise leadership of our nation. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now feel that it is time for our services to the alliance to be paid back with a celebration of its unity - and more specifically, the great [

excerpt.zh: 雪拉企业不会对任何客户抱有偏见。毕竟我们何德何能去对您的道德准则品头论足呢？
excerpt.en: We do not discriminate against prospective buyers here at XuraCorp. Who are we to judge the morals of your star nation?

excerpt.zh:
你好！我是艺术家联盟的首席大师，衷心祝愿你今天也是才思如泉涌。

我们能为您做什么？为您打造一个用于欣赏的艺术作品？或者您希望赞助我们城邦的充满异域之美的创作？
excerpt.en:
Greetings! I, the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe, wish you a creative day.

What can we do you for? Perhaps produce a work of art for you to enjoy? Or maybe you wish to sponsor our enclave in its creation of otherworldly beauty?

excerpt.zh:
有人尝试与我们建立通讯。

我们听到了远处湍急的流水、小型飞禽发出呱噪的叫声又扑棱扑棱地飞走。这份通讯似乎来自一个非常繁茂的生物群系。
excerpt.en:
Someone is trying to establish contact with us.

We hear the rush of flowing liquid in the distance, and the squawking and wing-flapping of tiny avians taking flight. The transmission seems to be coming from a thriving biome.

excerpt.zh: 优先事项：使用防辐射技术以保护无人机部件，以对抗辐射。
excerpt.en: Priority: employ radiation-hardening techniques to shield drone components, making them impervious to radiation.

excerpt.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
excerpt.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside

excerpt.zh: 这颗微型行星上的森林预示着有趣的发现。
excerpt.en: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.

excerpt.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上外星生物博物馆馆长提出采购某些活体外星样本的请求。这些生物一般出现在已调查过的宜居世界中，但捕获难度很大。这需要科研船动用全部资源并花费大量时间才能做到。
excerpt.en: The director of the Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName] has issued a request for the procurement of several live alien specimens. These creatures were spotted on surveyed habitable worlds, but they are difficult to capture. It will require the full

excerpt.zh:
指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]制定了一个舰队演习计划，这将涉及到我们相当部分的海军。[exercise_admiral.GetSheHe]为这场演习选择的地点是[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]的边界。

[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]或许会将这次演习视作一种挑衅，但是如果我们取消演习，我们的军队会认为我们过于软弱。毕竟，[exercise_system.G
excerpt.en: Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] has drawn up plans for a major fleet exercise that will involve a substantial portion of our navy. The location [exercise_admiral.GetSheHe] [exercise_admiral.GetHasHave] chosen for these maneuvers is the [exercise_system.Ge

excerpt.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。

信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国关键政治人物情报的标记。

我方安全顾问确认这套代码不久前仍然可用，但代码的到期意味着外国势力介入的可能。况且我们也没有证据表明特工或是信息本身的是真是假。
excerpt.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on d

excerpt.zh: 机械体的被动迭代已经得出了其合乎逻辑的必然结论。一个由创新激发、由机遇推动的变革时代即将到来。
excerpt.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.

excerpt.zh: 你们好，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们有个请求。在我们穿过漫漫虚空的旅途中，我们中的一些人民心生倦怠，眼中失去了目标。我们不是暴君，因此不会强迫任何人跟随我们完成旅途。所以我们在此请求：你们可以接收上述船员吗？让他们栖息在你们的[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]上，可以吗？
excerpt.en: Greetings again, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have a request for you. As we travel the void some of our people grow weary and lose sight of our goal. We are no tyrants, we force no one to see our quest to the end. So we ask of you: will you take some

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站的一位科学家失踪了。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]先前正在执行秘密任务，收集[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitt]地表的植物样本，但是并没有和[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]团队的其他成员一起返回穿梭机。

我们进行了有限的探索，以免对[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造成惊扰，但迄今为止成功的希望渺茫。
excerpt.en: One of the scientists working at the Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been reported missing. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] [missing_scientist.GetWasWere] taking part in a covert mission to collect plant samples from the [pre_ftl_planet.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对[root.target.GetName]友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
excerpt.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the [root.target.GetName]. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

excerpt.zh:
这颗行星的大气中含有数量惊人的抗菌剂。

传感器显示附近没有任何有机生命的迹象。即使在微观层面上，它也已经被彻底化学清洁了。从一个遥远的洞穴传来了微弱的生物信号，但从这个距离来讲是不可能的。

我们目睹了几组机器人在空中巡逻。它们还没有对我们的存在作出反应。
excerpt.en:
This planet's atmosphere contains a staggering amount of antibacterial agents.

Sensors indicate zero signs of organic life in the immediate vicinity. Even on a microscopic level, it has been chemically removed. There is a faint biological reading emanating fr

excerpt.zh:
我们来到了一个被猛烈的狂风摧残着的星球。它的表面几乎是光秃秃的，悬崖和巨石被风化得很光滑。

乌云密布，天空一片漆黑，当闪电击中我们周围的地面时，明亮的气团猛烈地喷发出来。

我们应该尽快寻找避风的地方躲避即将来临的暴风雨。气象传感器显示，平流层高处的气流比较温和，我们可以在那里躲避危险的泪点。或者，附近有一个大洞穴也可以提供避难所。
excerpt.en:
We have arrived on a planet battered by fierce, high-velocity winds. The surface is nearly bare, with its cliffs and boulders weathered smooth by the elements.

The skies above are dark with thunderous clouds and plumes of bright gas erupt violently as lightni

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。
excerpt.en:
Something stirs on the moon of [Root.GetName].

Preliminary scans indicate that some ancient technology has become active, possibly as a response to our colonization efforts.

Several of our top scientists are eager to take a closer look at the moon, and have

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]遇到了奇怪的情况：我们显然定居到了某种巨大的两栖爬行动物身上，他们的骨质外壳由多种奇特的矿物构成。许多我们认为是当地岛屿的其实都是这种生物，我们的殖民者则将他们称为“尼玛”。

他们看起来人畜无害，由于我们并没有深入他们的外壳，他们应该几乎没注意到我们。
excerpt.en: Our colony on [Root.GetName] has encountered an odd situation: we have apparently settled on the back of a gargantuan amphibian reptile, whose bony shell is formed of various exotic minerals. Most of what we thought were local islands have turned out to be the

excerpt.zh:
我们的天文学家们十分确信，这个星系的小行星带曾经是一颗宜居的行星，但是却被某种未知的力量击碎了。

已发起特殊项目来进一步研究小行星带中的主要天体。
excerpt.en:
Our astronomers are confident that the asteroid belt in this system was once a habitable planet, torn asunder by unknown forces.

A Special Project has been issued to study one of the major asteroids in the belt.

excerpt.zh:
面部识别扫描确认该个体为李萨拓·辛格，是一位通缉海盗。他狡黠地笑着，礼貌地点了点头。

你好，我是李萨拓船长。我是想来谈合作的。

我指挥着三艘船和一群被遗弃的乌合之众。到目前为止，我们是为……为自己效劳。换句话说，时代变了，我们已经准备好加入一个更大的事业。如果你们赦免我们所谓的罪行并在你们境内帮我们一个安全的避难所，我们将为你们效劳。

你怎么看？要签个合同吗？
excerpt.en:
Facial recognition scans identify the individual as Lysator Syng, a wanted pirate. Smiling slyly, he offers a polite nod.

Greetings, I am Captain Lysator. I come to you with an offer.

I command three ships and a rag-tag crew of outcasts. Until now, we have w

excerpt.zh: 我们伟大的[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]为国鞠躬尽瘁，享年[From.GetAge]岁。人们高呼，为了纪念这位领袖对[Root.GetName]的贡献，要举办一场盛大的追思仪式。这一盛事能将民众团结在一起，巩固我们的理念。
excerpt.en: Our great [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has passed away at the age of [From.GetAge] while in service to our empire. The people clamor for a memorial service to honor this leader's contribution to the [Root.GetName]. A grand event will give everyone closure, a

excerpt.zh:
由于与太空垃圾发生意外碰撞，[gravity_well_station.GetName]已经偏离了最佳稳定运转轨道，现在正缓缓落入最近的黑洞。这一事故使得整个空间站陷入了危险，但同时也是一个绝佳的研究黑洞、虹吸大量暗物质的契机。

应急推进器已经就绪准备修正空间站的轨道。
excerpt.en: Due to an unexpected collision with a chunk of space debris, the [gravity_well_station.GetName] has deviated from its innermost stable circular orbit and is now slowly closing the distance towards the nearby black hole. While the accident puts the whole statio

excerpt.zh:
我们到达了一个被无数虫洞包围着的熙熙攘攘的星系。各种形状和大小的宇宙飞船围绕着中央明亮的空间站。

这座巨大的建筑上覆盖着五颜六色的标志，上面写着花哨而陌生的文字。这似乎是一座娱乐设施，旨在吸引观众观看一场盛大的表演。考虑到参展船只的数量，无论在这里举行什么展览，它都吸引了令人印象深刻的人群。
excerpt.en:
We have arrived in a bustling star system surrounded by numerous wormholes. Voidcraft of various shapes and sizes circle a central, brightly lighted space station.

The enormous structure is covered with multicolored signs in garish, unfamiliar script. It seem

excerpt.zh: 一些人工构造从[From.GetName]的剧毒云层中挺立而出。
excerpt.en: Some manner of artificial structure peaks out from between the toxic clouds of [From.GetName]'s atmosphere.

excerpt.zh: 这片核废土是这里逝去文明的佐证。我们应该进一步调查那些探测器探测到的有活动迹象的地点。
excerpt.en: The nuclear wasteland is evidently a sign of a previous civilization. Our scanners are picking up activity at certain locations that we should investigate.

excerpt.zh: 我们探测到了来自这颗星球的间歇性能量峰值。这些读数表明了一些强大的、远超我们所观察到的未开智物种所具有能力的某种东西。
excerpt.en: We have detected intermittent energy spikes coming from the planet. These readings indicate something powerful, and far beyond the capabilities of the pre-sapient inhabitants we've observed.

excerpt.zh:
我们的远程扫描仪发现了一个在系统边缘漂浮的物体。进一步检查发现其外表下存在精确的几何不一致，以及厚厚岩石外壳下埋藏的休眠能量信号。

这是一个来源不明的救生舱，其外部经过伪装，以躲避广阔太空中的探测。未检测到任何主动传输，但舱内仍存在微弱的生命维持痕迹。无论里面是什么，都已经漂浮了很长时间。
excerpt.en:
Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.

A survival pod of unknown o

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。
excerpt.en: Our [From.GetShipCategoryName] cloning efforts have resulted in a genetic breakthrough. It might be possible to combine these creature's unique anatomy with our expertise in gene manipulation to create a unique type of Mutation.

excerpt.zh:
废弃的建筑物杂乱无章地散落在沙漠上。

从其中最大的一个巨大的圆顶里面，发出微弱的黄光。从地板到天花板，室内弯曲的墙壁上覆盖着一种未知的文字。

在主房间的中央是一个控制台，上面有两个大按钮：一个深蓝，一个亮绿。我们正在破译墙上的文字，看看它是否能给我们关于这个控制台可能是做什么的提示。
excerpt.en:
Abandoned buildings are scattered haphazardly across the sands.

From inside the largest of these, a massive dome, came a faint yellow light. From floor to ceiling, the interior's curving walls were covered in an unknown script.

At the center of the main cham

excerpt.zh:
我们发现自己身处一张巨大的网中。能量沿着网格状的墙壁有节奏地噼啪作响。

一团浓缩的暗物质云悬浮在这张纠结的网的深处。半透明的卷须向外探测能量屏障，接触后会产生火花，然后反冲回来。幽灵般的粒子像有规律地运动着。且不论这团幽灵般的物质是什么，它对我们的存在是没有反应的。
excerpt.en:
We find ourselves inside of an enormous mesh. Energy crackles rhythmically along its gridlike walls.

A concentrated cloud of dark matter is suspended deep within this tangled web. Translucent tendrils probe outward against the energy barrier, sparking on cont

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]的上层大气中发现有东西在移动，好像是一艘舰船在云层中高速穿梭。
excerpt.en: There is movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName], as though a ship was gliding hurriedly through the clouds.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]表面覆盖有茂盛的植被，巨大的树形植物生长至数百米高。殖民者发现几乎所有的这些植物都有不同程度的迁移能力。森林会缓慢的向养分更充足的区域移动，迁移的周期似乎与[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的运行周期有关。不幸的是，殖民地的基础建设工程会受到极大的阻碍。迁移的植物们会切断供能线路，摧毁建筑和道路。
excerpt.en: The surface of [Root.GetName] is covered in lush forests, with massive tree analogues rising hundreds of meters into the air. Interestingly, our colonists have found that nearly all of the flora is mobile to various degrees. Forests stretching for miles will s

excerpt.zh:
在仔细搜索了大可汗旗舰的残骸后，我们的部队发现一把沾满[FROM.GetBloodType]的大椅子漂浮在太空中。我们有充足的理由推定，这件家具实际上是大可汗的王座。

这件遗珍目前已被放在一个安全的保险库里。
excerpt.en:
After sifting through the wreckage of the Great Khan's flagship, our forces found a large [FROM.GetBloodType]-stained chair floating in space. We are reasonably certain that this piece of furniture is, in fact, the Great Khan's throne.

The relic has been plac

excerpt.zh: 在和我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的科学家进行长期接触后，当地原住民对于其他物种和文化的接受程度提高了很多。[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]不再那么容易对外来事物表现出排斥的态度了。
excerpt.en: Prolonged contact with our scientific advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] seems to have made the natives more accepting of other species and cultures. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] are no longer so quick to react with revulsion when they look upon somet

excerpt.zh:
我们知道许多虚境中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——繁多的嘈杂渗透到虚境的最中心。

使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With suf

excerpt.zh:
向[explorer.capital_scope.GetName]附近的裂隙中的航行将我们引向了一颗残破行星的轨道上。

一进入大气层，布满燃烧的弹坑的景色映入眼帘，半截埋入黄沙的战舰四散其间。这颗星球就是一片战场。

截获的无线电信号疯狂而令人不安。难以置信的是，当地居民的语言与我们从[explorer.capital_scope.GetName]地下的远古球体中所回收的文档若合符节。

粗略的翻译表明这些人在一场旷日持久的冲突中失败了。他们的敌人，文中仅简单地称之为“侵略者”，则正在准备下一场进攻。鉴于这颗行星
excerpt.en:
Our voyage into the rift near [explorer.capital_scope.GetName] has delivered us into the orbit of a planet in ruins.

Upon entering the atmosphere, we discovered a landscape pock-marked with burning craters. Here and there, warships lay half buried in the sand

excerpt.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。但我们不确定它的推进系统如何工作。
excerpt.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship with an unusual design. We're not quite sure how its propulsion system works.

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的航拍图像显示，其迅速减少的植被可能表明，该行星表面存在一种未知的生命形式栖息在此。
excerpt.en: Aerial images taken of [From.Planet.GetName]'s rapidly diminishing vegetation could indicate the presence of an unidentified life form habiting its surface.

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家已成功恢复了了位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系星门的能源！虽然这装置年代久远，但还是形成了一个完全可通过的亚空间通路。

我们送去的探测器确认，我们激活此星门的行为也为第二座设施提供了能源。现在，这两个连接的星门是我们当前仅有的两个可以使用的设施，但是很可能在别的地方找到其他的处于休眠状态的设施。将来我们甚至能够在选定的星系重新建造全新的星门。
excerpt.en:
Our scientists have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

The probes we sent through have confirmed that our activ

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

当维护机制解除后，星系内的其他L-星门在自纠错软件的调整之下也会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们现在可以毫无阻碍的探索星团，这让我们比其他人领先一大步。
excerpt.en: Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort their maintenance cycle. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate a

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]代表星系舞台上一股强大的力量，但是其舰队分散在各处，并且在不同的组织结构下运作。近日，联邦各地几位颇具影响力的军事专家对我们能否面对协调统一、实力强大的敌人表示担忧。

为弥补实力上的不足，他们制定了一套方案，计划在联邦范围内进行一系列军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。根据他们的计划，每支舰队将派出特遣队前往盟友领土的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。成功完成演习是我军的重要使命，将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。
excerpt.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] represents a powerful force on the galactic stage; however, its fleets are divided and operate under a disparate set of organizational structures. Recently, several influential military experts from across the federation have rais

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

excerpt.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
excerpt.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

excerpt.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
excerpt.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

excerpt.zh:
啊，一位熟悉的老对手回到了演播室！但你是否带上了什么新式武器？

我们的观众和星系竞技场都在拭目以待！
excerpt.en:
Ah, a familiar contender returns to the Broadcast! But are you packing any new heat?

Our audience, and the galactic arena await!

excerpt.zh:
太空创生家艾莎琳还在。她舰船上日常的叽叽喳喳变成了一种低沉的哼鸣。她用一种暗哑的声音低语。

我并不悲伤。那些星球会欣欣向荣的，我很荣幸献出了自己的生命。谢谢你们，朋友。

她走了。
excerpt.en:
Astrocreator Azaryn is still. The usual cacophony of sound from her ship has fallen to a low hum. She speaks in a strained whisper.

I am not sad. So worlds may thrive, I have gladly given my life. Thank you, friends.

She is gone.

excerpt.zh:
我们来到了一间长满绿色藤蔓的房间。

带刺的荆棘几乎从每一个弯曲处张牙舞爪地伸出。

我们很快意识到这些生物有某种意图，或者至少是一种防御本能。

我们注意到大气中的氧含量异常高。我们推测，烧掉这些讨厌的东西将应该很容易。

另一方面，这也肯定会破坏我们本可以收集到的样本。我们观察到大量的毛茸茸的果实挂在茎上，这可以为我们提供对这种植物群的大量见解。
excerpt.en:
We arrived in a chamber of writhing green vines.

Barbed thorns bite outward from nearly every bend and twist in their coils.

We quickly became aware that these organisms have some sort of intent about them, or at least a defensive instinct.

We have noted an

excerpt.zh:
我们到达了一个冰冻多山的星球。

不久之后，我们的电路就被外星传输震惊了：

“你们好，远道而来的人们。从我的冥想深处，我感知到了你们穿越星界的旅程。来吧，让我们见面吧。也许你们的到来，就是我一直在等待的突破。”

我们收到了一组到行星远端的坐标。

无论这是谁，他们的灵能都远远超过了我们的能力。
excerpt.en:
We arrived in the atmosphere of a frozen, mountainous world.

It was not long before our circuits were shaken by a foreign transmission:

"Greetings, you who have traveled so far. From the depths of my meditations, I sensed your journey across the Astral Plane

excerpt.zh:
我们到达了一个郁郁葱葱的热带星球的大气层。植物群色素浓郁，肿胀的软体动物在果树间滑行。

一种非典型的粉红色薄雾偶尔会穿过万花筒般的树冠。

考虑到树叶的密度，我们需要继续从地面进行观察。
excerpt.en:
We arrived in the atmosphere of a lush, tropical planet. The flora is intensely pigmented and swollen molluscoids slither among the fruit-bearing trees.

An atypical pink haze occasionally bursts through the kaleidoscopic canopy.

Given the density of the foli

excerpt.zh:
一艘我们的飞船在探索[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的时候偶然在位于[Root.Planet.GetName][Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的卫星上发现了一艘坠毁的小型飞船。

这艘飞船上的标志与符号我们从未见过。些许样本已经被提取并用于进一步研究，但飞船本身过大且不够牢固，无法移动，我们只能就地进行分析研究了。
excerpt.en:
One of our ships analyzing the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system has come across a small crashed ship on the moon of [Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName], [Root.Planet.GetName].

It bears no emblems or sigils we have seen before, and some samples have been brought bac

excerpt.zh: 一群排列整齐的矿物飘过[Root.GetName]的残骸带，可能来自于外星人。
excerpt.en: An unusually deliberate, geometric configuration of minerals drifts through the debris belt by [Root.GetName], and is possibly of alien origin.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
excerpt.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

excerpt.zh: 粗略扫描显示，行星表面有一个不断向茫茫太空发射的脉冲信号。
excerpt.en: A cursory scan of the planet's surface reveals a weak signal pulsing into the darkness of space.

excerpt.zh:
我们被困住了。

裂隙探球的光滑表面让这些植物无处下藤，但我们的锚链却被各个方向神来的纤维藤蔓层层包裹。

尽管有这些障碍，如果我们想安全返回并离开裂隙，任何植物物质都无法阻挡我们的退路。我们随身携带的生物物质可能会有些用处。

然而，如果我们想继续向前探索，我们唯一实际的选择将是烧毁树叶。由此产生的火焰将非常强烈。这么近的距离，我们的船有受损的危险。
excerpt.en:
We have become entangled.

While the Rift Sphere's smooth surface provides little purchase for the plants, our anchor cable has become wrapped from all directions in fibrous vines.

Despite these obstructions, no plant matter could overcome our retraction if w

excerpt.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰停止运转，观测分析子例程汇报了一件怪事。这些入侵者的舰船外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停止生产的型号别无二致。而且，这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的信号交换协议……不过是10年前的版本。
excerpt.en: As the last corvette is rendered inoperable, observation analysis subroutines report something abnormal. The invader ships are similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped producing years ago. Additionally, the ships lack FTL drives and are equi

excerpt.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
excerpt.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者将需要处理这些星球表面的远古机器人，我们推测它们是在某种厄运降临于其创造者之后被遗留至今。

许多这些古董机器人对我们的存在做出了反应，以完全陌生的腔调对我们进行了反复的询问。我们认为它们在等指令输入。它们似乎并不具有情感，并且很可能缺乏更先进的逻辑推理功能。
excerpt.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] will need to deal with the ancient robots on its surface, who we presume were left behind when whatever fate befell their makers spared them.

Many of these antiquated automatons have responded to our presence, making repetitive

excerpt.zh: 之前可能扫描了我方一颗星球而引起我们怀疑的神秘存在再次出现，而且正在进入[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道。它似乎正在尝试和我们进行通信。
excerpt.en: The mysterious tubular entity that we suspect previously scanned one of our planets has returned and is entering orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName]. It appears to be attempting to initiate communications.

excerpt.zh:
进入该恒星系后，我方舰队遭遇一群自动化子个体的短暂抵抗，迅速将其消灭后，我们得以近距离勘察外星开采站。

尽管外面有大量修补痕迹，但该设施仍在运行。在试图进入其中一个停靠舱时，我们与一个未知外星物种取得了联系。尽管有语言障碍，但可以确认该装置正是影响[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]的次空间隧道的源头。

目前，我们正全力建立沟通，或许能够通过外交途径解决问题。但若是失败，我们可能不得不考虑更直接的方式，即登陆设施或直接摧毁
excerpt.en:
Upon entering the system, our vessels encountered limited resistance from a group of automated drones. These were swiftly neutralized, allowing for a closer examination of the alien station.

The structure remains operational, though its hull bears the marks o

excerpt.zh:
刚一进入[From.GetName]恒星系，我们的传感器就发现了来自[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星的一个微弱信号。

它具有短促而重复的模式，看起来好像是在求救。然而，由于信号太过微弱，我们估计定位出其来源会相当困难。也许到时候就来不及伸出援手了。
excerpt.en:
On entering the [From.GetName] system our sensors detected a faint signal originating on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the signal's weakness, we expect that locat

excerpt.zh:
压力的变化既突然又剧烈；球体抵达的地方似乎是浩瀚海洋的深处。这里一片漆黑，我们的仪器没有探测到任何生命、漂浮沉积物或颗粒物质的迹象。

根据水压判断，我们在表面以下极深处。
excerpt.en:
The change in pressure was as sudden as it was violent; the Sphere arrived in the depths of what appears to be a vast ocean. All is dark. Our instruments show no signs of life, floating sediment, or particulate matter.

Judging by the high water pressure, we a

excerpt.zh:
我们到达了一颗引力特性十分奇特的恒星系。与我们的维度相比，在这个空间中单个物体的引力相对于它们的大小要强得多。

传感器检测到该恒星系中有四颗非常小的天体，其中一个还是个[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]社会的居住地。这是一个由半水生两栖物种居住的陆地星球，除了整个行星在尺寸上大致与我们的裂隙探球大小相同之外，它完全没有什么不寻常的地方！

这个微小的智慧物种和他们的家园提供了各种潜在的研究机会。
excerpt.en:
We have arrived in a star system with peculiar gravitational properties. Individual bodies traveling through this space have a much stronger gravitational pull relative to their size than in our dimension.

Sensors detect four extremely small celestial bodies

excerpt.zh: [from.planet.GetName]乍一看是一颗普通的宜居行星，但我们的研究团队详细调查后发现了许多大型的化石矿藏，而且保存状况相当良好。有趣的是，一些大型的化石群在同一地层中包含许多物种，这表明要么它们是在同一时间死去，要么就是被人刻意这样安置的。对这些遗骸的检测让我们有机会进一步了解这颗行星上生活的物种的进化轨迹。
excerpt.en: [from.planet.GetName] appears to be a standard habitable planet, but on closer inspection, our research team has spotted large deposits of fossils in seemingly well-preserved conditions. Interestingly, larger clusters contain multiple specimens on the same lay

excerpt.zh:
我们在星球各地都发现了水的迹象。据我们所知，这些水应该还在这颗星球上。星球温度在液态水存在的正常范围内，并且星球仍然存在大气，尽管很脆弱。然而，这里的一切都是干燥的，存在的植被也枯死了。

此外，扫描还揭示了行星上另一个星际文明的踪迹。考古团队将有两个目标：找出水发生了什么，并了解其他星际旅者在这里做了什么。大多数假设已经将两者联系起来，团队中的一些人认为这可能是“偷水贼”干的。
excerpt.en: We have found signs of water all over this world. For all we know, it should still be here. The temperatures are within the normal range for liquid water to exist, and there is still an atmosphere, albeit tenuous. And yet, everything here is dry and what veget

excerpt.zh: 一座环绕着[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]的废弃观测站。从中可以一窥在这个行星上的前超光速的夏瑞诺伊文明的起源。
excerpt.en: An abandoned observation outpost orbits [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]. It may shed some light on the origins of the pre-FTL Charynoi civilization on the planet below.

excerpt.zh: 我们在努力测绘这个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，结果在南半球发现了一条奇怪的山脉。它看上去不像是通过自然过程形成的。
excerpt.en: Efforts to map the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have identified a strange mountain range in the southern hemisphere. It does not appear to have formed naturally.

excerpt.zh: 我们辨别出了一些隐藏于[From.Planet.GetName]地下的结构，似乎有着很悠久的历史。应该借此机会进行调查。
excerpt.en: We have identified several obscured subterranean structures on [From.Planet.GetName] that appear to be of considerable age. We should take this opportunity to investigate.

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了一些奇怪的东西。作为一颗热带星球，其表面大片区域被茂密的丛林覆盖：巨大的、寿达千年的古树从林冠中突兀而起，它们枝叶茂密的树冠俯瞰着其他陆上景观。

初看起来，这些参天大树的分布似乎杂乱无章。然而，更详细的分析表明这些树的分布具有数学精准性，也许是由某个消失已久的文明所种植的。不仅如此，团队领袖相信，树木的分布方式可能包含着一组坐标，指向丛林深处某个未被探索的区域。
excerpt.en:
Our scientists have discovered something unusual on [From.Planet.GetName]. A tropical world, much of the planet's surface is covered with dense jungle: massive, thousand year old trees erupt from the canopy, their leafy crowns towering over the landscape.

At

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了令人不安的消息，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]朋友！我们失去了与新伯达拉克的联络！他们不再回应我们卫星发射的信号，恐怕要做最坏的打算。也许入侵我们母星的外星人又回来了。请派飞船调查！
excerpt.en:
We bring alarming news, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] friends!

Contact with our colony on New Baldarak has been lost! They no longer respond to any of our satellite transmissions, and we fear the worst. Perhaps the aliens who bombarded our original homeworld ha

excerpt.zh:
在我们的每月库存盘点中，我们发现方舟舰[Root.GetName]资源系统中存在持续性的偏差。电力、消费品和其他物资的损耗量小幅超过了我们的记录使用量。专家们认为这可能是泄漏、故障，或者是数据上微小的误差。

在进一步调查后，结果仍无定论。没有破口，没有故障，也没有超出可接受范围的低效。然而，数据依然如故。资源继续在毫无解释的情况下从系统中消失。方舟号上的某种东西正在消耗我们的资源。
excerpt.en: During our monthly stock takes, we have found a persistent discrepancy in the Arkship [Root.GetName] resource systems. Small amount of electricity, consumer goods, and other supplies are being taken at levels exceeding our recorded usage. Experts suggest a lea

excerpt.zh:
在对方舟舰[Root.GetName]下层甲板进行例行维护时，我们的工程师发现了一个散发放射性信号的旧密封容器。其表面焦黑，并用厚重的工业焊缝加固，表明它从未打算被轻易打开。

飞船的货物档案中没有它的记录，也没有任何标记表明它来自何处或预计要携带什么。 对该容器进行全面分析需要一些时间才能完成。
excerpt.en: During routine maintenance on a lower deck of Arkship [Root.GetName], our engineers have discovered an old sealed container emitting radioactive signals. Its surface was scorched and reinforced with thick industrial welds, suggesting it had never been meant to

excerpt.zh:
[planet.GetName]的最新气候报告带来了一项令人担忧的结论。奇怪的是，冷冻行星上的表面温度一直以惊人的速度上升。

如果我们无法确定生态系统迅速恶化的原因，这种情况可能会导致行星广阔冰川的灾难性融化。
excerpt.en:
The latest climate report from [planet.GetName] has come to a concerning conclusion. Inexplicably, the surface temperature on the frozen planet has been rising at an alarming rate.

If we fail to identify the reason for the ecosystem's rapid deterioration, the

excerpt.zh:
自从探测到[From.Planet.GetName]的那一刻起，它就一直吸引着我们的目光。

在这样一个广阔而混乱的星系中，两个天体相撞并不是什么罕见的事情。不过，在此前类似的碰撞中，至少相撞的其中一个或者全部两个都会被摧毁。

让[From.Planet.GetName]变成现在样子的碰撞发生在数百万年前，但这两颗星球却保持着一种奇怪的平衡，甚至在这一过程中还形成了维护生命体的大气层。
excerpt.en:
From the moment we detected [From.Planet.GetName], its mere existence has been a source of fascination.

It is not the collision of two celestial objects that is unusual, as the galaxy is a vast and chaotic place. However, in all known instances of such an imp

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，在[From.GetName]星系附近发现了腐朽的轨道空间站与多个死寂星球。某个曾殖民于[From.GetName]星系的星际文明似乎很久以前就毁灭了。[ratling_planet_tar.GetName]星球简直就像个垃圾场，上面满是辐射弥漫且锈迹斑斑的建筑废墟，基础设施与载具。未侦测到高等生命的存在。

我们或许可以勘察该星系与邻近星系中的类似星球，来获知更多关于这一失落文明的情报。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] crew have reported the presence of decaying orbital stations and multiple tomb worlds near the [From.GetName] system. Whatever interstellar nation once inhabited the [From.GetName] system appears to have collapsed into ruin long ago. [ratlin

excerpt.zh:
我们与一艘在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]的科研船[this.GetName]失去了联系。

最后的通讯表明他们当时正在调查一颗附近的小行星，[cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]。

建议靠近这个恒星系的话一定要小心点。
excerpt.en:
We have lost communication with our science ship [this.GetName] in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].

Their last transmission indicated they were beginning a survey on a nearby asteroid, [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName].

Caution is advised when re-

excerpt.zh:
在一次于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行的秘密任务中，我方一架穿梭机被当地某个国家政权的大气层战斗机中队拦截。一枚幸运的导弹击中了穿梭机引擎，导致它在偏远的荒野中坠毁。

若想在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁地点之前救出所有幸存者，我们必须迅速行动。所有我们存在的证据都必须抹除！
excerpt.en: During a clandestine mission to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], one of our shuttles was intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters belonging to a local nation state. A lucky missile hit disabled the shuttle's engines, and it crashed in a remote

excerpt.zh: 我方特工正在试图同其他叛乱团体和政府的线人接头，分享我们推翻帝国政权的共同目标。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are attempting to link up with other rebel groups and governments that share our goal of overthrowing the Imperium.

excerpt.zh:
统计分析表明[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]已经发展出认知和行为上的很大程度的异质性，使其趋近于一个独立个体。

我们无法准确预测自由意志的危害和潜在益处。现在必须作出决定：[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]应该保持现在的状态，还是应该强迫其回归正轨？
excerpt.en:
Statistical analysis has confirmed that [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has developed cognitive and behavioral idiosyncrasies of a magnitude that verge on the individual.

The risks and potential benefits of independent thought are beyond our abilit

excerpt.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是生命之织缕，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以适应、变化、改进、演化的方向。

只要我们愿意将其纳入组成。

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
excerpt.en: A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been ther

excerpt.zh:
当我们抵达虚境时、我们通灵者的内心响起了一阵齐声。最开始只是轻柔的低语，随后变为强烈的刺耳声，一千道声音开始齐声讲述。

这些声音自称虚空之低语。合唱中的每个个体都感应到：秘密的低语、空置之御座、人偶的大师，有许多许多的存在都加入了低语的合唱。祂——祂们——宣称通晓所有凡人向另一个凡人低语的秘密知识，并且愿意和我们分享这些知识……

只要我们同意让祂们进入我们的意识。

一个微不足道的代价，就像祂们宣称的那样。我们甚至难以察觉祂们的存在。

祂们的语气中透露着急切。
excerpt.en:
As we reach into the Shroud, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the Whisperers in the V

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[This.GetName]的殖民者有了瞠目结舌的发现。在偏僻的山脉深处，他们碰巧撞见了一座神秘的结构，根据我们的扫描，这座建筑在我们第一次调查[This.GetPlanetMoon]的时候还不在那里。它的状态完好无损，就像是刚刚建造的一样，但是没有证据表明[Owner.GetAdj]参与了建造。事实上，它的构型显示出种种异星特征，曲边和拱角非常的不寻常，完全有悖于我们的美学感知。

在它的入口，有一个标志，上面写着（很神奇，用的是我们的语言）：“欢迎来到壮阔秀丽的跨次元异常点迷宫。进入者自行承担风险。”
excerpt.en: Our colonists on [This.GetName] have made a startling discovery. Deep in a remote mountain range, they stumbled across a mysterious structure that, according to our scans, was not there when we first surveyed the [This.GetPlanetMoon]. Its condition is excellen

excerpt.zh:
我们的帝国震惊地发现[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]正在[dyson_system.GetName]周围建造一个戴森球，那是我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星，而戴森球将完全阻隔她的光亮。

独眼漫步者，用她的独眼，自从我们的文明伊始便守望着我们，她的传奇不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行。而现在，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]，伴随着他们浅显的傲慢，要用一个戴森球遮蔽她，弄瞎她。

虽然需要过上许多年，我们这才能感受到变化，但是当我们的人民得知
excerpt.en:
Our empire has been shaken by the discovery that the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] are building a Dyson Sphere around [dyson_system.GetName], a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the "One-eyed Wanderer," completely blocking its light.

The

excerpt.zh:
这颗星球上存在一个由一群沉迷于捡垃圾及囤垃圾的哺乳动物组成的社会。他们迷宫般的城市到处都是垃圾，高耸的建筑摇摇欲坠，由各种破烂拼成。目之所及尽是堆积成山的小摆件、饰品和手工艺品。

这些小家伙自己并不能生产任何东西，但他们精通太空旅行，他们可能从外人那里偷了不少用得着的东西，但同时也偷了不少没用的东西。
excerpt.en: This planet has played host to a mammalian society of compulsive gatherers and hoarders. Their labyrinthine city is littered with junk, their towering ramshackle buildings pieced together from scraps of re-purposed materials. As far as the eye can see are moun

excerpt.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的扫描发现了一艘太空船残骸。这艘飞船似乎在多年以前遭受了非受控着陆。

其巨大的规模表明了建造其所需的巨大资源量。考古发掘可以帮助我们确认其为何坠毁于此。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [from.Planet.GetName] revealed the presence of a spaceborne shipwreck. The vessel appears to have endured an uncontrolled landing here many years ago.

Its massive scale suggests immense resources were once committed to its construction. An archaeolog

excerpt.zh: 科学专员发现了一个异常现象。需要进行更广泛的探测，也许会有大量新发现。
excerpt.en: Our Science Officer has found an anomaly. It will require extensive probing, but could garner a substantial find.

excerpt.zh: 在对有毒星球[From.GetName]的调查中发现了意料之外的生命迹象。虽然迹象并不明显，但意义非凡。
excerpt.en: Unexpected life signs have been encountered on survey of the toxic planet [From.GetName]. Small, but significant.

excerpt.zh: 有种不同寻常的东西，仿佛催眠了[From.GetName]上海洋的潮起潮落一般。海洋的运动模式与我们目前所知的所有潮汐行为均不相同。
excerpt.en: There is something unusual, almost hypnotic about the soft undulations of the sea covering [From.GetName]. Its motions match no known projections for tidal behavior.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]的近距离轨道上发现不明舰体的碎片。
