excerpt.en: There are fragments of an unknown vessel in close orbit of [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 从[From.GetName]的底下洞穴中发出的意料之外的辐射。这会不会是什么东西发出的信号？
excerpt.en: Unexpected emissions are coming from the underground caves on [From.GetName]. Could these be a signal of some sort?

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]有显著的水体，同时其大陆部分是了无生机的荒漠。已授权进一步研究。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] has significant bodies of water, and yet its landmasses are lifeless deserts. Further study is warranted.

excerpt.zh: 我们接收到这颗气态巨行星的大气内发射出来的微弱信号。可能是什么人，或者是什么东西正在试图建立联系？
excerpt.en: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?

excerpt.zh: 被称为[LastKilledCountryName]的帝国在敌人的进攻之下已经灭亡。这会怎样影响星系的政治环境还有待观察。
excerpt.en: The star nation formerly known as the [LastKilledCountryName] has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.

excerpt.zh: 最近的调查显示，[From.GetName]被包围在了一个拥有难以置信的强度并反射所有探测手段的护盾之中。这个星球护盾似乎是从这颗星球附近的卫星中产生的。
excerpt.en: As confirmed by its recent survey, [From.GetName] is surrounded by an incredibly strong energy field that deflects all attempts to scan it. The field appears to be generated from the planet's nearby moon.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]散发出一道围绕着他所运行的行星的无法穿透的能量屏障。这道能量屏障的来源很难确定，但它似乎是来自于卫星贫瘠表面下深处的某个地方。

在卫星上最大的一个陨石坑里，可以发现一些古代遗址，可能是出于某种军事用途的大型基地。那里可能会存在着一些关于能量屏障的答案。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] is emitting an impenetrable energy barrier that surrounds the planet it orbits. The exact source of the barrier is difficult to pinpoint, but it appears to be coming from somewhere deep beneath the moon's barren surface.

Ancient ruins of what m

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰[Root.GetName]的报告指出，船员行为出现了一些轻微异常。个人日志显示出零星的古怪之处：对个人仪容的异常关注，为接近特定同事而定期调班，以及在公共区域下班后聚会次数的增加。这些似乎都没有干扰到舰船的运作，而且船员士气异常高涨。
excerpt.en: Reports from Arkship [Root.GetName] have flagged several minor irregularities in crew behavior. Personal logs reveal scattered oddities: unusual attention to grooming, regular shift swaps to be around specific coworkers, and an uptick in off-duty gatherings in

excerpt.zh: 自然选择和基因漂变再也不能阻止我们主宰生物学规律。作为一个文明，我们正在重塑物种未来的门槛前。[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]如同黏土，而我们将会是自己的雕刻家。
excerpt.en: Natural selection and genetic drift no longer stand between us and biological dominance. As a civilization, we are on the verge of redefining the future of our species. Our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] is clay, and we are its sculptor.

excerpt.zh: 你好。我是一个收藏家，在这向你提供一个千载难逢的机会。我有一个盒子要出售，盒子当中有什么我不会泄露，我也不会给你看。你可以用3000£energy£能量币来买，然后不管里面有什么都归你了，但是一旦出手概不退换。
excerpt.en: Greetings. I am The Collector and I offer you an opportunity. I have a box for sale, a box obtained through means I will not divulge and with a content I shall not reveal. You may purchase this box for £energy£ 3000 and keep whatever it contains, but I offer n

excerpt.zh: 来自[Planet.GetName]殖民地的报告显示:星球上的“返祖现象”正不断增加。显然相当一部分人口已经表现出迄今为止前所未有的性欲与攻击性，而没人知道这是为什么。
excerpt.en: Reports from our colony on [Planet.GetName] claims that there's been an increase in 'feral behavior'. Apparently parts of the population has expressed hitherto unprecedented levels of lust and aggression, and no one knows why.

excerpt.zh: 扫描发现，在[from.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]的中心出现了不规则现象，表明该构造的中心携带着一个奇怪的物质。这些不寻常的读数值得在风暴消散或离开该恒星系之前进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: Scans detect irregularities in the eye of [fromfrom.GetName] raging in [from.GetName], indicating that the formation is carrying a strange mass at its center. These unusual readings warrant closer investigation, before the storm dissipates or leaves the system

excerpt.zh:
最近，有几份机密文件被远程服务器非法下载。我们的安全人员坚持认为所有的主防火墙和二级防火墙都完好无损，到目前为止也没有外部网络攻击的证据。

但结论无可逃避：我们中出了个叛徒，而且鉴于这些信息的敏感程度，他一定有着很高的权限。
excerpt.en:
Recently, several classified documents were illegally downloaded by a remote server. Our security operatives are adamant that all primary and secondary firewalls remain intact, and so far there is no evidence of an external cyber attack.

The conclusion is ine

excerpt.zh:
第二次，继而再三确认导航系统的坐标后，我们不得不承认马达科-沃尔的天堂行星是一个只有荒原的荒芜星球。

尽管我们不能排除这种可能性：马达科所认为的天堂与我们的常识不同，但[utopian_planet.GetName]表面上的弹坑给出了另一种答案。这艘船的船长和乘员并没有简单的就接受了挫折。
excerpt.en:
After double- and triple-checking the navigational drive's coordinates, we have been forced to concede that where the Mardak Vol's paradisaical planet should have been are only the desolate plains of a barren world.

Though we cannot eliminate the possibility

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上不断地有奇怪的事件被报道。很显然有大量的个人在大街上跳舞，持续数小时甚至是一天到晚。他们拒绝停下来直到生理上的力竭。

至今，这种现象只影响了人口的相对一小部分，我们的当局政府尚未建立应对方案。
excerpt.en:
Strange occurrences have been reported among the colonists on [Root.GetName]. Apparently many individuals have taken to dancing on the streets for hours and even days on end, refusing to stop until they are physically restrained.

So far, it has only affected

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上最新建设计划被深层地陷打断了。伤亡不大，并且我们的基础设施没有受到太大影响。然而该地质活动揭露了一座地下交通网络的一角。尴尬的测量师们已经开始勘察这些突然出现的隧道。似乎这属于[From.Planet.GetName]过去的历史……
excerpt.en: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Emb

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员们以圣灵之名汇聚一堂。我们在各自的信仰之间找到了共同点，但联邦内仍然还有着多种信条、宗教和教会，和谐共处并不容易。

最近，僧团的成员敦促[Root.Federation.GetName]主持一场主教会议，以便共商起草一份联合教条，定义我们信仰的根基。这个提案被通过了，每一个[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员都要派出他们的代表。
excerpt.en:
The members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] are united around their spirituality. We found common ground in the fact that we are believers, but the federation is home to various creeds, faiths and churches and cohabitation is sometimes uneasy.

Lately, member

excerpt.zh:
我们的研究人员终于拼凑出了“万爪之母”的故事：我们的宾客是一位专注于研究闪现的唯心主义教团的领袖：这是一种允许在宇宙中任何地方瞬间传送的灵能技术。纵观她的物种的历史，从来没有人成功地进行过闪现……直到现在。

万爪之母不确定她是否有能力复制这一壮举，更何况她的能量储备目前已经耗尽，无法再做尝试。

当前，她愿意继续接受我们的照顾，并将通过帮助我们的研究人员来回报我们的热情款待。
excerpt.en: Our researchers have finally pieced together the Many-Tentacled One's story: our guest is the head of a spiritual order focused on studying the Jaunt: a psionic technique that allows for instantaneous teleportation anywhere in the universe. Throughout the hist

excerpt.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。
excerpt.en: Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the gro

excerpt.zh: 短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员们——我们现在知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]物种——向我们的接舷小队投降。我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，可以进行审问工作并学习它们的科技。
excerpt.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] species - s

excerpt.zh:
星系熔炉现已全面武装并投入运行。随着虫洞通道完工，我们已取得通往围绕星系核心六个集结星系的通道。

我们开始进行核心过热工作。其它帝国可能察觉并试图进入这些恒星系，但暂时我们占有优势，核心已屈服于我们的意志。

使用虫洞保护星系核心恒星系
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Crucible is now fully armed and operational. With wormhole tunnels completed, we've secured access to all six staging systems around the Galactic Core.

Our work to overheat the Core can begin. Other empires may detect our activity and attempt to

excerpt.zh:
曾经辉煌的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]游牧战士文明已经消亡了。[marauder_killer.GetName]的势力摧毁了最后一座容纳着其大部分成员的巨大空间站。幸存的难民们在星系中四散奔逃。

尽管可能有些[From.GetSpeciesName]海盗和佣兵成了漏网之鱼，失去太空居所对他们来说是一个无法挽回的致命打击。这彻底终结了他们的侵略生涯。
excerpt.en: The once proud nomadic warrior culture of the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is no more. Forces from the [marauder_killer.GetName] have destroyed the last of the massive space stations that housed the majority of their population. Refugees from their surviving ci

excerpt.zh: 在常规调查中，我们发现这艘舰船一直在激活的星门旁警戒，但是对于我们的呼叫没有任何应答，而且其似乎在处于高功率运转状态。
excerpt.en: During our standard survey, we found a hulking ship standing guard near an activated gate. The vessel is not responding to our summons and appears to be at functioning at critical power levels.

excerpt.zh: 我们的最早期数据集中，有些单元记录了拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——他们能入侵机械和有机体的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
excerpt.en: From our earliest datasets, some of our units have recorded [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - hacking into the minds of both machines and organics, manipulating objects by internal processing alone, or performing a range of other impr

excerpt.zh: [GetEaterCovenantProposedEvent]
excerpt.en: [GetEaterCovenantProposedEvent]

excerpt.zh:
我们刚一跃入虚境，一个存在就主动找了上来。祂的思想在我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。这是渴求之器具，祂将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
excerpt.en: As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is the Instrument of Desire and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all

excerpt.zh: [GetCradleCovenantProposedDesc]
excerpt.en: [GetCradleCovenantProposedDesc]

excerpt.zh:
[Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
excerpt.en:
The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert

excerpt.zh:
鉴于来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的需求如雪花般飘来，我们的研究工作已经愈发重要了。我们的许多科学家都在与这种压力作斗争，但从中却迸发出天才的闪光和偶现的惊人突破。

其中最新的一项是来自[targeted_scientist.GetName]设计的预备在我们某个部门中进行一系列实验。唯一的问题是，在他们的每一项研究计划中都包含了对[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的活体实验。
excerpt.en:
Our research efforts grow ever more important in light of the continuous stream of demands from the [overlord_empire.GetName]. Many of our scientists struggle with this pressure, but we see glimmers of genius and the occasional amazing breakthrough.

The lates

excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集专职的灵能使子个体，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of dedicated telepath drones, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunica

excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommun

excerpt.zh:
我们进入了一个几乎与[This.System.GetName]一模一样的星系，也就是进入裂隙的那个地方。

起先我们不是很确定到底是不是到了新的地方，但传感器探测到了一颗此前未知的行星在围绕着[This.System.Star.GetName]。

不一会儿，我们就遇到了一个机械装置，它自行推进到了传感器范围内。它无缝对接上了球体的通讯系统，并自己是我们的“顾问”RIV。

当我们在考虑如何在报告中描述好这次相遇时，它仿佛在读我们的心:“你需要我来帮忙写报告吗？”
excerpt.en:
We have entered a system nearly identical to [This.System.GetName], the system where we entered the rift.

At first we were unsure we had even traveled anywhere, until our surveys returned a previously unknown planet circling [This.System.Star.GetName].

Withi

excerpt.zh:
我们进入了一颗陆地星球的大气层。这颗行星看起来可能适合居住，但地形和树叶明显发生了褪色，就好像星球表面和上面的一切都被漂白了一样。

尽管有明显的植物群存在，但船上的传感器显示没有生命迹象。对这个行星生态系统的彻底分析需要进行直接的生物调查。

我们找到了一个可行的着陆点。
excerpt.en:
We have entered the atmosphere of a continental world. The planet looks potentially habitable, however the terrain and foliage have significant discoloration. It is as if the surface and everything on it has been bleached white.

Despite the obvious presence o

excerpt.zh:
在裂隙的另一边有什么东西控制住了球体使我们的回收装置失效了。

我们收到的第一批数据难以理解，但随后的传输让这些信息慢慢拼凑到了一起。我们推测，在这条裂缝的另一边，时间的流动要快得多，事实上，我们正在接收来自裂缝另一边的实时通信。

结果加是每天处理大约一个单词。以下是我们目前收到的报告。

“我们观测……”

“道歉……方法……恶劣……”

“紧急……”

“理解……”

这些简短的信息几被严重的噪音和无法解读的数据几乎淹没了。

谁都不知道裂隙探球的[Explorer.GetCrew]究竟处于何等的危险之中。
excerpt.en:
Something on the far side of the Rift has taken hold of the Sphere and disabled our retraction device.

The first parcels of data we received were unintelligible, but subsequent transfers are slowly piecing these messages together. We speculate the flow of tim

excerpt.zh:
我们在一个废弃的研究设施内。

这个房间的表面覆盖着厚厚的灰尘，表明它已经有一段时间没有使用了。

我们无法找到任何研究人员，无论是活着与否。无论这个地方的看守者是谁，他们早已离开了。

墙壁上排列着重型架子，每个架子上都放着一枚大型蛋。它们中的大多数都处于不同的腐烂状态，但仍有一些活体标本。

在这个房间的中心有一个敞开的容器，里面装满了苍白的粘性液体。对液体的分析显示，它含有大量的蛋白质和氨基酸。从一些蛋上留下的残留物来看，我们推测这些液体是由研究人员注射的。
excerpt.en:
We are inside of an abandoned research facility.

The surfaces in this room are coated in a thick layer of dust, indicating it has not been in use for some time.

We can detect no researchers, living or otherwise. Whoever the caretakers of this place might hav

excerpt.zh:
到达不久后，我们着陆在一个岩石基座上，它的尺寸恰好与裂隙探球相合。事实上，这个位置与我们的需求吻合到说是巧合也未免太勉强了。

一片广阔而灿烂的天空在我们的四面八方伸展开去。初步扫描显示，我们正坐在一座巨大的塔顶，塔底被涌动的云层挡住了视线。

在底座的边缘有一位孤独的生物。它穿着一件破烂的、满是灰尘的长袍，显然在等着迎接我们。
excerpt.en:
Soon after arrival, we touched down on a stone pedestal that conforms perfectly to the dimensions of the Rift Sphere. In fact, the location is so obviously suited to our needs that the idea of it being a coincidence has been rejected out of hand.

In all direc

excerpt.zh:
温度难以置信地高。要不是提前准备好的隔热护盾，我们可能就已经葬身烈火了。

远处，有一座黑色的方尖碑静静耸立着。一系列人系开凿的河道汇聚到这座巨大的纪念碑上，把岩石地貌整齐地分割开来。

天空静静地漂浮中发光的球状生物。它们的卷须从精致的身躯上垂下。从这个距离我们还看不出他们是否怀有敌意，但至少在目前，他们似乎没有注意到我们。

方尖碑似乎是最需要的调查对象，但许多漂浮的生物飞得很近，令人不安。也许在离得太近之前观察一下周围的环境会更安全。
excerpt.en:
Temperatures here are incredibly high. If not for the precautionary heat shields we had applied beforehand, we'd already be incinerated.

Looming in the distance is a black obelisk. A series of artificial channels converge on this vast monument, neatly carving

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的一处破损的拱顶发现了奇怪的信号。
excerpt.en: We have picked up strange signals from a broken dome on [From.Planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
乍一看，[From.Planet.GetName]上只有冰雪。雪白的大地、玻璃般晶莹的湖泊和锯齿状的松绿色冰川广袤无垠，火红的橘色天空映衬着地面，宛如裂开的伤口，将[From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName]中夕阳西下的红色光芒倾注在海面。如果世界有终结，那这里一定就是了。海面风平浪静，积雪一尘不染，唯一能听到的，只有冰层崩裂的咔嚓雷动和平原上呼啸的狂风。

然而，[From.Planet.GetName]曾经是某族的家园。在一片广阔而又贫瘠的旷野之中，一座黑色的金属尖塔从苍白的大地上突兀而
excerpt.en: At first sight there is only snow and ice on [From.Planet.GetName]. Vast expanses of impenetrable white, glass lakes and jagged turquoise glaciers against fiery orange skies torn open like a wound, pouring red into the seas as [From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName

excerpt.zh: 我们自[From.Planet.GetName]的偏远山谷捕捉到了一束独特的信号。由于信号源离这颗星球上的任何已存在文明都十分遥远，追踪这束信号、搞清楚它的来源，或许会有特殊意义。
excerpt.en: We have picked up a unique signal from a remote valley on [From.Planet.GetName]. As the signal's source is far away from any civilization that has existed on the planet, it might be of interest to track it down and figure out where it is coming from.

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系的扫描显示，它的小行星带是一种非同寻常的类型。与通常组成这类结构的岩石、冰块加太空垃圾的大杂烩不同，它看起来像是许多大型的人造居住站所形成的残骸。这显然是在过去几千年内的某个时间被难以想象的暴力所摧毁的。这片残骸场中必然潜藏着许多不为人知的秘密，但由于体量巨大，进行测绘就需要花费挺长的时间。
excerpt.en: Our scans of the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system show that its asteroid belt is of an unusual variety. Instead of the standard mix of rocks, ice and space rubble that usually make up such formations, it seems to be the remains of a number of large, artific

excerpt.zh: 即使不依靠仪器，也可以很容易地看到[From.Planet.GetName]上存在着庞大的城市集群遗迹。显然，曾有一个高度发达的文明居住在那里，但现在已检测不到生命迹象，也不能收到符合技术社会特征的电磁信号。这颗行星似乎陷入了死寂。我们需要着陆去了解更多情况。
excerpt.en: Even without instruments, one can readily see the remains of vast conurbations down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Clearly a highly advanced civilization once dwelt there, but today there are no life signs nor electromagnetic signals consistent with a technological

excerpt.zh: 一个与中子星非常接近的大型空间站正在发出奇怪的读数。尽管其当前位置稳定，但显示出相当大的损坏。焦痕的扩散表明它在过去曾被几次大爆炸所摧毁。
excerpt.en: A large station orbiting in alarmingly close proximity to the neutron star is giving off strange readings. Although its current position is stable, it shows considerable wear and tear. A proliferation of scorch marks indicates that it was rocked by several lar

excerpt.zh: 我们开始过载[target.GetName]来播种宇宙风暴。
excerpt.en: We have begun supercharging [target.GetName] to seed a Cosmic Storm.

excerpt.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
excerpt.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 沙漠星球[Root.GetName]似乎埋藏着一些秘密。
excerpt.en: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.

excerpt.zh: 出于未知的原因，[Root.GetName]笼罩在一道不可穿透的护盾内，而且护盾正在开裂。
excerpt.en: For reasons unknown [Root.GetName] has been enclosed within an impenetrable shield and the shield is cracking.

excerpt.zh: 在对[Root.GetName]进行扫描之后，我们得到了一些关于地表下事物的微妙读数。
excerpt.en: Scans of [Root.GetName] return subtle readings of something beneath the surface.

excerpt.zh: 在[tomb_planet.GetName]——我们领土内一颗没有生命存在的[tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表上，一些古老的建筑物隐藏在某种隐形能量场之下。偶然有一颗小行星在撞击[tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon]时发生了偏转并被旁经的货船监控到，我们这才发现了它的存在。
excerpt.en: A chameleon energy field of some sort concealing an ancient structure was recently exposed on the surface of [tomb_planet.GetName], a lifeless [tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon] inside our space. Only a chance asteroid impact which was deflected off the field while t

excerpt.zh: 随着我们在机器人学方面最近取得重大进展，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学家认为我们完全可以造出精密度足够承受更高级神经意识的合成躯体。我们可以将前一段时间从外星库房中回收的神经扫描图上传至机器人中，并让这些外星人由此复活。
excerpt.en: Following the recent advancements in the field of robotics, the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] is confident that we can produce synthetic bodies sophisticated enough to support a higher neurological consciousness. We could upload the neural pat

excerpt.zh: 自殖民[Root.GetName]以来，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈异象不断。生态系统十分不稳定，而且生物的进化程度也不符合范式。科学家猜测是有外部的干扰，而猜测已被证实！几个殖民者发现了庞大的地下改造装置，应该有数千年的历史了。装置在改造进程中就失去了动力，使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈处于未完成的现状。只要提供足够的能源，应该就能重启装置。但谁也不知道会发生什么……
excerpt.en: Since our initial settlement of [Root.GetName], several anomalies in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s biosphere have been discovered. The ecosystem is unstable and has not developed according to projected models for a world of this type. Our scientists suspect outsi

excerpt.zh:
许多报告说[Root.GetName]有无法解释的地层活动。整个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能感受到震动，许多殖民点都因此受损。对地震进行调查时，科学家发现了庞杂的地下洞穴网络。

洞穴最深处栖居的是某种本土原始文明，它们正在挖掘通往地表的隧道！它们的行为可能是由殖民地的活动诱发，但我们无法确定。我们也无法预计它们与殖民者碰面之后会采取何种行动！
excerpt.en: There have been many reports of unexplainable seismic disturbances on [Root.GetName]. Tremors can be felt across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and many of our settlements have suffered damage. While investigating the earthquakes, our scientists discovered a vast n

excerpt.zh:
我们一在[Root.GetName]安顿下来就发现了大量的节肢类活动。具体来说，有一种叫做“密弥库蚁”的会建造聚群的微小昆虫出乎意料地数量众多。

它们的地下群落数量众多，遍布整片大陆，但目前为止还没有造成过什么问题。目前尚不清楚它们是在寻找着地表上的什么东西，或是为了躲避地下的什么东西而逃出。
excerpt.en:
Since settling on [Root.GetName], we have noted increased arthropod activity. Specifically, tiny colony-building insects designated "Myrmeku" have become unexpectedly productive.

Their underground colonies are spread across the continent in great numbers, but

excerpt.zh: 一处[Root.GetName]上的地理学异常现象引起了我们的注意。一个采矿设施周围突然出现了碗状的凹地，随后我们对此展开了调查。这个凹地的特征几乎从未在冰川区以外的地方发现过，但奇怪的是：当暴露在某些电磁波段时，这个“圆凹地”的侧壁会产生共振，并且会产生花瓣状的可见光散射。调查正在进行。
excerpt.en: A geological anomaly has come to our attention on [Root.GetName]. We began surveying after a bowl-shaped depression suddenly appeared alongside a mining facility there. Features like this are almost never found outside of a glacial region, but stranger still:

excerpt.zh:
首席的科研船神出鬼没，侦测起来相当困难，但这还不是最难的。

传感器上显示的数据令人不解，上面显示首席的船两侧各有一艘虎视眈眈的护卫舰。

首席物理学家正在向我们致意。
excerpt.en:
The ephemeral Science Ship remains difficult to detect, but apparently not difficult enough.

The blur of confused sensor readings that we have come to associate with the Head's ship is flanked on both sides by a pair of rather nasty-looking corvettes.

The Ph

excerpt.zh:
我们大获全胜的舰队在濒死的缇扬奇族母身旁游弋，她那闪闪发亮的肉身上布满了弹孔和伤痕。她那巨大的触须虽然仍试图捕捉附近的舰船，但动作逐渐放缓，最终停了下来。

就这样，古老的族母被终结了，就像那些在我们之前企图围捕她的舰队一样。
excerpt.en:
Our victorious fleet circles the dying Tiyanki Matriarch, her glowing flesh scored by countless blast-marks. The violent thrashing of her tentacles, still trying to grasp at nearby ships, first slows, then draws abruptly to an end.

At last she expires: the an

title.zh: 即将进行的试点：物流重构

excerpt.zh:
各种货物的运输路线是我们贸易联邦兴旺繁荣的生命线。但迄今为止，各帝国仍在容器设计、装载程序及运输管道等方面采用各自的物流标准。

为了使效率最大化，一个新的试点项目将在几年后实施——项目目标是调研并试验一种全新、具体，适用于联邦所有成员国的运输标准。

参与试点需要拥有一个至少有50点贸易额流经的恒星系。此外，设有外星贸易公司意味着更高的统计数据，所以应对其进行鼓励。

由于项目所涉范围广泛，一些开销必不可少。但这些牺牲是为了长远的利益。换句话说，也就是更多的未来利润。

联邦各成员国均被强烈鼓励参与项目。
excerpt.en:
The routing of various goods is the life-blood of our prosperous trade federation. But so far each empire has relied on their own logistic standards with regards to container design, loading procedures, and shipping pipelines.

In order to maximize efficiency,

excerpt.zh:
随着我们继续在这个星球上净化那些肮脏的异星渣滓，我们的[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品收集愈发充盈。

希望这些展品能成为这个污秽星系的残骸，进一步激励我们履行誓言。
excerpt.en:
As we continue our efforts to cleanse this world of filthy xeno scum, our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies has grown.

May these exhibits serve as the carcass of this contaminated galaxy and further inspire us in our sworn mission.

excerpt.zh:
[from.target.GetName]刚刚注意到了我方存在，并引起了警觉。看上去我们对当地的情报了解不足，我们的特工已经引起了当地[patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]的注意。

这次[from.GetName]行动还是有机会挽回的，但是需要立马对间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]进行援助。
excerpt.en:
The [from.target.GetName] has just been alerted to our presence. It seems we lacked sufficient intelligence on the local area, and our operatives have earned the attention of local [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural].

Operation [from.GetName] is not truly jeopardize

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的两名关键特工在一场意料之外的自然灾害中身受重伤，该灾害同样造成了许多[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]伤亡。附近居民紧急驰援，那几名特工现在得到了基本的照料。

[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还没能开始质疑我们的特工，尽管他们伤势严重，但和当地的大量受灾者相比不算什么。用不了多久，[from.GetName]行动就会受到更严格的审查——尤其是在我们的两名关键特工身体
excerpt.en: Two of our key operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have been seriously injured during an unexpected, natural disaster which also claimed the lives of several [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Local residents rushed to their aid; the operatives

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者汇报了一个奇怪的现象：在他们一个主要殖民定居点外，“雪”开始聚集起来。

好吧，“雪”只是他们用来描述这种物质的代名词。显而易见的是这肯定不是真正的雪，因为[Root.GetName]可是一颗沙漠星球，即使在两极地区温度也极少降到冰点以下。而且，也没有任何人目击到这些东西从天而降。不过，初步的扫描显示这种物质确实主要由冰冻的水构成，至于为什么不会融化仍不清楚。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]希望能进一步研究它的性质，而另一些人则认为它会带来危险，
excerpt.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] report a strange phenomenon: snow has begun gathering outside of one of their main colonial settlements.

Well, "snow" is the term they have used to describe it, anyway. It would seem implausible that it is real snow, given that

excerpt.zh:
我们的裂隙探球被淹没在一种粘稠的红色液体中。在我们周围漂浮着巨大的圆盘状固体物质，但到目前为止，我们还没有与它们相撞。一层半凝胶状物质的固体墙四面包围着我们。我们轻松地滑行。

我们从裂隙中感受到的有节奏的脉冲与我们周围液体的谐波频率是同步的。每隔三秒钟，我们就会被一股压力向前推进，迫使我们更深地进入管状系统。我们的引擎很难抵抗液流。

这是一个收集样本的好机会，但这些的设备可能会阻碍我们在扭曲的隧道中航行。
excerpt.en: Our Rift Sphere has arrived submerged inside of a viscous, reddish fluid. All around us drift large disc-shaped blobs of more solid matter, but we have avoided collision with them thus far. A solid wall of a semi-gelatinous material surrounds us on all sides.

excerpt.zh:
我们进入了一个充满令人困惑的视觉奇景、几何图案和变幻莫测的色彩的空间。

尽管周围的环境看起来并不危险，但它们就像视错觉一样让人迷失方向。构成这个宇宙的物质令人困惑。无论这些样本如何放大，我们都会看到同样的重复模式，如同自身的无限浓缩。

很明显，在这个裂隙中有一些我们还不了解的物理原理。
excerpt.en:
We have entered a space of confusing visual spectacles, geometric patterns, and shifting colors.

The surroundings do not appear dangerous, but they are as disorientating as an optical illusion. Attempts to analyze the material that makes up this universe are

excerpt.zh:
在球体穿过裂隙时，我们经历了一阵剧烈的加速。

这个宇宙的巨大引力把我们拉了进去。在经历了一段不舒服又危险的旅程后，我们发现自己漂浮在一个密集的星系群中，每一个星系都在我们球体有限的传感器范围内。据我们所知，这似乎构成了整个宇宙。

初步报告还指出这里的暗物质的含量很高；更重要的是，质量还在不断增加。直接的结果是，随着时间的推移，引力正在增强。
excerpt.en:
As our Sphere passed through the rift, we experienced a wild burst of acceleration.

The tremendous gravity of this universe was pulling us in. After an uncomfortable and dangerous ride, we found ourselves floating within a dense cluster of star systems, every

excerpt.zh:
一大片松散的岩砾在我们面前铺展开去，上方是一片苍白、空旷的天空。

这里看不到行星或恒星。似乎不是星系或任何已知系统的一部分。在我们的传感器所能探测到的范围内，这片景观向各个方向无限延伸。地表布满了像小行星一样大的坑洞。

在地平线的远方，几十头巨大的蠕虫状生物正从地面冒出来，用一对有力的鳍在稠密的大气中滑行。它们一定在地下有某种聚居地。
excerpt.en:
A vast plane of loose rock and gravel stretches before us. Above it hangs a pale, empty sky.

No planets or stars can be seen here. This does not appear to be part of a galaxy or any known system. As far as our sensors can detect, this landscape continues infi

excerpt.zh:
在碎片的另一头，我们发现了一座与我们自己恒星基地相似的结构。我们的裂隙探球刚一接近，就收到了许多语言和许多频段的问候。令人惊讶的是，这是我们自己的语言。

招待我们人与我们一样惊讶，因为我们居然也在说着他们的语言。但在简短礼貌的交谈后，我们发现这块星域是一个与我们颇为相似的宇航文明。他们自称为[mirrored_empire.GetName]。他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们已经抛弃了迷信，但他们仍保有天真的信仰体系。

这些人们混杂着熟悉感和陌生感，令人有些不安。我们也许可以与他们合作，但我们能相信这些
excerpt.en:
Beyond the rift, we discovered a structure that resembled one of our own starbases. As soon as our Rift Sphere approached, we were hailed in a number of languages and on several frequencies. Surprisingly, one of those languages was our own.

Our hosts were jus

excerpt.zh:
我们到达了一处狂暴湍流的内部。

我们的观察窗完全被一种未知的气态流体的涟漪所掩盖。

我们能采集少量的大气样本，但每次分析的结果都与上一次大不相同。我们不确定是我们的仪器出了问题，还是材料本身存在某种固有的不稳定因素。

我们在样品中发现的一个不变的特性是它包含着异常大量的星界物质。

我们意外地注意到微小的温度变化会剧烈影响它的成分。我们将其放置在一个隔绝容器中，以待进对该现象的进一步研究。
excerpt.en:
We have arrived inside of a violent whirlwind.

Our viewing windows are completely obscured with rippling waves of an unknown gaseous fluid.

We have been able to take a minor sample of the atmosphere, but each analysis comes back wildly different from the las

excerpt.zh:
那些无人机所保护的是一颗被潮汐锁定的行星，一面向着夜空的黑暗与严寒，另一面则沐浴着永恒的光明。在温暖的昼半球，我们发现了一座可能曾是瓦格罗人城市的废墟。

凯德斯相信，他过往的细节可能就深埋于此，并且希望在这里的发现能够揭示这颗行星的历史。

这个遗址必须由凯德斯亲自挖掘。
excerpt.en:
The planet the drones were protecting is tidally locked, one side facing the cold darkness of space, and the other bathed in perpetual light. On the warm, light-filled half of this world we uncovered the ruins of what may be a Vagrosian city.

Keides trusts th

excerpt.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的轨道影像显示了一座破败的采矿设施，周围还有许多被遗弃已久的原始太空货船。

除了这些影像外，我们的短波通讯阵列还拾获了一个来自行星地下深处的非常微弱的求救信号。对该遗址进行更详细的研究将揭示信号的起源。
excerpt.en:
Orbital imaging of [from.Planet.GetName] has flagged a dilapidated mining facility accompanied by long abandoned rudimentary space faring cargo vessels.

Alongside these images, our shortwave communications array has picked up a very faint distress beacon eman

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上发现了一座古城的废墟。通过它的大小和规模发现它很可能是一个星际文明的首都或主要空间居住地。

为了了解这座废墟的起源，我们需要全面挖掘。
excerpt.en:
We've discovered the ruins of an ancient city on [From.Planet.GetName]. Given its size and scale, this was likely the capital or central administrative hub of a major space-faring civilization.

A full excavation will be necessary to properly determine its ori

excerpt.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]详细的调查揭示了一些属于曾经遍布整个行星的文明的微弱信号。
excerpt.en: A closer look at [From.Planet.GetName] shows small signs of a civilization that once populated the planet.

excerpt.zh: 在调查完[From.Planet.GetName]后，我们发现了一种奇特的生物。尽管我们只和它们相处了一会，但这已经激发了我们的保护欲。建议开展进一步的研究。
excerpt.en: After a survey of [From.Planet.GetName], a strange creature was discovered. Despite having only been among us for a short time, it has already instilled a deep  desire to nurture and protect it. Further study is advised.

excerpt.zh: 一个古老、似乎被遗弃的建造结构漂浮在[Root.GetName]上空，除此之外那便是一颗普通的小行星。
excerpt.en: An old, seemingly abandoned structure looms over [Root.GetName], an otherwise unremarkable asteroid.

excerpt.zh: 对[From.GetName]的光学扫描中，在其部分表面发现了类似小屋的建筑结构，证明此处之前可能有生物居住。
excerpt.en: Optical scans of the planet [From.GetName] have revealed small hut-like structures littering parts of its surface, suggesting it is inhabited.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道俘获了一个小型未知物体，其正以难以置信的高速移动。
excerpt.en: Caught in an orbit around [From.GetName] is a small, unknown object moving at such a high speed it beggars belief.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气极其稀薄，但似乎有风一样的东西在吹拂着它表面的沙海。
excerpt.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.

excerpt.zh: 我们检测到[this.GetName]地表上的自发爆炸！在没有在轨战舰或可探测到的地表生命的情况下，这些巨大爆炸的产生原因仍然未知。
excerpt.en: We have detected spontaneous explosions on the surface of [this.GetName]. With no orbiting warships or detectable surface life, the cause of these massive blasts remains unknown.

excerpt.zh: 一个摇摆不定的信号萦绕在[Root.GetName]，而且并不来自星球表面。
excerpt.en: A wavering signal haunts [Root.GetName], though it does not seem to originate from the planet's surface.

excerpt.zh:
一群青少年在游荡于方舟舰人迹罕至的区域时，发现了一个松动的金属检修面板。打开面板后，他们进入了方舟舰[Root.GetName]中一个未被记录的次级甲板区域。在此后的几个小时里，内部追踪系统和环境监测系统均无法探测到这群青少年的踪迹。

当他们返回时，这些年轻的探险者表现出明显的心理和生理创伤迹象。有些人一直在胡言乱语与近乎木僵的状态之间反复切换。然而，尽管经过多次尝试，他们都拒绝提供任何关于此次事件经历的陈述。

专家认为，无论在那个次级甲板层区域发生了什么，其严重程度都足以使其被刻意从所有记录中抹除。
excerpt.en: While straying in one of the Arkship's less-frequented sections, a group of juveniles identified a dislodged metallic access panel. Opening it, they entered an undocumented sub-level of Arkship [Root.GetName]. For several hours thereafter, the group ceased to

excerpt.zh:
最近的报告显示，一种侵入性真菌物种已蔓延至方舟舰[Root.GetName]的整个水培甲板。该生物似乎在方舟舰农业系统受控的湿度和营养丰富的基质中茁壮成长，在多个生产层级形成了密集的菌丝网络。

遏制措施已被证明无效，因为该真菌对标准的除草处理没有产生可测量的反应。我们怀疑该物种可能已迅速适应了飞船的封闭生态系统。如果不加以控制，此次爆发可能会显著降低粮食产量，并对方舟舰有限的农业生产能力造成额外压力。
excerpt.en: Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of Arkship [Root.GetName]. The organism appears to thrive in the controlled humidity and nutrient-rich substrates of the arkship's agricultural systems, forming

excerpt.zh:
我们的舰队已经击败了守卫这个裂隙的奇怪船只，但似乎它们并不孤单。

我们收到了一段传输信号，来源于这个恒星系唯一行星旁边的建筑物内的存在。
excerpt.en:
Our fleets have defeated the strange ships guarding this rift, but it seems they were not alone.

We have received a transmission from beings inhabiting a structure nearby the lone planet in this system.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的殖民地进行的例行生态研究中，偶然发现了一种奇怪的真菌生命形式。科学小组报告说，菌丝体的表面闪闪发光，色彩斑斓，但最让他们感兴趣的是，每当大范围内发生某些事情时，不同的蘑菇群似乎在相互交流。

此外，生物体的生物特征似乎与殖民地的生态系统明显不同。当地科学团队相当困惑，并要求提供专业支持，因为我们可能正在处理一种有感知力的物种。
excerpt.en: A routine ecological study of our colony on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon a strange fungal lifeform. The science team reports that the surface of the mycelium is shimmering and colorful, but what was most intriguing to them was the fact that separate cluste

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的神秘机器人对我们的殖民者从一落足于行星上起就非常欢迎。我们的许多定居者一开始不信任这个小机器人，但它对我们建立殖民地的过程难以置信地有帮助，并且在其中扮演了重要角色。

在头几年的殖民过程中，这个小东西在[Root.GetName]上的第一座城市诞生了衍生形象，并成为了整颗行星的吉祥物。
excerpt.en: The enigmatic creature on [Root.GetName] has been very welcoming to our colonists after they settled down on the planet. At first many of our settlers were distrustful of the small robot, but it has shown itself to be incredibly helpful and has played a key ro

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的地质勘探揭示了这颗行星远比我们之前预想的更加富有矿藏。在调节了我们的传感器以后它便可以扫描更深的地下，发现了许多大有前景的矿场。我们应该委派更多的人力物力进行勘探，或许可以发现更深处的有用矿脉。
excerpt.en: Geological surveys on [Root.GetName] have revealed that the planet is richer in minerals than we thought. After calibrating our sensors to penetrate deeper into the ground, we have discovered several promising mining sites. Should we direct additional resource

excerpt.zh: 在最近的一场降雨中，殖民者注意到了[Root.GetName]的表面出现了一些金属泥潭。这些泥潭具有很大的黏度，如同液态金属一般。
excerpt.en: After a recent rainfall, colonists have noticed metallic puddles appearing on the surface of [Root.GetName]. These puddles have a viscous consistency, like liquid metal.

excerpt.zh:
[planet.GetName]上传回的最新消息称我们对行星废弃物管理能力的计算发生了错误。大量的垃圾场融合在一起，形成了一片无法通行的废土，一直延伸到行星人口中心的边缘。

当地人开始大规模地将这些垃圾发射到轨道上，不过这也只是缓兵之计。
excerpt.en: The latest report from [planet.GetName] informs us that we have miscalculated the planet's waste management capabilities. Massive dumpsites have merged to form a single, impassable wasteland, one that stretches to the very edge of the planet's population cente

excerpt.zh: 日前，[Root.GetName]上涌现出大量的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪事件。这些人唯一的共同点就是他们在失踪时都孤身一人。随着消息散播开来，人们对于失踪的恐惧随之降临。民众的惶恐不安对殖民地的日常运作带来了极大的麻烦。
excerpt.en: Recently, numerous [Owner.GetColonistPlural] have gone missing on [Root.GetName]. The only discernible pattern is that each was alone at the time of their disappearance. As news began to spread, a collective fear of going unescorted has gripped the colony. Thi

excerpt.zh:
现在，[planet.GetName]上重要的殖民工作已经完成，[Root.Owner.GetName][Owner.GetScientistPlural]开始将注意力转向这个行星上的高耸尖塔。

这些矿物构成的结构似乎完全中空，将行星地壳下方的气体一路传输到大气热层。并且由于某些未知的原因，这些气体还吸引着缇扬奇以及其他太空生物，让它们长途跋涉来到这颗星球。

我们如果能够对这种星球奇观开展一次彻底的研究，就能加深我们对于这些奇幻现象的了解。当然了，我们也可以想个方法来收集这些稀有的气体。
excerpt.en:
Now that crucial colonization efforts of [planet.GetName] have been completed, [Root.Owner.GetName] [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have turned their attention towards its lofty spires.

These mineral formations appear to be entirely hollow, transporting gaseous su

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetStarName]星系发现了我们失去联系的一个亚光速探测器。我们需要尽快展开回收工作。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] has detected one of our missing sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system. We should begin recovery efforts as soon as possible.

excerpt.zh:
我国特使[event_envoy.GetName]似乎并未完成[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的任务，好好维护[Root.GetAdj]利益，反而与一名[other_species_nation.GetAdj]外交官堕入爱河。由于担忧如此逾矩可能招致的恶果，这对恋人私奔去了[third_party.GetName]：那个国家危险的自由主义宪法允许这样的结合。

如此一来，[event_envoy.GetName]已丧失了我国给予[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的特使职位。但是，对我们自己
excerpt.en: It seems that, instead of performing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] task and representing [Root.GetAdj] interests, our envoy [event_envoy.GetName] has fallen for the charms of a [other_species_nation.GetAdj] diplomat. Fearing the repercussions of this transgression,

excerpt.zh:
发现了我们在他们的[GetPreFTLLower]星球上的行动后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的许多[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]国家暂时放下彼此间的争吵，共同组建了一个跨国界军事组织。

根据当地媒体报道，这个特遣组织的主要责任是保卫他们的[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]免受“未知外星势力针对[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]全体的敌对活动”。
excerpt.en:
In an apparent response to our operations on their [GetPreFTLLower] world, many of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have momentarily put aside their squabbling to form a new supranational military organization.

Ac

excerpt.zh: 尽管已经像训练时那样准备了所有的预防措施，位于[from.target.GetName]的一名我方特工还是提出了对于他们的伪装的担心。特别是在[from.GetName]行动的关键时刻，决不能暴露出来——因此，间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]请求投入更多资源来使得[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]避免未来的意外发生。
excerpt.en: Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the [from.target.GetName] has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for Operation [from.GetName] - as such, Spymaster

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[from.target.GetName]的间谍首脑，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择叛逃。

看上去[root.GetOperativeRole]对于[from.target.GetName]的文化和主体物种生出了同情，
excerpt.en: Our Spymaster in the [from.target.GetName], [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteA

excerpt.zh:
随着一种新型瘟疫在舰船上散播开来，利爪一号上的船员们开始陷入恐慌。根据初步的分析判断，对于我们的族群而言，这是一种相对无害的病毒。然而，对于船上的鸟类船员来说情况就不一样了，病毒首先附着在羽毛上，导致羽毛根部感染腐烂，不出几天，感染就会蔓延到血液中。

如果任由这样发展下去，最终会达到不可挽回的地步。
excerpt.en: Panic grips the crew of the First Talon as a novel disease is sweeping across the ship. According to initial analysis, it's a strain of a relatively harmless virus, common to our people. However, to the avian crew of the Talon, its effects are both serious and

excerpt.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
excerpt.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service im

excerpt.zh: 进入[From.GetName]星系之后不久，我们很快就定位了一颗符合凯德斯幻视的行星。在这颗行星的表面流淌着熔矿的海洋。
excerpt.en: Shortly after entry into the [From.GetName] system, a planet matching Keides's vision has been located. Oceans of molten minerals stream across the planet's surface.

excerpt.zh: 追踪着凯德斯的幻视，我们来到了一颗位于[From.GetName]恒星系的行星。茂密的丛林覆盖了地面的90%。
excerpt.en: Following Keides's vision has led us to a planet in the [From.GetName] system. Dense jungle covers more than 90% of its land area.

excerpt.zh: 如凯德斯的幻视一般，我们在伊弗施恒星系的一颗行星上观测到了一座舰船之冢。
excerpt.en: Just as in Keides's vision, we have observed a graveyard of ships on a planet in the Ivusheh system.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上的准备工作已经完毕；我们的特工已经准备好将[target.GetName]引入只有一步之遥的星海的大舞台。
excerpt.en: Our preparations on [target.capital_scope.GetName] are now concluded; our operatives are poised to bring the [target.GetName] one step further onto the galactic stage.

excerpt.zh:
一个规模庞大的老兵代表团致信，要求离开当地前往位于[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的殖民地——此地也是我们的附庸[subject_empire.GetName]的首都。随信件附上的还有一笔礼金，用于“使官僚的齿轮运转更为润滑”，他们这样委婉地表述道。

似乎在我们的老兵中间流传着许多这样的故事，讲述一个人前往这些恒星系是如何在冒险中发了大财——或是作为雇佣兵，或是作为海盗。无论是哪一种，很显然这些老兵掏出了自己的家底进行众筹，希望能够通过前往[subject_empire.Capit
excerpt.en: A large contingent of our veterans has sent a letter requesting leave to travel to the colony at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], the capital of our vassal [subject_empire.GetName]. Included with the letter is a gift of credits to "grease the wheels of bureau

excerpt.zh:
此处的环境构成是非物质的。简单的扫描表明，整个空间都是某个未知来源的全息投影。

在我们抵达不久之后就收到了一份用我们语言发出的通讯。我们面前的空间凝聚成了一行文字。

“我不认识你。”

在我们解释了自己的来历之后，这个实体继续说：

“真有趣。那很好。我们玩个游戏吧。我来当创世神。”

全息投影组成了新的画面。在一颗荒芜的星球上，一个[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]物种正在挣扎求生。它正在向我们展示一个幼年文明的诞生。

“我们要对他们施加何种赐福呢？”
excerpt.en:
The composition of this environment is immaterial. A simple scan revealed that the entire space is a holographic projection from some unknown source.

Soon after our arrival, we received a communication in our own language. The space in front of us resolved in

excerpt.zh:
球体外出了一片空白什么都没有。

初步的探测表明，光谱中的所有频段以完全一致的强度从所有的方向同时在向我们轰击。我们无法判断朝向。

我们的高度、深度和方向的测量设备都完全无法运转或者显然已经发生故障。看起来，围绕着我们的一片空白似乎毫无分别。

也许只要我们走得足够远就能避开这些干扰。或者我们可以在无人机的帮助下更详细地探索这个区域。
excerpt.en:
Outside the Sphere, there is nothing but white.

Initial readings indicate that an equal amount of every color on the spectrum is bombarding us from every direction at once. We have no way to determine our bearings.

Our altimeters, depth gauges, and compasses

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
excerpt.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

excerpt.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

excerpt.zh: 对[From.GetName]的初步扫描结果表明，其内部含有大量致密的精加工金属，也许是某种机械或其他科技。若要获得更多细节数据，则需进行进一步扫描。
excerpt.en: Initial scans of the asteroid [From.GetName] suggest a dense mass of wrought metal within it, perhaps part of some machinery or other technology. Further scanning required for more detailed data.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]充满绿意的平原十分寂静，除了那微弱但稳定的信标信号。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName]'s verdant plains are quiet, save for a weak but steady beacon signal.

excerpt.zh: 经过初步探测，我们在求救频率中发现了异常的信号。
excerpt.en: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的颜色格外碧绿，初步扫描表明其表面可能存在一些有趣的物品。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] is exceptionally green, and preliminary scans indicate that there might be several articles of interest on the surface.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的诞生

excerpt.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该使这种贸易市场合法化，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
excerpt.en: De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is

excerpt.zh: 和以往相比，我们最近在采掘技术方面的进步使得我们能更加深入[Root.GetName]的地壳部分。而在巨大的矿井深处，我们碰巧发现了一个古老外星文明留下的痕迹，它一直延伸到山脉中。这个文明似乎是沿着这些未被开发的矿脉所建立，发掘这个遗址将阻碍我们在这颗星球上的采矿作业，并无法再从新矿脉中提取矿石，但这也将带给我们新的科学发现。
excerpt.en: Our recent advancements in mining technology have enabled us to bore deeper into [Root.GetName]'s crust than ever before. In the depths of its cavernous mineral mines, we have stumbled upon traces of an ancient alien civilization leading further into the mount

title.en: The Demise of Shard the Dragon

excerpt.zh: 裂爪，这条邪恶而年迈的巨龙终于咽下了她的最后一口气。在她的脖子旁边，疙疙瘩瘩鳞片下的绒毛上，心脏位置旁边，藏着一个包裹，里面就是她最珍贵的宝物，誊录仪——那个可以复制一切曾经碰到过的文物的遗珍。
excerpt.en: The vile old dragon known as Shard has drawn her final breath. In a satchel around her neck, nestled in the downy fuzz underneath the gnarled scales above her heart, hangs her most treasured possession - the Rubricator - a relic capable of replicating any arti

excerpt.zh:
在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的一个广袤而与世隔绝的山谷中发现了一些不同物种的化石，这些物种似乎不是属于[Root.GetName]的。它们大体上都来自大约360万年前的同一个时期，时间跨度在几个世纪内。

每个物种似乎都是在其所属的独特的生物圈中进化而来的，而且它们似乎都具有智慧。奇怪的是，到目前为止发现的每个化石都显示出因暴力遇害的迹象。
excerpt.en: Fossilized remains from several different species that do not appear to have been indigenous to [Root.GetName] have been found in a large and secluded valley on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They all date from roughly the same time period, within the span of a few

excerpt.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
excerpt.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

excerpt.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
excerpt.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

excerpt.zh: 行商联盟欢迎您光临绰尔的罗盘，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
excerpt.en: The Caravansary Caravan Coalition welcomes you to Chor's Compass, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

excerpt.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
excerpt.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

excerpt.zh:
[sky_megacorp.GetName]向我们提供了一个利润丰厚的机遇。他们想为一种叫做“普乐快车”的全新提神饮料打广告。

可以将这种饮料的广告直接投射到我们的公民的视觉植入体中，只要一抬头就能看见。所产生的收入可以用于无数的公众项目。

尽管这种广告具有侵入性，但我们确信这种饮料本身应该是美味无害的。
excerpt.en:
The [sky_megacorp.GetName] has offered us a lucrative opportunity. They wish to advertise their latest product, an energizing drink called Plasma Quench.

Ads for the drink will be projected straight into our citizens' ocular implants whenever they happen to g

excerpt.zh: 初步报告显示这星球上的海洋从某种程度上来说居然是活的，其中包含着一种我们从来都没见过的外星实体。研究员提议组织进一步在轨研究以更加深入了解这种神秘生物。
excerpt.en: Preliminary reports suggest the ocean covering this planet is somehow alive, comprising an alien entity unlike any we've encountered before. Researchers propose an extended orbital study be organized in order to learn more about this mysterious being.

excerpt.zh:
结束了！叛乱基本已经被粉碎，而全帝国忠诚的子民们则在欢庆我们的胜利。

现在那些叛徒们已经束手就擒，我们得想想怎么料理他们。我们是要对他们网开一面还是让他们得到应有的惩罚呢？
excerpt.en:
It is done! The rebellion has been utterly crushed, and loyal citizens throughout the Imperium are celebrating our victory.

Now that the traitors have been brought to heel, we must decide how to deal with them. Should we show leniency or are they to be punish

excerpt.zh:
古旧的星海共同体的一切相关被一扫而空，取而代之的是新的帝国。作为这一重构的一部分，泛星系防卫军被更名为帝国海军。

这一新的舰队将继承泛星系防卫军的多数军衔系统和构架，但将更换新设计的制服和军衔徽章，所有的现役人员将被要求向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。

尽管舰队的船员和后勤队伍仍然将从帝国的成员国中招募，但[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]军官的比例大幅提高了。
excerpt.en:
All references to the old Galactic Community are being swept away in the new Imperium, and as part of this reorganization, the Galactic Defense Force has changed its name to the Imperial Armada.

This new fleet has inherited much of its rank structure and orga

title.en: Conflict! What is it Good For?

excerpt.zh: 一场战争在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上爆发了。最近这些年，这颗星球上的某些派系设法积累了足够的财富，对生产资料实施了垄断。与之对应，其他人对于日益严重的不平等进行了反抗。现在，一场席卷一切的阶级战争爆发了。对于[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]来说，这是一个黑暗的时代，后果将持续很长时间。
excerpt.en: A war has broken out on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]. In recent years, certain factions on the planet managed to accrue enough wealth to monopolize the means of production. In turn, others revolted against the growing inequality. Now, an all out class war has

excerpt.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

他们不知道民主带给了我们什么样的好处，也不知道自由的真正味道。
excerpt.en: The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power stru

excerpt.zh:
我们发现[From.GetName]被完全包裹在某种能源屏障之中。[Root.GetName]所有用传感器穿透屏障的尝试都失败了——扫描光束被偏转回来，仿佛面对着一面镜子。

屏障的能源读数已经爆表，用纯粹的火力来突破是不可能的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提出了一个特殊项目来研究清除屏障的方法……如果它是用来封锁内部而非阻拦外人的话，移除屏障倒是有相当大的危险。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] has been found to be completely enveloped in some kind of energy barrier. All attempts by the [Root.GetName] to penetrate the barrier with its sensors have failed - the scanning beam is simply deflected back at the ship, as though it was looking

title.zh: [galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除

excerpt.zh: 根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示
excerpt.en: According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The

title.zh: 挑选泛星系贸易市场新总部
title.en: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经表态，迁移泛星系贸易市场的新一轮竞争由此展开。位于[market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的的市场总部已经开始收尾工作，交易员的关注都集中在未来几年的预测上。他们哀叹这一戏剧性的——且在他们看来并不必要的决定对泛星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。

总部新址的提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商业
excerpt.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with trade

excerpt.zh: 我们的舰队摧毁了[From.GetName]的总部。从他们的太空基地的残骸中尽可能回收有价值物资的行动也已如火如荼地展开。我们已经获得了大量资源。
excerpt.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

excerpt.zh:
第一次与外星物种接触后，人民日益焦虑于社会可能将发生剧变，导致[this.GetName]各地爆发出了游行示威。示威者质疑长久以来的传统，挑战治理的基础，并要求适应这一启示重塑的未来。

尽管这些运动是非暴力的，但其规模却给公共服务带来了巨大压力，扰乱了日常生活。然而，许多公民并不认为这些抗议活动仅仅是骚乱而已。他们认为这是一种清算，表明我们正眼睁睁地见证自己的身份在被改写。
excerpt.en: Protests have erupted across [this.GetName], driven by a growing anxiety over the perceived transformation of our society following first contact with an alien species. Demonstrators question long-standing traditions, challenge the foundations of governance, a

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，可以从你们的土拨鼠洞里钻出来了。我们从你们这“解放”了足够多的财富，现在正在用船载回去呢。

嗨！舵手伙计们！我们要回[marauder_system.GetName]了。让我们离开这群混球的地盘吧，这鬼地方真让我感到恶心。
excerpt.en:
You can emerge from your shelters now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have liberated a sufficient amount of your wealth, and our ships are loaded to capacity.

Helmsman! Set course for [marauder_system.GetName]. Let us depart this blasted region of space. It

excerpt.zh: 载有大量[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]难民的运输船从[marauder_neighbor.GetName]方向进入了我们的领域。他们肯定是被人从一个个残破的空间站—那些他们曾称之为家园的地方赶出来了，大概是因为资源有限而采取的控制人口的措施。已经允许他们在[Root.GetName]安定下来。
excerpt.en: Transports carrying a large number of [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] refugees have crossed into our space from the direction of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. These exiles have apparently been expelled from the decrepit space stations they once called h

excerpt.zh:
在从[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]装载物资时，我们检测到其中一个货舱发生了收容失效。据报告，安全门另一侧传来了低沉的轰鸣声，证实了舱室内存在潜在危险。

我们要冒险进行调查吗？
excerpt.en: While loading materials from the [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], we detected a containment breach in one of the cargo bays. Deep rumbling noises were reported from the other side of the security doors, confirming the presence of a potential hazard with

excerpt.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往[target.owner.GetName]境内。每一个人都会装作一名求职者。一部分人将会携带推荐信，找和关键设施运营相关的工作；其他人则要在背地里试试运气。
excerpt.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the [target.owner.GetName] under tight aliases. Each will pose as a worker seeking employment. Some are carrying statements of recommendation and will seek work close to key facilities; others will try th

excerpt.zh: 通过伪装成帝国低级职员或是官僚，我们的特工现已成功渗透进[target.GetName]内部。
excerpt.en: Concealed as low-level Imperial officials and bureaucrats, our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 所有[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[target.GetSpeciesName]重要领袖都被我们的密探调包了。现在渗透人员正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的进展。是时候采取行动了。
excerpt.en: All [target.GetSpeciesName] leaders of significance on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have been replaced by our own agents. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

excerpt.zh: 我们对[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[owner.GetPreFTLLower]居民进行潜移默化影响的工作已经达到了顶峰。我们的特工已经准备好把我们的文化价值传播到[target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。
excerpt.en: Our work to influence the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] inhabitants of [target.capital_scope.GetName] has reached its zenith. Our operatives are now ready to bring our own cultural values to bear on [target.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上已逐步整合了当地[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的数个关键节点中心。目标是让当地蜂巢在日常活动中对我们更加依赖，并让我们可以最终无缝吞并他们的星球。渗透单位正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]上的进度。什么时候动手完全取决于我们自己。
excerpt.en: We have slowly assimilated multiple key nodal centers from the local [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [target.capital_scope.GetName]. The goal is to make the local hive more reliant on us for their day-to-day activities until we can seamlessly annex their worl

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]的特工以先进的知识武装头脑，已经渗透了当地的大学，凭借着开创性的理论确立了自己作为杰出思想家的地位。然而，此人不断取得的成功却遭到了当地学者的质疑：许多人拒绝与此人接触，指责其为骗子。

无休止的学术争吵阻碍了我们的特工传播新思想。我们的间谍首脑正在请求进一步的指示。
excerpt.en: Armed with our superior knowledge, our operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have infiltrated local universities, establishing themselves as brilliant thinkers known for their ground-breaking theories. Their rising success, though, has been met wit

excerpt.zh:
发生了严重违规行为！间谍首脑 [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在一次秘访[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]地表时不慎暴露了踪迹。目前事故的细节仍在调查中，但[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]与当地的[from.target.GetSpeciesName]发生了短暂但直接的接触，他们一瞬间便落荒而逃。我们的特工尽力抓捕目击者，但目前仍一无所获。

[from.GetName]行动仍在进展当中，但我们将采取特殊措施来遏制
excerpt.en: A drastic breach has occurred! Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been compromised during a clandestine visit to the surface of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Some details remain unclear for now, but [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] came int

excerpt.zh:
我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。

终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。
excerpt.en:
An incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.

At last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we ca

excerpt.zh:
多亏了我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的许多交易，我们已经能够集中精力建立和改善帝国的内部工作。在我们的科学家和工程师们的努力工作下，我们看到我们的殖民地在过去几年里蓬勃发展。人们在几年前还以为是幻想的事情，突然之间不仅变成了现实，而且变得司空见惯。

我们收到消息，我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的长官想亲自看看我们的最新进展，并有可能把其中一些带回他们的祖国。
excerpt.en: Thanks to our many deals with [overlord_empire.GetName], we have been able to focus much of our efforts on building and improving the internal workings of our empire. With our scientists and engineers hard at work, we have seen our colonies blossom these last

excerpt.zh:
我们对[Root.GetName]的竭泽而渔已经对环境造成了显著，乃至不可逆转的变化。工业污染引发的失控温室效应造成了严重的气候破坏。放射性物质的泄露更是导致大片[Root.GetPlanetMoon]区域不再宜居。

这种变化已经来到了关键的十字路口，除非我们改变开发手段，减少对星球环境的影响，不然的话就会遭受灭顶之灾，留下的将是一个不宜居且充满辐射的星球，星球上也会只剩波涛汹涌的海洋与死寂的不毛之地，如同预言末日的人们所给过的最恐怖的警告一般。
excerpt.en: Our exploitation of [Root.GetName] has caused significant - perhaps irreversible - changes to the world's environment. Industrial pollution has caused significant climatic disruption via a runaway greenhouse effect, and rampant radioactive leaks have rendered

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的主导物种，[From.GetName]，已经被提升了。只需要轻微的基因改造，就可以释放出他们内在的潜力，使他们的认知能力和操纵的灵活性得到极大的提高，而前几代的成员将被安装上小型的义体植入物。
excerpt.en: The dominant species on [Root.GetName], the [From.GetName], have been uplifted. Only minor genetic alterations were needed to unlock their inherent potential for vastly improved cognitive ability and manual dexterity, while members of previous generations will

excerpt.zh: 在环形世界施工管事出色的领导下，我们能将建造流程最优化，显著加快了建造速度。
excerpt.en: Under the skillful leadership of the ring world construction manager, we have been able to optimize the construction workflow, increasing the build speed significantly.

excerpt.zh:
这个裂隙中包含着一次史诗之战的余波。

残留的只有无数的军舰残骸和硕大无朋的生物尸体，比我们最大战舰的全长还要大上十倍。

与这些战舰残破的船体形成鲜明对比的是，尸体的状态非常好。不知这些舰船使用的是什么武器，但似乎几乎没有造成损坏。我们尚未确定该生物的死因，但似乎不太可能是战斗的结果。

这只野兽一定有非凡的耐力。分析它的分子组成有助于我们加固舰队的船体。另一方面，我们也可以尝试研究它的内部，也许可以了解这种生物是如何死亡的，以及这里到底发生了什么。
excerpt.en:
This rift contains the aftermath of a titanic struggle.

All that is left is the wreckage of a military fleet and the corpse of a monstrous creature, ten times the largest of the battleships from tip to tail.

In contrast to the mangled hulls of the warships,

excerpt.zh:
我们发现自己身陷于一座前不见头后不见尾的互相联通的舱室网络。

这里的地面是光亮透明的电路板。肉眼可见的能量顺着导体的支路网络流淌着。

这座无尽长廊好像在无限地自我重复，毫无变化。目前的探索一筹莫展，建议另辟蹊径。
excerpt.en:
We have found ourselves encased in a network of interconnected chambers with no clear ending or beginning.

The floor surfaces here are a glassy circuit board. A visible current of energy can be seen flowing through a grid of branching conduits.

The corridors

excerpt.zh:
我们被垃圾包围了。

时不时就有新裂缝在我们周围的太空中打开，并向旋转的垃圾堆中倾倒更多的垃圾。根据碎片的性质，我们判定这里是一个星际文明的垃圾场。未知机器的零件和碎片与外星家庭的日常一次性用品掺杂散落在一起。

一般来说，这些物品的价值与废料无异。然而，我们的传感器却在其中发现了生命的迹象。

一个穿着宇航服的未知生物的处于休眠状态。目前还不清楚它在这里漂浮了多久。
excerpt.en:
We are surrounded by garbage.

From time to time, we have witnessed new tears in space open around us and dump even more garbage into the swirling heap. Based on the nature of the debris, this space is being treated as a junkyard for a star-faring civilization

excerpt.zh:
我们的探测器发现了一窝巨大的的蛋，每一颗都有裂隙探球那么大。这些蛋预计很快就要孵化，这样一来这种我们连其近亲是什么样都不了解的生物很快就要慢行星都是了。我们探测不到这颗行星上生活着其他生物，所以该物种的生长周期也扑朔迷离。

在这颗几乎荒芜的行星上，生态系统并不像能维持这么庞大种群数量的样子。对此我们的主要猜想是该物种遵循着某种星际迁徙模式。因为该物种的成体目前必然是在星球之外。
excerpt.en: Our probe has discovered a clutch of giant eggs, each as big as the Rift Sphere. They are expected to hatch imminently, and when they do the planet will be crawling with creatures we know next to nothing about. We can detect no other living specimens on the pl

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]行星的表面没有任何生命。然而，有迹象表明这里先前存在繁荣的生物圈，加之此处有趣的地壳活动，我们需要对其进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is devoid of all life. However, there are indications of a previously thriving biosphere, and some interesting tectonic activity which may warrant a closer look.

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的表面在受到一艘星际飞船的猛烈撞击后，凹陷出一个小峡谷。这艘飞船的残骸仍然可以在峡谷底部找到。虽然撞击肯定发生在亿万年前，但残骸似乎相当完好。派遣一支考古探险队将能了解更多信息。
excerpt.en: A small canyon of sorts has been carved onto the surface of this [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] by the violent impact of a starship. What remains of the vessel can still be found on the canyon floor. Although the crash must have occurred eons ago, the wreckage ap

excerpt.zh: 我们的扫描仪探测到该星球的一个区域不断发出一些有趣的信号。经分析，那里很有可能存在古代文明的遗迹正等着我们去发现。
excerpt.en: Our scanners picked up a series of intriguing signals coming from this area of the planet. Based on their composition, it's highly likely there is a remnant of an ancient civilization waiting to be uncovered there.

excerpt.zh: 我们的调查船扫描了[From.Planet.GetName]并探测到一些值得进一步观测的人造结构。令人不安的是，那里没有任何人口存在的迹象。
excerpt.en: Our survey ship has scanned [From.Planet.GetName] and detected some artificial structures worth a closer look. Unnervingly, there are no signs of any population down there.

excerpt.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？
excerpt.en: [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that. However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system shows signs of an extraordinarily violent

excerpt.zh: 一层厚厚的玻璃和金属覆盖在这颗原本贫瘠的行星上，或许暗示着它过去发生了某种灾难性事件。
excerpt.en: A thick layer of glass and metal covers this otherwise barren planet, perhaps hinting at some sort of cataclysmic event in its past.

excerpt.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]的表面几乎完全被一些整齐排列的圆形小池塘覆盖。这种规整的网格表明它们可能是精心设计的而非自然形成。现场调查可能带来更多的解答。
excerpt.en: [from.Planet.GetName]'s surface is almost entirely covered by a lattice grid of small, circular, liquid-filled pools. Their neat alignment suggests deliberate engineering rather than natural formation. A field expedition may provide more answers.

excerpt.zh: 大啖异星土，饥肠犹未足。
excerpt.en: We feast: another world's soil tasted; our hunger yet unsated.

excerpt.zh: 传感器表明在[Root.GetName]轨道上存在有潜在价值的实体。
excerpt.en: Sensors register potentially interesting entities in orbit of [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
excerpt.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
excerpt.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的表面似乎布满凹痕，也并非不寻常。

不寻常的是这些伤痕的形状，无规律的分布。不太可能是陨石撞击的结果。
excerpt.en:
[Root.GetName]'s surface appears heavily pockmarked, which is not unusual.

What is unusual is the regular shape of the scars, irregularly distributed. This is unlikely to be the result of meteorite impacts.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近发现了未知的现象。该现象正导致光线频繁折射，有时甚至被完全遮蔽。
excerpt.en: An unknown phenomenon has been discovered near [From.GetName]. It is causing light to be frequently refracted and occasionally even entirely blocked out.

excerpt.zh: 对[Root.GetName]表面进行的反复扫描给出的读数都不一致，似乎行星本身就在不停发生剧变。
excerpt.en: Repeated scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface give inconsistent sensor readings, almost as if the planet itself was in a constant state of upheaval.

excerpt.zh: 在扫描小行星带的时候，我们的科研小队发现了一些不寻常的东西。
excerpt.en: While scanning the asteroid belt our science team found some sort of irregularity.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上矿物的成分和预期并不相符。
excerpt.en: The mineral composition of [Root.GetName] does not match projections.

excerpt.zh: 我们的探测器发现[From.GetName]的能源放射规律存在异常。
excerpt.en: Our sensors indicate odd irregularities in [From.GetName]'s energy emission pattern.

excerpt.zh: 乍看上去，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]似乎不能支持生命的存在，但我们探测到了从冰冻的地表以下发出的生命信号。
excerpt.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

excerpt.zh: 一个废弃外星平台正围绕一颗恒星漫无目的地漂浮。仔细研究或许可以揭示其作用。
excerpt.en: A defective platform of alien design is drifting aimlessly around a star. Perhaps closer study could reveal its purpose.

excerpt.zh: 以剑与火，燃异端之地。以彼之烬，沃泱泱星河。
excerpt.en: By sword and flame shall heretical worlds burn, and with their ashes shall the galaxy be salted.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
excerpt.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a signific

excerpt.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
excerpt.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

excerpt.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
excerpt.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

excerpt.zh:
[this.GetName]的殖民者发展出了一种爱好，沉迷于星界裂隙 ，其位于行星南半球的可观测天空中。人们激烈地推测它的起源，以及它蕴含着怎样的危险或机遇。

来自[owner.GetName]各地的业余天文爱好者聚集到这颗行星，亲眼见证这番绝景。
excerpt.en:
Colonists on [this.GetName] have developed a fascination with the Astral Rift visible in the sky from the planet's southern hemisphere. Rampant speculation exists about its origins, as well as what dangers or opportunities it might present.

Amateur astronomer

excerpt.zh:
惨败在所难免。

我们先祖的舰队面对入侵者毫无胜算。入侵者武器骇人且毫无慈悲。现在先祖们已经几乎没有立锥之地了，人们惊慌失措地恳求我们把他们从裂隙中带走逃生。

一位杰出贵族私下联系我们，希望以一大笔能量币报酬换取我们保护[riftworld_noble_leader.GetHisHer]的人身安全。

该帝国内容最全面图书馆的管理员恳求我们取回他们大量的书籍和数据磁盘来保存。

我们必须做出取舍，因为入侵者可不会等我们。
excerpt.en:
The carnage was absolute.

Our ancestral fleets stood no chance against the invaders. Their weapons are terrible, and their mercy is none. Few bastions of safety now remain. The people are panicking and begging to flee back with us back through the rift.

One

excerpt.zh: 围绕着[Root.GetName]的轨道空间到处都是曾经居住在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]遗留的残骸，他们在文明被毁灭之前向太空射出了数千个原始的卫星和飞弹发射平台。许多都在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]可怕的使用核武的战争中被反卫星武器摧毁了，这样一来太空垃圾就更多了。我们在地表的殖民者认为这些残骸已经影响了基础设施的运作，因为这些残骸，我们只能在有限的条件下使用卫星和轨道飞行的技术。
excerpt.en: The orbital space around [Root.GetName] is cluttered with debris left behind by the alien civilization that once inhabited the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Before they wiped themselves out, their early space programs saw the launch of thousands of primitive satellite

excerpt.zh:
科学家的船就在这个星系里——如果没猜错的话。

我们没法通过探测器确定他们的位置，不过他们主动呼叫了我们。把他们的信号接到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
excerpt.en:
The Researcher's ship is in this system - we think.

We are unable to lock in their position on sensors, but they are hailing us. Patching them through to [Root.Capital.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
一个神秘的太空舱飘在[from.GetName]中。它看起来没有任何攻击能力并且对我们的信号毫无反应。

初步扫描显示它受损的外部是用先进的材料和陌生的工程科技建造的。需要进一步分析。
excerpt.en:
A mysterious capsule is adrift in [from.GetName]. It has no obvious offensive capability and is unresponsive to our signals.

Initial scans show that its damaged exterior is constructed using advanced materials and unfamiliar engineering techniques. Further an

excerpt.zh:
“[Species.GetName]记录再突破”这样的标题在[Owner.GetAdjective]的体育新闻中已经屡见不鲜了。随着[GetAthletePlural]们竞相使用更新、更复杂的改装来超越彼此，运动能力的极限也在不断被突破。

“强化体育”的粉丝们为这些结果欣喜若狂，但越来越多的铁杆爱好者呼吁应该单独设立强化运动员的项目。还有一些人希望限制参加团体比赛的改造人的数量，让纯天然的[GetAthletePlural]在聚光灯下还能占有一席之地。
excerpt.en: 'Another [Species.GetName] Record Broken' - this headline has become commonplace in [Owner.GetAdjective] sporting life. As [GetAthletePlural] race to outdo one another with newer and more sophisticated modifications, the limits of athletic performance are cons

excerpt.zh:
有了如此众多能够控制感官和情感体验的植入体，强化改造的个体现在更倾向投身虚拟活动，以此进行娱乐或者逃避现实。虽然忆痕艺术家理论上可以激发出任何情绪，但这种做法却已经出现了一些黑暗的转折。

忆痕俱乐部高价收购那些具有强烈情感体验的自录记忆，例如婚礼、交配仪式、自杀、袭击和谋杀等等。这一做法导致了犯罪率上升，犯罪分子不但会为了记忆犯罪，还会在这些创伤经历后窃取受害者的植入体。

我们应该如何应对与之相关的乱象?
excerpt.en: With so many implants able to control sensory and emotional experiences, augmented individuals have turned to virtual life events as escapism and entertainment. While engram artists can theoretically stimulate any emotion, the practice has taken a dark turn.

excerpt.zh:
一位海军军校生泄露了机密信息，其愚蠢之举令人震惊。作为一名网络战斗模拟器的忠实粉丝，这位学员与其他玩家就我们驱逐舰上炮塔的旋转速度发生了争论。

为了支持自己的说法，学员甚至上传了几张我们舰船的机密蓝图，这些文件很快传遍了全星系网络。尽管肇事者已被处理，但由于这一事件，内阁中有声音呼吁全面禁止网络游戏。
excerpt.en:
In an appalling display of foolishness, a naval cadet has leaked classified information. A dedicated fan of networked combat simulators, the cadet got into an argument with other players about the angular velocity of the turrets on our destroyers.

To bolster

excerpt.zh: 最新一代的感官义体件可以让用户屏蔽不必要的感觉。包括不受欢迎的气味、不得体的画面等等，一切都可以被淡化、掩盖，甚至完全从用户的感知中抹去。我们社会中较为保守的团体越来越担心这种审查制度会对我国公民的良知产生影响。
excerpt.en: The latest generation of sensory cyberware allows user to block out unwanted sensations. From unwelcome smells to unseemly pictures, everything can be toned down, masked, or even entirely erased from the user's perception. There are growing concerns amongst th

excerpt.zh: 最近，雄心勃勃的企业和地下运动的广告倾向于在用户的义体件中隐秘地植入信息。虚假记忆、选择性荷尔蒙反应和睡眠建议正变得司空见惯。忧心忡忡的政界人士向我们提出了这个关切，并主张禁止这些侵入性信息，或至少加以监管。
excerpt.en: A recent trend in advertisement for underground movements and ambitious corporations is to implant surreptitious messages in the user cyberware. Fake memories, selective hormonal reactions, and sleep suggestions are becoming commonplace. Concerned political ac

excerpt.zh: 一个先前从未遭遇过的智慧哺乳动物联络了我们，事关仍居住在[utopian_planet.GetName]上的远古马达克·沃尔族。事情似乎非常紧急。
excerpt.en: We are being hailed by a previously unencountered species of sapient mammal regarding the ancient Mardak Vol still residing on [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems very urgent.

excerpt.zh:
已经有报告陆续地从被派遣到[from.target.GetName]的间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]发送过来了。这标志着我们在一个外星帝国开始建立了我们第一个间谍网。

尽管我们在表面上看上去相似，但是我们应该很快就能发现这些特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是如何可能与我们相异甚远……
excerpt.en:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the beginning of our first Spy Network within a foreign empire.

Though we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how the

excerpt.zh:
被分配到[from.target.GetName]开展工作的间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命存在的星球里建立了首个间谍网。

若计划妥当，我们能够潜移默化地影响这个[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时掩盖我们的存在。值得庆幸的是，我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]有着惊人的生理相似性，这能让我们的特工很难被发现。
excerpt.en:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a world which is still unaware of alien life.

With careful planning, we will be able to subtl

excerpt.zh:
我们围绕[fromfrom.GetName]建造了一座观测站来研究上面的居民，但却意识到[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反而是在研究我们：他们完全清楚其他外星物种的存在，并很快注意到了我们[root.GetScientistPlural]的到来。

我们先前在这个恒星系的活动一定已经让[fromfrom.owner.GetName]对我们的存在有所警觉。当前情况下，保持我们的存在隐形化已经没有什么意义。
excerpt.en: We built an observation post around [fromfrom.GetName] to study its inhabitants, only to realize the [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are the ones studying us: they are fully aware of the existence of other alien species, and soon noticed the arrival of o

excerpt.zh: 我们已成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。从今开始至知悉更详细的信息为止，我们将其代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。如果他们具有语言，我们必须进行破译才能建立交流。
excerpt.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. For now, we have code-named them [This.ContactCountry.GetName], until we can find out more about them. If they possess a language, we must decipher it in order to establish

excerpt.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。
excerpt.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - h

excerpt.zh: 失落帝国行为
excerpt.en: Fallen Empire Behavior

excerpt.zh:
地质警报系统已发出预警[planet.GetName]主定居点附近一年内可能发生火山喷发。

我们可以投入资源进行控制性减压，利用熔岩流进行地热发电，同时安排人手待命，在喷发时采集岩浆以提炼贵金属；或者集中转移区域内平民与物资，尽可能降低风险。

鉴于预测可能存在误差，我们也可以暂不采取行动，继续观测。
excerpt.en:
Geological alert systems warn that a volcanic eruption near the main settlement on [planet.GetName] is likely to occur within the next year.

Investing in a controlled pressure release could allow the lava flow to be harnessed for energy production. Crews coul

excerpt.zh: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]现在有雇佣兵可供雇佣。
excerpt.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

excerpt.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]星系没能提供多少答案。塞拉伦涅感到一种无法解释的熟悉感，而我们的扫描仪在恒星轨道上检测到了一块漂浮的人造残骸碎片。其结构暗示其采用了深空设计，但哪怕有什么标记或识别符号，也早就因时间而消逝。

“我曾希望来到这里能唤醒些什么，”她轻声说道。“但……还不是时候。”
excerpt.en: The [fromfrom.GetName] system offers few answers. Seralune senses a familiarity she cannot explain, and our scans have detected a fragment of artificial debris drifting in the star's orbit. Its construction suggests deep-space design, but any markings or ident

excerpt.zh: 从方舟上，我们的岩质蜂群成千上万地降临，吞噬着这个世界的地壳与地幔，直到一切荡然无存。
excerpt.en: From the Arkship, our lithoid swarms descend in their thousands, feasting on the crust and mantle of this world until nothing remains.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在甄别并试图同[target.GetName]国内的犯罪团伙接触，他们很容易被我们的援助影响到。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are working to identify and make contact with criminal elements inside the [target.GetName] that would be susceptible to our assistance.

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了一份来自许多利爪号船员的请求。他们要求我们调配资源研究他们民族的过往。在利爪号徘徊于亚空间的时候发生了许多许多事情。他们希望能为子孙后代记录下一些东西。
excerpt.en: We received a request from several members of the Talon's crew. They have asked us to use our resources to research their people's past. Much occurred while the Talon lay in limbo. They have asked that it be recorded for posterity.

excerpt.zh:
遗物所生成的虫洞的另一端是瑟塞特星系。进入后不久，我们的传感器发现了一队有敌意的无人机。它们似乎在守护着这个星系唯一的一颗行星。初步的扫描结果显示，那些无人机上没有生命形式的信号，行星上同样也没有。

凯德斯非常确信那颗行星就是他们民族的起源地。毫无疑问答案就在那里。

随后，无人机群向我们发出了通讯要求。
excerpt.en: At the other end of the relic-spawned wormhole lies the Sursect system. Shortly after entry, our sensors picked up a fleet of hostile drones. They appear to be keeping vigil over the system's single planet. Initial scans suggest there are no life forms present

excerpt.zh:
我们的思绪带着全新的目的在虚境中行动。当我们试着推进时，它也在将我们回推。起初，我们将此解读为对我们存在的抗拒，但如今我们明白了：虚境正在向我们发问。

尽管这些问题的含义依旧模糊，但它们并非无关紧要。据[GetTelepathPlural]所言，我们给出的答案将会影响社会的未来。
excerpt.en:
Our thoughts move through the Shroud with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.

Though hazy in meaning, these questions are not tr

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获取了一些奇怪的读数，很有可能表明其上有生命存在。由于这些信号较为微弱，而且在我们试图与之联系时毫无反应，所以如果想弄清真相，我们需要派出一支研究团队。
excerpt.en: We have picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. Given the weakness of these signals and the lack of response as we attempt to contact these lifeforms, we must send a research team if we are to figure out w

excerpt.zh:
在观察[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]当地人口时，我们的外派团队发现了件有趣的事情。

这里的首都大街小巷都在交头接耳着关于一位“天选之人”的事情，据说是从星间下凡实现一个古老预言，并将带领[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]走入下一个黄金时期。

我们的所有人员都记录在岗，所以究竟是谁在访问这颗行星很值得进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
While observing the local population of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], our away team have come across an interesting discovery.

The capital city is abuzz with talk of a "Chosen One" who has reportedly descended from the stars to fulfill an ancient pro

excerpt.zh:
我们注意到一些舰队指挥官和领袖之间的分歧和争论有所增加。如果[admiral_democracy.GetName]认为我们应该干点什么，可以肯定[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]将对着干。

起初，这似乎只是对手之间的良性竞争，但最近气氛变得越来越令人不快，充满火药味，我们看到他们的同僚也开始站队了。
excerpt.en: We have seen a rise in disagreements and arguing between some of our commanders and leaders. If [admiral_democracy.GetName] thinks we should go through with something, you can be sure that [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] will argue that we should do the opposite.

excerpt.zh:
数字产业正在蓬勃发展。从模拟第一人称冒险的刺激到在数字度假胜地的放松，虚拟娱乐从未如此引人入胜、令人上瘾。虽然这个新兴产业代表着一类关键的经济驱动力，但随着人们在数字乌托邦中花费的时间越来越多，现实世界的生产已经开始受到影响。有些人面临着与“真实”生活完全失去联系的危险，但仍然可以通过参与数字经济为社会做出贡献。

我们是应该禁止令人上瘾的虚拟世界，将其作为一种新的赚钱娱乐形式加以推广，还是通过监管找到一个折中方案？
excerpt.en: Digital industry is booming. From the thrill of simulating a first person adventure to relaxing on a digital resort, virtual entertainment has never been more engaging - or as addictive. While this burgeoning industry represents a key economic driver, producti

excerpt.zh:
新的合成形体使我们摆脱了有机身躯的病痛伤害。不幸的是，这也带来了一系列全新的问题，从简单的机械故障到危及生命的服务器稳定性、连接问题，还有数字病毒等等。

我们是应该集中精力保护我们数字化的思想，把身体当作一次性商品，还是把它作为我们身份的延伸给予更多的关注？
excerpt.en: Our new synthetic forms have freed us from ailments and injuries of the organic body. Unfortunately, they have also created a whole new set of issues, from simple mechanical breakdowns to life-threatening server stability, connection concerns, and digital viru

excerpt.zh:
我们变得更快、更强、更好了。但让合成身体治愈危险的环境中仍有精神风险。即便知道意识可以复原能缓解痛苦，但并不能完全解除。特别是意识的复原并不是万无一失的这件事，并且新的身躯也不能无中生有。

我们可以选择忽视精神痛苦将合成人的性能推向极致，或是让我们的雄心壮志为人口精神健康做出妥协。
excerpt.en: We have become faster, better, stronger. But subjecting synthetic bodies to dangerous situations still comes at a mental cost. Knowing that the mind can be restored may lessen the trauma, but does not remove it entirely. Especially as the retrieval is not alwa

excerpt.zh: 我们的一些情报机构发现了一些资料，这些资料指出[ringworld_builder.GetName]的环形世界可能是一个大规模杀伤武器的秘密发射平台。虽然这些资料的正确性有待确认，但这样的见解已经在国内定型，公众要求我们采取行动。可以确定的是如果[ringworld_builder.GetName]没有什么可隐瞒的话，他们会允许我们的武器专家检查平台的。
excerpt.en: Some of our intelligence assets have uncovered data suggesting that the [ringworld_builder.GetName]'s ring world could be hiding a secret launch platform for weapons of mass destruction. Though the validity of the source has yet to be confirmed, the notion has

excerpt.zh:
我们被巨大的机械结构包围了。

齿轮和链条在我们的四面八方转动着。每过十分之一秒，机械就往前搏动一刻。齿轮上的每一个齿几乎都达到了我们裂隙探球的宽度。

这一切都坐落在无边无际的稠密气体和浓雾的星云中央，无始无终。
excerpt.en:
We are surrounded by giant machinery.

Gears and pinions twist in all directions. Each tenth of a second, the machine clicks one step forward. A single tooth from one of these gears is nearly the width of our Rift Sphere.

Amidst swirling nebulae of dense gas

excerpt.zh:
这里既没有恒星，也没有行星。只有一束来自神秘来源的漫射光照亮了这个巨大的物体，在我们的面前若隐若现。

它的形状大致为矩形，处于完全沉默的状态——没有可探测到的推进系统或任何形式的动力特征。它的大小与一个小型恒星基地相当，看起来死气沉沉。没人知道它在这个隐蔽的口袋维度上漂浮了多久，或是从何而来。

无数的装饰字形和符号被复杂地雕刻在它的表面。由此我们排除了这是自然现象的可能性。
excerpt.en:
There are no stars here, no planetary bodies. Only a diffuse light of mysterious origin reveals the massive object looming before us.

Roughly rectangular in shape, it is completely inert - there are no detectable propulsion systems or power signatures of any

excerpt.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的地质扫描显示在一个特定的地下区域中，局部的极端温度接近绝对零度。

对内部更详尽的研究将会带来更多的答案。
excerpt.en:
Topographical scans of [from.Planet.GetName] show extreme temperatures approaching absolute zero localized in a particular subterranean region.

A more detailed study of the interior should yield more answers.

excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
excerpt.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

excerpt.zh:
在我们迄今的探索中，[From.Planet.GetName]表面的情况完全没有先例。从山脉到整个大陆般广袤的地质区域突然被切割成各种几何形状，其规整程度远非自然形成所能及。原本自然的环境被突然破坏，变成完全平坦的平面、完美的三角形和尖锐的锥形。

目前，对这一令人困惑的现象的任何解释都只是纯粹的猜测。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is utterly without precedent in all our exploration to date. Vast geological areas, from mountain ranges to entire continents, are suddenly cut by shapes far too geometrically regular to be natural in origin. The otherwise

excerpt.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]扫描揭示了地底深处的一间人工密室——其用途和来源未知。放大后发现了一座从地表通往地下拱顶的挖掘井。

欲进行进一步的分析，需派遣一支探险队前往[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] uncovered an artificial chamber deep beneath the surface - its purpose and origin unknown. Magnification revealed an excavated shaft leading from the surface to the subterranean vault.

Further analysis will require sending an ex

excerpt.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上的科学船已经探测到遍布这个海洋星球表面的圆形岛屿群。从地质的角度来看，它们非常不寻常：其表面看起来很自然，没有人造结构，但它们都呈圆形，且几乎是完美的圆。我们需要前往那里收集更多数据。
excerpt.en: The Science Ship in orbit around [From.Planet.GetName] has detected clusters of small, round islands dotting the ocean planet. From a geological standpoint they are highly unusual: the surface appears natural, with no artificial constructions, yet they all app

excerpt.zh: 科学船在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上进行的扫描显示了其海面下有着奇怪的构造，海水以难以解释的方式在流动。虽然该星球天气相对平静，风暴很少，但海面下的水受一些未知力量的影响，不断翻涌和搅动。建议进行详细调查。
excerpt.en: Scans made by the Science Ship in orbit of [From.Planet.GetName] shows some strange formations beneath the waves, and inexplicable water currents. The weather is relatively placid and storms are rare, yet the planetary seas seem to constantly roil and churn, d

excerpt.zh: 来自[From.Planet.GetName]的可见光传感器反馈的信号显示这个海洋星球的海床上有着极不寻常的构造。
excerpt.en: The visual sensor feed from [From.Planet.GetName] shows formations in the seabed of this ocean world that are highly unusual.

excerpt.zh:
漂浮在 [From.Planet.GetName] 行星残骸水晶的般清澈的海洋上，包裹在微小冰盖的，似乎是一个人造结构。

需要一个团队来挖掘这个结构。
excerpt.en:
Encapsulated in what remains of the planet's tiny ice cap, floating on the crystal clear oceans of [From.Planet.GetName], is what appears to be an artificial structure. 

A team is required to excavate this structure.

excerpt.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]表面居高不下的辐射水平指向了一座破旧的反应堆复合体。这座孤零零的设施似乎废弃已久，有待调查。
excerpt.en: Elevated radiation levels on the surface of [from.Planet.GetName] were traced to a dilapidated reactor complex. The isolated facility appears inactive and warrants investigation.

excerpt.zh:
轨道遥测显示在[From.Planet.GetName]表面有一个巨大的坑洞。此坑洞并非陨石撞击坑，因为其深度令人咋舌，与直径完全不成比例。事实上，该坑洞的实际深度尚无法确定，因为坑道半路上就被岩屑堵塞，任何进一步的轨道扫描均被阻碍。

传统的开挖式考察看起来是确定坑洞下方究竟有何种物体的唯一途径。
excerpt.en: Orbital telemetry shows a massive impact crater on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It was not caused by a meteorite strike, as the crater is surprisingly deep in proportion to its diameter. In fact, the actual depth cannot yet be determined, as the shaft
