excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的地表扫描结果表明了一种迹象：曾经可能有一个科技文明在这颗星球上活跃，但它现在已经灭绝了。我们需要组织一次地表考察以获得更多信息。
excerpt.en: Surface scans of [From.Planet.GetName] picked up signs that a technological civilization may have been active on the planet, but has since gone extinct. We will need to mount a surface expedition to learn more.

excerpt.zh:
一颗本应“正常”的熔岩星球，让科研船的传感器出现了无法控制的故障。

建议进行进一步研究。
excerpt.en:
What should be a "normal" molten planet is making the Science Ship's sensors glitch uncontrollably.

Further study is advised.

excerpt.zh: 从[From.Planet.GetName]的轨道上可以很容易地看到一座直径数千公里的人造建筑。形状表明在它的中间位置似乎有一片重要区域。从轨道上获得的探测数据显示没有任何异常，因此我们有必要进行进一步的探测。
excerpt.en: An artificial construct thousands of kilometers across is readily visible from [From.Planet.GetName]'s orbit. The shape seems to indicate a location of importance in the middle of it. Sensory readings from orbit indicate nothing out of the ordinary so closer i

excerpt.zh: 从轨道中拍摄的[From.Planet.GetName]的影像清晰地展现了这个技术文明的基础设施。神秘的是，尽管庞大的城区被复杂的表面交通网络相连接，但这颗行星看起来似乎已完全废弃，没有任何尚存感性生物的迹象。此行星内核比大多数行星更活跃，但这里没有灾难性事件或其他任何足以直接解释这些人口失踪的原因的事件的迹象。他们都去哪里了呢？
excerpt.en: Orbital imagery of [From.Planet.GetName] clearly shows the infrastructure of a technological civilization. Mysteriously, despite massive urban areas linked by an extensive surface transport network, the planet seems totally abandoned, with no signs of extant s

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]我们检测到了军事舰船武器的微量辐射痕迹。
excerpt.en: Faint traces of weapon radiation indicative of a military spacecraft have been detected on [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 我们在贫瘠的[From.GetPlanetMoon]上发现了异乎寻常的东西。似乎有人在此之前就来过这里了。具体情况有待进一步调查。
excerpt.en: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.

excerpt.zh:
我们观测了大量小行星[Root.GetName]，有了一些发现……

还有待进一步的调查。
excerpt.en:
Observing the massive asteroid [Root.GetName], we have found...

Something. Further investigation is warranted.

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]荒芜的表面上，光学传感器发现了一些可能是建筑的东西。
excerpt.en: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上存在着大量的飞船残骸。这有可能是某次大型舰队行动遗留下来的。
excerpt.en: A large amount of ship debris can be found in orbit around this [Root.GetPlanetMoon], possibly the remnants of some kind of massive fleet action.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]地表冰层的最上层覆盖着规模异常巨大的晶体沉积。我们还检测到了一个微弱的信号存在。
excerpt.en: The superficial layer of surface ice on [From.GetName] covers an abnormally large crystal deposit. We are also detecting the presence of a faint signal.

excerpt.zh: 这颗气态巨行星周围存在大量碎片。大部分来自各种规格的失事星舰。
excerpt.en: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.

excerpt.zh: 一座巨大的远古船骸围绕[From.GetName]漂浮。
excerpt.en: A massive shipwreck of ancient design circles [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面坐落着一座类似大型机器的物体，其来源与功用尚未查明。
excerpt.en: On the surface of [From.GetName] sits what appears to be a large machine, of unknown origin and purpose.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的扫描结果标示了一些被土著居民抛弃的聚落。在聚落的建造者身上究竟发生了什么事情？
excerpt.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal what appear to be the abandoned settlements of a primitive society. What manner of fate could have befallen their builders?

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]附近有非常奇特的能源信号，好像整个星球都在时隐时现一样。
excerpt.en: Enigmatic energy readings surround [From.GetName], as though the entire planet is wavering in and out of existence.

excerpt.zh: 一群静止的吊舱环绕着[From.GetName]，我们开始时以为这是个小行星带。
excerpt.en: First thought to be asteroids, a halo of motionless drop pods surrounds [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的发射光谱表明这颗气态巨行星的主要构成成分拥有和某种流行的酒类饮料相同的分子结构。
excerpt.en: The emission spectra of [From.GetName] suggest the gas giant's primary composition has the same molecular structure as a popular inebriant.

excerpt.zh: 我们短暂地接收到了非比寻常的能源示数，发射源来自[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。这有可能是我们的系统出现了故障，也有可能预示着我们发现了不得了的东西。
excerpt.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

excerpt.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]冰冻表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
excerpt.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s frozen surface.

excerpt.zh:
[from.System.GetName]的一颗小行星内我们探测到了一个光亮四溢的物体。

由高度先进材料构建，它正在所有频率上广播稳定的无线电波。我们的扫描仪显示其内部没有含有爆炸性或挥发性化合物。看起来我们可以安全接近并进一步开展研究。
excerpt.en:
A brightly lit object has been detected on an asteroid in [from.System.GetName].

Constructed of highly advanced materials, it is broadcasting a steady stream of radio waves on all frequencies. Our scanners indicate no explosive or volatile compounds contained

excerpt.zh: 光学扫描显示，[Root.GetName]表面有几处不同寻常的翠绿。
excerpt.en: Optical scans indicate that the surface of [Root.GetName] is unusually verdant in places.

excerpt.zh: 对[From.GetName]地表厚重冰层多次进行扫描，仪器均产生了杂乱数据及异常干扰模式。冰层之下存在某种持续干扰探测设备的物体，我们建议进一步调查。
excerpt.en: Repeated attempts to scan the thick glacial layer covering [From.GetName] resulted in erratic data and unexpected interference patterns. Something beneath the ice keeps disrupting our equipment. Further investigation is advised.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了外形类似球体的高密度能量信号。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: We have discovered powerful concentrated energy in the form of an orb. Investigation is advised.

excerpt.zh: 这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部检测到了生命迹象。这是否表明是有生物圈存在？
excerpt.en: Life signs have been detected coming from inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could it indicate the presence of some kind of biosphere?

excerpt.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]的时候，我们发现了一种怪异的岩石形态，矗立在这颗本以为空无一物的荒凉行星上。
excerpt.en: While surveying [From.GetName], we uncovered a grotesque rock formation from what has been thought to be nothing but a barren planet.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表上一个小的矩形物体就像镜面一样反射各种探测射线。我们的探测器无法探测出其组成成分。
excerpt.en: A small rectangular object on the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is deflecting all scanning beams like a mirror. Our sensors are unable to determine its material composition.

excerpt.zh: 传感器显示，我们在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气内短暂探测到了一艘中型飞船。
excerpt.en: The sensor profile of a mid-sized vessel was briefly detected inside the upper atmosphere of this gas giant.

excerpt.zh: 此世界的上方静静地飘着一座远古轨道船坞。它在战争中严重受损，多个部位缺失。
excerpt.en: An ancient orbital shipyard drifts in silence above this world. It has suffered significant battle damage, and entire sections of the facility are missing.

excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
excerpt.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

excerpt.zh: 可以看到这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中发生了大风暴。进行深入研究可能十分有价值。
excerpt.en: Massive storms are visible in the upper atmosphere of this gas giant. It might be worth the effort to study them in more detail.

excerpt.zh: 扫描这颗恒星时发现一个小型物体。它处在高速轨道上，体积又实在太小，令探测器难以仔细分辨。
excerpt.en: Scanning the star unveils a small object in rapid orbit. Its small size and high velocity make it difficult for our sensors to isolate.

excerpt.zh: 异常读数表明，这座荒凉的星球或许不只是表面上看起来那样而已。
excerpt.en: Unusual readings suggest there may be more to this desolate world than meets the eye.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]表面被一种外形奇特的树木覆盖着。
excerpt.en: The surface of [Root.GetName] is dominated by particularly impressive-looking trees.

excerpt.zh: 扫描发现了一片来源不确定的残骸场。这会和在此恒星系中巡逻的被抛弃的科研船有关吗？
excerpt.en: Scans have identified a debris field of uncertain origin. Could this have something to do with the abandoned science ship patrolling the system?

excerpt.zh: 这颗行星有着令人难以置信的异乎寻常的美景。这到底是什么样的力量塑造而成的？
excerpt.en: This entire world is unusually picturesque - suspiciously so, perhaps. What forces are at work that could have caused this?

excerpt.zh: 你们非法入侵了我们，然后现在又一口一声朋友？呸！我们[contact_empire.GetName]会对你们种族保持警惕的。
excerpt.en: You hacked into us, and now you call us friend? Bah! The [contact_empire.GetName] will remain vigilant towards your kind.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。探测器显示，该新石器时代文明已经掌握了火的使用并发展出了基本的口语，但我们还未发现任何金属冶炼和书面交流的迹象。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
excerpt.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken

title.en: The Ransomeers: Picking Up the Pieces

excerpt.zh:
海盗的基地在我方飞船造成的连锁效应中缓慢地分崩离析。与此同时，我们开始了对卢克西昂号生还者的搜索。

如果他们真的上了救生艇，现在也该联络我们了……
excerpt.en:
As the pirate base slowly tears itself apart in a savage chain reaction instigated by our military vessels, the search for the captive crew of the Luxion begins.

If they made it to a lifeboat, they should be attempting to hail us by now...

excerpt.zh:
来自星辰各处的飞行员们齐聚方舟舰[Root.GetName]，参加一场盛大的比赛。比赛将持续近一恒星年，在此期间，参赛者们将围绕方舟舰和附近的星球进行紧密的轨道穿梭和圈数冲刺。

现在只剩下一个问题：我们预计谁会第一个冲过终点线？
excerpt.en:
Pilots from across the stars have gathered on Arkship [Root.GetName] for a grand race. It will run for almost one stellar year, during which time participants will thread tight orbits and launch laps around the Arkship and nearby celestial bodies.

One choice

excerpt.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
excerpt.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a signific

excerpt.zh: 感激……安全……奖励……
excerpt.en: gratefulness... safety... reward...

excerpt.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
excerpt.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a signific

excerpt.zh:
不稳定的引力异常正在从[From.System.GetName]的星界细缝中泄漏出来，显现为缓慢移动的奇点在附近空间中传播，然后剧烈地内爆。穿越这个恒星系的舰船可以避开它们，但必须小心谨慎地行驶。

进一步调查这种情况，可能能够发现稳定维度裂口的方法。
excerpt.en: Unstable gravitational anomalies are leaking out of the Astral Scar in [From.System.GetName], manifesting as slow-moving singularities that travel throughout nearby space before violently imploding. Ships passing through this system can avoid them, but must tr

excerpt.zh: 我们一直明目张胆地在[contact_empire_system.GetName]星系进行行动，对于隐藏自己的行动丝毫没有任何注意。尽管他们的技术水平不高，但是即使是[contact_empire.GetName]也注意到了我们的行动。现在第一次接触不可避免了。
excerpt.en: We have been careless, conducting operations in the [contact_empire_system.GetName] system without bothering to hide our activities. Despite their modest technology level, even the [contact_empire.GetName] have taken notice of our activity. First Contact is no

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的殖民者还会碰到分散在各地的残余变异生物，它们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]中断已久的改造进程完工后又出现了。虽然大部分人畜无害，当地部队可轻松解决，但其中一只却在偏远的居住站肆虐。据说它会跟踪我们的殖民者，而近来又有多起不明失踪事件。前往调查的安保部队的残尸最近才被发现，殖民地的领袖急切地请求军团援助。
excerpt.en: Our colonists on [Root.GetName] are still encountering scattered survivors from the mutated creatures that spawned after we finished the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s aborted terraforming process. Most are relatively harmless and can be put out of their misery by loc

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]殖民者发起的地质勘探发现了位于山脉内部的巨型避难所。所有证据都指出这个辐射避难所的建造者就是在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]发起古代核战的种群。避难所已封闭了数个世纪，但勘探仪器显示内部发出了微弱的信号。科学家们迫不及待想打开避难所大门，看看后面藏着什么。
excerpt.en: Geological surveys conducted by our colonists on [Root.GetName] have revealed a massive vault buried deep inside a mountain range. All evidence points towards this being some kind of fallout shelter built by the same species that perished in the [Root.GetPlane

excerpt.zh:
为了改善日常生活，[Root.GetName]的殖民者开始定期探索星球上的资源。最近一次北极探索时，在深海发现了一个巨大物体：一艘外星战列巡洋舰。

深海的压强可能会造成困难，但仍有可能打捞这艘沉船。
excerpt.en:
The colonizers on [Root.GetName] regularly explore the planet in hopes of finding more resources to help with day-to-day life. A recent expedition to the north pole has now unveiled a large object on the bottom of the ocean: An alien battle cruiser.

The press

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：真实之窗开启

excerpt.zh:
科研船原型机第一次清楚地出现在了我们的传感器上。它以极近的距离围绕着这个星系的恒星运转，不过其他地方并没有什么特别的。

只需简单的光学扫描，这艘船的秘密就暴露无遗。它的船身设计十分普通，没有什么独到之处。上面有许多十字形的金属网格，像是交流电压控制下的电磁铁。只要足够接近恒星，飞船就能稍微扭曲恒星发出的射线，将它们缠绕于自身附近，把自己伪装起来。

这个科技理论上听起来不错，但是实际应用中却有一些明显的问题。由于暴露在恒星的辐射中太久，它的整套设配都已经被烤焦而且变得毫无用处。
excerpt.en:
For the first time, the prototype Science Ship is plainly visible on sensors. It is orbiting dangerously close to the system's star, but appears otherwise unremarkable.

A simple optical scan reveals the ship's secret. Its hull is a standard design altered wit

excerpt.zh:
威胁首席科学官的那些阳炎海盗已经被消灭了，不过不是出自我们之手。

首席正在向我们致意。
excerpt.en:
The Sunblaster Pirates threatening the Head of Research have been destroyed by some hand not our own.

The Head Physicist is hailing us.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经找到风信子号了！该船正以稳定的轨道围绕[hyacinth_planet.GetName]运行。舰体内没有探测到能源特征，并且没有收到任何遇险信标。我们会派出一支武装登船部队进入内部调查。
excerpt.en: We have located the Hyacinth! The great arkship is parked in a stable orbit over [hyacinth_planet.GetName]. No power signatures have been detected from within its hull, and we are not picking up any distress beacons. An armed boarding party should be sent to i

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]核心内部有什么东西开始稳定地脉动，定期使地面产生轻微的颤动。那像是心跳一般的声音几乎令人感到宽慰。

但我们担心那声音可能变得越来越大。地质学家正在密切监测星球，留意危险的地质运动。
excerpt.en:
Something deep within the core of [From.GetName] has begun to pulsate at a steady pace, sending gentle ripples through the ground at regular intervals. It gives off a soft almost soothing sound, similar to that of a heart beating.

Concerns have been raised, h

excerpt.zh:
虚空孳孽蜷曲的身体发出一阵轻微的震颤，黑色液体从其伤口与鼻口中泄出，接着它便消逝了，眼睛茫然地凝视着虚空。

但愿我们永远不会见到它生长至成年期的样子，或是其生母的所在之处。

我们的科学家对研究其蛋壳保留能源的独特能力表示很感兴趣。
excerpt.en:
A light tremor passes through the Voidspawn's curled up body, ribbons of black fluid trailing from its wounds and snout, then it is gone, its liquid eyes staring emptily into space.

Hopefully we will never know the form it might have taken if allowed to reach

excerpt.zh: 用以决出联邦领袖的黄金律挑战赛将在数日后举行。由当前的联邦领袖开始，联邦中的每个帝国都有机会进行投标，直至仅剩一个参与国为止。这一投标国就是被选出的联邦领袖。
excerpt.en: In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the fed

excerpt.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上快速的科技进展催生了工业化的时代。交通方式的跃进式发展将此前星球上相对孤立的区域连成一片，创造了环球贸易和思想交流的机遇。

然而，资源的危机正在悄悄酝酿。如果其他星球上的历史也会重演的话，这里的人们很快就会陷入战争。
excerpt.en:
Rapid technological advances on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] are ushering in an age of industrialization. Breakthroughs in transportation have linked previously disconnected areas of the world, creating opportunity for global trade and the sharing of ideas.

H

excerpt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民已经开始积极地寻找他们星球之外的智慧生命迹象。随着他们准备大胆地前往许多文明已经拜访过的地方时，可能我们是时候要重新评估我们的第一次接触协议了，做好准备，让更广泛的星海共同体迎接新的成员。
excerpt.en: The inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have begun actively searching for signs of intelligent life beyond their world. As they prepare to boldly go where many have already gone, it may be time for us to reassess our first contact protocols, in preparation

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了报告，是关于在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上进行超光速航天器推进装置的事项。当地居民似乎打算成为一个彻底的太空文明。然而，他们在星空中发现的东西，可能会证明当下阶段他们还无法理解。
excerpt.en: We have received reports of superluminal spacecraft propulsion on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. The inhabitants seem intent on becoming a full-fledged spacefaring civilization. What they discover in the stars may prove too much for them to comprehend.

excerpt.zh:
天气条件：完美无瑕
核热火箭：燃料齐全
飞行计划：已优化

今天，当[pre_ftl_country.GetName]启动首次行星际任务时，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的所有广播都在播放这些指示。这些为了这项任务经过多年训练的航天员，于当地时间的今天早上登上了火箭。现在他们已经翱翔于那片我们和他们共享的天空。让我们追随他们的征程吧。
excerpt.en:
Weather Conditions: Flawless
Nuclear Thermal Rocket: Fully Fueled
Flight Plan: Optimized

These were the indicators broadcast all over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched its first interplanetary mission. The astronauts who

excerpt.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系的殖民地上抓获的人质从[abduction_planet.System.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。趁着夜色的掩护，他们设法降落在了星球的一个人迹罕至的地方，俘获了数名活体外星人，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的
excerpt.en: A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the world in the cover of da

excerpt.zh: 尽管我们尚未从位于[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘宇宙飞船处获取太多情报，当前最有力的假说——根据其自身的行为以及它发射的尚未破解的信号里暗含的模式——是这艘舰船属于某个未知的太空文明。我们正全力破解他们的语言，希望能够尽早建立沟通。
excerpt.en: Although we have been unable to discover much about the mysterious vessel in the [This.System.GetName] system, the most convincing current hypothesis - based upon its behavior and the patterns of the still undecipherable signals we have intercepted from it - i

excerpt.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的、美丽的、神奇的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

我们应该避免与它们接触，从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]远距离观察这些生物。
excerpt.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, wondrous, forms of spaceborne life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.Ge

excerpt.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，这说明它们也许是以生命形式存在的——这样的现象毫无疑问令人好奇，但我们得要小心处理。

我们最杰出且聪敏的科学家们都准备好研究这些实体了。
excerpt.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equal

excerpt.zh:
随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。

[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持星海共同体的创立吗？
excerpt.en: As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of

excerpt.zh:
我们在[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]内探测到了一个微弱的信号。基于初步的破译结果，我们相信这是某个失踪已久的海盗珍宝藏库。

尽管要费很多功夫，但相信我们能够发掘出其中的秘密。
excerpt.en:
We have detected a faint signal from somewhere on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]. Based on the rudimentary cryptography, we believe this to be from a long-lost pirate's Treasure Trove.

It will take some effort, but we're confident we would be ab

excerpt.zh:
结晶熵研究揭示惊天秘密：在高浓度下，该物质可被用于制造足以摧毁整颗行星的武器。若我方掌握此力量，整个星系或将归于我手。

但若追求军事应用，将破坏与邻邦脆弱信任。谁又能保证此武器不会反噬自身？

若望证我方意图，必须公然削弱星系熔炉核心，禁止生产此类武器。否则，终会有人将其用于杀戮，即我方或他人。

该抉择将解锁特殊项目。
excerpt.en:
Our continued research into Crystallized Entropy has unveiled a chilling possibility: when highly concentrated, they can power weapons of unimaginable scale, capable of devastating entire planets. With such power, the galaxy could fall under our mercy.

But ex

excerpt.zh:
噬星者已经被消灭，它的遗骸缩成一团并慢慢蒸发，只剩下它的卵鞘和消化系统及其中的恒星物质。

我们的一些科学家强烈要求我们去检测残余物质，另一些则希望能取回其卵鞘。或许它的消化系统蕴含着非常有用的知识，或者我们可以从其卵鞘中找到什么有趣的发现呢？
excerpt.en:
The Stellar Devourer has been vanquished. Its remains curled up and evaporated, leaving only its egg sac and its digestive system with the stellar matter it contains.

Some of our scientists have urged us to examine the remains, while others wish for us to ret

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。
excerpt.en:
Buried deep in the crust of [From.GetName] are the partial, fossilized remains of what appears to have been a close relative to the Ether Drake that once dwelled in the [From.GetStarName] system.

In the eons since this cousin-Drake's passing, its soft tissues

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。

Buried deep in the crust of [From.GetName] are the partial, fossilized remains of what appears to have been a close relative to the Ether Drake that once dwelled in the [From.GetStarName] system.

In the eons since this cousin-Drake's passing, its soft tissues

excerpt.zh:
[great_khan.GetName]，[From.GetName]的大可汗，[great_khan.GetHerHis]自吹自擂称自己是军事天才 ，却在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭受了可耻的失败。[great_khan.GetSheHe]指挥的舰队在与[khan_destroyer.GetName]的舰队交战中被击溃时，大可汗和[great_khan.GetHerHis]的侍从们却乘着小型运输机逃进超空间航道四散逃离。.

尽管到现在，[great_khan.GetName]仍在
excerpt.en: In spite of [great_khan.GetHerHis] vaunted military genius, [great_khan.GetName], the Great Khan of the [From.GetName], has met with defeat in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system. When the armada [great_khan.GetSheHe] [great_khan.GetWasWere] commanding was

excerpt.zh:
塞拉伦涅浮现出了一段新的记忆。她回想起一艘巨大的世代飞船，其船体旨在承载整个未来。

随后是一次剧烈的震动：警报声响起，远处走廊里金属炸裂的火光闪现。她记得自己被一位女子抱起，带进了一个逃生舱。

“她紧紧抱着我。她说我必须活下去……说我太重要了。接着我就孤身一人了。我几乎能看见她的脸庞，但每次它都悄然逝去。”
excerpt.en:
A new memory has surfaced for Seralune. She recalls a vast generational ship, its hull designed to hold entire futures.

Then a violent shudder: alarms, a flash of exploding metal in a distant corridor. She remembers being lifted by a woman and carried to an e

excerpt.zh:
欢迎收看“冠军之铸”现场秀！这里是全星系最顶尖的视觉与毁灭盛宴。

位于[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]星系的下一届冠铸秀现已开放报名。一场壮丽的大乱斗正等待着大家。

准入要求：一支规模最多[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模的舰队。

胜者将赢得奖励、名望以及至高无上的冠铸秀的大奖杯。

想要锻造属于你的传奇？那就报名参赛。

想要安宁与清静？没门！
excerpt.en:
This is Champion's Forge Live! The galaxy's premier source of spectacle and destruction.

Registration is now open for the next CFL Tournament in the [champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] System. A glorious free-for-all awaits.

Entry requirement: a fleet o

excerpt.zh: 我方特工已经开始接近目标驿站，并绘制了安全模式图，确定了进入位置。我们已准备好推进至下一阶段。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have made their initial approach to the target waystation. Security patterns have been mapped and entry vectors identified. We are ready to move to the next phase.

excerpt.zh:
天津四星系一片寂静。

“风信子”号脱离跃迁，发现没有信标，没有信号，也没有在星球间穿梭的飞船。奥林波斯星悬浮在半远处，庞大而冷漠。

有一颗卫星不对劲。殖民地的广播曾描述那里有绿色的大陆和广阔的水域，而扫描仪显示的却是一个死寂的世界——那是被核武器摧毁后的星球特有的无可错认的灰褐色。那里没有任何生命。

在近地轨道上，缓慢而暗淡地漂浮着的是“秋菊”号。它没有被毁。只是空无一人。每一扇舷窗都漆黑一片。这艘曾运载着二十五万殖民者来到这个世界的飞船，已经在这里停滞了数十年。
excerpt.en:
The Deneb system is quiet.

The Hyacinth drops from transit to find no beacons, no signals, no ships moving between worlds. Olympus hangs in the middle distance, enormous and indifferent.

One moon is wrong. Where the colony's broadcasts described green contin

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站上的小型天体实验室侦测到一颗4级小行星正在靠近。若不采取行动，它将会以相当大的力撞击到[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的[GetRandomCompassDirection]半球，足以造成灭绝级事件。

我们的任务是被动观察，通常情况下我们不允许进行干涉，但许多科学家认为在这种情况下应该破例。若不采取任何行动，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]注定将
excerpt.en: The small astrometric lab on our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected a Class-4 asteroid on an incoming trajectory. Unless action is taken, it will impact the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s [GetRandomCompassDirection] hemisphere

excerpt.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上发现了一位充满前途的[owner.GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]科学家。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap]杰出的研究远远领先于[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的同僚，其中一些科研成果即便以我们的标准来看待也是具有革命性的。

尽管[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的工作确实提升了[pre_ftl_co
excerpt.en: We have identified a scientist among the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shows great promise. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap] brilliant research is far ahead of [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] pee

excerpt.zh:
作为我们[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]观测计划的一部分，绑架小队通过外科手术的方式在一部分[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的脑内装入了植入体，以便追踪他们的位置，监视他们的行为。不幸的是，由于一些制造上的瑕疵，许多植入体失灵了，现在……我们的测试对象身上还出现了一些副作用。

有些测试对象自杀了，还有至少三个测试对象陷入了歇斯底里的暴力状态。我们观测站上的[root.GetResearcherPlural]请求协助，对剩余的测试对象进行管制，在更多事故发生之前移除他
excerpt.en: As part of our observation efforts on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], abduction teams have surgically installed brain implants on a number of [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects to track them and monitor their behavior. Unfortunately, due to a manufacturi

excerpt.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向[target.GetName]重大灾难。
excerpt.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw to

excerpt.zh:
一位位于[from.target.owner.GetName]的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。

他身受重伤，但还是勉力完成了任务，而且到目前为止仍未被发现。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们特工呆在他们那疗伤越久就越容易暴露。
excerpt.en:
An operative in the [from.target.owner.GetName] has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

Their injuries are severe, but our operative managed to complete their task and has maintained c

excerpt.zh: 我们的情报分析师将潜在目标的表单合并到一块之后，我们的独行特工开始渗透[target.GetName]。
excerpt.en: As our intelligence analysts put together lists of potential targets, individual operatives are beginning to infiltrate the [target.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在对[Root.Target.GetName]国内的数名关键外交要员进行投资，希望能够找到把柄以备未来之用。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are investigating key diplomatic actors within the [Root.Target.GetName], searching for hooks which we may be able to exploit.

excerpt.zh:
我们对利爪终号的联合研究得到了对这艘钢铁巨兽内部运作方式的独到见解。我们相信我们的研究团队跟利爪号的船员们通力合作将有可能进一步改进舰船的外部结构，让它面对攻击和船体破坏具有更强的抵抗力。

我们已经获得了斯克兰德的允许，但项目还需要更多资金。
excerpt.en: Our joint research on the Last Talon has given us unique insights into the inner workings of this behemoth. We believe that our engineering team, in cooperation with those aboard the Talon, have an opportunity to further improve the outer layers of the ship, m

excerpt.zh:
闪烁的屏幕上浮现出斯克兰德的指挥界面。这位舰队司令的羽翼蓬立，双眼发出锐利的目光。

这些……混账！他们只知道杀戮、破坏！

他愤怒地咬紧了喙，继续说。

我请求……不，我下令发起战争！我们不能让他们毁掉一切，让我们再次一无所有！我、我相信我们一起可以防止我人民所遭遇的悲剧再度重演。我已经准备好与你们分享我们所知道的一切。
excerpt.en:
The screen flickers as Skrand's command deck appears. The admiral's feathers are ruffled, his sharp eyes flashing.

These... outsiders! They came here only to kill, to destroy!

Clacking his beak furiously, he continues.

I request-- No, I DEMAND that we decla

excerpt.zh: 近期在基因工程方面的进展有助于重新恢复舰队司令斯克兰德的种族。也许暂时还不具有相应的基因多样性来确保他们继续繁衍，但用兼容的基因填补空白应该可以完成这项工作。我们现在只需要足够的资金就可以开始行动。
excerpt.en: Recent developments in genetic engineering could enable us to repopulate Admiral Skrand's species. We may lack the genetic diversity to make them fully capable of reproduction, but filling in the gaps with compatible genes should get the job done. All that is

excerpt.zh:
一群逃兵与叛徒在[pirate_system.GetName]星系安了家。这些亡命之徒驾驶着偷来并经过改装的舰船从我们的编队中溜走，如今正掠夺着维持我们航程的贸易航线。他们自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并发誓不效忠于任何旗帜。

他们出身于舰队，对我们的舰船、航线和行动模式了如指掌。绝不能任由他们继续壮大。
excerpt.en: A band of deserters and renegades has made its home in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. Slipping away from our formation in stolen and modified vessels, these outcasts now prey upon the trade lanes that sustain our journey. They call themselves the "[pirate

excerpt.zh: 我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]星系的贸易路线没有得到很好的保护，现在近乎变成了法外之地。该恒星系已经吸引了越来越多的海盗、走私贩以及其它各种不法分子，肆无忌惮地掠夺我们的货物。
excerpt.en: Our trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system is poorly protected and passes through what has largely become lawless space. An increasing number of pirates, smugglers and various other criminal elements have been drawn to the system, and they now raid

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

excerpt.zh: 我们的间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经整理总结了结果，事关我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上掩盖星际生命存在的行动。
excerpt.en: Our Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has outlined the results of our operation to cover up the existence of interstellar life on [target.capital_scope.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已尽其所能，将各种细小的技术进步播撒到[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。现在就看当地人如何连点成线，把量变转化成质变。他们已经做好了一切准备。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have done all they can, seeding various small technological advances into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society. It is up to the locals now to connect the dots, and assemble these small steps into a larger one. They are as ready as they'll ever be

excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
excerpt.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的地表正在对我们的建设活动表现出前所未有的反应。一种无法甄别的粘稠物质开始从关键设施的地基中渗出。

这种渗出物是一种深红色液体，外观呈胶状，摸起来极具粘性。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望进一步研究这种排放物。虽然目前它仅仅带来些许不便，但为确保[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的安全，最好还是谨慎行事。
excerpt.en:
The surface of [Root.GetName] is exhibiting an unprecedented reaction to our construction efforts. An unidentified viscous substance is beginning to ooze out from the foundations of key installations.

The ooze is some kind of crimson liquid; gelatinous in app

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.GetColonistPlural]汇报了关于[Root.GetName]上的沙子的奇特现象。

本该是风和日丽的一天我们定居点附近却唐突刮起剧烈的沙尘暴。如洪水般的流沙凭空出现又霎时消失无踪。甚至还有人在风平浪静的一天看到沙丘在横向移动。

这些事件至今没有找到任何气象或地理学的解释。

这些怪异的沙子没有造成直接的伤害，但妨碍到了我们殖民地的运作。对这一独特自然现象的研究仍在进行当中。
excerpt.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] are reporting strange phenomena with the sands on [Root.GetName].

Severe sandstorms materialize abruptly in close proximity to our colony on otherwise calm days. Rivers of fast-moving sand appear from nowhere before stopping as s

excerpt.zh: 虽然我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的契约本质是军事上的，但我们没有想到它会对我们产生如此恶劣的影响。我们的人民因宗主国的不断要求而受苦，我们的一些顾问推测，如果这种情况继续下去，将对我们的长期计划产生永久性影响。
excerpt.en: Though our agreement with [overlord_empire.GetName] is militaristic in nature, we did not expect the atrocious effects it would have on us. Our people are suffering with the constant demands from our overlord, and some of our advisors speculate that if it cont

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]表面炙热，不适宜生物生存。行星上明显的人工遗迹影像引起了[GetScientistPlural]的注意。考古调查或可揭示这里的居民和曾发生在他们身上的故事。
excerpt.en: The surface of [Planet.GetName] is scorching hot, and hostile to biological life. Images of clearly artificial ruins have therefore caught the attention of [GetScientistPlural]. An archaeological investigation could reveal who was here, and what happened to th

excerpt.zh: 远离[Planet.GetName]人口中心的活跃火山山脉中，一座古庙破败残存。了解其历史或能更深入了解当地文化。
excerpt.en: Far from the population centers of [Planet.GetName], in a range of active volcanic mountains, an ancient temple lies in ruins and disrepair. Understanding its history may grant us further insights into the planet's local culture.

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]抗拒着一切靠近者。指派到该项目的研究者开始编造借口拖延工作，而仪器则会出现类似拒绝接收数据一样的故障。

这里发生了一些事情——一些可怕的事情，它的回声至今仍在现实中回荡。
excerpt.en:
[From.Planet.GetName] repels all who approach. Researchers assigned to its study invent excuses to delay their work, while instruments glitch and fail as if rejecting the data itself.

Something happened here - something so horrific that its echoes still rever

excerpt.zh: 整个行星都被巨大的建筑物所覆盖着，这个遗落的大都会星肯定有秘密等待发掘。
excerpt.en: An entire planet covered in vast structures, this fallen megalopolis surely has secrets to be unearthed.

excerpt.zh: 在对[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的扫描中发现在这颗行星最难以靠近的区域有一座孤立的设施。这座结构似乎正在休眠或已被抛弃，其中没有任何能量迹象，看起来也饱经风霜。进行考古发掘可能会带来更深入的洞见。
excerpt.en: Scans of [fromfrom.planet.GetName] discovered an isolated facility in the planet's most inaccessible region. The structure appears to be dormant or abandoned, with no energy signature and signs of prolonged weathering. An archaeological expedition may yield fu

excerpt.zh:
与一个较小小行星的碰撞在[From.Planet.GetName]表面露出一个略微伸出的类似小型防爆门或者气闸室的东西。它似乎有着数千年的历史，先前一直被岩石和尘土所掩盖。

由于未知原因，我们的扫描无法穿透到小行星的内部，并且常规切割工具也无法对防爆门造成影响。为了了解这扇门的背后有什么，我们的团队或许不得不从另一个方向向小行星的中心挖掘。
excerpt.en:
A collision with a smaller asteroid has revealed a small blast door or airlock extending slightly from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It appears to be thousands of years old, and had previously been concealed by rocks and dust.

For unknown reasons, sca

excerpt.zh:
来自[From.Planet.GetName]的探测读数显示，这颗星球曾经郁郁葱葱，被繁茂的植被所覆盖。然而现在一切皆为过往云烟，它只不过是一块荒芜光秃的巨岩。

虽然缺乏任何值得注意的构造运动，但使用感应器对这颗行星进行扫描之后，设备记录了下令人困惑的数据。数据表明，有东西正在在地下移动，绝对是一个“庞然大物”。这个发现值得我们进行深入调查。
excerpt.en:
Readings from [From.Planet.GetName] reveal that it was once mostly covered in lush vegetation. Now the forlorn orb is little more than a barren rock.

Despite lacking any noteworthy tectonic activity, sensory scans of the planet have registered puzzling seismo

excerpt.zh: 探测器在[From.Planet.GetName]的冰雪之下探测到了一座隐藏的设施。部分坍塌与阻塞的隧道似乎组成了连接各种地下结构的巨大网络
excerpt.en: Scanners detect a hidden complex buried beneath the ice and snow of [From.Planet.GetName]. A large network of partially-collapsed or blocked tunnels seems to connect the various underground structures.

excerpt.zh: 即使用肉眼也很容易看出，[From.Planet.GetName]的地表上部分区域的地形极不规整。光滑的弧面上唐突地出现了一个巨大的球形凸起。也许在过去某一时刻，一颗卫星亦或是一颗巨大的小行星与这颗行星发生了碰撞，但碰撞的方式一定相当微妙，碰撞并未撕裂这颗行星，而仅仅是使不速之客寄宿在了行星地壳内部。
excerpt.en: Even with the naked eye it is easy to see something highly irregular in the shape of [From.Planet.GetName]. The smooth curvature of the surface is suddenly interrupted by a gigantic spherical bump. At some point a moon or large asteroid collided with the plane

excerpt.zh: 传感器在一簇小行星内检测到了能量读数。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: Sensors have detected energy readings in a cluster of asteroids. Further investigation is recommended.

excerpt.zh:
一座大型废弃空间站被困在这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部，向着巨行星内部缓慢下坠。其自重很可能在下一个千年里彻底毁坏这个空间站。

好在该空间站飘入大气层还不太深，我们仍有可能对其开展考古行动。
excerpt.en:
A large derelict space station is trapped in a slow terminal orbit inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. The gravitational stresses will likely destroy it completely within the next thousand years.

It has not yet drifted deep enough into the atmosphere to

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]的整个表面如同伤疤般布满了又长又浅的运河。它们随意地交错穿插，布局上没有明显的逻辑。目前还不确定它们是否是一种不寻常的自然特征，又或是别的什么。

需要进行一次地面考察以查明更多的情况。
excerpt.en:
The entire surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is scarred by long, shallow canals. They cross and re-cross each other haphazardly, with no apparent logic to their layout. It is as yet uncertain if they are an unusual natural feature, or something else.

A surface

excerpt.zh: 一座破旧的观测站围绕着[big_rip_planet.GetName]旋转，但地表上并没有智慧生命存在的迹象。进一步调查或许可以得知原因。
excerpt.en: A tattered old observation post circles [big_rip_planet.GetName] but there are no signs of intelligent life on its surface. Closer investigation may give us the answer to why.

excerpt.zh: 传感器表明在[Root.GetName]地表存在有潜在价值的发现。
excerpt.en: Sensors register potential finds on the surface of [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上有一系列撞击坑。但在其中较大的一个坑里，有什么东西带来了视觉上的不一致感……
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] is home to a number of exquisite impact craters. However, something breaks the visual uniformity in one of the larger craters...

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一个时空中的异常裂缝。我们越靠近，已知的物理相对论定律越不适用。

研究这一现象很可能将推动我们对宇宙机制的科学理解提升到一个更高的水平。
excerpt.en:
We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. The closer we get, the less the known laws of physical relativity hold purchase.

Studying this phenomenon could very well push our scientific understanding of the mechanics of the universe to a higher le

excerpt.zh: 我们的扫描仪检测到了[from.System.GetName]恒星系中黑洞的物理特性与预期相比存在显著偏差。它的引力不可预测的，这导致空间中一个点到另一个点在时间上表现出显著的不一致性。
excerpt.en: Our scanners have detected significant deviations from the expected physical properties of the black hole in the [from.System.GetName] system. Its gravitational forces are unpredictable, resulting in noticeable temporal inconsistencies from one point in space

excerpt.zh: 有一个小型货舱被遗落在了这颗气态巨行星的上方空间。它被行星的重力所捕获，最终将被拖入其大气。
excerpt.en: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示这是一颗死亡行星，它曾经是气态巨行星，但大气层被[from.System.Star.GetName]强烈的辐射剥离了。

尽管如此，它的地表上还是探测到了非常痕量的生物质，需要进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
Surveys of [from.GetName] reveal it to be a chthonian planet, a former gas giant stripped of its atmosphere by the intense radiation of [from.System.Star.GetName].

Despite this, very faint traces of biomass have been detected on its surface, warranting furthe

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]恒星系中发现了一颗红色的行星，颜色很深。我们应该对此开展调查。
excerpt.en: A scarlet planet was surveyed in the [From.GetStarName] system. The intensity of the color is remarkable. We should investigate.

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的质量扫描发现对流层下层有大量快速移动的物质。

如果没有更详细的调查，这些异常读数的来源很难加以确认。
excerpt.en:
Mass scans of [from.GetName] reveal high concentrations of fast moving physical matter located deep within the lower troposphere.

The source of these unusual readings is difficult to verify without further detailed investigation.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]所在的残骸场在某种未知力量的影响下翻滚。
excerpt.en: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.

excerpt.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
excerpt.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。
excerpt.en: Highly irregular gravitational readings surround [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]轨道上检测到了不明来源舰体的遗骸。
excerpt.en: Sensors report a shipwreck of unidentified origin has been sighted in orbit of [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 扫描显示在[Root.GetName]众多冰封的山巅之上存在异乎寻常的外星造物。
excerpt.en: Scans indicate the presence of a foreign, alien-made object on one of [Root.GetName]'s many frozen mountain tops.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的大气主要由各种气态金属构成。进一步了解这颗行星的严苛条件后我们或许就能提取这些有价值的化合物。
excerpt.en: The atmosphere of [from.GetName] is primarily composed of various metals in a gaseous state. With better understanding of this planet's harsh conditions we may be able to extract these valuable compounds.

excerpt.zh: 我们的科研团队调查到了一些“谜团”。需要得到这种现象的更多细节，才能真正解开这个谜团。
excerpt.en: Our survey has uncovered something that can only be described by the science team as "mystical." We would need to investigate the phenomenon in more detail to unshroud this mystery.

excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]的地质扫描表明这颗熔融星球的地壳承受着非常巨大的构造应力。可能有重大的地质事件即将发生。
excerpt.en: Geological scans of [from.GetName] suggest that the planetary crust of this molten world is under immense pressure from pent-up tectonic forces. A significant geological event may be imminent.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]外层气体的怪异活动打开了一些极深的开口，短暂地暴露出行星的固体核心。这一独特现象值得进一步研究。
excerpt.en: Strange movements in [from.GetName]'s gassy outer layers are causing exceptionally deep vents to open up, exposing the planet's solid core in brief intervals. This remarkable phenomenon warrants further study.

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示了大面积快速迁移的高压力风暴。

这些风暴释放着极强的热信号。需要着重研究才能揭示该现象是自然发生或是由某种至今未知的生命形式引起。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] show vast swathes of rapidly migrating high-pressure storms.

These storms are emitting extremely volatile heat signatures. Focused research will be needed to reveal if the cause is natural or a hitherto unknown form of life.

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示熔融行星的表面持续不断地在长距离漂移。

需要进行近距离研究才能理解这一异常地理现象。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] show sections of the molten planetary surface shifting continuously across large distances.

Closer study is required to understand this unusual geological phenomenon.

excerpt.zh:
[from.System.GetName]内的公转周期展现出了引人注目的规律。每颗环绕恒星的行星都以两倍其相邻行星的周期公转着，精确到千分之一秒。

这种怪异的精确比值值得调查。
excerpt.en:
Orbital durations in the [from.System.GetName] system exhibit a remarkable pattern. Each planet orbits the star in exactly double the time of its neighbor, accurate to over a thousandth of a second.

This anomalously perfect ratio warrants investigation.

excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的成分与周围的小行星大不相同。它的起源可能与小行星带上的其他小行星截然不同，应该进行更进一步的研究。
excerpt.en: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的地表上出现了奇怪的图案，从太空中都可以明显观察到。
excerpt.en: Strange patterns, clearly visible even from space, are forming across the surface of [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的上层大气中悬浮着一系列大型圆柱体机械。其中没有任何操作员，看起来未在运转。
excerpt.en: Suspended within the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName] is a series of large cylindrical machines. They appear inactive devoid of any crew.

excerpt.zh: 在[from.GetName]的上层大气探测到了高浓度的毒性有机分子。
excerpt.en: High concentrations of organic poisonous molecules have been detected in the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 根据初步扫描，[Root.GetName]有一些奇怪的特性，它的读数与我们对此类行星的预估相去甚远……
excerpt.en: According to preliminary scans, [Root.GetName] is exhibiting several strange properties and gives readings that are not at all in line with what one would expect from a planet of this type...

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]在初步扫描后发现一艘全副武装的舰船正位于小行星带的轨道中，我们必须小心行事。
excerpt.en: Preliminary scans of [From.GetName] indicate that a heavily-armed vessel is in orbit of the asteroid. It would be wise to proceed with caution.

excerpt.zh: 我的探测器从宇宙风暴的余波中在[solar_system.GetName]星系发现了三个缇扬奇信号。
excerpt.en: In the aftermath of the Cosmic Storm our sensors have detected three Tiyanki signatures in the [solar_system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的探测器发现一个近期被[from.GetAffectedStormType]带进这个恒星系的不明物体。

需要近距离调查以验证该异常物体的本质。
excerpt.en:
Sensors in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have detected an unknown object brought into the system by the recent [from.GetAffectedStormType].

Closer inspection is needed to verify the nature of the anomaly.

excerpt.zh: 我们探测到了奇怪的宇宙射线，科学专员要求对其进行调查。
excerpt.en: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.

excerpt.zh: 一颗环绕着此气态巨行星的小型卫星似乎很快就要撞上这个巨行星了。
excerpt.en: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]附近突然探测到一处激增的辐射。调查时得多加小心。
excerpt.en: A significant spike in radiation has been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Proceed with caution when investigating.

excerpt.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示[Root.GetName]的剧毒大气之下存在珍贵物质。
excerpt.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances beneath [Root.GetName]'s noxious clouds.

excerpt.zh: 我们碰巧收到来自[From.GetName]上的某个地方的加密讯息。
excerpt.en: We have come upon an encrypted datastream transmitting from a location on [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出那颗恒星周围确实环行着另一个与未叙尊者的神龛别无二致的物体。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system. Its crew reports the star is indeed orbited by another object not dissimilar to the shrine of the Untold.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出另一个在轨道上的物体与未叙尊者的古龛有很高的相似性。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system, where its crew report another object in orbit bearing strong resemblance to a shrine to the Untold.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员们本以为搜寻洞察女神的神殿会更费功夫一些，没想到刚一进入[Root.GetStarName]就看到了非常明显的指引。这个星系中的星体上被雕刻着人工矿物的图案，纷纷指向了一片中央区域。
excerpt.en: Expecting perhaps for a more difficult search when scanning for the shrine to the Percipient, the crew of [Root.GetName] were not ready to see it obviously signposted when entering [Root.GetStarName]. Artificial mineral patterns have been carved around on stel

excerpt.zh: 我们找到了正确的恒星系！这颗恒星的辐射数据和之前遇到的完全一致。我们制定了一个特殊项目来对这颗恒星进行研究。
excerpt.en: We seem to have found the right system! The radiation data of the local star match the ones previously encountered. A Special Project has been issued to perform research on the star.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]舰上引擎突然发生的激增使方舟舰的驱动核心超出了安全运行公差。热点正在主引擎组件中蔓延，压力上升的速度超过了调节系统的补偿能力。

如果不加控制，过剩的输出可能会损坏关键的引擎部件。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]建议了几种可能的对策：排放多余的等离子体以稳定系统，重新分配工作任务优先级，或者暂时关闭引擎进行全面重新校准。
excerpt.en:
A sudden engine surge aboard [Root.GetName] has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.

If left

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]方舟舰内部环境传感器测得空气中挥发性化合物含量升高。船员，特别是舰桥上的船员，报告了与轻度毒性接触相符的症状：恶心、定向障碍和持续性神经性疼痛。

尝试通过标准通风协议清除污染物并无效果。腐臭气味弥漫在走廊中，无法被过滤，并加剧了船员的不适。我们的工程报告还标记了飞船废物处理系统的不规则性，表明可能存在迫在眉睫的系统故障。

有必要迅速展开调查。
excerpt.en: Internal environmental sensors aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] have registered elevated levels of volatile airborne compounds. The crew, particularly those stationed on the bridge, have reported symptoms consistent with low-grade toxic exposure: nausea, diso

excerpt.zh:
在穿过[solar_system.GetName]星系的行星带时，我们观察到在碎片中漂浮着几个闪烁着微光的天体。初步扫描显示它们是形状不规则的小行星，但通过进一步的近距离观察，我们发现它们存在层状的鳞片式结构，这些结构在恒星光芒的照射下反射出不断变幻的色带。

进一步的分析表明，这些碎片部分源自矿物，部分源自生物。它们看起来像是一头以太巨龙的残骸，这头巨龙似乎被一颗小行星撞击，在离开该星系之前失去了部分装甲外皮。星光照耀在这些被丢弃的鳞片上，将棱镜般的七彩光芒洒落在方舟舰上。
excerpt.en: While passing through the planetary belt in the [solar_system.GetName] system, we observed several faintly shimmering objects drifting among the debris. Initial scans suggested irregular asteroids, but closer inspection revealed layered, scale-like structures

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上正在开展常规审计，结果发现了货物记录中存在差异。

监控录像显示，方舟舰居民中已经形成了一个非正式的交换网络。一个以物易物的系统在船员和定居者之间悄然兴起。易腐物品、工具、奢侈品和个人服务在监控有限的僻静角落被进行交易。

这一发现引发了一些令人不安的问题。有人赞赏其中展现出的聪明才智；而另一些人则警告说，方舟舰上的任何监管疏忽都可能带来严重的风险。
excerpt.en:
A routine audit aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has uncovered discrepancies in our cargo records.

Security footage indicates the formation of an informal exchange network among the Arkship's residents. A barter system has quietly emerged among crew and civilian

excerpt.zh:
自方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，集体意识中便掀起了阵阵波动。曾经完美同步的节点已开始失去协调性。随着冲动无法在格式塔意识中清晰传播，记忆正变得支离破碎。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它正在干扰将我们联结在一起的神经通路。原本应当流畅无阻的集体意识，如今却变得断断续续、支离破碎。
excerpt.en: Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, disturbances have rippled through the shared consciousness. Nodes that were once in perfect synchrony have begun losing coherence. Memories grow fragmented as impulses fail to propagate cleanly through the

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰已抵达[solar_system.GetName]。

据报告，自从远程传感器解析出该恒星系以后，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]就一直没有离开过观测平台。当地政府已表示欢迎。
excerpt.en:
The Arkship has arrived at [solar_system.GetName].

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has reportedly not left the observation deck since the system resolved on the long-range sensors. The local government has extended a welcome.

excerpt.zh: 这什么意思？你是谁？你这个大骗子，毫无疑问。根本没有什么外星人！
excerpt.en: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!

excerpt.zh: 在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。
excerpt.en: Our infiltrated bodies will need to be placed in strategic locations before we can enact our grand design. Our earlier intel gathering revealed understaffed starbases and poorly defended planets as prime targets. Soon we will get to work.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经建立了许多前线和藏身处来监控[target.GetName]上的人口。对异见者、孤独者，或高技能人才将进行评估和标记，以便我们获取。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have established a number of fronts and hideouts from which they monitor the population of the [target.GetName]. Dissidents, loners, or highly skilled individuals will be assessed and marked for extraction.

excerpt.zh: 我们已消灭行商联盟之家——贸易空间站堂吉。这些贪婪害虫完蛋了！
excerpt.en: We have crushed the profiteering vermin that called Tradestation Tungle home. The Caravansary Caravan Coalition is no more!

excerpt.zh:
在我们社会中一些不守规矩的份子倡议在我们整个家园松绑一些规制，在首都造成了不小的骚乱。伟大的存在正计划把这些份子转移到外部世界，这样它们就不能对我们的边界和我们人民的和谐再构成任何威胁。

如果你们能接纳这些被流放者将会对我们有很大帮助。
excerpt.en: Several unruly elements in our society are advocating for easing the restrictions on entering our homeland, causing quite a ruckus in the capital. The Great One is looking to move these elements into foreign lands, so they will no longer pose a threat to our b

excerpt.zh:
我们最近在我们最大的城市之一发生了一长小型灾难，并迅速制造了难以言说的毁坏。为了将其修复如初，我们正寻找愿意向我们贡献材料的人，让我们开始重建工作。

当然，我们会慷慨地想愿意帮助我们的人支付酬劳。不仅如此，我们还可以派出一队工程师与你们的人民分享我们的一部分秘密。
excerpt.en:
We have recently seen a small calamity happen in one of our greatest cities, leaving untold destruction in its wake. To restore it to former glory, we are looking for people willing to send materials our way, so we can begin the reconstruction.

We will, of co

excerpt.zh: 一位我们的首席科学官对你们的帝国产生了浓厚的兴趣，虽然很难说你们到底能提供什么我们帝国所没有的。但无论如何，他们希望能宜居你们国家并向你们中最杰出的人学习。
excerpt.en: One of our foremost scientists has taken a particular interest in your empire, though it is hard to say what you could offer that we of the Empire could not. In any case, they seek to move to your country and learn from your best.

excerpt.zh:
在我们探索[Root.GetName]上靠近我们居住站的废墟时。一些殖民者无意中激活了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上以前使用核武的战争中遗留下来的未引爆的核聚变武器上的计时器。

这个大约35兆吨当量的核心炸弹一旦引爆，附近的数个居住站将从地图上被抹去。此核聚变武器极度不稳定所以无法去挪移，我们也没有足够的时间去撤离这个区域。
excerpt.en:
While exploring some ruins near one of our major settlements on [Root.GetName], a few colonists inadvertently activated the timer on an undetonated hydrogen bomb left over from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s previous nuclear war.

With an estimated yield of 35 meg

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上定居了一段时间之后，我们收集到了一些奇怪的数据。具体来讲，[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]的地质构成似乎与[Root.GetName]大相径庭。这意味着它不是与星球同时形成的，而是原本在别处形成，后来不知怎的被[Root.GetName]的重力场捕获了。至于[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]到底源自何处仍是个谜。
excerpt.en: Now that [Root.GetName] has been settled for a while, some data irregularities have been noticed. Specifically, the moon [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] does not seem to be made of remotely similar material to [Root.GetName]. This suggests it was not f

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的构造变动导致一个巨大板块上的黑曜岩薄层破碎。熔岩倾泻而出遍布地表，造成了毁灭性的影响。从殖民地发回的报告相当可怕。
excerpt.en: Tectonic events on [Root.GetName] have caused the Obsidian sheets on one of the giant plates to shatter. Lava pours across the surface to ruinous effect. Reports from the colony are dire.

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：毁坏的无人机

excerpt.zh:
这些无人机的敌我识别系统的模组被拆除了，应该是首席干的。不过它们的威胁评估处理器还完好无损。由于此人的破坏行为，威胁等级有些升高。

首席科学官不像是想让它们攻击我们，但是它们很好地掩护了首席，让其成功逃走了。

查看情报日志的特殊项目，以获得首席最后一次出现的位置。
excerpt.en:
The drones' IFF modules had been removed, likely a result of the Head Researcher's repairs, but their threat assessment processors remained intact and somewhat stressed by the Head's invasive procedures.

It is unlikely that the head meant for the drones to at

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：无人机被击毁

excerpt.zh:
科学家留下的无人机似乎被某个人或者是某个东西击毁了。

我们应该抓住这个机会，寻找有关首席的线索。

一个特殊项目已经添加到情报日志中。
excerpt.en:
It seems the drones left behind by the Researcher have been destroyed, by something or someone.

We should seize this opportunity to pick up the Head's trail.

A Special Project has been added to the Situation Log.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，我看到您一下子就除掉了那些海盗。

作为一名科学家，我痛恨争斗……但我也深知在那种情形下这是必需的。如果我落入那些海盗之手，想必待遇不会太好。
excerpt.en:
I see you made short work of the pirates, [Root.GetRulerTitle].
As a scientist, I abhor violence... But recognize that it may have been necessary in this case. I strongly suspect I would have been treated less than kindly at the hands of those pirates.

excerpt.zh: 在[marauder_system.GetName]星系流窜的异教徒已经被击败。
excerpt.en: The cultist fleet operating in the [marauder_system.GetName] system has been destroyed in battle.

excerpt.zh:
我们找到失联的探测器了！我们在[From.GetName]星系探测到了一支临时拼凑的小型舰队，其中一艘飞船用短距离牵引光束锁住了探测器。

他们正在呼唤我们。
excerpt.en:
We have found our missing probe! A small fleet of jury-rigged ships has been detected in the [From.GetName] system, and one of them has the probe locked in a short-range tractor beam.

They are hailing us.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经在[this.GetName]中发现了这艘不祥的舰船。
excerpt.en: The ominous ship has been sighted in [this.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 紧随着最近过境的电力风暴，在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表之下探测到了一场难以解释的能量骤增。进一步扫描发现了一座古老的地下复合体，其中的发电机被风暴重新激活，让这座设施又开始了运作。
excerpt.en: Following the passing of a recent Electric Storm, an unexplained power surge was detected beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Further scans revealed an aging subterranean complex whose power generators were reactivated by the storm, bringing the faci

excerpt.zh:
终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
excerpt.en:
At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, we have been

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]表面正呈现出在超强耀斑出现之前所特有的动荡现象。考虑到[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]远古文明的命运，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在争分夺秒设计一个护盾矩阵来抵挡即将到来的巨量等离子喷发。
excerpt.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [Root.GetStarName] is exhibiting surface turbulence typical to that preceding a superflare. Considering the fate of the ancient civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are scr

excerpt.zh:
仅仅过了一年之久，在[hatchling_egg.GetName]上新成立的殖民地就发生了一系列灾难性的大地震，将地貌变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

这种地震现象通常是由地幔内的岩浆流造成的，但在[From.GetName]上根本没有地震活动，除了从地核里发出的不祥震动之外。当地行政机构已开始怀疑殖民地的长期可行性。
excerpt.en: Barely a year old, the newly established colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has been shaken by a series of devastating earthquakes that are transforming the environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming a

excerpt.zh:
一个管状外星实体已经进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，而毫无预警或解释。它似乎不靠任何引擎或是推进器就能移动，完全无声地在虚空中滑行，其圆柱体不祥地旋转着。

尽管它没有表现出任何敌意，但也并未回应我们的呼叫。我们的军团顾问警告说，它可能会对下面的居民造成严重威胁，并恳求我们动手将它消灭。但我们的科学家则请求研究这一非凡的科技。
excerpt.en:
A tubular alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName], with no warning or explanation. It appears to be moving without engines or thrusters, gliding in complete silence through the void of space, cylinders rotating ominously.

Though it has yet to display

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.Owner.GetName]，但没有任何人比科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]更加痛心。是[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe]第一个发现了迷失无助的变形虫幼体，并见证了它在[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer]自己温柔的教导下逐渐步入成年。

现在，失去了[Root.Fleet.GetName]无言的陪伴，科学专员[amoeba_findi
excerpt.en: News of the death of [Root.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.Owner.GetName], though none have been as affected as Science Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]. It was [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe] who first discovered the Space Amoeba as

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

excerpt.zh:
自由重新回到了全星系！星海帝国终于陨落了，最后一个帝制派也向日益壮大的义军投降了。

随着[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]被罢黜，过去的星海共同体重回生机。时间将会证明重建起的制度是否能够防止下一位星系独裁者的诞生，但现在，过去帝国的疆域里的各个行星上同时掀起了庆祝活动。
excerpt.en:
Freedom has been restored to the galaxy! The Galactic Imperium has fallen, and the last of the Imperial loyalists have surrendered to the advancing Rebel forces.

With the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] deposed, the old Galactic Community has been resurrected. Ti

excerpt.zh:
[attacking_country.GetName]攻击了[victim_country.GetName]！帝国的成员国收到外部势力的攻击需要[Root.GetRulerTitle]的立即反应。

[Root.GetName]需要介入这场战争吗？帝国的其他成员都在翘首以盼。
excerpt.en:
The [attacking_country.GetName] has attacked the [victim_country.GetName]! This attack on an Imperial member state by an outside power requires an immediate response from the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Should the [Root.GetName] intervene in this war? The rest of t

excerpt.zh:
随着[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]中的战斗进入尾声，一份来自客服无人机的新信息显示到了我们的屏幕上。

“我们留意到您对我方最终用户许可协议强制执行抗拒。由于您展现出压倒性军事力量，我们现正式废除对MKIII地质辐射矩阵的知识产权声索。我们希望您能在使用这一新科技的过程中获得快乐。”

无人机发生了爆炸，同时切断了通讯链接。
excerpt.en:
As the battle draws to a close in [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName], a new communication from the customer service drone plays on our screens.

"We have noted your objection to our efforts to enforce the terms of the End User License Agreement. As a result of yo

excerpt.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
excerpt.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

excerpt.zh:
马上就要到决定谁将在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的时间了。如我们先前同意过的，我们将通过徒手近距离搏斗决定领袖。

每个成员国的领袖将被带到位于[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，我们当前主席国[fed_leader.GetName]的一个大型竞技场。在那里，一场面向全[Root.GetAllianceName]广播的比赛即将展开，他们将相互战斗，至死方休，直到仅剩一人存留。
excerpt.en:
It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.

The leader of each member nation will soon be brought

excerpt.zh:
访问者：欢迎来到温科沃特。无论您是慕名已久还是故地重游，我们都非常乐意为您的花园之旅提供帮助。

谨代表园丁并根据WAPP-715号命令，请不要擅自闯入指定的温科沃特美术堂生物区。不遵守我们的指引将会降低所有相关人员的生存机会。
excerpt.en:
Visiting entity: welcome to Wenkwort. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.

On behalf of the Gardeners and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intru

excerpt.zh:
在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上，居民们正在使用原始的雕刻图画来表达和分享想法。我们的研究人员记录的样本表明，居民对他们自己星球以外的天体有认识，甚至已经开始记录星座。

对于这样一个年轻的文明来说，他们早期绘制的星图是相当准确的，但也不至于到了无法改进的地步，只要我们想留下一些暗示……
excerpt.en: On [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], the inhabitants are using crudely carved imagery to express and share ideas. Samples documented by our researchers indicate that the inhabitants have an awareness of celestial bodies beyond their own planet, and have even begun

excerpt.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]科学技术得到了进一步的发展，因为工业化使他们的社会达到了新的高度。他们在工程方面的最新突破彻底改变了他们对交通的运用，这使他们离行星统一更近了一步。

与我们模型预期的不同，[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]现在成为了一个统一的星球。他们将资源统一调配，人们则将为整个星球的社区的福祉作为首要任务，生活水平大幅提升。
excerpt.en: Technology continues to progress on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], as industrialization takes their society to new heights. Their most recent breakthrough in engineering has revolutionized their use of transportation and brought them a step closer to planetary

excerpt.zh:
在一个有趣的跨文化交流例子中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上相当数量的年轻人对[owner.GetAdj]的所有事物产生了消费性的兴趣。这些充满激情的年轻人急切地争抢与我们文化相关的任何东西，现在他们构成了这颗星球上一个充满活力和不断发展的亚文化群体。

我们甚至得知即将到来的粉丝大会将举办一场服装大赛。
excerpt.en: In an amusing example of cross-cultural exchange, a significant number of young people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have developed a consuming interest in all things [owner.GetAdj]. Eagerly snatching up anything even remotely connected to our culture, these pas

excerpt.zh: 自己在宇宙中并不孤单，这一发现让[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]上的许多人感到震惊。毫不奇怪，这一事件产生了严重的经济影响。随着整颗星球上的金融机构暴跌不止，生活水平明显下降。
excerpt.en: The revelation that they were not alone in the universe came as a shock to many on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]. Not surprisingly, the event has had severe economic effects. With financial institutions across the planet in free-fall, there has been a mark

excerpt.zh:
随着我们进一步调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]——我们现在知道是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]——我们终于知道他们使用的短语常常用典于在过去一些时间点上发生的重大的、知名的事件。这些典故的意味在他们族人内部显然是广为人知的，可以用于表达一种情感，或描述事务的状态。

幸运的是，看上去这种形式的语言并不是唯一的版本，仅仅作为“高端腔”，用于官方的场合或者智者之间的交流。一种更加广泛的“低端腔”文法在非正式的场合被频繁使用，特别是在年轻人或者文化水平不高
excerpt.en: As we continued to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - it became clear that the phrases they use are references to significant, well-known events that happened at some point in their pas

excerpt.zh:
生活在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]星系的缇扬奇的行为与该物种的已知行为模式并不一致。缇扬奇通常是迁徙性的，而这群缇扬奇却紧紧守在一颗满是他们同类尸体的行星周围。

它们遮天蔽日的触手阻碍了对这个坟地的研究，除非我们将它们引走或者处置掉，否则进一步的调查难以进行。
excerpt.en: The actions of the Tiyanki inhabiting the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system do not match known behavior patterns for their species. While Tiyanki are usually nomadic, these herds remain stationed around a planet entirely covered in the carcasses of the

excerpt.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]中的小行星只是一只栖居在里面的巨大有机体的外壳。

我们成功地将其摧毁，并找回了[this.GetName]。此后调查小行星的时候可得小心了。

可能还有其他的这种生物潜藏于此，等待着不小心的猎物。不幸的是，[leader.GetName]遭受到了一些不可修复的损伤。
excerpt.en:
The asteroid in [fromfrom.GetName] served only as a shell for a massive organism living inside.

We have successfully destroyed it and recovered [this.GetName]. Caution should be taken in further investigations of asteroids.

More of these creatures may be out

excerpt.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]中的小行星只是一只栖居在里面的巨大有机体的外壳。

我们成功地将其摧毁，并找回了[this.GetName]。此后调查小行星的时候可得小心了。

可能还有其他的这种生物潜藏于此，等待着不小心的猎物。不幸的是，[leader.GetName]遭受到了一些不可修复的损伤。
excerpt.en:
The asteroid in [fromfrom.GetName] served only as a shell for a massive organism living inside.

We have successfully destroyed it and recovered [this.GetName]. Caution should be taken in further investigations of asteroids.

More of these creatures may be out

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢被[from.GetName]摧毁。

不幸的是，有部分高价值标本无法取回。
我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。

我需要在另一个恒星系中重建博物天枢让标本展览得以继续。
excerpt.en:
Our Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] has been destroyed by [from.GetName].

Unfortunately, we were unable to recover some of our valuable Specimens.
Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive stat

excerpt.zh:
[GetCuratorsDesignation]留意到了你们在收集保存异星奇景标本方面的审慎努力。一石一世界，一晶一星河。

[GetStage1Description]

愿它成为你们继续伟大事业的动力。
excerpt.en:
[GetCuratorsDesignation] noticed your careful efforts in the collecting and preserving of Xeno Geology specimens. The story of our galaxy is often hidden inside its rock and stone.

[GetStage1Description]

Let this be an incentive for you to continue your grea

excerpt.zh:
有人可能认为没人愿意靠近奔涌的开放熔岩流，可在[planet.GetName]则不然。

殖民者驾驶悬浮艇沿活跃的熔岩流竞速，躲避漂浮巨石，加速越过熔岩瀑布。有人押注赛果，赌馆甚至吸引了有组织犯罪。少数飞行员甚至在各种事故中丧生。

法律对此行为并无禁止，因为从未想过有人会如此冒险。我们可以纵容殖民者的热情，任其自由，但随着赌博活动日益猖獗，这可能引发更危险的行为乃至犯罪。或者，我们可以规范这项运动，虽会引来抱怨，但长远看可减少伤亡与犯罪。还可以直接全面禁止，虽能奏效，但执行成本高昂。
excerpt.en:
One might think individuals would not want to spend time near open, quick-moving lava flows. At least on [planet.GetName], one would be wrong.

Colonists are racing utility hovercraft along active lava flows, dodging floating boulders and boosting themselves o

excerpt.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]前超光速物种的成员与我们最古老神话中的神灵极为相似，这可以部分归因于趋同进化和心理学的普遍规律，但随着我们对该物种了解的加深，联系愈发明显。

它们会是我们神话传说中的生物吗？这一可能引发了广泛关注，可以投入资源推进研究。但有时，巧合的累积并无更深含义，过度探究可能暴露我们的存在，引发不可预见的后果。
excerpt.en: Members of the pre-FTL species on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have striking similarities to mythological beings from some of our oldest myths. Some of this may be accounted for by broad trends in convergent evolution and psychology, but the more we learn about th

excerpt.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击将雪拉企业的财产和雇员置于危险当中，我们别无选择，只能终止我们之间的贸易协定，而且我们不会退款。
excerpt.en: Your reckless attacks have put XuraCorp property and employees at risk. We have no choice but to terminate our current trade agreement. There will be no refunds.

excerpt.zh: 我们从艺术家联盟收到了一条信息。他们的一座空间站被摧毁了！
excerpt.en: We have received a transmission from the Artisan Troupe. One of their stations has been destroyed!

excerpt.zh: 我们的军队成功从可汗军手中解放了[liberated_planet.GetName]！现在[liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon]终于回到了我们的掌控中。
excerpt.en: Our forces have successfully liberated [liberated_planet.GetName] from its occupation by the Great Khan's soldiery! The [liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon] has finally been returned to our full control.

excerpt.zh:
狂热的混战终于在[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]星系平息下来。铸炉熄灭了。残骸在渐冷的星光中漂流，应急信标断断续续地重新亮起。

“多么壮观的场面！”冠铸秀解说员嘶吼着，声音因真情流露而变得沙哑。“这就是我们来的目的！这就是全星系观众拭目以待的时刻！”

第三名并不可耻，这恰恰证明了我们有资格站在转播镜头前。即便身处领奖台的最底层，我们依然可以俯视那些被我们击溃的舰队。
excerpt.en:
The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, vo

excerpt.zh:
锁定方案：异常。

已进行校正。

威胁重评估：无。
excerpt.en:
Targeting solution: Malformed.

Correction Applied.

Threat Reassessment: None.

excerpt.zh:
最近[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的几个大国之间爆发了一场大规模的战争。

我们的研究人员在安全的轨道上进行观察时，冲突迅速发展为在全球范围内进行相互核武投射。

[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的全部人口似乎都在核火中消亡，自然环境也遭到了巨大破坏。
excerpt.en:
A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.

The [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlane

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上空的观测站在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表发现了一个非法定居点。可能是某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]走私贩或者[Root.GetName]的不法分子设立的哨站。

由于这些走私犯有时候会撞见当地的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，这里已经发生了一些零星的事故——某些事故甚至还上升到了暴力行为。我们需要尽快行动，在不法分子造成更大损失之前带走他们。
excerpt.en: Our observation post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected an illegal settlement on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. It appears to be some kind of outpost set up by [Root.GetSpeciesName] smugglers and other criminal elements from the [Roo

excerpt.zh: 我们暗中潜伏的特工已经加强了对于潜在目标的监控。
excerpt.en: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on potential targets.

excerpt.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。

按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
excerpt.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the [from.spynetwork.target.GetName]. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.

In acc

excerpt.zh: [from.target.GetName]的生存环境似乎对我们派遣到[from.GetName]行动中的[GetIndividualNamePlural]有轻微的毒性。我们的特工已经开始出现症状，哪怕是最轻的症状都开始损坏他们的正常功能，而最坏的情况则是被敌对[from.target.GetGestaltEntityName]给逮到。
excerpt.en: Something about the [from.target.GetName] living environment appears mildly toxic to the [GetIndividualNamePlural] assigned to Operation [from.GetName]. Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them o

excerpt.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境充满了静电噪声——比我们预测的要多得多。我们向[from.GetName]行动派遣的伪装无人机正在经历间歇性的数据丢失。这会导致我们数据收集风险的显著上升，从而增加了我们暴露的概率。
excerpt.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with electrostatic noise - far more than we had anticipated. The disguised drones we have assigned to Operation [from.GetName] are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses

excerpt.zh: 位于[target.GetName]的特工正积极工作，辨识并追踪那些潜在能提供支持的领袖。
excerpt.en: Operatives within the [target.GetName] are actively working to identify and pursue leads that could potentially be used to gain favors.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]尝试影响[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，遭遇了广泛的质疑。许多当地人笃信我们的特工不是魔物就是恶灵，正在想方设法地远离他们。敌对示威似乎很可能发生。
excerpt.en: Our attempts to influence the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] are being met with widespread suspicion. Many of the locals are taking great steps to avoid our operatives, believing them to be creatures of magic or else

excerpt.zh:
一大批高价值实验对象借助挖掘的隧道从[root.GetName]上的一座设施内逃了出来。

这条隧道是用简陋的工具和赤裸的 [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] 挖掘而成，必定耗费了多年时间。我们无法确定有多少人知晓它的存在，也不清楚为什么这么长时间也没人能发现。
excerpt.en:
A number of our valuable test subjects have fled from a facility on [root.GetName] via a makeshift escape tunnel.

Fashioned using improvised tools and bare [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], the tunnel must have taken years to build. We cannot be sure how many

excerpt.zh:
在涡旋的黑暗中，远处的影子倏然出现，又消失入虚无……一阵阵模糊不清的不谐和心声难以理解地咆哮着。光明灭闪烁，热点膨胀收缩。

或有运动之物，莫名旋转。这究竟是我们自己，还是虚境在运动不息？

那个存在靠近了，同时从四面八方靠近。心声忽然出现。

你看到了什么？
excerpt.en:
In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.

There is motion. Something spins. Is it us

excerpt.zh:
强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。

突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。

一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。

所见何物？
excerpt.en:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange prese

excerpt.zh:
在层层叠叠的虚境中，一副幻景展现在我们面前。

浓雾形成了一只挣扎着的生物轮廓，朦胧的卷须紧紧地缠绕着，它动弹不得，奄奄一息。

这只动物本身我们前所未见。

一个心声回荡在我们之内。

命运的绳索正在召唤！你要拉哪一头？
excerpt.en:
From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.

The mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.

The animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.

excerpt.zh:
虚境无休止地搅动，露出一大片黑沙。海浪破碎，但只闻其声不见其形。

前面，或者也许叫前面的地方，出现了一个棱镜。一束光照亮了它，瞬间折射形成一个模糊的图像。

无数模糊的身影和移动的形体短暂出现，又被黑暗吞没。

在附近的沙滩上，有一个存在。

所示之物即所见，对吗？
excerpt.en:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy

excerpt.zh:
一汪黑色的液体在我们面前舒展开。

突然，液面上闪烁起一个模糊的影像。我们瞥见了一座亮闪闪的山峰，每个山脊都镶着耀眼夺目金边，随后它有忽然消失。

一个心声在我们的[GetMindLoc]深处鸣响着。

你看到了未见之物吗？
excerpt.en:
A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.

Suddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.

A voice resonates within the recesses of our [G

excerpt.zh:
虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。

我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。
excerpt.en:
The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.

Our [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the t

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的一位[Owner.GetExplorer]突然失去了联系，此前他刚刚汇报过在一处此前未测绘的山谷里发现了潜在的异星天然气。
excerpt.en: Communications were lost with one of our [Owner.GetExplorer] on [Root.GetName], shortly after they reported a potential Exotic Gas discovery in a previously unmapped valley.

excerpt.zh:
此前被认为休眠已久的[Root.GetName]地热喷泉剧烈喷发，向大气层喷射出含有暗物质的气体。

此次喷发遮天蔽日，导致了严重的引力异常，阻碍了星际旅行和通讯。

我们认为暗物质可能源于该行星独特的核心。这种极端的环境对我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]构成了威胁，因此我们已经部署了轨道虹吸装置用于从平流层提取这种瘴气。
excerpt.en:
What was previously thought to be a long dormant geyser on [Root.GetName] has violently erupted, spewing Dark Matter infused gas into the atmosphere.

The eruption has saturated the skies, leading to severe gravitational anomalies that are blocking offworld tr

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一种极为恶心的本土生物。

它们进化出了一种防御机制，同时也成为了它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

清除这些令人厌恶的生物将为我们带来丰厚的异星天然气和食物资源。
excerpt.en:
We have encountered a notably disgusting species of fauna native to [Root.GetName].

They have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on

excerpt.zh:
来自[Root.GetName]的报告显示，农村与城市人口之间出现了令人担忧的地区间敌对情绪。除了他们所处的地理位置外，目前尚未发现引发这种敌意的明显原因。

新移民最初会遭到敌视，但在被分配到各自的地区几周后，他们很快就会被接纳。基于此，我们的科学家确信，这种异常行为是由地区内的局部因素驱动的。

在我们调查此事的同时，我们需要稳定局势，以防止进一步升级。我们可以选择正式支持农村或城市地区，或者部署额外的执法力量以维持和平。
excerpt.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] show an alarming emergence of interdistrict hostility between the rural and urban populations. There is no discernible cause that has triggered this animosity other than their arbitrary geographical location.

New immigrants are ini

excerpt.zh:
我们正在为[Root.GetName]上未来的扩张做土地整备时，一座巨大的结构仿佛在一瞬间凭空出现

这座结构释放着极不稳定的能量波，使其形态若隐若现，因此我们在该区域的初步扫描时没有发现这座建筑。

当它显现时，可以看到其密封的外墙装饰着某种难以理解的符号，而我们的记录中没有任何一种语言与之相符。

其功能尚未明确。该建筑目前为止还没有造成任何伤害，但确乎影响了我们的发展工作。
excerpt.en:
As we were preparing land for future expansion on [Root.GetName], a large structure seemingly blinked into existence.

The structure is emitting highly unstable energy waves causing it to intermittently appear and disappear from view. This explains why it was

excerpt.zh:
一阵重力异常将我们的观测站晃离了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的轨道，导致它短暂进入了行星的下层大气。

虽然我们的乘员没有受伤而且也恢复了原定轨道，但有人担心观测站可能会被地上的[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现。

只有时间知道我们是否暴露，以及这会对他们的社会造成何等影响。
excerpt.en:
A gravitational anomaly knocked our observation post over [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] out of orbit, causing it to briefly drop into the planet's lower atmosphere.

While our crew are unharmed and our original trajectory has been restored, there are c

excerpt.zh:
我们从[subject_empire.GetName]被占领的殖民地收到了一封通讯，行文措辞如同现在他们整个国家一般支离破碎。我们的附属国无法自保，正在寻求我们的帮助。

由于我们的外交协议所具有的军国主义性质，我们自然应当涉足其中，并保护我们的附属国不受到进一步的伤害。我们的一些顾问则考虑，也许通过鼓舞我们的附庸让他们奋起保卫自己而不是直接介入，才是对双方更合适的决定。
excerpt.en:
We have received reports from the occupied colonies of [subject_empire.GetName], disorganized and destitute as they currently are. Our subject is now looking to us for aid, as they seem unable to defend themselves.

Considering the militaristic nature of our d

excerpt.zh:
我们收到一份报告，一艘身份不明的货船在[crash_planet.GetName]的居民区坠毁。在我们正寻找能做些什么来帮助他们时，所有曾经住在那里的人都暂时被转移到避难所。

寡头团体不仅主张无视那些被赶出家园的人的困境，而且主张在该地区开发一个新的矿产，因为这艘货船似乎发现了一个我们以前从未见过的完整的富矿脉。当然，他们的对手强烈反对这个想法，并要求我们把精力集中在重建受灾群众的家园上。
excerpt.en:
A report has come back to us, that an unidentified cargo ship has crashed into a residential area on [crash_planet.GetName]. All who used to live there have temporarily been moved into shelters, while we are seeing what we can do to help.

The oligarchic group

excerpt.zh: 如今，这种争论和冲突已不再局限于司令部，我们在帝国的每个部门都能看到。最近的事件涉及到因民事需要而划拨给[Root.Capital.GetName]的资金，寡头们想要把它们重新分配给军队。
excerpt.en: Now no longer contained simply to the admiralty, we see the arguments and conflicts in every office across our empire. The latest incident involves funds earmarked for civil needs on [Root.Capital.GetName], which the oligarchs want to re-allocate for the milit

excerpt.zh:
在寡头派办公室附近发生了一场特别残酷的抗议之后，这两个派系的一些成员都受到了质疑。不出所料，双方的故事都截然不同，大多都将一切归咎于对手。

他们不仅希望我们选择一方，而且双方都愿意介入以确保我们投入的时间是值得的。
excerpt.en: After a particularly violent protest close to the offices of the oligarchic faction, several members of both factions have been brought into question. As expected, both sides have incredibly different stories, mostly blaming their rivals for everything that we

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了一份报告，提到一个亲密盟友[admiral_democracy.GetName]挪动公共资金用于不光彩的个人支出。许多人声称这可能是代其派系行事。如果公众知道这场运动挪用了公共资金为私人服务，那肯定会给他们的民粹主义议程泼冷水。
excerpt.en: A report has been brought back to us, about the scandalous personal spending of public funds by a close ally of [admiral_democracy.GetName]. Many claim it might have been on behalf of their faction. If the public were to learn this movement has used public fun

excerpt.zh:
经过漫长的调查，他们似乎终于找到了司令部办公室第一起谋杀案的凶手。所有的证据都指向了[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]最亲密的顾问之一，他私自下令暗杀了他们的对手。

虽然[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]没有做错任何事，但如果公众知道了，会对其运动造成不良影响。
excerpt.en: After a long-winded investigation, it seems they have finally found the perpetrator of the first murder in the admiralty offices. All evidence points to one of the closest advisors to [admiral_oligarchy.GetName], who personally ordered the assassination of the

excerpt.zh:
我们一直在[targeted_planet.GetName]上对行星本身的结构进行大量研究，以确定如何为了我们的殖民地对行星进行改善。最近的发展不幸出了岔子，毒性废料污染了大片土地，使它们完全不宜居住。

然而，我们的计算表明，这不仅是一起孤立的事件，只要这种广泛的行星研究继续下去，就可能会有更多这样的灾难发生。
excerpt.en: On [targeted_planet.GetName], we have have been conducting significant research on the structure of the planet itself to see how one might improve it for our colonies. The latest developments have sadly gone awry, with toxic wastes affecting large swathes of l

excerpt.zh: 一大群人来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的人在我们成为他们的附庸后，开始来我们的世界旅行，并对我们的文化和人民表现出兴趣。起初，我们认为这对所有人来说都是一件好事，但近段时间，我们看到当地人和[overlord_empire.GetAdj]游客之间的冲突增加了——他们似乎对我们的帝国怀有一些误解，他们倾向于使用[overlord_empire.GetAdj]的文化和理想为他们的粗野辩护。
excerpt.en: A large number of people from the [overlord_empire.GetName] started visiting our worlds after we became a subject of theirs, expressing an interest in our culture and people. At first we figured it would be a good thing for all of us, but we see a rise in conf

excerpt.zh: 我们收到消息，一群来自[subject_empire.GetName]的朝圣者想方设法来到了我们的宇域。看上去他们相信[overlord_empire.GetName]在他们的家园代表了某种宗教上的重要性。尽管有关他们宗教信仰方面的细节尚不清楚，但这群人作为旅客举止十分得体，在停留期间人们对他们只有点赞，没有差评。
excerpt.en: Word has reached us of a group of pilgrims from the [subject_empire.GetName], making their way through our space. It seems they believe the [overlord_empire.GetName] holds some religious significance for their homeland. Though the details of their religious co

excerpt.zh:
我们获悉，我们的宗主投资了相当可观的能量和资源来改善他们的恒星基地工程，以期巨幅提升提升产出能力和潜能。

由于防卫工作是我们两个帝国之间关系的重要基石，我们已经寻求订立协议，以获取一部分的科技，从而对我们其中的一座恒星基地进行相似改进。
excerpt.en:
We have been informed that our overlord has invested a considerable amount of energy and resources into improving their starbase engineering, improving the output and potential of theirs by leaps and bounds.

As defense is an important keystone in the relation

excerpt.zh:
一个完全由不明骨头建造的原始城市废墟在经历这颗星球上的一场强力沙尘暴之后被发现。

我们的科学家渴望发掘这座可怕的古城。
excerpt.en:
The ruins of a primeval city built entirely out of bones of an unknown origin have been unearthed following a violent sandstorm on this planet.

Our archaeologists are eager to begin excavation on this grisly ancient city.

excerpt.zh: 废墟遍布[From.Planet.GetName]，但奇怪的是，从它们的爆炸模式来看，似乎是大量的地下核爆引发了这一切，而不是正常的大气层核爆或是轨道轰炸。这需要进一步调查，或许需要一次考古挖掘来揭露这里到底发生了什么。
excerpt.en: Ruins cover [From.Planet.GetName], but oddly the blast patterns seem to indicate that vast nuclear explosions occurred underneath the surface rather than from atmospheric or orbital bombardment. This warrants further investigation, but it will require an archa

excerpt.zh:
我们在这颗星球上发现了有着令人惊异数量的严重异变化石，它们都属于同一种已灭绝的智慧物种。

究竟是什么导致了一个高等社会数百万成员的异变？我们的考古学家想进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
A surprising number of heavily-mutated fossils has been found on this planet, all belonging to the same species of extinct sapients.

What could have led to the mutation of millions of members of a once-advanced society? Our archaeologists would like to invest

excerpt.zh: 科研船检测到了一条从[From.Planet.GetName]发射出的怪异读数。
excerpt.en: The Science Ship has picked up a strange reading emanating from [From.Planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的表面覆盖满了被其低重力束缚的机器人碎片。看起来它们都是由军事行动造成的。如果这些作战机器人没有被破坏到无法修复的话，本来是足够武装几只军队的。
excerpt.en: The entire surface of this small asteroid is covered in robot debris, trapped in its weak gravity field. All of it appears military in nature, and there are enough combat droids here to outfit several armies had they not be shattered beyond all repair.

excerpt.zh: 在这颗星球的地壳内，数量惊人的地下通道系统交错盘旋。究竟是什么造就了这一切呢？
excerpt.en: An extensive network of subterranean tunnels of truly astounding proportion make swirls in the crust of this planet. What could have created them?

excerpt.zh: 我们的能量赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 某种未知结构正漂浮在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中。似乎是用到了空气静力学的原理来维持漂浮。
excerpt.en: Some kind of unknown structures are floating in this gas giant's upper atmosphere. They appear to be using aerostatic lift to remain buoyant.

excerpt.zh: 传感器表明在[Root.GetName]地表存在有潜在价值的发现。
excerpt.en: Sensors register potential finds on the surface of [Root.GetName].
