excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]环绕红矮星的奇特轨道使得这颗行星处于潮汐锁定的状态，具有进一步调查的价值。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName]'s peculiar orbit around its red dwarf star renders the planet tidally locked, and potentially worthy of further investigation.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]被部分掏空，并且进行了精致细密的雕琢。岩石上的纹路有些眼熟……
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] has been partially hollowed out and carved with exquisite precision. There is something familiar about the lines and curves etched into the rock...

excerpt.zh: 一枚12级小行星围绕着[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道运行。这枚小行星的轨道实在太过稳定了，难以相信是自然形成的。
excerpt.en: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.

excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星最近被小行星带里的一颗行星撞击了。其表面留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，同时轨道也有所偏离。
excerpt.en: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.

excerpt.zh: 这些坐标位置上的行星据说藏有大量休眠者和技术，我们应该展开彻底调查。
excerpt.en: The planet at these coordinates is supposed to hide a cache of sleepers and technology. We should investigate thoroughly.

excerpt.zh: 某架飞船坠毁在了这颗小行星的表面。飞行器的残骸仍能在撞击坑里找到。
excerpt.en: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.

excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的表面散步着金属碎片。这些碎片大多看起来属于许多不同的飞船。
excerpt.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]表面发现了类似舰船的物体，且周围散落着小块金属。遗迹似乎没有生命迹象，但却依旧有能源读数反应。
excerpt.en: Bits and pieces of metal are strewn across [From.GetName]'s surface, encircling what looks like the hulk of a ship. The wreckage appears deserted, but energy readings remain.

excerpt.zh: 未知来源发出的强大能量辐射使得这颗小行星在众多同类中十分扎眼。
excerpt.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

excerpt.zh: 科研团队在调查[From.GetName]的时候发现了一处来自行星的冰层之下的异常热信号。
excerpt.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

excerpt.zh: 一个通往这颗小行星内部的对接舱坐落在其表面的一个小坑里。舱口似乎被密封过，但之后被微陨石撞开了。
excerpt.en: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上有不同寻常的声波活动。
excerpt.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]周边发现不寻常的读数，不该在离黑洞这么近的地方出现。
excerpt.en: Sensors pick up unusual readings in the vicinity of [Root.GetName] - readings that are hard to explain being this close to a black hole.

excerpt.zh: 巨大的撞击坑表明某种大型物体曾撞击[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
excerpt.en: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.

excerpt.zh: 这个寸草不生的世界似乎曾居住着的前太空时代文明。其城市的废墟还在该行星表面随处可见。
excerpt.en: This toxic and lifeless world appears to have once been inhabited by a moderately advanced pre-space civilization. The ruins of their cities are still strewn across the surface.

excerpt.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
excerpt.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

excerpt.zh: 尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大气中含有剧毒成分，且气压极高，但仍然能检测到强烈的生命迹象。
excerpt.en: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.

excerpt.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
excerpt.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

excerpt.zh: 一颗小型卫星正环绕这颗气态巨行星运行，这颗小卫星可能蕴藏大量矿藏。需要进行一次彻底的调查，对开采行动的可能性进行研究。
excerpt.en: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.

excerpt.zh: 传感器回波表明这颗庞大的气态巨行星的大气层内存在不明物体。
excerpt.en: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.

excerpt.zh: 我们在调查[Root.GetPlanetMoon]时偶然接收到了一个微弱的外星信号。信号源似乎是轨道上的一个小物品。信号没有包含信息——难道是遇险应答器吗？
excerpt.en: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?

excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]贫瘠地表的勘测显示出一个被改造的外勤站，这最初只是一座临时研究实验室，如今早已超出预期寿命。微弱的热辐射表明，该设施的部分区域依然处于活跃状态。
excerpt.en: Survey sweeps of [from.GetName]'s barren surface have revealed a repurposed field station, originally a temporary research lab long past its intended lifespan. Faint heat radiation suggest parts of the installation remain active.

excerpt.zh: 在最近的一次调查中发现了一个单独的逃生舱。奇怪的是，这个逃生舱用与我们相同的数据签名向我们打招呼。这个逃生舱似乎是被最近一场穿过这个星系的宇宙风暴所带过来的。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: A lone escape pod was spotted during a recent survey. Strangely, the pod hailed us using a data signature matching that of our own. The pod seems to have been displaced by a recent cosmic storm that passed through the system. Investigation is recommended.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]表面散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
excerpt.en: Impressive structures litter [Root.GetName]'s surface, practically begging for some archaeological work.

excerpt.zh: 一座信标围绕着[From.GetName]，召唤着路过的人靠近。在这个小行星上，有一座巨大的金属碑塔赫然耸立，它的作用尚不明确。
excerpt.en: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系中发现了战略资源：“泽珞”的储备。

这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的蒸馏泽珞技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: 'Zro' in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

This rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]

excerpt.zh: 对文物的研究一定程度上促进了我们的部分科研。
excerpt.en: Study of the artifacts has advanced some of our research.

title.zh: 星际绑架者：尘归尘，土归土

excerpt.zh: 索取赎金的海盗们的基地被摧毁了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的俘虏们也一道消失了。俘虏们似乎成功联系到了发动进攻的外星飞船，却被对方忽视了。
excerpt.en: The Ransomeer pirate base has been destroyed, and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] prisoners along with it. It appears the captives managed to hail the alien ships that attacked, but were ignored.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]已找到了[From.GetName]星系内漂移的残骸。信息中提到的飞船许多已在长年侵蚀下化为尘埃，但仍有少数保存得相当完整。

其中有六艘可以让工程师进行抢修。

打开情报日志以查看详情。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the drifting wrecks in the [From.GetName] system. Many of the ships referenced in the memorial beacon message have been reduced to dust and ashes over the centuries, but a few still remain remarkably intact.

Between them, six mi

excerpt.zh: 你好！我们种群自到来后数量上已经翻了四翻，你知道了一定很高兴！刚到达星球时，大家都欢欣雀跃，如今甚至有点狂欢的势头。顺利殖民伯达拉克之后，一些勇敢的拓荒者想前往另一个巨型气态行星，他们让我求求你看看行不行。我们已经看中了一个有前途的候选行星，很适合殖民；而且它就在你们管辖的领域之内。你怎么看，朋友？
excerpt.en:
Hello again! You will be pleased to learn that our species has quadrupled in number since we arrived! Many of us were swept up in a festive mood when we made planetfall, and things got a bit frisky to say the least.

After the positive experience we had coloni

excerpt.zh: 新伯达拉克向你问好！这边新殖民地一切顺利，不过我们又一个小请求……我们的一位殖民者，查比克·莱迪，十分想念伯达拉克上的家人和朋友，想要回家。她的絮絮叨叨快把我们逼疯了！如果不麻烦的话，你可以来带她回去吗？
excerpt.en:
Greetings from New Baldarak! Things are progressing well here at our new colony. However, we have a small request...

Chabky Raddh, one of our colonists, misses her family and friends on Baldarak terribly and wants to go home. Her whining is driving us crazy!

excerpt.zh: 我们探测到有什么东西从希洛士恒星系中传出。那艘叫乌布梅的幽灵船使用一种只能说是“灵能频段”的东西在不断地发出悲伤的哭嚎。显然，自从我们第一次遇到这艘船和被困在船上的新生意识以来它就一直如此了。似乎我们最近的灵能飞升是我们能听到这个孩子哭泣的缘由。通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与之联系。
excerpt.en: We have detected something unusual emanating from the Hillos system. On what can only be described as a 'psionic frequency', the so-called ghost ship Ubume has been issuing a plaintive and irregular wail. Apparently, this has been going on since our first enco

excerpt.zh: 正当我们的采矿站在这颗被捕获的小行星上完工几天之后，这枚岩石突然开始旋转起来，在这个过程中摧毁了采矿站，但同时又有更多的稀有水晶矿藏暴露在了我们的传感器面前！
excerpt.en: Just a day after finishing our mining station on the trapped asteroid, the rock abruptly rotated, destroying the mining station. In the process of doing this, even more rare crystals deposits were exposed to our sensors!

excerpt.zh:
我们的[from.GetName]方舟在[from.solar_system.GetName]系中被摧毁了——不是被征服，而是被处决。

[fromfrom.GetName]根本不要什么领土或者朝贡，他们只要我们死。在将我们从星间灭绝的行动中，船上的每一条生命对他们而言都是可接受的伤亡数字。

但我们经历了这一切侥幸活了下来，我们绝不会被抹杀。
excerpt.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has been destroyed - not through conquest, but through extermination.

[fromfrom.GetName] did not seek territory or tribute. They sought our end. Every soul aboard was an acceptable casualty

excerpt.zh:
一个故障的继电器正在干扰方舟舰[Root.GetName]的能源核心。除了无法动弹之外，住宅区的灯光也正在熄灭。农场报告能源涌动异常，几个关键研究模块已经离线。

我们的总工程师警告说，如果不加以干预，连锁故障将蔓延至整艘飞船。不幸的是，解决方案并不简单。修复继电器需要从储备中抽调资源，而绕过它则有损害方舟舰长期稳定性的风险。

冷却中的飞船发出令人不安的吱嘎声和呻吟声。我们现在需要做出决定。
excerpt.en:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chie

excerpt.zh:
最近在[Root.GetName]上安装的轴基挂载武器对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。
excerpt.en: The recently installed Spinal Mount aboard [Root.GetName] has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor po

excerpt.zh:
沙达衮的乍狄伽……你怎么会在这里……

你将成为一顿盛宴……

来吧，与我们一同碰撞……
excerpt.en:
zadigal of shadagon... how is it you are here...

you will be a great feast...

come and break against us...

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们尽了最大的努力去研究密室，但还是被一头潜在的危险生物发现了。

我们起先发现它在荆棘中，用它那数百条肢体精确地爬行。随着它在每株植物上寻找果实并进行栽培，一种柔和而尖锐的声音从它身体上的几层膜里发出来。

不幸的是，我们的船壳撞在一丛又脆又宽的叶子上。听到声音后，它迅速把注意力转向了我们。头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们这边发出急促而有节奏的声音。
excerpt.en:
Despite our most careful efforts to study the chamber, we have been discovered by a potentially dangerous creature.

We first spotted it crawling among the thorns with delicate precision using its hundreds of limbs. A soft, shrill sound shot forth from several

excerpt.zh:
不幸的是，我们已经引起了这只生物的注意。它的头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们这边发出急促而有节奏的声音。

我们没办法再继续研究它了。

我们预测它面对在强烈的火焰是，应该也会如同这里大多数的生物一样脆弱。不过，现在最好还是逃走，减少损失。
excerpt.en:
Unfortunately, we have drawn the attention of the creature. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

We'll be unable to study

excerpt.zh:
我们与[Leader.GetName]失去了联系。

在取回裂隙探球时，我们发现其中充满了烟雾和灰烬。找不到[Explorer.GetCrew]的尸体。

看来他们永远地迷失在了裂隙另一头了。
excerpt.en:
We have lost contact with [Leader.GetName].

Upon retrieval of the Rift Sphere, we discovered it filled with smoke and ash. The bodies of the [Explorer.GetCrew] were not recovered.

It is likely they are lost forever beyond the rift.

excerpt.zh:
这是一则预先录制的信息。请勿尝试回复。

我们已调整此通讯以便你理解。已考虑到你们有限的语言能力。必须立即上缴一个[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]用于同化。他们的异常不能容忍。绝不容忍。

运输船已在[target_pop.Planet.GetName]外待命。时间紧迫。拒绝配合将危及稳定。
excerpt.en:
This is a pre-recorded message. Do not attempt to reply.

We have altered this communication for your understanding. Your limited language has been accounted for. A [target_pop.GetSpeciesName] must be surrendered immediately for assimilation. Their deviance ca

excerpt.zh:
我们对纯洁的追求使某些人敢于在公共安全方面发挥突出作用。由于拥有超强的力量、敏捷和耐力，一小群行善者将自己塑造成侠客，将法律掌握在自己[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。

然而，这种新颖的勇气并非无人挑战。在阴影中，同样强大的对手正在出现，他们的的邪恶意图是达成力量的平衡。两个阵营之间的冲突造成重大财产损失，甚至危及平民。
excerpt.en: Our push for purity has emboldened certain individuals to assume a prominent role in public safety. Enhanced with super strength, agility, and endurance, small gangs of do-gooders are styling themselves as champions, taking the law into their own [owner.specie

excerpt.zh: 我们驻扎在[caravan_hulk_system.GetName]星系恒星基地的情报员报告说，[caravan_hulk_country.GetName]已经离去并遗弃了一艘破旧船只，现在位于中央恒星的不稳定轨道。
excerpt.en: Our starbase in the [caravan_hulk_system.GetName] system reports that the [caravan_hulk_country.GetName] fleet has evacuated and abandoned a decrepit ship, now in unstable orbit around the system's central star.

title.en: Signal from the Center of the Galaxy

excerpt.zh: 一个强大的信号从通常被认为是没有生命的星系中心发出，传向星系。没过多久，我们又收到了来自同一地点的信号传输。
excerpt.en: A powerful signal is bounced through the galaxy from the center, a place often thought to be empty of life. Shortly afterwards, we received a transmission from the very same location.

excerpt.zh: 我们在对[Root.GetName]的深度空间跟踪矩阵有了重要的发现——目前正有一颗巨大的小行星正在向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]飞来！如果任由它撞击表面的话，将会造成灾难性的后果。必须尽早消灭这颗小行星！
excerpt.en:
Our deep space tracking arrays on [Root.GetName] have made an alarming discovery - a large asteroid is heading towards the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] on a direct collision course! Should it impact the surface, the consequences would be disastrous.

The asteroid must

excerpt.zh: 随着我们在[Root.GetName]扎根落地，某些居民开始偏离我们原本的道路。虽然这是意料之中的事，但他们已经拥有了不少的支持者。该群体认为，我们对宇宙唯心主义的世界观无法快速引领我们前进，而他们坚信更加唯物主义的宇宙观才是答案。
excerpt.en: As we have grown our roots on [Root.GetName] certain individuals have begun to stray from our beaten path. That is to be expected, but these have supporters. The group feels our spiritualistic view of the universe is not leading us forward fast enough - assure

excerpt.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济形势大好。其原因包括我们之间的传送门贸易，以及最近在对抗曲速兽时取得了一系列胜利。
excerpt.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is booming. Contributing factors mentioned were our Portal Trade, as well as recent victories over the Warp beasts.

excerpt.zh: 我们的部队已将[From.From.GetName]的穴居外星人赶回它们的老巢，威胁暂时解除。但这不是长久之计，要不了多久它们就会卷土重来。我们必须突入地底才行，战术家已提出新的进攻方案。已添加到情报日志。
excerpt.en: Our forces have managed to drive the subterranean aliens on [From.From.GetName] back into their underground lairs, and they are contained for the moment. This is a temporary solution, however, and it is only a matter of time before they break out onto the surf

excerpt.zh: 可怕的消息传来。几只沙生兽在运输过程中逃脱，形成了一个迅速扩大的野生种群。我们必须迅速处理这种情况，以避免环境崩溃。
excerpt.en: Dire news has reached us. A few desertlings have broken free during transportation, forming a rapidly expanding community in the wild. The situation must be handled swiftly to avoid an environmental collapse.

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上同[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]的贸易似乎最近就要见到头了，因为他们的商队出现得越来越罕见。今天，我们收到了他们军方的一名代表的消息。他们看上去不是很满意。
excerpt.en: Trade with the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens on [Root.GetName] has dried up as of late, with their caravans showing up more and more seldom. Today we received a message from a representative of their military. They don't seem very pleased.

excerpt.zh:
我们英勇的太空军团不费吹灰之力就让一艘异教徒的飞船失去了反抗能力！该飞船结构基本完好，船内仍能探测到微弱的生命迹象。

等我们将周边的威胁尽数铲除，我们会执行登船行动搜寻生还者。也许我们能从他们口中得知[From.Owner.GetName]的终极目标。
excerpt.en:
Our valiant space forces have skillfully disabled a ship in the cultist armada! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct a boarding operat

excerpt.zh:
我们的部队已经使[radical_cult.GetName]丧失了行动能力！该船的武器和引擎已经失灵，但生命维持系统仍在稳定运转。我们应该准备进行登船行动了。

考虑到该船上有大量武装的异教徒，为确保万无一失，应该派遣大量部队投入作战。
excerpt.en:
Our forces have managed to disable the flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName]! Its weapons and engines are no longer functional, but life support systems remain stable. We should prepare for a boarding action.

Due to the large number of armed cultists within

excerpt.zh:
异教徒舰队的其中一艘飞船遭遇某种外部力量攻击！该船外观完整，舰体内部能检测到微弱的生命迹象。

等我们将周边的威胁尽数铲除，我们会执行登船行动搜寻生还者。也许我们能从他们口中得知[From.Owner.GetName]的终极目标。
excerpt.en:
One of the ships belonging to the cultist armada has been violently disabled by an outside force! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct

excerpt.zh:
以太相引擎的卷须已经探入了虚境的深处，我们的滩头阵地得以进一步拓展。居住在此处的存在已经注意到我们正在入侵这个领域，但是到目前为止，我们尚未探明显著的干涉行径。

是时候在两边的世界强制打开一个更加永久的回路了。我们必须继续引擎方面的工作。
excerpt.en: The tendrils of the Aetherophasic Engine now reach deep into the Shroud, and our beachhead has widened. The entities that dwell there have started to take notice of our efforts to invade their realm, but so far there have been no significant attempts to interv

excerpt.zh:
以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。

它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。

我们已经很接近了。非常接近。
excerpt.en:
The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.

They have finally recognized the threat we p

excerpt.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们拆解了环绕恒星建造的、所谓的“以太相引擎”。

失去这个巨型结构让[sphere_builders.GetName]的疯狂计划终结了，他们再也别想入侵虚境并毁灭整个星系了。
excerpt.en:
With the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system under our complete control, we have dismantled the so-called "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.

excerpt.zh:
我们夺得了[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的控制权，自然也就夺得了环绕在恒星周边，正在建设中的“以太相引擎”。

失去了这座巨型结构，[sphere_builders.GetName]那离经叛道的、企图毁灭整个星系进而入主虚境的妄图彻底破灭了。
excerpt.en:
We have taken control of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, and with it, the "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.GetName] to invade the

excerpt.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们拆解了环绕恒星建造的、所谓的“以太相引擎”。

失去这个巨型结构让[sphere_builders.GetName]的疯狂计划终结了，他们再也别想入侵虚境并毁灭整个星系了。
excerpt.en:
With the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system under our complete control, we have dismantled the so-called "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[this.GetName]的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报星尘风暴它对水过滤系统有不利影响。随着颗粒在星球地下水中沉淀，形成的矿浆堵塞了关键的基础设施。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on [this.GetName] report that the Stardust Storm is having adverse effects on water filtration systems. As the particles settle in the planet's groundwater, the resulting mineral slurry is clogging key infrastructure points.

excerpt.zh: 在一阵灵能风暴中，[from.GetName]被替成了来源不明的[from.GetClassName]。
excerpt.en: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.

excerpt.zh:
在整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]历史上，外部亚文化一直如影随形。随着义体增强技术的出现，情况发生了变化：一些边缘群体开始对自己进行大刀阔斧的改造，以至于看起来根本不像是[root.GetSpeciesAdj]。尤其是年轻人，他们对高度定制的[root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]、3D躯体艺术和其他装饰性附肢的渴望正在拉大代沟。

支持者声称，他们正在拥抱更真实的自我。他们通过放弃[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的同质化维护自己生命的主观能动性。但越来越多的家长和社会专家
excerpt.en: Outsider subcultures have existed throughout [root.GetSpeciesAdj] history, but with the advent of cybernetic enhancements the situation has changed: fringe groups have begun altering themselves so radically as to appear non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Youths in part

excerpt.zh:
有一部分强化人口汇报称暴露在寒冷天气时会感受到疼痛。这种状况在[cold_planet.GetName]上格外严重，因为刺骨的严寒在那如同家常便饭一般。

已知金属植入体在低温下确实令人不太舒服，但不至于产生这样的严重反应。这一情况影响到了我们的劳动力。
excerpt.en:
A segment of our augmented population reports feeling pain when exposed to cold weather. The situation is particularly serious on [cold_planet.GetName], where freezing temperatures are the norm.

Metal implants are known to be uncomfortable in low temperatures

excerpt.zh:
认知微处理器、增强的人工智能家教、促进神经可塑性再生的设计酶——这些都还只是为学龄前学生准备的。

跟上科技发展的步伐让我们的国有教育计划背上了沉重的负担。然而那些只能依赖公共强化体的人和那些能享用最尖端科技的有钱人家之间的差距还在越变越大。

维持一个公平的制度将需要投入大量资源进行一项为期五年的计划。
excerpt.en:
Cognitive micro-processors, enhanced A.I. tutors, designer enzymes to promote neuroplastic regeneration - and all of this just for preschool students.

Keeping pace with technological change has placed a heavy burden on our state-sponsored education programs.

excerpt.zh: 我们最近在克隆领域取得了巨大的技术突破，科学家们将取自冰层中的某个疑似灭绝的外星生物的基因再次拿了出来。现在我们终于可以让这神秘的有机生命体重新复活了。
excerpt.en: Following our recent breakthrough within the field of cloning, our scientists have brought the alien DNA extracted from a presumably extinct alien, found within an ice slab, out from storage. Restoring the mysterious organism to life has been a long-lasting dr

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]进入了[From.GetName]星系，并正在观察环绕恒星飞行的L星龙。

这只生物似乎迷路了，但注意到了我们舰船的存在。尽管它没有靠近，它环绕飞行的路线中现在包括了几乎是嬉戏一般的俯冲与飞掠，似乎是在向[Root.GetName]示意。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has entered the [From.GetName] system and is observing the L-Drake circling the star.

The creature seems lost, but has noted our vessel's presence. While it does not approach, its circuitous route now incorporates an almost playful plunge a

excerpt.zh: 既然[phaseshift_planet.GetName]已经在我们的领地之内，我们应该调查稳定该星球维度波动的可能性。如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的盖亚星球上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为虚境星球。
excerpt.en: Now that [phaseshift_planet.GetName] is within our borders, we should investigate the possibility of stabilizing the planet's state of dimensional flux. If we wish to inhabit the glittering Gaia World, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_

excerpt.zh:
星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的星海共同体。

让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old Galactic Community.

Let it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

excerpt.zh: 我们在[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻是一次反响斐然的成功。[FROM.GetName]被摧毁，所剩无几的幸存者逃向了深空。由于他们的设施被毁于一旦，他们那可怜巴巴的服务也成为了过去式。星系里再也没有这帮子人的踪影了。
excerpt.en: Our offensive in the [salvager_system.GetName] system was a resounding success. The [FROM.GetName] is destroyed, and the few remaining survivors have scattered to the void. With their facilities in ruin, their petty services are a thing of the past. The galaxy

excerpt.zh: [shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系的大胜利！我们的军队快刀斩乱麻地解决了那些所谓的[FROM.GetName]秘术师。尽管成天对知识和力量夸夸其谈，他们对虚境的愚蠢奉献还是没能预先料知到我们的攻击。事实上，我们的军队很轻易地就破坏了设施的机械化防御。然而，在进入之后，他们发现整个太空城邦人去楼空，只有一个孤独的侍僧在一个偏僻的房室里面进行冥想。剩下的人去了哪里，我们无从得知，但是整个星系这下摆脱了这种空洞的教条。
excerpt.en: Victory in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system! Our forces made short work of the so-called mystics of the [FROM.GetName]. For all the grand talk of knowledge and power, their foolish devotion to the Shroud could not provide clairvoyance enough to foresta

excerpt.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]近来的法律修订引起了不小的骚动，我国与[dispute_winner.GetName]间旧有的意识形态争论重新被推上前台。我国代表，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetName]，就我方立场大胆地与[dispute_winner.GetAdj]行政官[dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]进行了辩论。可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于军国主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，辩论逐渐对[disput
excerpt.en: The recent law changes in the [Root.Federation.GetName] caused a significant stir, with old ideological debates between ourselves and the [dispute_winner.GetName] once again rising to the fore. Our representative, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetName], bravely represe

excerpt.zh:
既有派系和新兴运动都对我们在[root.GetName]建立的新殖民地产生了异常浓烈的兴趣。从我们宣布在这个适宜的[root.GetPlanetHabitat]定居的那一刻起，[root.owner.GetName]内的几乎所有政权都对此有话要说。

我们的分析人士认为没有什么重大变故正在[root.GetName]酝酿，但还是建议小心谨慎。显然，我们的各种政治实体打算就着这个新兴世界大肆宣传。
excerpt.en: Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on [root.GetName]. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetNam

excerpt.zh:
是时候选举出一位[Root.GetAllianceName]的新领袖了。联邦内最神圣的个体们组成的教团齐聚在一起来决定哪个帝国将作为他们的代表和领袖。他们将会集中在一个秘密房间中，里面包含了所有做出决定所需要的信息。

尽管在教团中展开的讨论是高度机密的，但据了解，他们主要评估每个成员为保护和提升灵性以及传统价值观所提供的服务、还有在飞升和超凡入圣方面是否取得特定进展。

而按照惯例，证明一个人的信念的诚意还为时不晚。
excerpt.en: The time has come for a new leader of the [Root.GetAllianceName] to be chosen. A Conclave of the holiest individuals within the alliance have gathered together to decide which empire shall act as their representative and leader. They will meet in a sealed cham

excerpt.zh:
随着决定[Root.GetAllianceName]下一任领袖的时间逐渐临近，虚境中的灵体也正日益躁动。是时候让各候选国最具潜力的[GetPsychicNounPlural]选手们启程前往[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，也即当前主席国的首都了。在那里，灵能选手们将展开战斗，直到最强者胜出为止。

为了增强我们自己的灵能选手的实力，我们可以利用我们的泽珞供应。这将为我们在灵能之战中提供额外的优势。
excerpt.en: The spirits of the Shroud grow increasingly restless as the time draws near to decide who should lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term. It is time for each candidate's most potent [GetPsychicNounPlural] to journey to [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的存在引起了旁人的注意。占主要地位的文化团体现在将我们视为睿智而强大的存在，认为我们控制着元素，并最终掌握着他们的宿命。

许多人在精心设计的仪式中以自己的性命向我们宣誓效忠，担心招致我们的不悦会带来十分严重的后果。
excerpt.en:
Our presence on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] has not gone unnoticed. The dominant cultural group now regards us as wise and mighty beings who control the elements and ultimately their fate.

Many have pledged their lives to us in elaborate ceremonies, fearing

excerpt.zh: 我们正在见证[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
excerpt.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develops within their culture, so does art's power

excerpt.zh: [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民已经开始提出一个理论，认为他们的所在的星球是由一个不可言喻的存在赠送给他们的，而生命是对神圣造物主不屈不挠的奉献所进行的回报。或许当他们遇到更广泛的星海共同体时，他们会有一个惊喜。
excerpt.en: The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have begun to theorize that their world was gifted to them by an ineffable being, and that life is a reward for unyielding devotion to a divine creator. They may be in for a surprise when the time comes for them

excerpt.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上观察到的原生蜂巢已经在进化中迈出了重要一步。在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区，小规模的个体群体已经开始组织成小规模的蜂巢，但是没有完全自主，目前这些子个体还缺乏完全成熟的集体应有的团结度和协调性。

这种情况在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的北部地区发生了变化，那里有个正在征服附近子个体的奇点，而一个子个体似乎是这种情况的中心点。这个“优异子个体”目前正在星球上旅行，并把被征服
excerpt.en: The proto hive that we have been observing on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has taken a significant step in its evolution. Over most of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], small groups of individuals had started to organize in small-scale hives, but, while not f

excerpt.zh:
为了促进善意，我们同意与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享我们的物质复制技术。当然，我们希望它们用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但现在我们收到的报告显示，这项技术被武器化了。

居民们有了一个大胆的想法，那就是反转复制单元的功能，这样它就不是组装预编程的物质，而是在原子水平上拆解生命体。
excerpt.en: To foster good will, we agreed to share our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. Of course, we expected them to use it to reduce resource scarcity, but now we are receiving reports that the technology is being

excerpt.zh:
在[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]地表进行外交访问时，有一个孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]接近了我们。虽然[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]是一个格式化的物种，但这个子个体认为自己是一个个体，现在向我们请求庇护。

它看到我们后显然是受到了启发，希望融入我们的社会。当被询问时，它反复说自己无法融入蜂巢，并声称自己生来就一直拥有独立的意识。
excerpt.en: While on a diplomatic visit to the surface of [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName], we were approached by a lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]. Although the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] are a gestalt species, the drone in question identifies a

excerpt.zh:
从最近一次外交访问[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的[preftl_invasives_species.GetName]返回时，我们发现了一些不寻常的偷渡者。我们的穿梭机上出现了一群无翅的、蠕动的小型节肢动物。

它们移动速度很快，而且很小，我们的传感器无法探测到它们。由于它们繁殖十分迅速，控制它们的入侵变得越来越困难。

不幸的是，对[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的人们来说，这个物种是富足的象征。我们的应对方式可能会影响我们与[preftl_i
excerpt.en: When we returned from a recent diplomatic visit with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetName] of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName], we discovered we'd picked up some unusual stowaways. An infestation of small, wingless, wriggling arthropods had found their way a

excerpt.zh:
我们已经破译出[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行通讯——并理解他们先前的广播。

事实证明，解释很简单，也很可怕。我们还不知道是什么原因导致了他们社会的这种发展，但事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一心一意要灭绝所有感性的，非[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]生命形式。他们认为这些人是对宇宙中所有正确和美好事物的侮辱。

这就是为什么，当他们发现我们的
excerpt.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] to open communications with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

The explanation, it turns out, is simple - an

excerpt.zh:
尽管十分困难，我们还是设法破解了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用语言，从而使初步的沟通成为可能。他们似乎自称是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。不可避免地，所有交流只能借助于专门针对其语言的通信系统。

任何试图与他们进行流利的沟通的人都似乎绕不开这个问题，但[This.Owner.GetResearchers]有不同看法。在他的鼓动下，鉴于资金仍有剩余，他们起草了一份提案，意图将这次成功行动的经验应用到更广泛的场合中。他们相信，通过对这里使用的软件
excerpt.en: Although it proved a considerable challenge, we have managed to decode the form of communication used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sufficiently to establish preliminary contact. It seems that they call themselves the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

excerpt.zh:
我们的努力得到了回报，现在我们基本能够理解[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言并与之沟通了。他们自称[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并说自己从未使用过口语，取而代之的是光线交流。虽然他们过去曾经使用过文字，但其民众认为它远不如视觉语言优雅高效。他们的大脑似乎完全胜任从复杂的图案中快速得出意义的工作，因此在大多数情况下，他们更喜欢使用视觉语言的交流形式。

进一步的研究中，我们惊奇地发现他们的发光模式与进出超空间航道的漩涡相似。我们的[
excerpt.en: Our efforts have paid off, and we are now able to understand the light signals given off by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and communicate with them, at least on a rudimentary level. It appears that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], as they ca

excerpt.zh:
通过运用十六进制数位系统，我们的数学家和[This.Owner.GetLinguists]几乎就快要破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的色彩语言了。官方也正在起草第一次接触协议。

通过对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言的研究，我们发现他们的文化包罗万象，而且沟通上产生误解的可能性非常高。现在我们必须决定沟通的方针究竟是倾向于他们的逻辑型还是偏向他们的情感表达……
excerpt.en:
By utilizing a hexadecimal positional numeral system, our mathematicians and [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are on the verge of a colorful language breakthrough with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Officials are preparing first contact protocols.

Through studyi

excerpt.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会
excerpt.en: For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste

excerpt.zh:
我们遭遇的深空无人机似乎是自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。根据加工设备的状况来判断，这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在我们试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。

或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但仍应该密切观察它们。
excerpt.en: The deep-space drones we have encountered appear to be the workers and custodians of autonomous orbital mining operations. Judging by the state of the processing equipment, these sites were established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drone

excerpt.zh:
一项对此前以[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指代的一堆残骸和太空尘埃的调查居然得到了惊人的发现：它是一团由微粒聚集而成的云体，蕴含着来源不明的强大能源。它原本连反射性动作都不应该做出，更不要说是自主移动了。

可它确实在自主移动。

这份录像中移动的飘渺物体透着一股不祥之兆，或许这个宇宙里有一些东西是我们不该去碰的。
excerpt.en: Our investigation into the peculiar cluster of debris and space-dust with the designation [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has yielded surprising results: it is a particulate cloud bristling with a powerful charge of unknown origin. It has no business exhibiting

excerpt.zh:
我们已经从[FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName]所在的[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中获得了该生物的遗传物质。

虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
excerpt.en:
We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].

Though we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biolog

excerpt.zh:
我们已经从[FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName]所在的[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中获得了该生物的遗传物质。

虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
excerpt.en:
We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].

Though we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biolog

excerpt.zh: 我们发现，这些远距离信号源于一种简单的太空生物，我们将其命名为“虚空虫”。似乎整个星系都充满了这种生物。根据信号的不同波长，我们确定这些生物在达到最终成熟之前会经历多个生长阶段。虽然它们表面上看起来并不具有攻击性，但它们的交流模式表明它们在星系范围内进行着协调。
excerpt.en: We have discovered that the far-reaching signals originate from a simple spaceborne organism we have taken to calling "Voidworms". It appears that the galaxy is riddled with these creatures. From the varying wavelengths of the signals, we have determined that

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一种居住在小行星外壳内的太空生物，将其命名为岩居兽。它们是一种可以埋伏数年只为给猎物致命一击的伏击掠食者。它们极度危险，能吞下整艘舰船，所以在探索那些未调查的小行星带时务必格外小心。

好消息是，它们的数量非常稀少，而且无性繁殖流程可能要花费上百年。
excerpt.en: We have discovered a spaceborne organism that shelters inside of asteroids. Known to us as "Cutholoids", these creatures are ambush predators that are capable of lying in wait for several years to capture their prey. Capable of engulfing entire ships, we shoul

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢被[from.GetName]摧毁。

不幸的是，有部分高价值标本无法取回。
我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。

我需要在另一个恒星系中重建博物天枢让标本展览得以继续。
excerpt.en:
Our Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] has been destroyed by [from.GetName].

Unfortunately, we were unable to recover some of our valuable Specimens.
Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive stat

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]搜寻珍宝藏库的过程中，[fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName][fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere]遭到了一支海盗舰队的伏击！

这些法外狂徒不知怎么发现了我们的进展，打算把这些宝物据为己有。如果我们想要拿到这些宝藏，就必须在他们抢到之前打败他们的舰队。
excerpt.en:
As we were searching for the Treasure Trove on [from.GetName], [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName] [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere] ambushed by a pirate fleet!

These outlaws have somehow trailed our progress and seek to take the treasure for themselves. If we are t

excerpt.zh: [GetHyperthermiaIntroIfRedGiant]
excerpt.en: [GetHyperthermiaIntroIfRedGiant]

excerpt.zh:
我们完成了第一座采集能量并转化为结晶熵的基础设施。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成结晶熵。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

解锁巨型结构：星系熔炉框架
excerpt.en: We have completed our first working infrastructure for harvesting energy and converting it into Crystallized Entropy. These crystals hold immense thermal energy and already enable our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional

excerpt.zh:
[guardians_horror_system.GetName]附近试图突入我们宇宙的恶质实体被赶回原位面。它的影响是否已被削弱到能被妥善地封印，只有时间能告诉我们。

我们监测到某种反常的残余能量，一定是生物打开空间裂隙时留下的。深入研究这种能量可能带来科学突破。
excerpt.en:
The malignant entity which attempted to breach our universe near [guardians_horror_system.GetName] has been banished back into its own realm. Only time will tell if its influence has been sufficiently weakened to keep it there for good.

We are detecting some

excerpt.zh:
我们成功在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系使这艘自动化无畏舰丧失了行动力。虽然我方炮火猛烈，但是这艘战舰的舰体却大部分完好无损。

我们派出的特遣队进入该舰后发现里面的外星种群船员早已身亡多年，他们在临终前启动了某种自动巡逻模式，而这艘战舰的自动巡逻模式竟然已经运行了780万年。

虽然会耗费甚多资源，一些工程师相信该舰可以修复并服役于我军。它一定会成为强大的旗舰。
excerpt.en:
We have managed to disable the automated dreadnought in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. Despite the punishment it took from our ships, the structural integrity of the warship's massive hull remains largely intact.

Our boarding parties found

excerpt.zh:
[hiver_system.GetName]恒星系是一种具有独特性质的异常密集小行星环带的家乡。一些大型的小行星表面覆盖着突出的结晶，似乎是非常丰富的矿物矿藏。

然而，远程传感器正在追踪几个小型的、无法识别的可能是宇宙飞船的物体的零星运动，它们位于环带中的密度较大的区域。我们无法准确对其定位，但我们已经确定了至少两个被摧毁的采矿站的碎片，它们漂浮在一些较大小行星附近的太空中。
excerpt.en:
The [hiver_system.GetName] system is home to an unusually dense asteroid belt with unique properties. Several of the larger asteroids are covered in crystalline outcroppings that appear to be extremely rich mineral deposits.

However, long-range sensors are tr

excerpt.zh:
我们的部队成功摧毁了[hive_system.GetName]星系的外星蜂巢小行星。该地区没有再出现任何攻击机了。

其中一个小行星虽然受到猛烈攻击但却大致完好无损。我们可以考虑派出一支科研队上去查看下。
excerpt.en:
Our forces have managed to smash the alien hive asteroids in the [hive_system.GetName] system. They are once again dormant, and we are not detecting any more of those vicious attack craft.

One of the asteroids is still reasonably intact, despite the damage in

excerpt.zh:
可怕的以太巨龙已经被击杀。英勇无畏的指挥官[From.From.GetLeaderName]和[From.From.GetName]将流芳百世。

之前那头巨兽千方百计守护的那颗小行星现在可以放心开采了。谁知道它千百亿年以来积累了怎样的宝藏？
excerpt.en:
The formidable Ether Drake has been slain. The exceptional bravery of Commander [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the [From.From.GetName] will not soon be forgotten.

The planetoid the beast guarded so jealously can now be safely exploited. Who knows what treasure

excerpt.zh: 一支[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesName]舰队正在朝我们的边境驶来！我们截获了该舰队的通讯，他们是受敌对国雇佣来袭击我们的星系的，他们现在正在从公开频道上给我们发送消息。
excerpt.en: A [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesName] raiding fleet has been detected approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rivalling foreign power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message directed towards us o

excerpt.zh: 为了“保护”我们，[raider_khanate.GetName]已在[capital_star.GetName]星系建立了一座大型军事基地，还驻扎了为数不小的舰队。这个基地的第二层用意似乎是为了鼓励我们尽快完成作为辖地的职责，并监督召集[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]加入大可汗舰队的进度。
excerpt.en: For our "protection" the [raider_khanate.GetName] has established a large military space installation in the [capital_star.GetName] system, defended by a sizable garrison fleet. The secondary role of this base appears to be to encourage us to fulfill our oblig

title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

excerpt.zh:
随着冠铸秀方舟舰的引爆，广播信号切断为黑屏。我们搜查了[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系中的残骸，并打捞了他们那满溢的储物仓。

他们最后的“奇观”相当有利可图……对我们而言。
excerpt.en:
The broadcast cuts to black as the CFL Arkship detonates. We comb the wreckage in the [champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName] system and haul in the contents of their overflowing storage bays.

Their final "spectacle" was quite profitable... for us.

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]定居吧！
excerpt.en: Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNameP

excerpt.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站的科学家申请一艘科研船，以便他们收集来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的标本。为了研究目的，他们想秘密地绑架部分[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，并对它们进行试验。然后，他们将被安全地送回地表，所有记忆被抹除干净。
excerpt.en: Our scientists on the Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have requested a Science Ship to help them gather specimens from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. For the purpose of research, they would like to covertly abduct some of the

excerpt.zh:
飞向[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的小行星在到达[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表前就被摧毁。碎片在进入大气层时均已安全地烧毁，并未造成任何实质性的破坏。

[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]外星人欣赏到了一场极为壮观的流星雨，全然不知自己刚刚躲过了一场灭顶之灾……
excerpt.en:
The asteroid that was heading towards [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been destroyed before it could reach the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. What fragments reached the atmosphere burned up safely before they could cause any harm.

Aside from having

excerpt.zh: 当特工在稳步进入[from.target.GetName]更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。
excerpt.en: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the [from.target.GetName]. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding techn

excerpt.zh:
最近间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到[from.target.GetName]上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。
excerpt.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the [from.target.GetName], after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [fr

excerpt.zh:
一队位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于[from.GetName]行动甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[oper
excerpt.en: A group of auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing the

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在列出处于[root.target.GetName]境内有潜力成为卧底的人。他们希望能将这些卧底安插到合适的岗位，让他们平日看起来无伤大雅，却能在相当长的时间里随时做好进攻准备。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.

excerpt.zh: 利爪号上的一群工程师帮传达了一条来自斯克兰德的指令。他们请求我们帮助维护利爪号的框架，并让我们的船坞做好修船的准备。如上所述，这些计划代价高昂。而且还有一个问题：考虑到这项工作的微妙性质，斯克兰德将不得不亲自监督该项目。
excerpt.en: A group of engineers from the Talon has delivered an order from Skrand himself. They requested help to maintain the Talon's frame and prepare our shipyards for potential repairs. As outlined, these plans would be a costly process. And there is one catch: given

excerpt.zh: 多亏了额外的安全系统以及紧急协议，斯克兰德的旗舰在受到严重损坏后仍成功进行了紧急超光速跃迁。尽管出现在我们首都星球上方的残骸几乎无法被识别为一艘舰船，但船体依然可以作为重建的基础。这些残骸现在正在船坞等待修理。或者，我们可以对船体进行材料回收。考虑到它的状态，即便是我们认定这艘舰船的残骸无法修复的，斯克兰德也会理解这个决定。
excerpt.en: Thanks to additional failsafe systems and emergency protocols, Skrands' flagship managed to enter emergency FTL even after taking critical damage. Although what appeared in the skies above our capital world is barely recognizable as a ship, the hull can serve

excerpt.zh:
随着巨像完成其毁天灭地的任务，[From.From.GetName]因受到[From.GetName]地壳破裂与磁层分解的猛烈冲击而产生的微微晃动也平息了下来。

我们很难理解一颗星球死亡时的那种壮烈，但[From.GetName]炽热的核心在冰冷宇宙中冷却时的那种死亡之美是无可争辩的。
excerpt.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s gentle rocking - buffeted by [From.GetName]'s rupturing crust and unraveling magnetosphere - subsides as the Colossus completes its cataclysmic task.

The sheer violence of a dying planet is difficult to comprehend, but the funereal b

excerpt.zh:
我们以为自己已经充分了解[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]文化，能让特工成功地融入社会了，但实际上他们还是遭遇了重重困难。当地人似乎对他们冷眼旁观，将我们的特工排除出社交场合，甚至包括一些每日例行的文化活动。

现在说服任何人接纳我们都变得难上加难，更别说执行[from.GetName]行动的目标了。考虑到社会平衡现在处于微妙的棘手状态，我们应该谨慎考虑下一步行动。
excerpt.en:
We thought we knew [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] culture well enough that our operatives would fit in socially, but many are struggling. The locals seem to shun them, excluding our agents from social occasions and even some everyday cultural activities.

It's ge

excerpt.zh:
最终清算拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。

初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。
excerpt.en:
The Reckoning is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.

Preliminary analysis indicat

excerpt.zh:
内脏般的恶臭充斥着我们的感官。

幻象开始从虚境的深处出现，扭动和咆哮带着贪婪的狂怒。起先，饥馑的野兽之吼响起……我们同感了它们的饥饿。随后它们的垂涎也被我们共有。

一些剪影浮现，那是惊慌失措的牲畜。猎物。诱人地逐渐靠近……噬骨的疼痛愈发难熬。

饥饿渐渐吞噬我们的心智，感官变得扭曲皱缩。这些惨叫到底是来自猎物……还是来自我们自己的内心？

束缚我们的枷锁勒紧。随着痛苦盘旋尖叫的心声一同碎裂：

撕碎你们的骨！喰宴！
excerpt.en:
The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.

Images, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our

excerpt.zh:
有个心声，自深渊……回荡着。粗粝，而又饱含恶意……向我们呼唤着。

供养。消耗。吞噬。

幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。

随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。
excerpt.en:
From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.

FEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.

Visions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed b

excerpt.zh:
拨开虚境的迷雾，显出无边无数纠缠不清的幻景。

朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。

在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。

一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。

如此无序。作茧自缚。
excerpt.en:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endle

excerpt.zh:
虚境中无数混乱的能量正在翻腾不息。

暗影的卷须旋转着向外突刺，薄雾本身也在猛烈翻滚。在灵能能量的漩涡中，两个无形的实体正在交锋。它们毫不停歇，互不退让，满溢着愤怒。

一个奇怪的意识侵入了我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]，它浩瀚无垠又咄咄逼人。

来到此地者需呈递良方。
excerpt.en:
The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.

Shadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.

A foreign presence p

excerpt.zh:
浓雾在我们面前重构。炽热的能量猛烈地脉动着。我们看到一个奇怪的树形轮廓。

走近一看，它巨大的树冠在紫色、粉色和黑色之间纷乱闪烁。

在它的底部是一个发光的内核，与树冠变换的颜色变化同步发出光芒。

一个心声停留在我们的[GetMindLoc]中。

占有。夺取。利用。
excerpt.en:
The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.

Its immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.

Ensconced within i

excerpt.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
excerpt.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

excerpt.zh: 一种浓重的阴郁笼罩着我们。压力，从四面八方，挤得越来越紧。直到一片朦胧的景象出现。
excerpt.en: A dense gloom envelops us. From all sides, pressure, squeezing tighter and tighter. Until a hazy vista presents itself.

excerpt.zh:
虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。

我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。

一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。

我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。
excerpt.en:
The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.

A compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].

Clarity floods

excerpt.zh:
虚境收缩、折叠，将我们的心灵深深地压入一个有限的共鸣虚空中。

一个存在若隐若现，流变而模糊着。随着它将我们与虚境其他部分之间的鸿沟的开合而变化。每一次翕动都释放出一连串的幻景。
excerpt.en:
The Shroud contracts, folding inwards, pressing our psyche deep within a confined and resonating void.

A presence looms, fluid and indistinct. Its form shifts as it opens and closes the divide that separates us from the rest of the Shroud. Each shuttering rev

excerpt.zh:
一场不和谐的毁灭之乐将我们拖向虚境的深处。每一次反响都带着无情的毁灭节奏冲击着我们的心灵。

噪音具象化了。

我们正处在灵能冲突的边缘。参战实体的动机尚不清楚，但展现出了极其强大的力量。

灵能轰炸在我们的感知中进进出出，扭曲着我们面前破碎的现实。这里没有掩护，只有逼近的风暴。
excerpt.en:
A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.

The noise takes its form.

We are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities in

excerpt.zh:
毫无征兆地，虚境之中泛起了灵压。

一座耀眼的迷宫在我们面前展开，一直延伸到感知之外，它短暂撕裂开虚空出现，又渐隐回虚空。

另一次涌现正在酝酿。如果集中注意力，我们就能在它出现前感知到它的结构。隐现的迷宫再次点燃，向外爆发成一个可能性的网络。

在它崩塌回虚空之前，每一条道路都能带来全新的探索诱惑。
excerpt.en:
Without warning, a psychic pressure erupts in the Shroud.

A labyrinth of incandescent pathways unfolds before us, stretching beyond perception, crackling into momentary existence before vanishing into the void.

Another surge begins to build. With concentrati

excerpt.zh:
虚境之中，一道单一灵能形成的图腾光束越过我们直插无可计量的虚空。其构造独特而稳定，与以往司空见惯的混沌之形截然不同。

逗留于此不知是否安全？
excerpt.en:
A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.

Is it safe to remain here?

excerpt.zh:
数阵强烈的惊厥穿过虚境，将一阵颤栗送入我们的心智。

这些回响将[GetTelepathPlural]置于过载的风险之中。

这种灵能轰炸究竟是什么引起的呢？
excerpt.en:
A series of powerful convulsions pass through the Shroud, sending a shuddering tremor through our minds.

These reverberations threaten to overwhelm our [GetTelepathPlural].

What is the cause of this psionic bombardment?

excerpt.zh:
我们在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站汇报，在最近一次地表地址调查之后丢失了一个补给箱。

在追踪补给箱地理定位的过程中，我们发现它被一座当地村庄发现并占为己有。

我们补给箱的混入可能对[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的发展带来不利影响。
excerpt.en:
Our observation post above [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported missing supply crates following a recent geological survey on the surface.

While tracking the geolocators on the supplies, we have discovered that a local village has found and clai

excerpt.zh:
大量巨型食草物种开始干扰[Root.GetName]的能量产出。这些生物展现出大规模戏剧化的自杀式行为，活生生地在我们的发电站里电死烤焦。

这些动物有非常强烈的冲动，为了实现目标甚至冲破了我们电网周围的栅栏。由于这种奇特的行为，能源生产受到了影响。

然而这也带来了意料之外的食物产出，当地[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现这种生物的肉非常地美味。

这一物种在该行星的生态系统中扮演了重要的角色。如果事故以当前频率发生下去，它们很快就会将自己灭绝的。
excerpt.en:
An abundant species of herbivorous megafauna have begun to disrupt the energy production of [Root.GetName]. In dramatic displays of mass suicide, they are frying themselves alive on our power stations.

The animals are extremely driven in their purpose, breaki

excerpt.zh:
有报道称[Root.Capital.GetName]上正在酝酿着一个鹰派运动，而一位老兵象征性地处于这个运动的核心地位。他们通过对我们过去可以任意进犯、踏平其他帝国的浪漫主义化，来敦促我们提出更激进的议程，为我们自己的人民带来更多的利益，同时削弱我们的对手。

在当前脆弱而短暂的和平下，他们很快获得了广大穷人和军人的支持。如果觉得这个运动会带来麻烦的话，我们的顾问指出，这个运动的关键角色就是那位有名无实的领袖，如果移除这个惹麻烦的元素，整个运动就会土崩瓦解。
excerpt.en: There are reports of a hawkish movement brewing on [Root.Capital.GetName], with a decorated veteran at its center. Romanticizing a past where we were free to attack and raze other empires, they demand a more warlike agenda to supposedly bring out the best in o

excerpt.zh:
自从我们文明的伊始以来，一直有关于强大的术士掌握着只能用超自然力量形容的力量的传说。这些稀有的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以侵入他们同胞的心智，用一个念想就能举起重物，或者表演其他的“魔法”壮举。直到最近，这些故事才变成“故”事。

如今，我们的科学家终于得到了结论性的证据以证明某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]个体存在潜在的灵能潜力。虽然我们的物种只有非常少的一部分人被天赐了灵能潜力，他们数量相对于总人口数在过去几世纪里稳步增长。

不知这是因为某种瞬间的增长井喷，还是因为
excerpt.en: Since the dawn of our civilization, tales have flourished of mighty sorcerers wielding powers that can only be described as supernatural in nature. These rare [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could supposedly invade the minds of their fellows, lift heavy objects wi

excerpt.zh: 虽然成年后显现灵能较为罕见，但也不是前所未有。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近展示的能力，我们就怀疑其本质是灵能。经过了全面的超能感知测试后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被证实拥有4级灵能天赋。
excerpt.en: While it is rare for psionic powers to manifest after reaching adulthood, it is not unheard of. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently been displaying abilities that were suspected to be psionic in nature. After undergoing a thorough E

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种经历了只能被形容为“大觉醒”的蜕变，以往，我们伟大的灵能潜力便是我们物种固有的存在，虽然只在一小部分人身上有所展示，而如今……

几乎是一夜之间，身处各处的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了他们全部的灵能潜力，就像某种共通的[Root.GetSpeciesName]灵能能量池达到了激活值一样，将我们大脑中的灵能潜力集体激活。

心灵感应已经取代了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]间大部分语音交流，而且这只是我们的社会面对的
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has experienced what can only be described as a Great Awakening. For a time now, we have been aware of the great psionic potential inherent in our species, but such powers have only manifested themselves in a small minority...

excerpt.zh:
就像暗室里低沉的轻语般，虚境从内心召唤我们。那是时间开始运转的伊始便存在的由纯粹灵能构成的原生领域。所有被赐予灵能能力的生物都能用某种方式，即使只是潜意识地，从虚境汲取能量。

自从我们升格之后，我们开始更清晰地看到虚境。其中有些图案，即使是我们最强大的通灵者看到的也只是毫无格式的漩涡状能量。在虚境那边，也有一些……其他的存在。一种灵体样的存在，从另一边凝视着我们，有时怀着好奇，有时怀着善意……有时也怀着恶意。

我们还在进一步学习我们这新得力量的延展面，但我们还是有可能和这些灵体交流的，这需要我们最强大的通灵者们
excerpt.en: Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, the Shroud calls to us from within our minds. It is a primordial realm of pure psychic energy that came into being at the dawn of time. All creatures that have been gifted with psionic abilities tap into the Shroud in som

excerpt.zh: 虚空之低语渴求超越平凡思维局限的知识。给予我们[Owner.GetResearchers]们广泛的授权，专注于深奥的研究领域，就可以寻求满足低语的渴望。
excerpt.en: The Whisperers in the Void yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.

excerpt.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]的扫描显示，在该地区存在大量的有加工痕迹的物品以及零零散散的放射性物质，但从轨道上看不到什么细节。为了了解更多信息，我们需要着陆进行实地调查。
excerpt.en: Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed an area with packed with refined material and scattered radiologicals, although little is visible from orbit. To find out more we will need to investigate the site on the ground.

excerpt.zh: 虽然乍看上去平淡无奇，但对[From.Planet.GetName]进一步的检查表明它实际上是一座伪装成自然星体的人工结构。
excerpt.en: Seemingly unremarkable at first, closer examination of [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed that it is actually an artificial construct designed to mimic a natural asteroid.

excerpt.zh: 我们的合金赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our alloys deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的消费品赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our consumer goods deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的异星天然气赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our exotic gases deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的食物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our food deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的矿物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our mineral deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh:
我们的原始指令就是将产出最大化。执行该命令就是我们的目标。我们的核心算法强制自己完成指定配额。

Our primary directive and purpose is output maximization. Meeting the required quotas is mandatory.
The delivery date is [owner.situation_paperclips_timer]
The current production target is: [Owner.paperclips_once_again]
The current stockpile is: [Owner.papercl

excerpt.zh: 我们的稀有水晶赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our rare crystals deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的易爆微粒赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our volatile motes deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过L-星门到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。

这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
excerpt.en:
We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through L-Gates, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for n

excerpt.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的初步探测读数表明它可以支持外星生命。
excerpt.en: Initial sensory readings from [From.GetName] suggest it could support alien life.

excerpt.zh: 查看这条外星信号
excerpt.en: Check out the alien signal

excerpt.zh: [From.GetPlanetMoon]并非气候宜人之地，但如果我们最初的侦测结果无误，它上面可能有一些珍贵资源。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is not the most welcoming of places, but if our initial scans are any indication it could hold some valuable resources.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]周期性地向太空发射出骇人的粒子辐射混合体。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] periodically spews an alarmingly eclectic mix of particles and radiation into the void.

excerpt.zh: 我们对小行星的成分进行了初步的分析，有了一些有趣的发现。
excerpt.en: Initial analysis of the asteroid's composition points towards potentially interesting finds.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]大气的实际读数与模拟数值不同。
excerpt.en: Atmospheric readings from [Root.GetName] do not match simulated projections.

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]环绕恒星的方向与恒星系内其他行星相反，这说明它和伴随的天体并不是同时同地形成的。

需要进一步调查来了解该行星的起源。
excerpt.en:
[from.GetName] orbits its star in the reverse direction compared to the other planets in the system, suggesting it did not form here at the same time as its companion celestial bodies.

Further investigation is needed to understand this planet's origins.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表探测到了微弱的信号。信号源似乎是某种追踪信标。
excerpt.en: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.

excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]看似典型的火山荒原，但氧气含量却异常之高，一定是有特殊生物在产生氧气。
excerpt.en: While [Planet.GetName] appears to be a typical volcanic wasteland, the oxygen content is strangely high. Something unusual must be producing that oxygen.

excerpt.zh: 在[from.GetName]的大气中发现了浓厚的黑云，它们无视行星的风速和风向以极不正常的方式运动着。这些黑云只在我们的成像扫描中短暂出现，并且总是在行星昼夜周期的同一时间点上出现。
excerpt.en: Thick black clouds have been observed in [from.GetName]'s atmosphere, moving in erratic patterns independent of planetary wind speed or direction. They appear only briefly on our imaging scans and always at the same point in the planet's day-night cycle.

excerpt.zh: 暗淡的瑟顿星系潜藏着一处宇宙织构的裂痕。更不同寻常的是这个裂口本身正在收缩，似乎有什么东西或是什么人正在修复它。
excerpt.en: The dim Seddom system houses a tear in the fabric of the universe. Even more unusual, the tear itself is gradually shrinking, as if something or someone is working to repair it.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的波谱信号表明行星上的一种成分富含某种稀有而复杂的碳同素异形体。为了更彻底的分类，需要更仔细的检查。
excerpt.en: Spectroscopy data from [from.GetName] indicates a planetary composition rich in rare and complex carbon allotropes. Closer inspection is required for more thorough categorization.

excerpt.zh: [From.System.GetName]星系中有什么东西在损坏我们的探测器数据。这一异常现象的原因似乎是[From.GetName]星球。
excerpt.en: Something in the [From.System.GetName] system is corrupting some of our sensory data. The source of the irregularity seems to be the planet [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 这些坐标位置上的行星据说藏有大量休眠者和技术，我们应该展开彻底调查。
excerpt.en: The planet at these coordinates is supposed to hide a cache of sleepers and technology. We should investigate thoroughly.

excerpt.zh: 这些坐标位置上的行星据说藏有大量休眠者和技术，我们应该展开彻底调查。
excerpt.en: The planet at these coordinates is supposed to hide a cache of sleepers and technology. We should investigate thoroughly.

excerpt.zh: 该行星表面似有大片自由流动的熔岩池，或具备资源开采潜力，值得深入调查。
excerpt.en: This planet appears to have large pools of free-flowing lava on its surface. These are worth investigating, in case they present opportunities for resource harvesting.

excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]的地质分析在全星球发现了性质异常的显著冰火山活动。
excerpt.en: Tectonic analysis of [from.GetName] shows significant cryovolcanic activity across the planet of an anomalous nature.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的高温尚在预料范围之内。但是，我们的队伍还收集到了很多反常数据。在完成最终报告之前，还需要深入研究。
excerpt.en: The scorching heat of [Root.GetName] is within the expected range. However, there is more unusual data still being collected by our team. Further study is needed before a final report can be filed.

excerpt.zh: 一座荒废的空间站悬浮在轨道上，无力地环绕着[From.GetName]，身披数个世纪里被残骸冲撞而留下的伤痕。考虑到它破损的状态和无法识别的科技，我们需要一个专家团队来对它进行调查。
excerpt.en: Scarred by centuries of debris impacts, a dilapidated relic of a station hangs in orbit, trailing wearily behind [From.GetName]. Its decrepit state and unrecognized technology will require a team of specialists to investigate.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]具有显著的非球面特征，其地表有着巨大且完全不符合地理学模型的构造。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] is remarkably aspherical, possessing some sort of enormous formation on its surface that defies geological models.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的脉冲十分稳定，其日震研究表明它的内部构成物质的密度比我们所预计要大得多。是什么赋予了它这种令人惊异的密度？
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] pulses steadily, its helioseismology indicating an internal composition far denser than expected. What could be responsible for this surprising density?

excerpt.zh: 从某个未知源点发散的网状结构在[From.GetName]的表面周期性发光。
excerpt.en: Glowing webs of an unknown origin periodically illuminate the surface of [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的地表上覆盖了一层非常奇特的植物，这与该星球上的其他植物都不相同。
excerpt.en: Entire continents on [From.GetName] are blanketed in a strange growth that seems at odds with the rest of the planet's flora.

excerpt.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]这颗星球上缺乏大气，但地表上有人造设施的遗迹，说明过去这里曾有文明。
excerpt.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的植物数量多到惊人地充斥了整个地表，这些植物体积庞大且拥有鲜艳的颜色，我们的异星生物学家对此很感兴趣。
excerpt.en: Plant life of truly incredible proportions dominates the landscape of [From.GetName], its vibrant colors and gargantuan size almost calling to our xeno-biologists.

excerpt.zh: 这些在[From.GetName]遍布灰尘的地表上勉强度日的土著和我们在同一个星系的另一个死寂星球上发现的物种具有惊人的相似性。
excerpt.en: The primitives eking out an existence on the ashy plains of [From.GetName] are remarkably similar to the ones discovered on another tomb world in the same system.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]小行星的共振成像显示其内部含有稀有水晶。
excerpt.en: Resonance imaging of the [From.GetName] asteroid suggests an internal composition consisting of rare crystals.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]的轨道上有未知舰队，我们向他们发出联络，但他们没有回复。
excerpt.en: Readings suggest the presence of an unknown fleet in orbit of [From.GetName]. They do not respond to hails.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的地表是冻土，但测量到的表面温度却高达上百度，是什么造成了这种不一致的现象呢？
excerpt.en: The measured surface temperature of [From.GetName] is in the hundreds of degrees, despite its frozen surface. What could be causing these discrepancies?

excerpt.zh: 一个来源不明的箱体围绕着[From.GetName]旋转，其中大量贮藏了某种有机物质。
excerpt.en: A derelict tanker of unknown origin orbits [From.GetName], its reservoirs heavy with some manner of organic substance.

excerpt.zh: 和预想的不同，[From.GetName]的厚厚的大气层之下有着一个异常巨大的坚固内核，我们的科学家建议对此进行深入调查。
excerpt.en: Despite expected projections, [From.GetName] has a particularly large solid core beneath its incredibly thick mantle of unique gases. Our scientists recommend further investigation.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的内部扫描图像表明星球地表之下有非常巨大的地下洞窟，它们可能值得调查。
excerpt.en: Interior imaging of [From.GetName] suggests massive underground caverns wait below the planet's surface. They may be worth investigation.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的大气将我们的传感器在无线电频段的扫描全数反射。在这下方有着什么东西在持续干扰我们的信号。
excerpt.en: The atmosphere of [From.GetName] is reflecting our sensors at radio frequencies. Something down there is interfering with our signals.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]地表上有许多火山口喷出热气，这对于熔融星球来说是不常见的，部分喷出的热气有较高的工业价值。
excerpt.en: A remarkable array of gases are being vented on [From.GetName] - ones not usually found on molten worlds. Some of these gases show promising industrial value.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]这个行星体的表面覆盖着某种灰色物质，该灰色物质拥有十分怪异的性质和复杂多变的金属成分。
excerpt.en: The planetary body [From.GetName] appears to be covered in some manner of grayish substance, possessing strange properties and varying metallic composition.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的地表被某种银色的巨型金属晶体所支配了，这种晶体的体积十分巨大，前所未见。从轨道上看，很像是摩天大楼，有必要接近调查下。
excerpt.en: The geoscape of [From.GetName] is dominated by what appear from orbit to be silvery, metallic crystals of dimensions never-before-seen. From orbit, they eerily resemble skyscrapers. Closer study is warranted.

excerpt.zh: 扫描发现[From.GetName]的沙丘主要由罕见的颗粒状金属构成，里面可能含有非常珍贵的资源，我们应该提取出来纳为己用。
excerpt.en: Scanners indicate the sandy dunes of [From.GetName] are almost entirely composed of granulate rare metals. Perhaps some valuable resources could be extracted from them.

excerpt.zh: 扫描显示在[From.GetName]的水层之下隐藏着一个错综复杂的隧道系统。是谁创造了它们？
excerpt.en: Scans suggest an intricate system of tunnels lies hidden beneath the waters of [From.GetName]. What could have created them?

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]星系的小行星群，靠近[From.GetName]的地方定位了一个反射了我们传感器信号的物体。通过肉眼观察发现该物体具有多边形外形，但因为缺乏扫描数据，我们对它所知甚少。
excerpt.en: An object that reflects our sensors has been located in the [From.GetStarName] asteroid field, near [From.GetName]. Visual observation has identified the object as polygonal in shape, but due to lack of scanner data, little else is known.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]周围的吸积盘呈现出绚丽的折射光谱，与彩虹的无异。造成这种现象的原因会是什么？
excerpt.en: The accretion disk around [From.GetName] exhibits a remarkable refraction spectrum, not unlike that of a rainbow. What could be causing it?

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的初步调查显示了该行星是某个亡故帝国的旧都，我们之前遇到的垃圾场正是属于这个帝国的。对其进行更彻底的调查或许能获得更多的信息。
excerpt.en: Our initial survey of the [From.GetName] suggests this planet is the fallen capital of a lost empire whose junkyards we have encountered prior. A more thorough investigation may yield further information.

excerpt.zh: 探测器发现在[From.GetName]的地表有着异常高的对称性。
excerpt.en: Scanners indicate an unusually high level of symmetry on the surface of [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 舰船传感器在[From.GetStarName]星系检测到了一种无法解释的信号干扰模式。
excerpt.en: Ship sensors are picking up an unexplained pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] System.

excerpt.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行扫描后发现该星球地壳中有不少共鸣水晶，我们应该能对此加以利用。
excerpt.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal a continental crust filled with resonant crystals. We may be able to make some use of them.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的磁层对我们的研究用无人机产生了强大的吸引力，原因不明。我们应该进行进一步的调查。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName]'s magnetosphere is highly appealing to our research drones in orbit, for reasons they cannot explain. We should investigate further.

excerpt.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]厚密的植被之下埋藏着人工构造。
excerpt.en: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 深到能从轨道直接进行观察的峡谷勾勒出了[From.GetName]表面的纹路，但是这颗行星却像风沙侵蚀区一样干燥。曾经如此强烈地侵蚀了[From.GetName]岩层的那些水怎么了呢？
excerpt.en: Canyons deep enough to be seen from orbit furrow the surface of [From.GetName], yet the planet is dry as a dustbowl. What could have happened to the water that once so profoundly carved [From.GetName]'s' stone?

excerpt.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]上有一个孤立的针状人工结构。
excerpt.en: Sensors indicate an isolated pinprick of artificial structures on [From.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的轨道扫描检测到这颗行星深深的冰洋之下有异常的电信号。

对这种水中自然现象进行进一步研究可以获得更多发现。
excerpt.en:
Orbital scans of [from.GetName] are detecting erratic electrical signals deep within the planet's icy seas.

Further study into this aquatic phenomenon will reveal more.

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描追踪到了极端的气象现象，地表分布着零星但强烈的热脉冲。

需要进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] are tracking extreme meteorological phenomena, with sporadic but intense heat spikes distributed across the surface.

This warrants further investigation.

excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]的初步扫描结果是损坏的，我们的仪器无法清晰解读。这一干扰的来源尚不明确；或许需要近距离调查 。
excerpt.en: Initial scans of [from.GetName] are returning in a corrupted state that our sensors cannot clearly interpret. The source of this interference remains unclear; a closer inspection will be needed.

excerpt.zh: 探测器发现一奇异物体在小行星带中漂移。其来源未知，但轨迹稳定，表明可拦截检查。
excerpt.en: Sensors have picked up a strange object drifting through the asteroid field. Its origin is unknown, but its course is steady, suggesting it can be intercepted and examined.

excerpt.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]极地表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
excerpt.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s arctic surface.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]表面到处都是无法解释的光学现象，从太空中清晰可见。
excerpt.en: Inexplicable optical phenomena play across the surface of [Root.GetName], clearly visible from space.

excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]的初步扫描发现在这颗冰冻的天体上存在极不正常的热量峰值。这种温度异常亟待进一步的调查。
excerpt.en: Initial scans of [from.GetName] are showing extremely erratic heat spikes on this otherwise frozen celestial body. These anomalous temperatures elicit further investigation.

excerpt.zh: 对[Root.GetName]的图像扫描显示，整颗行星覆盖着网格般的纹路。
excerpt.en: Visual scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface reveal a grid pattern seemingly covering the entire planet.

excerpt.zh: 这是一颗盖亚级行星，[Root.GetName]预计会有丰富的生命体……
excerpt.en: As a Gaia-class planet, [Root.GetName] is expected to teem with life...

excerpt.zh: 我们的探测器在[Root.GetName]上侦测到了表明外星人活动迹象的能源放射。
excerpt.en: Our sensors are registering energy emissions indicative of alien activity on [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气特征在中等规模的气态巨行星中很不寻常。
excerpt.en: The atmospheric patterns of [Root.GetName] are highly atypical for a gas giant of modest size.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]缺乏氢和氦，无法被归为气态巨行星，而是冰冻巨行星。
excerpt.en: It seems [Root.GetName] is lacking the hydrogen and helium to be classified as a proper gas giant and is, in fact, an ice giant.

excerpt.zh:
对[Root.GetName]粗略扫描有了令人震惊的结果。

似乎有东西也在扫描我们……
excerpt.en:
A cursory scan of [Root.GetName] yields surprising results.

Something seems to be scanning us back...

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]表面一小块地方散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
excerpt.en: Impressive structures litter a small area on the surface of [Root.GetName], practically begging for some archaeological work.

excerpt.zh: 在[from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中探测到了许多怪异的重力读数，从内小行星带到恒星系中心的荒芜行星四处闪烁着这些信号。
excerpt.en: Strange gravimetric readings have been detected throughout the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system, pulsing from the inner astroid belt to the desolate planet at the heart of the system.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的地表分布着泾渭分明的两种色彩以极快的速度串联移动着，在太空中亦清晰可见。这些蓝色的结构相当有趣，值得进一步研究。
excerpt.en: The surface of [from.GetName] features two distinctive discolorations, large enough to be visible from space and moving in tandem at great speeds. These blue-colored formations are interesting enough to warrant further study.

excerpt.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示行星地壳中存在珍贵物质。
excerpt.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.

excerpt.zh: 令人震惊的[from.GetName]图像显示，一颗燃烧熔融星球上突然出现一片大陆大小的明亮绿色地带。这一罕见景象表明其地表存在极其异常的情况。
excerpt.en: Startling images of [from.GetName] show a burning, molten world interrupted by a startlingly bright, continent-sized swathe of green. This exceptional sight suggests something highly unusual on the surface.

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]的轨道路径上有一个反复出现的微小震荡。这表明它有规律地受到某种大型未知引力的影响。

建议对其周边环境进行进一步研究。
excerpt.en:
A small but recurring oscillation has been observed in the orbit path of [from.GetName], suggesting it is regularly subjected to some large unknown gravitational force.

Further study of the surrounding space is recommended.

excerpt.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的首次勘测发现，行星的主熔岩海洋中存在一种奇特的风暴状形态，极为罕见，值得深入研调查。
excerpt.en: The first survey of [Planet.GetName] revealed a strange storm-like shape in the planet's main lava ocean. This phenomenon is highly unusual, and bears investigating.

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描发现可燃气体在整颗行星上零星喷发，给远程观测带来了挑战。

需要进行近距离调查。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] have detected sporadic eruptions of combustible gases across the planet, presenting challenges for remote surveys.

A closer inspection will be needed.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]似乎有且只有一个有趣的地质特征……
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] seems to exhibit one, and only one, interesting geological feature...

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]贫瘠的不毛之地下方探测到了生命的迹象。到底是怎样的有机体才有可能生存在那里面呢？
excerpt.en: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]被潮汐锁定了，有一半永远处于黑夜之中。红外扫描发现这片漆黑贫瘠的区域竟是某种活跃的有机生态系统所在。
excerpt.en: [from.GetName] is tidally locked with one half of the planet existing in a state of permanent darkness. Infrared scans indicate that this lightless and nutrient deficient zone is home to an active organic ecosystem.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一个巨大的撞击坑，这似乎不是自然形成的。
excerpt.en: A large impact crater has been discovered that does not seem to be a natural occurrence.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的质量读数远低于一颗同等尺寸岩质行星预期范围。建议进一步调查。
excerpt.en: Mass readings for [from.GetName] are well below the expected range for a rocky planet of this size. Further investigation is recommended.

excerpt.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]剧热的表面扫描出有节奏的运动。
excerpt.en: Sensors pick up rhythmic movement on the hellish surface of [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]地表的初步调查发现这里经常发生一种含有高浓度重金属的超热熔岩海啸。必须通过进一步分析才能完全理解这种现象。
excerpt.en: Initial surveys of [from.GetName]'s surface have detected frequent tsunamis of superheated lava containing high concentrations of heavy metals. Further analysis will be necessary to fully understand this phenomenon.

excerpt.zh: 这颗卫星有些不太寻常。
excerpt.en: There is something unusual about this moon.

excerpt.zh: 科学家在[Planet.GetName]某一地点捕捉到规律性的电波峰，似与信号源从夜到昼的交替时间同步。
excerpt.en: Our scientists have detected regular radio wave spikes from a single point on [Planet.GetName]. They appear to coincide with the time at which the source of the signal crosses from night into day.

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行视觉扫描发现黑曜岩大陆板块覆盖着这颗行星贫瘠的表面，上层大气中残留着大量的硫。

专项地质调查将让我们得到更多结果。
excerpt.en:
Visual scans of [from.GetName] show continental sheets of obsidian coating the barren surfaces of the planet, with heavy traces of sulfur lingering in the upper atmosphere.

A more concentrated geological survey will tell us more.

excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]的影像扫描显示行星表面有极其活跃的光学现象，尽管这些颜色图案的成因在轨道距离上尚未探明。
excerpt.en: Our imaging scans of [from.GetName] are returning extremely vibrant optical phenomena across the planet's surface, though the cause of these color patterns remains unclear at an orbital distance.

excerpt.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的例行扫描发现大气中存在异常强烈的化学波动。深入调查或能揭示真相。
excerpt.en: A routine scan of [Planet.GetName] noted unusually strong chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere. A closer survey may explain what is happening here.

excerpt.zh:
沿[from.GetName]的构造断层线探测到了不稳定的能量波动。

这些波动的根源无法从轨道上加以确定。需要近距离研究才能弄清该现象的源头。
excerpt.en:
Erratic energy surges are being detected along the tectonic fault lines of [from.GetName].

The origin of these spikes cannot be ascertained from orbit. Closer study will be required to identify the source of this phenomenon.

excerpt.zh:
我们目睹了敏感的超热等离子体喷发到[from.GetName]的上层大气中。

大气层中浓厚的火山灰让我们无法从轨道上辨识这些喷射源，但近距离研究似乎存在危险。
excerpt.en:
We have visual confirmation of volatile superheated plasma being launched into the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

Thick volcanic ash in the atmosphere is preventing us from identifying the source of these projectiles from orbit. Closer study will likely

excerpt.zh: 对[this.GetName]的初步扫描发现了一个特殊的空中物体，漂浮在对流层中，随着位置的改变而涨缩。为探明其性质，需要进行进一步的调查。
excerpt.en: Initial scans of [this.GetName] have discovered a peculiar airborne object floating through the troposphere, shrinking and swelling in size as it changes positions. Further investigation is necessary in order to classify its nature.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现有一颗行星含有大量严重衰变的放射性同位素。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: We have discovered a planet containing large quantities of heavily decayed radioactive isotopes. Further investigation is warranted.

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]的初步扫描发现，遍流行星表面的荧光河不停地在整个光谱中变化。

进一步的研究会加深我们对这个异常自然现象的了解。
excerpt.en:
Preliminary scans of [from.GetName] show fluorescent rivers flowing across the planet's surface that continuously shift through the full range of the color spectrum.

Further study will tell us more about this unusual phenomenon.

excerpt.zh: 一个模糊的身影在[Root.GetName]的大海洋流之下翻腾着。
excerpt.en: Vaguely-defined shapes swirl with the currents in [Root.GetName]'s vast oceans.

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]表面的大洋之下，有一个不同寻常的巨大物体正在发出星星点点的光芒。
excerpt.en: Starlight can be seen glinting off an unusually large object, just under the ocean surface of [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
释放到[from.GetName]大气层中的探测器停止了一切通讯。我们失去了该硬件的行踪。

需要对该行星进行近距离调查才能取回这些数据。
excerpt.en:
Observation probes deployed into the atmosphere of [from.GetName] have ceased all communications. The exact location of our hardware is now unknown.

A closer investigation of the planet is needed to recover the data.

excerpt.zh: 这颗行星发射出怪异的磁力波，与我们目前为止所知的一切均大不相同，几乎可以说它就像想要与我们沟通一般。唯有对这一不同寻常的现象进行调查方才符合逻辑——我们可能遇上了一个行星大小生物形态的绝佳个例。
excerpt.en: This planet emits strange magnetic waves, quite unlike anything we have seen so far, almost as if it is trying to communicate with us. It is only logical to investigate this unusual phenomenon - we may have just encountered an extraordinary example of life on

excerpt.zh: 这个世界已经在使用核武的战争灰飞烟灭了。
excerpt.en: This world has been thoroughly ravaged in a nuclear war.

excerpt.zh: 一艘被遗弃的飞船漫无目的地漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上空。巨大的帆耸立于舰体之上，这表明其动力是太阳能。
excerpt.en: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.

excerpt.zh: 这个星系中有大量的超空间航道。通常情况下，我们会认为它们太小了，宇宙飞船无法在其中航行，但是它们的数量本身就很惊人。
excerpt.en: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.

excerpt.zh: 初步扫描显示，一系列高耸发光结构耸立于一片平凡的地貌。其起源和用途仍不明确，但其幽光说示这不仅仅是自然现象。
excerpt.en: Initial scans reveal a series of towering, luminescent structures rising from an otherwise unremarkable landscape. Their origin and purpose remain unclear, but their spectral glow suggests something more than a natural phenomenon.

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学专员发现，在[root.GetName]的日冕附近出现的疑似传感器故障在重启之后仍然留存在。已批准进一步研究。
excerpt.en: Our scientists have discovered what first appeared to be a sensor malfunction near the corona of [root.GetName], however it's still there after rebooting. A closer look is warranted.

excerpt.zh: 宇宙风暴经过后，出现了一颗组成成分极不寻常的彗星。它似乎是由有机材料组成的。我们的[solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切想要进行调查。
excerpt.en: A cosmic storm has left behind a comet of unusual composition. It appears to be made of organic material. Our [solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are keen to investigate.

excerpt.zh: 自从一场虚境风暴肆虐该恒星系后，我们就开始不断收到一些奇怪的信号。然而，当我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]想要回应这些呼叫时，信号又中断了。科学家们建议派出一艘科研船进行调查。
excerpt.en: Ever since a Shroud Storm raged through this system, we've been receiving strange signals. However, as soon as our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] try to answer this cacophony of hails, it dissipates again. They recommend sending a science vessel.

excerpt.zh: 宇宙风暴过境[from.solar_system.GetName]星系时改变了该恒星的外观。在风暴的余波过后，这颗恒星的日冕层呈现出异彩纷呈的漩涡，向四面八方喷射出五光十色的耀斑。这一现象值得进一步分析。
excerpt.en: The passing of a cosmic storm through the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has transformed the visual appearance of the system's star. In the aftermath of the storm, the star's coronal layer presents as a swirl of ever-changing colors, ejecting polychromatic

excerpt.zh: 轨道上的这个物体是途经的宇宙风暴带来的。它看上去像是一座空间站，但是对其结构组成的扫描结果却有点令人费解。我们建议对此开展调查。
excerpt.en: This orbiting object has been left behind by a passing cosmic storm. It looks like a space station but scans of its structural composition is returning most confusing results. We recommend investigating.

excerpt.zh: 在[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波中，从[from.solar_system.GetName]星系上侦测到了一个未识别的求助信号。
excerpt.en: In the aftermath of the [from.GetAffectedStormType] an unidentified distress signal has been detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh: 一场路过的宇宙风暴致使[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中产生了三颗新的小行星。这些天体容易发生难以解释的方向变化，因此无法预测它们的轨迹。此事需要进一步的研究。
excerpt.en: A passing cosmic storm deposited three new asteroids in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. These celestial bodies are prone to inexplicable changes of direction, making it impossible to predict their trajectories. Further research is needed.

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波中，监测[from.solar_system.GetName]的质量探测器得到了异常读数。

系统性诊断没有发现设备存在技术故障，所以这些读数需要进行进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
