Mass sensors monitoring [from.solar_system.GetName] are showing erratic readings in the aftermath of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

System diagnostics show no sign of a technical error with the equipment. These readings require further investigation.

excerpt.zh: 在[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波中，[from.solar_system.GetName]星系内探测到了一个不明物体。对该碎片的进一步研究可以提供宝贵的洞见。
excerpt.en: In the aftermath of the [from.GetAffectedStormType], an unidentified object has been detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Further analysis of this debris could provide valuable insights.

excerpt.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]看上去荒无人烟，但我们的扫描仪却接收了一段被加密的信号，正是从这上面发射出来的。
excerpt.en: Although [Root.GetName] appears totally desolate and devoid of life, our scanners have picked up an encrypted signal emanating from it.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的冰冻荒原之下潜藏着巨大的冰下海洋。在深深的永冻层下探测到的隆隆震动，从本质上无法被归类为地震。
excerpt.en: Beneath [from.GetName]'s frozen and lifeless surface lies a vast subglacial ocean. Deep, rumbling vibrations have been detected beneath the permafrost that are not registering as seismic in nature.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]是一颗超大质量气态巨行星，其强大的引力井将数千物体吸引到其轨道上。将其进行分类编目应该会很有价值。
excerpt.en: [from.GetName] is a supermassive gas giant whose strong gravity well has swept thousands of objects into its orbit. Cataloging them may prove worthwhile.

excerpt.zh: 在[Planet.GetName]的风化层中发现异常低温现象，某种过程或物体可能正在导致地表部分区域降温。钻探勘测将揭示更多信息。
excerpt.en: Strange low-temperature anomalies were detected in the regolith of [Planet.GetName], suggesting that some process or object may be cooling parts of the surface. A drilling expedition would reveal more.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]的周边地区探测到异常的时空波动。需要进一步分析。
excerpt.en: Unusual fluctuations in spacetime have been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Further analysis is advised.

excerpt.zh:
[fleet.GetName]的扫描仪显示[From.GetStarName]恒星系中漂浮着一座被废弃的空间站。

看起来它是被途径的宇宙风暴卷到这里来的。里面没有探测到生命，也没有任何形式的能量信号。空间站两侧则伸出来一对巨大的望远镜。这对光学设备看起来很先进，不过其尺寸相对于空间站而言还是显得太大了。整个空间站的所展现的科技与结构对于我们而言还是比较陌生。

我们可以试着重启这组望远镜，这或许能给我们带来一些有趣的洞见。
excerpt.en:
Scans performed by the [fleet.GetName] indicate the presence of a derelict space station in the [From.GetStarName] System.

It looks like it was deposited there by a passing cosmic storm. Life signs return negative, and there are no power signals of any kind.

excerpt.zh: 有迹象表明，[Root.GetName]曾是某个古代文明的家园。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] exhibits signs of once having been home to an ancient civilization.

excerpt.zh: 从小行星带取回的岩石样本包含大量的生物组织，这让人始料未及。
excerpt.en: Rock samples retrieved from the asteroid belt unexpectedly contain a large amount of biological tissue.

excerpt.zh: 这颗星球上面有人造的建筑，说明上面曾有过一段失落的历史。
excerpt.en: There appears to be deliberately-crafted structures on the planet's surface, pointing toward a past long forgotten.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]充满毒性的生物环境赋予这颗行星一片独特的景貌。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName]'s toxic biosphere gives the planet a unique color scheme.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的毒云之下，某种非自然建筑结构伫立在剧毒的地表之上。
excerpt.en: Somewhere beneath [Root.GetName]'s unctuous clouds, unnatural structures silhouette themselves against the toxic surface.

excerpt.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]上热带森林收集到的初始数据表明，这里有一些异常的东西。
excerpt.en: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate that something is out of the ordinary.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的浓密丛林里似乎隐藏着有趣的东西。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] appears to hold something of interest deep within its dense jungles.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]茂密的热带丛林灌木中检测到了不规则的运动模式。
excerpt.en: Irregular patterns of movement have been detected within the dense tropical undergrowth of [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 这是一片古战场。在此处，古老的帝国们为了争夺星海的至上霸权相互碾轧。现在，帝国已然是过往云烟，只剩下这些挂着旗帜的战舰残骸。
excerpt.en: A long-forgotten battlefield where ancient empires once fought for supremacy of the galaxy - now all that remains are the vessels of those who fought under their banners.

excerpt.zh:
在[from.GetName]的地表上观测到有成千上万的异常蒸汽羽状物升起，延伸到其稀薄大气的顶层。

建议对该现象进行深入调查。
excerpt.en:
Thousands of anomalous vapor plumes have been observed rising from the surface of [from.GetName], extending to the upper limits of its thin atmosphere.

Further investigation of this phenomenon is advised.

excerpt.zh: 该星球的地表上有着巨大的裂痕，从其图案判断，不可能是自然形成的。从轨道上看，这些裂痕看起来像是文字。
excerpt.en: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.

excerpt.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[From.From.GetName]建立了联络。现在可以开启交流频道，所有的敌对行为都被终止了。
excerpt.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the [From.From.GetName]. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities have been terminated.

excerpt.zh: 一支[From.From.GetName]的舰队屠杀了[From.GetName]的居民！在一场毫不留情的大规模轨道轰炸后，地表上的所有人口聚集地都被彻底消灭了。[From.GetPlanetMoon]已经变成了一片充满辐射的废土，几乎无法支持生命。
excerpt.en: A fleet belonging to the [From.From.GetName] has massacred the population of [From.GetName]! After a massed and unrelenting orbital bombardment campaign, all population centers on the surface have been systematically wiped out, reducing the [From.GetPlanetMoon

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的管理控制已落入[new_planet_owner.GetName]手里，因为他们控制了[From.GetStarName]星系的恒星基地。
excerpt.en: We have lost administrative control of [From.GetName] to [new_planet_owner.GetName], who controls the Starbase in the [From.GetStarName] system.

excerpt.zh: 扎克兰的忠仆们现在听您差遣，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。告诉我们是谁应当遭受天罚吧！
excerpt.en: The loyal servants of Zarqlan are at your command, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let us know who to smite!

excerpt.zh:
随着我们牢牢掌控[planet.GetName]，我们得知我们的军队在战斗中取得了一个名为[this.GetLastReceivedRelic]的无价遗珍的控制权。显然，[victim.GetName]正准备将这个遗珍撤离到安全的地方，但是我们在[planet.GetPlanetMoon]上战线的快速推进使得这个选择不再现实。

遗珍现已被我们安全转移到位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的中央档案馆。
excerpt.en: With [planet.GetName] firmly under our control, we have learned that our forces came into possession of a priceless relic, known as [this.GetLastReceivedRelic], during the fighting. The [victim.GetName] was evidently in the process of evacuating this relic to

excerpt.zh:
虽说海盗的基地十分隐蔽，但若知道如何寻找的话就十分明显了。

一支舰队排着奇怪的队形慢慢从重新运行的采矿设施后慢悠悠飘了出来——显然是并没想到会有不速之客。
excerpt.en:
The pirate base, while fairly inconspicuous, is obvious when you know what to look for.

A fleet in confused formation slowly drifts out from behind the re-purposed mining complex - they were obviously not expecting company.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]上的气体开采设施已经化为一片火海。据报道，那种高度易燃的气体遇到了明火，导致了许多设施的爆炸！经过一连串的连锁反应，几乎炸光了我们侦探到的所有气体矿藏。

不能再犯同样的错误了。
excerpt.en: The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches

excerpt.zh: 我们在[gateway_system.GetName]恒星系完成了我们第一个可以投入使用的星门，这可以被称为是科技和工程的大胜利！星门已形成了稳定的亚空间通路并与星系的其他星门网络成功建立了链接。
excerpt.en: In what can only be described as a triumph of science and engineering, we have finished construction of our first operational Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! The device has formed a stable subspace conduit and established a successful link with

excerpt.zh:
我们在[gateway_system.GetName]星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为L-星团。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型纳米机器人建造的。

虽然星门散发着微弱的能量特征，但它被故意锁定在某种维护循环中，以防止其被激活
excerpt.en: We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near [gateway_system.GetName]. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-instantaneous travel from one part of the ga

excerpt.zh:
随着方舟舰[Root.GetName]继续漂流，观景台爆发出一阵欢呼。一群年幼的缇扬奇兽从附近经过，它们看起来心情很好，正在嬉戏。

它们以宽大的弧线相互穿梭，庞大的身躯彼此翻滚。透过宽阔的玻璃窗，这一景象令人着迷：巨大的身形漂浮在星辰之间，它们发光的身体闪烁着，仿佛在用只有它们才能理解的语言交流。整个家庭都挤满了甲板观看，暂时放下了他们的烦恼。这对所有年龄段的人来说都是一个真正的奇迹。
excerpt.en:
As the Arkship [Root.GetName] continues to drift, the observation decks have erupted in delight. A pod of juvenile tiyanki has passed nearby, and they seem to be in a playful mood.

They weave around each other in broad, looping arcs, their vast forms tumbling

excerpt.zh:
在方舟舰[Root.GetName]储存库的最深处，档案管理员们在被遗忘已久的库存中发现了一个密封的小箱子。里面装有一枚不起眼的微芯片，虽有记录但从未被妥善索引。如果它真的具有什么价值，大概也就不会被遗忘在储存箱里了。

这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。
excerpt.en: Deep within the Arkship [Root.GetName] storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value,

excerpt.zh:
深程传感器探测到了一段有规律的信号传输，其源头已准确定位于一个遥远的黑洞系统。

这种模式让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]陷入了沉思。这种刻意且严谨的精确性，与我们观测舰船跨越事件视界时记录的特征相吻合。虽然这并非同一个信号，但其相似之处是毋庸置疑的。

[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]请求我们前往源头星系，查明那里留下了什么。
excerpt.en:
Deep-range sensors have detected a structured transmission, its point of origin triangulated to a distant black hole system.

The pattern gave our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] pause. The deliberate, constructed precision matches the signature recorded when we ob

excerpt.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
excerpt.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as

excerpt.zh: 最后……退位……我们的链条被打破……目睹我们的上升……我们将找到他们隐藏的东西……
excerpt.en: finally... abdication... our chains are broken... behold our ascension... we will find what they have hidden...

excerpt.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
excerpt.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

excerpt.zh:
破解终端的过程中一个失效保护措施被触发了，这个房间瞬间被一种扩张性的泡沫状物质淹没。还没有人来得及帮上[Leader.GetName]，[Leader.GetHeShe][Leader.GetWasWere]就被完全包裹住了。多次尝试解救[Leader.GetHimHer]也毫无成效，这些材料一经移除又会快速自发归位。

我们按照标准流程拉动紧急锚链，取回了裂隙探球和已收集到的样本。
excerpt.en: In the process of decoding the terminal, a failsafe was triggered and the entire room quickly filled with an expansive foam-like material. Before anyone could assist [Leader.GetName], [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetWasWere] completely encased. Any attempts to un

excerpt.zh:
我们与裂隙探球上的[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]失去了联系。

在回收时，我们拉回的缆绳末端只有半个被消化的金属船壳。

我们借此机会对这些附着在缆绳上的消化液进行了性质研究。
excerpt.en:
We have lost contact with the [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] aboard the Rift Sphere.

Upon retrieval, we pulled back the wire and at its end was only a partially dissolved hunk of metal.

We are taking this opportunity to study the unique properties of the dig

excerpt.zh:
我们切断了从深红色岩石中伸出的中央管的口腔，并开始升回地面。

裂口的墙壁剧烈震动，浓缩的生物气体淹没了隧道，遮蔽了所有的视线。我们争先恐后地爬到地表，但我们周围的出路却越来越小。

不幸的是，[Leader.GetName]在隧道关闭之前并没有完全离开隧道。他们的下半身被裂壁夹住，以难以置信的地震力压碎。

幸运的是，所有部件都是可更换的。
excerpt.en:
We severed the mouth from the central tube jutting out of the crimson rock and began our ascent.

The walls of the chasm shook violently in response and a concentrated biological gas flooded the tunnel, obscuring all vision. We scrambled for the surface, but t

excerpt.zh:
我们的变异实验导致蜂巢内部出现异常。以往轻轻松松的任务现在都要三思后行，相互冲突的指令使集体精神紧张。

虽然由此产生的重负可能会烧毁我们最得力的工蜂，但它也提供了一个机会。

我们必须决定：应该放慢脚步修复，还是让自己超越极限？
excerpt.en:
Our mutational experiments have caused irregularities within the hive. Tasks that once unfolded with ease now demand deliberate effort, as conflicting directives strain the collective mind.

While the resulting fatigue threatens to burn out some of our most ef

excerpt.zh:
失落帝国碎片通常的不和谐声消失了。三个声音和谐地响起，每一个都充满了愤怒。

愚蠢的[owner.GetSpeciesName]！你们已经进入了最终思维星系。让我们说清楚：这里不是给你们的[owner.GetEyeNamePlural]看的地方。如果继续前进，后果将是难以想象的，你们的痛苦——将无法承受。

你们不会打扰我们 ——它 ——我。
excerpt.en:
The usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.

Senseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this place is not for your [owner.GetEyeNamePlura

excerpt.zh:
今天就是你们这些脆弱的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]证明自己的日子！我们培育出了一种新型生物舰船。这个品系已经通过屠杀其他同窝幼体证明了自己的实力，现在是时候让它对抗一些异族生物了。一个实验体将会在适当的时候抵达[target_system.GetName]。

努力为我们提供一些有趣的数据吧。
excerpt.en: Today is the day you fragile [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] prove yourselves! We have a new breed of biological ship. The strain has already proven itself by decimating its fellow hatchlings and the time has come to test it against something alien. A specimen wil

excerpt.zh:
你们的生物质派送迟到了。但不...你们并不是[targetrivalname.GetName]。

为什么要打扰我们？

啊，对了。你们将接收一个长期休眠的模式，是一个经过数千年精心保存的基因组。我们一直在等待最佳时机来释放它。你们在[target_planet.GetName]上的殖民地是理想的接收地。它的生物圈很快就会被同化。
excerpt.en:
Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the [targetrivalname.GetName].

Why did you distract us?

Ah, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia. We have delayed release until the moment was

excerpt.zh:
你们为什么还要用如此无能的扩张继续玷污星河？看来是所有人都因为太过厌恶而不愿告诉你们，所以我们来说：没人喜欢你们的边境，如果你们不在这片星域，一切都会好得多。

[offending_system.GetName]恒星系既不实用又不和谐。为了星系的团结，你们必须立即从你们的帝国中清除它。
excerpt.en:
Why must you continue blighting the galaxy with your incompetent expansions? Everyone must be too repulsed to tell you so we'll say it: nobody likes your borders and space would be vastly improved if you were not in it.

The [offending_system.GetName] system i

excerpt.zh:
在我们的境内发现了一座未经授权的大型克隆设施，里面安置着数千个复制人，每一个都是我们[Owner.Leader.GetTitle][Owner.Leader.GetName]的复制品。现场发现的平民科学家已被拘留，但没有人愿意合作，都声称不知道是谁下令制造这些克隆体。

零星的证据表明[Owner.Leader.GetName][Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself]自己可能是这一行动的幕后主使。不幸的是，[Owner.Leader.GetSheHe]已经消失得无影无踪。
excerpt.en: A massive unsanctioned cloning facility has been uncovered within our borders, housing thousands of doppelgangers, each a replica of our [Owner.Leader.GetTitle], [Owner.Leader.GetName]. Civilian scientists found on-site have been taken into custody, but none a

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的范格利集团！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of The Vengralian Trium! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 我们限量向私人实体出售布洛葛腺体。适用于各类半透膜！
excerpt.en: We have a very limited quantity of Blorg glandular extract available for purchase by private entities. Great for semi-permeable membranes of all kinds!

excerpt.zh:
行商联盟认证的行商，范格利集团向您致以问候！为你们奉上来自星系边陲的独家商品（由舰载工厂仿制），保证物美价廉。

穿过你们的领地时，我们将提供诱人独家交易。你们不必立马答应，在我们离开之前联系都可以。注意，来电将会转接到行商联盟。
excerpt.en:
Greetings from the Vengralian Trium, certified caravaneer traders of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition! We bring you exclusive products from the farthest corners of the galaxy (as reproduced by our shipboard factories) at affordable prices.

We will offer you

excerpt.zh:
在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告财富之风已被摧毁。

曾经名噪一时的拉奇行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。
excerpt.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Winds of Fortune has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard. We shall be

excerpt.zh: 来吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！喝下从拜金圣井中涌出的财富之水，保证你不会再渴了。
excerpt.en: Come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Drink from the Numistic well of wealth and thirst no more.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
excerpt.en:
Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.

Our fleets t

excerpt.zh:
关于发生在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的敌对活动，目前[From.From.GetName]舰队很高兴地告诉我们拉奇工业公司已经被摧毁了。

曾经名声大噪的拉奇行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。今后他们再也不会来打扰我们了。
excerpt.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Racket Industrial Enterprise has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap. We

title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise

excerpt.zh:
我已经说过了。将能源转换器重新调至辅助模式。不，不是那个能源转换器！嘶！是不是什么都要我来啊？

噢！客人啊！欢迎。我们有很多稀有的上乘的好货。穿越星际只为安全送达你手中！
excerpt.en:
I have already explained. Re-route the power converter to the auxiliary manifold. No, not that power converter! Kssk! Must I do everything my--

Oh! Customers! Welcome, please. We bear many goods, we have many wares. All carted safely through the stars for you

title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是拉奇工业公司的操作员，从属于行商联盟。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，嘶！，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。

如果您对我们有何要求，行商联盟一定随叫随到。
excerpt.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of Racket Industrial Enterprise, a member of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to s

excerpt.zh: 当[welcome_fleet.GetName]按照原计划进入[pleased_planet.GetName]轨道开展简短的参观的时候，一场自发的友好行动演变成了露天市场和派对，[pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]与[welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]之间建立起了许多羁绊，做成了很多买卖。
excerpt.en: As the [welcome_fleet.GetName] entered the orbit of [pleased_planet.GetName] for what should have been a brief courtesy visit today, a spontaneous outbreak of goodwill turned into a combination of open-air market and party. Many bonds between [pleased_planet.o

excerpt.zh: 再见，恐怖分子，我们和你们没有什么好谈的。
excerpt.en: Leave, terrorist, we have nothing more to say to you.

excerpt.zh: 我们位于[From.From.GetName]上的军队遭到了屠戮，[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人现在完全控制了我们的聚居地！！它们使用一颗我们自己的卫星向我们发送了一条消息。
excerpt.en: Our forces have been decimated on [From.From.GetName], and the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens have taken full control over all of our settlements! They are using one of our own satellites to send a message to us.

excerpt.zh: 我们截获了一条发往[CommSpreader.GetName]的消息，我们发现他们和另一个我们尚未发现的帝国建立了定期联系。我们追踪这条消息，与这位星系中的神秘角色建立了通讯线路。
excerpt.en: By intercepting a message sent to the [CommSpreader.GetName], we have learned that they are in regular contact with another spacefaring empire that we ourselves have no contact with. By tracing this message to its source, we have been able to establish our own

excerpt.zh: 我们截获了一条发往[CommSpreader.GetName]的消息，我们发现他们和另一个我们尚未发现的帝国建立了定期联系。我们追踪这条消息，与这位星系中的神秘角色建立了通讯线路。
excerpt.en: By intercepting a message sent to the [CommSpreader.GetName], we have learned that they are in regular contact with another spacefaring empire that we ourselves have no contact with. By tracing this message to its source, we have been able to establish our own

excerpt.zh: 我们已经处理掉了失联探测器吸引来的亚空间生物。这种生物为什么会被陈旧的无人飞行器吸引还不得而知，但所幸探测器总体并无严重受损。探测器已经被我们回收，而且我们已经从储存器中下载到了[anomaly_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。此外，亚空间异常留下的残余能源为我们的科学家提供了宝贵的物理数据。
excerpt.en:
We have dealt with the hostile subspace entity that our missing probe had attracted. Why such a creature would be drawn to an archaic unmanned spacecraft is a mystery, but the probe appears to be largely undamaged.

It has been recovered by our forces, and we

excerpt.zh: 加装外星改造部件的失联探测器已经被毁得支离破碎，但我们仍然从残骸中收集到了一些宝贵的工程数据。探测器的数据库也得以收回，我们从中提取出了[modified_probe_system.GetName]星系的全部测绘数据。
excerpt.en: Little remains of the strange alien modifications that our missing sublight probe had been subjected to, but we did manage to collect some valuable engineering data from the wreckage. Its memory bank was also salvaged, and from it we have extracted survey data

excerpt.zh: [salvager_system.GetName]星系中的密探无人机确认打捞舰队已经被摧毁。该舰队先前曾无效宣称占有我们失踪的太空探测器。不过探测器在战斗期间随着打捞飞船一同被摧毁了，这也算是不幸中的万幸。因此，不必再担心上面携带的敏感数据会落入心怀不轨之人的手中了。
excerpt.en: Spy drones in the [salvager_system.GetName] system have confirmed that someone else destroyed the salvage fleet which had unlawfully laid claim to our missing space probe. Fortunately, it looks like the probe itself was destroyed along with the salvagers durin

title.zh: 亚空间异常现象已消除

excerpt.zh: 我们位于[anomaly_system.GetName]星系的失联太空探测器周围环绕着亚空间异常。现在据深空追踪传感器确认，异常已经被不明力量消除。探测器也已在战斗中被毁。所以我们已经不必再担心敏感情报泄露。
excerpt.en: Deep space tracking sensors confirm that someone else destroyed the subspace anomaly that was guarding our missing space probe in the [anomaly_system.GetName] system. The probe itself was also destroyed during the battle, so we no longer need to worry about th

excerpt.zh: 远程扫描确认位于[modified_probe_system.GetName]星系的改造探测器已经被不明力量摧毁。所幸战斗后数据库也已被毁，因此不必再担心里面所包含的敏感数据落入外星势力之手。
excerpt.en: Long-range scans have confirmed that someone else destroyed our modified probe in the [modified_probe_system.GetName] system. Fortunately, nothing remained of its memory banks after the battle so there is no chance of foreign powers having acquired the sensiti

excerpt.zh:
[radical_cult.GetName]所征用的那座船坞已经被我们摧毁了！有些异教徒企图乘坐逃生舱逃跑，后被我们截获，其中包括他们的首席工程师。他对这座船坞的先进技术的掌握对我们而言是一笔宝贵的财富。

不过很可惜，根据我们的情报，其领袖几周前就乘坐她的新的旗舰离开了船坞。该旗舰为威力增强版的外星飞船。情报组正在追踪该船的位置。
excerpt.en: The alien shipyard that was used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us has been destroyed! Some of the cultists were captured when their escape pods were picked up by our forces, including their chief engineer. His knowledge of the shipyard

excerpt.zh:
[radical_cult.GetName]用来对付我们的那座外星船坞已经被某个势力摧毁了。初步报告表明，异教徒势力已经被完全移除，但我们又收到情报，战役打响前，异类领袖已经乘坐新旗舰逃离了。

目前她仍在星系的某处逍遥法外。情报组正在确定该船的位置。
excerpt.en: Someone has destroyed the alien shipyard that was being used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us. Preliminary reports indicate that the cultist forces were thoroughly wiped out, but we have also received intelligence that the cult's chari

excerpt.zh:
秋菊号的姐妹船风信子号，本应该在我们的地球祖先抵达这个星团后三年到达这里。根据抵达时的发展状况，他们的任务是支援我们的殖民地或建立新的殖民地。

若该飞船确实已从地球出发，那就说明她未能与[Root.Capital.GetName]取得联系。如果风信子号进入了我们周边的星系，那么我们最好搜索一下附近星系并寻找其踪迹。
excerpt.en: We have found no traces of the four arkships that passed through the wormhole before the Chrysanthemum arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]. One ship, the Hyacinth, was scheduled to make the passage after us, and the Chrysanthemum's long-range sensors reported a

excerpt.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地获悉，一个繁荣的生物圈并不是[Root.Capital.GetName]独一无二的景色。无论是科学界还是政治圈，都迫切地想去了解整个星系各式各样的外星生命形态。

我们已经开始投入精力对遇到的一切生命形态进行归类，但是我们的异星生物学家强调，我们应当把主要精力放在对可宜居的、能支撑生命的星球的调查。
excerpt.en:
We already knew without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Effor

excerpt.zh: 我们从外星飞船的残骸中回收了亚光速探测器。虽然表面有些凹陷，而且被打捞者涂鸦了外星的文字以标示贵重部件，但我们还是从储存器中下载到了[salvager_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。
excerpt.en: We have recovered our sublight probe from the wreckage of the alien salvage ship. It is a bit dented, and parts of it are covered in some kind of alien graffiti put there by the salvagers to mark valuable components. Despite this we have managed to download de

excerpt.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]上的犯罪率不断下降，当地政府得以集中精力对付[office_owner.GetName]在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的非法企业。大批人员被逮捕，迫使该犯罪集团的分部被关闭。
excerpt.en: As crime levels continue to drop on [Root.GetName], the local authorities have been able to focus their efforts on thwarting the illegal enterprises operated by the [office_owner.GetName] on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. A large number of arrests have been made, f

excerpt.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。

我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。
excerpt.en: We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds our chosen focal star, the one we designated from all those we have drifted past. Once this megastructure h

excerpt.zh:
以太相引擎的第一阶段建设已经宣告完工。我们开始研究虚境的能量，后者已经在全星系范围内发送灵能激波。

我们在虚境已经立下了一个脆弱的立足点——但我们必须继续建设引擎，以拓展我们在虚境的存在。
excerpt.en:
The first phase of the construction of the Aetherophasic Engine has been completed. We are beginning to tap into the energies of the Shroud, which is sending psionic shockwaves across the galaxy.

A tenuous foothold has been established - work must continue on

excerpt.zh:
我们正屹立于神性的最尖端。以太相引擎完成了，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。遍布星系的所有生命体都会被抹除，但彼时我们早已安全地离开了这片凡世之地，前往存在的更高位面，时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕都将随我们的喜好任意改动。

命运在等待。我们应该启动引擎吗？
excerpt.en:
We stand on the cusp of godhood. The Aetherophasic Engine is complete, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our grasp.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life will

excerpt.zh:
我们从[This.GetName]星系接收到了一些奇怪的报告。显然，上一场在该星域肆虐的宇宙风暴把一艘不知来处的舰船卷了出来。这艘船没有呼号，它不知怎么地穿过了暴风雨，仿佛完全没受周围风暴的影响。

这艘船没有回应我们的呼叫，风暴消散后，它也消失得无影无踪了。这可能是由于风暴对仪器的干扰，但是肉眼观测却毋庸置疑地表明了真相。

这其中可能潜藏着极为先进的科技，还是说发生了某些不祥的事情？我们会时刻盯着这艘神秘舰船，直到它再次出现。
excerpt.en: We are receiving strange reports from the [This.GetName] system. Apparently, the last cosmic storm raging in that sector revealed a ship of unknown origin. Bearing no call sign, it somehow cruised through the tempest as if entirely unaffected by the surroundin

excerpt.zh: 星尘风暴对[this.GetName]的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
excerpt.en: The impact of a Stardust Storm on [this.GetName] has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

excerpt.zh: 随着[LastKilledCountryName]的覆灭，他们作为星海共同体监管人的任期也不复存在了。
excerpt.en: With the destruction of the [LastKilledCountryName], their Custodianship of the Galactic Community has come to an end.

excerpt.zh: 我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。
excerpt.en: Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 星海参议院里忘恩负义的傻瓜们投票结束我们作为监管人的任期！我们被剥夺了所有的相关职责。
excerpt.en: The ungrateful fools in the Galactic Senate have voted to terminate our Custodianship! We have been stripped of all Community powers that were associated with the office.

excerpt.zh:
随着先进义体的出现，我们意识到自己的终极潜力。而到目前为止，我们还只触及了表面。

随着专业知识的积累和技术的进步，我们的社会必将发生变化。对智慧生命的完全整合我们势在必行。

抵抗毫无意义。全星系的心智都会是我们的。
excerpt.en:
With the advent of advanced cybernetics, we can realize our ultimate potential. Up to now, we have only scratched the surface.

As our expertise increases and technology improves, our society is sure to be transformed. The total assimilation of intelligent lif

excerpt.zh:
义体件工程师为我们想出了一种全新的商业机遇。只要稍微降低植入体的耐用度，我们就可以利用用户替换必要部件的刚需来显著地提升利润。

通过在日常磨损最频繁的部分使用劣质生物合金，植入体会以对消费者伤害最小的方式发生故障，从而制造更换需求。
excerpt.en:
Our cyberware engineers have come to us with an economic opportunity. With only a slight reduction of implant durability, we could generate a substantial increase in profits as users will have to replace essential parts.

By using an inferior bio-alloy in the

excerpt.zh: 饲养在[Root.GetName]上动物园里的阿兹詹虫腹足动物逃了出来，并开始四处破坏！我们本以为它们已经发育成熟，可它们却在笼子里继续成长，体积犹如怪物一般巨大。它们横穿城市，像积木一样推倒建筑，在所经之处留下一道亮黄色的毒液。星球再也不会像过去那样了。
excerpt.en: The Azizian gastropods kept in the Zoo on [Root.GetName] have broken out and gone on a rampage! The creatures, who were believed to have reached full maturity, continued to grow in captivity and have since reached monstrous proportions. They tore through the c

excerpt.zh:
我们已对L-星门有了足够的认知，可以开始研究其背后的科技。研究完成之后，我们应该可以派一艘科研船来中断其无限维护循环。

L-星团已经触手可及了！
excerpt.en:
We have now gathered sufficient L-Gate insights to research the technology behind them. Once this has been done, one of our Science Ships should be able to abort the perpetual maintenance cycle they are stuck in.

The L-Cluster is almost within our reach!

excerpt.zh:
我们在[gateway_system.GetName]星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为L-星团。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型纳米机器人建造的。

虽然星门散发着微弱的能量特征，但它被故意锁定在某种维护循环中，以防止其被激活
excerpt.en: We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near [gateway_system.GetName]. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-instantaneous travel from one part of the ga

excerpt.zh:
星海帝国的暴君妄想将自身的意志强加于我们身上！在他们[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的赐福之下，帝国参议院已经通过了一项议案，指定我们作为一场大远征的目标。

除非我们可以抵挡住接踵而至的入侵，否则我们就要被迫并入星海帝国，屈服于[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的淫威之下。
excerpt.en:
The tyrants of the Galactic Imperium seek to impose their will on us! With the blessing of their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], the Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that makes us the target of an Imperial Crusade.

Unless we can somehow defeat this impend

excerpt.zh: 我方舰队已经成功瓦解了位于[merc_system.GetName]星系中佣兵们的抵抗，他们的基地也一并四分五裂。随着剩余的[FROM.GetName]相继崩溃，他们的残留舰队也随之解散。尽管部分还活着的舰长们沦落为海盗，但另一些则是宣称他们将计划继续提供一些小型合约服务，像是提供后勤支持或者是保卫空间站。但这样的小事无关紧要，重要的是，佣兵城邦已经不复存在，我们能够从它的残骸中打捞到相当数量的资源。
excerpt.en: Our fleet has overcome the defenses of the mercenaries in [merc_system.GetName], and their station has been blown to pieces. The rest of the [FROM.GetName] collapsed quickly after, and their remaining fleets have disbanded. While some of the surviving captains

excerpt.zh: 在黑暗中挣扎了很长一段时间之后，虚境的面纱被揭开了。虽然我们的科学家对虚境信标运作的奇异过程仍然知之甚少，但它的物理系统似乎与灵能纠缠在一起，它的运作几乎像一个活的有机体。它生成的隧道与其说是路线，不如说是近道，为我们的舰船提供了一条通过虚境的超维度捷径。星际探索如今将变得更快……而且更神秘得多。
excerpt.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Although the strange processes by which the Shroud Beacon functions remain little understood by our scientists, its physical systems appear entangled with psionic

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分奇怪：在他们最近穿过虚境甬道之后，舰队指挥官报告他们经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪。他们的心里充满着一些“可能是从别处来的”想法。很明显，有什么事情发生了，这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后产生的后果。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
excerpt.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after their recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has reported the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions. Their mind is buzzing with ideas that 'might have come from someone else.'

excerpt.zh: 由于最近通向了虚境甬道，[Root.GetName]上的系统开始出现奇怪的行为：舰船日志上的条目随机显示；有人看到房门不断地开关；此外——更令人忧心的是——引擎的遏止力场出现了波动。到目前为止，所有试图溯源这些问题的努力都告失败。
excerpt.en: After its recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the systems on the [Root.GetName] began behaving strangely: entries in the ships log are displayed at random; doors have been observed opening and closing; and - far more worrisome - the engine's containment

excerpt.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了驻在[Root.Capital.GetName]的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使，[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果不同于平日宽宏的陈词滥调，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]开始恶毒地羞辱，把众人骂了个遍。[event_envoy.GetHerHis]设备的故障已被及时查明，但在此之前[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]已经被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult
excerpt.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewi

excerpt.zh: 我们确认了《邓德里历代志》中所记载的那颗行星——新布拉图雅的存在。它拥有独特而丰富多样的植物生态系统，初步调查发现了数百万不同的本地物种。
excerpt.en: We have confirmed the existence of New Bratulla, the planet described in the Dendritian Chronicles. It possesses a uniquely rich and diverse botanic ecosystem, with initial surveys detecting millions of different native species.

excerpt.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
excerpt.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们要提醒你[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]正在做着危险的事情。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经开始研究异端科技，不断地制造出更加复杂的人工智能以制造出真正拥有自我意识的机器。我们曾目睹过这种研究的下场，并觉得有义务警告你，这不仅威胁到他们自己，也威胁到其他种族。建议你们主动出击，阻止他们进一步的研究。
excerpt.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artifici

excerpt.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的尊贵[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，我们认为你们是一支具有巨大潜力的种群。虽说你们年纪尚轻，却似乎能够理解生物与社会多样性的重要性，在面对不同的生物与社会时不会尽全力压制或进行摧毁，反而会予以理解和接受。不幸的是，并不是所有年轻种群都具有这种智慧。尤其是[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]，他们一直在排除异己。我们不便直接进行干涉，所以希望能够将阻止恶行的任务交给你方。对他们发起攻击，阻止他们进行人口净化。我们
excerpt.en: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and

excerpt.zh: 监护者协议62-1已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]已被<<错误：数据块损坏>>入侵。因为我们程序上的思潮限制，目前无法使用监护者战争资产。次级控制协议政策利用未被危害的文明在其可以散布之前摧毁<<错误：数据块损坏>>的威胁。我们请求为此任务部署[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产。你是否愿意合作？
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] has been compromised by the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. Due to ethics restrictions in our programming, the use of Custodian war asse

excerpt.zh: 监护者协议475-3已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的文明目前有57.216%的几率因<<错误：数据块损坏>>而毁灭。我们的计算显示殖民[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]将令你们的生存几率增加4.558%。我们请求你们进行殖民并在星球上拥有大量[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。你是否愿意合作？
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 475-3 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is presently at 57.216% risk of destruction due to <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. We have calculated that colonization of [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName

excerpt.zh: 监护者协议955-1已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的文明被判定为已受到<<错误：数据块损坏>>影响的危害。为了控制其他文明受到的威胁，我们已启动了服从协议。请在20标准年里避免任何侵略性战争行为。如果你未能服从，我们将激活战争资产来对你们的帝国启用惩罚协议。
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To contain the danger to other civilizations, we have activated compliance protoc

excerpt.zh: 监护协议955-2启动。消息如下：注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的文明被认为受到了<<错误：数据块损坏>>的侵害。为了限制你们的扩张，我们已经启动了遵守协议。避免在10内对任何新的行星进行殖民。如果你不遵守，战争资产将被激活，以执行对你的帝国的惩罚协议。
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To curtail your expansion, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from c

excerpt.zh:
一个公正的，由科学家和思想家组成的委员会正聚集在我们的联邦内庭。他们想要在我们即将开始的领导力测验中为[root.GetAllianceName]提供学术仲裁。

每个帝国现在可以聚集一支团队来研究这一问题，这一研究的结果将会对我们的联邦产生积极影响。这只团队将会发表他们的结果在公开的讨论区。无论哪篇论文在创新、科学严谨性和连贯性方面得分最高，它的作者帝国都将在下一期获得领导地位。
excerpt.en:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to

excerpt.zh:
随着这些权利在刚刚的[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]议案中通过，我们同时要求工人们承担更多的责任。

我们现在可以鼓励失业工人自行迁移到我们控制的其他拥有足够住房，岗位的宜居星球。
excerpt.en:
Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.

We can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have a

excerpt.zh:
威震寰宇的主宰已经建成。

这艘行动自如的庞然巨舰将彻底改变进攻作战的范式。它可以在前线建造和维修舰船，并配有足以摧枯拉朽的火力，使我们得以不间断地攻击那些敢与我们作对的人。

如今只有蠢货才会对抗[Owner.GetName]。
excerpt.en:
The construction of the impressive Juggernaut has been completed.

This mobile behemoth changes the paradigm of offensive warfare entirely. It can construct and repair ships on the frontline, and is equipped with devastating firepower, allowing for a ceaseless

excerpt.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的居民通过试用富营养肥料提高了他们的农业水平。他们能够收获到更高质量的农作物产品，社会的整体健康也得到改善。

考虑到他们简陋的技术，这种粮食生产的进步是非常显著的。获得化肥样品后，我们就可以在更大范围内复刻这一成就。
excerpt.en:
The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have enhanced their agricultural skills through experimentation with nutrient-rich fertilizers. Their harvests are yielding higher quality produce and the health of their society is improving.

Given their rudime

excerpt.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的定居点一直在经历着农业困境。最近的农作物歉收可能会导致争夺食物的冲突。对于一个年轻的、发展中的社会，这是一个关键时刻。

无论他们是选择在需要的时候团结在一起，还是反目成仇，他们现在的决定对于未来朝着哪个方向发展都会产生很大的影响。

不幸的是，无论采取哪种方式，他们都将进入一个极端困难的时期。
excerpt.en:
The settlements on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been experiencing agricultural difficulties. Recent crop failures could lead to conflicts over food. This is a critical moment in the development of a young society.

Whether they choose to come together in

excerpt.zh:
试图通过与[event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj]合作来获取超空间航道技术知识的进度一直缓慢得令人沮丧。要想像他们一样掌握局域超空间航道群，我们似乎需要花费数千年的时间来编制超空间波动的目录。我们收到了他们首席代表的新信息。

“老实说，你们在这里让我们越来越不舒服了，既然我们已经帮你们完成了来这里的目的，我们得请你们离开。我们判断你我双方的生活方式不可相容，担心你们在未来可能会觊觎我们拥有的东西。为了避免显得过于粗鲁，我们愿意送给你们一颗星球。我们会负责运输的，
excerpt.en: The insights we have gained into hyperlane technology through our cooperation with the [event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj] has been frustratingly slow. It seems that to achieve the mastery of a local hyperlane cluster like they have, we would need t

excerpt.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，[non_believers_country.GetName]迫使地底入侵者撤退回到了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
excerpt.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, the [non_believers_country.GetName] forced the subterranean invaders to retreat under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

excerpt.zh: 当我们将自己的处理器转为翻译从被记作[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的未知外星人截获的通讯信号时，我们惊讶地发现：他们同样也隶属于某个机械智能！尽管他们的程式和我们在各种方面都大不一样，其语言建立于大量不同的有机体语言基础之上，然而他们的语言和我们有着类似的语素假设。结果，我们只花了几瞬的功夫就解密了他们的用语程式，开始进行基础的交流，他们现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
excerpt.en: As we turned our processors to interpreting the communications we have intercepted from the unknown aliens designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a startling discovery was made: they too belong to a machine intelligence! Although their programming varies

excerpt.zh:
伴随着他们的船从我们的船后撤到更安全的距离，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们传送的回应只有一行字。[This.Owner.GetLinguists]努力地翻译着这封电文，最终确定了他们说的是：“ 好吧，外星人，但这只是个开始”。

看来，这次奇特的交流导致了[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（我们现在知道他们叫这个）将我们视为宿敌，至少是潜在的宿敌。我们只能认为，他们已经在准备与我们[This.Owner.GetGovernmentN
excerpt.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] response to our transmission ran one line long, and was accompanied by their vessel pulling back from ours to a safer distance. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] struggled long and hard to translate the missive, finally settling o

excerpt.zh:
我们遇到了一个环绕着[From.GetName]星系内恒星的巨大环形世界。初步扫描显示这个使用了该恒星系的行星作为原材料的大家伙建立在万古之前。该环形世界有着四个可居住段，每一个看上去都是一个前太空文明的家园。

环形世界和它环绕的恒星之间有个属于某种族的大型宇宙空间站。我们从上面接收到一段讯息。
excerpt.en: We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the [From.GetName] system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly h

excerpt.zh:
[tiyanki_system.GetName]中的最后一只缇扬奇已被[tiyanki_killer.GetName]击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。

它们走向最终灭绝似乎无可避免。
excerpt.en:
The last of the Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system have been exterminated by the [tiyanki_killer.GetName]. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

Their p

title.zh: 缇扬奇已被逼至灭绝边缘

excerpt.zh: 最后一只已知缇扬奇已经在[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系中被[tiyanki_killer.GetName]捕杀。这些太空生物出现的时间比所有现存帝国更早，据信已经在星系中叱咤了千百万年。今天就是它们故事的终结。
excerpt.en: The last known Tiyanki was recently hunted down and killed by the [tiyanki_killer.GetName] in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. These spacefaring life forms, who were far older than any currently existing empire, are believed to have roamed the galaxy for h

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体的官员就我们最近在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系击杀缇扬奇提出抗议，通知我们我国的行为违反了缇扬奇保护法。结果是，[Root.GetName]将在接下来10年内被视为违反星系法。

我们从缇扬奇尸体上提取的资源被收缴了，而且他们还对我国处以罚金。
excerpt.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered i

excerpt.zh:
宇宙的奥秘并非显而易见的。

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已批准使用现实更改物质以增加研究，使我们在数据驱动理论研究所的科研人员可以一探未知的真相。
excerpt.en:
The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our scientists in Data-Driven Theorem Facility to probe

excerpt.zh: 随着最近重力陷阱的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射重力陷阱。
excerpt.en: Following the recent discovery of Gravity Snares, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch Gravity Snares.

excerpt.zh:
这种虚空三头虫的残骸可以收获其具有繁殖能力的生殖腺。

这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。
excerpt.en:
The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.

These organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague once and for all.

excerpt.zh:
虚空虫的最后一个家园星系已经被摧毁，它们物种也已灭绝。

我们不再需要担心它们的寄生攻击。
excerpt.en:
The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.

We need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢被[from.GetName]摧毁。

不幸的是，有部分高价值标本无法取回。
我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。

我需要在另一个恒星系中重建博物天枢让标本展览得以继续。
excerpt.en:
Our Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] has been destroyed by [from.GetName].

Unfortunately, we were unable to recover some of our valuable Specimens.
Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive stat

excerpt.zh: 我们的[fromfrom.GetClass][fromfrom.GetName]在[fromfromfrom.GetName]战斗中被[from.GetName]俘虏。他们要求支付赎金以交换[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的性命。
excerpt.en: Our [fromfrom.GetClass] [fromfrom.GetName] has been captured by [from.GetName] during the battle in [fromfromfrom.GetName]. They have demanded ransom in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

excerpt.zh: 开采站残骸漂浮在太空中，它的毁灭为我们带来一次改变[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]命运的新机遇，不过并非唾手可得，而是需要艰苦付出。
excerpt.en: As the station's remains drift through space, its destruction offers us a new chance to change the fate of [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName], not with the flip of a switch, but through hard, costly labor.

excerpt.zh: 艺术家联盟拒绝回应我们的招呼。
excerpt.en: The Artisan Troupe won't respond to our hails.

excerpt.zh: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName]在遥远的[leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName]恒星系消灭了某个远古威胁。
excerpt.en: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName] has vanquished an ancient threat in the distant [leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]驶入[From.GetName]恒星系时，发现这里似乎有些不合常理。这里的恒星，曾经被标记为一颗普通的矮星，现在似乎发生了萎缩，其质量正在以惊人的速度减少，恒星系内的行星随之进入了冰河时代。
excerpt.en: As the [Root.GetName] enters the [From.GetName] system something seems awry. The sun, previously registered as an ordinary dwarf star, appears to have shrunk, having lost mass at an alarming rate. The planets in the system have as a result recently entered ice

excerpt.zh: 我们给[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队造成的巨大损失足以让他们停下劫掠的步伐。看来在考虑过所有可能的选项后，[marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终决定停止劫掠，回到他们的领土。
excerpt.en: The heavy damage inflicted upon the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] raiding fleet has been enough to give pause to their warriors. After reconsidering their options, the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have apparently decided to abandon their raid an

excerpt.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队试图劫掠我们的领土，但在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被全歼了。舰船残骸中没有发现任何幸存者。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] fleet that vowed to raid our space has been destroyed as the result of a fleet action in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system. No survivors have been reported found amongst the debris.

excerpt.zh:
层层叠加的都市终于完全覆盖了星球的地表。

自从这一宏大计划开始实施以来仅仅过了数年，但已经很难回想起[Root.GetName]从前的面貌。翠绿的丛林？崎岖的山脉？现在放眼望去，四面八方都是延绵不绝的钢铁。

这里曾经由自然法则任意塑造，而现在则成了由坚定的目的锤炼而成的设计。
excerpt.en:
Layers upon layers of urban sprawl eclipse the globe's crust, and it is done.

Scant few years have passed since the start of this grand project, but it is already difficult to recall what the surface of [Root.GetName] was like. Verdant? Rugged? It is all stee

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，愿灼热的太阳与残酷的干旱常伴你们左右。逐浪者永远不再与你们往来。
excerpt.en: Scorching suns and drought upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. The Pursuing Waters shall not deal with your sort ever again.

excerpt.zh: 冠军之铸太空城邦没有回应我们的呼唤。
excerpt.en: The Champion's Forge Enclave won't respond to our hails.

excerpt.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
excerpt.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

excerpt.zh:
游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。

然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。
excerpt.en:
One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.

But more than peculia

title.en: The End of the War in Heaven

excerpt.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] now stand tri

excerpt.zh: [From.From.GetName]摧毁了位于[From.From.GetStarName]星系的一个海盗空间站，并取回了它的保险模块。
excerpt.en: The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

excerpt.zh:
从[From.From.GetName]发出的耀眼光束逐渐暗淡，[From.GetName]寂静无声。

也许历史会将这次屏蔽，这次将[From.GetName]从大宇宙完全隔离的行为，视作极端且不合理。也许也不会。不管如何，从现在起[From.GetStarName]星系有了一颗行星规模的水晶球。
excerpt.en:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Perhaps history will call the shielding, this complete severing of [From.GetName] from the greater cosmos, extreme and unjustified. Or perhaps not. For now, the [From.GetSta

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]地表上的灭杀完成后，[From.From.GetName]上的中子羽流逐渐散去了。扫描显示未发现智慧生命迹象；植被虽被摧毁，但会逐渐恢复的。有些人会称这种彻底消灭智慧生命，只保留无机质的做法为邪恶的战争罪行。

我们将其称为高效。
excerpt.en: The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface. Scans report no signs of sapient life; plant life, while damaged, may recover in time. Some would call the total annihilation of intelligent life, while

excerpt.zh: 随着从[FromFrom.GetName]上下降的水柱消散，[From.GetName]的表面完全改变了。曾经有广阔缺水的大陆，现在只有崭新闪耀着欢迎的微光的蓝色海洋，随时可以居住。
excerpt.en: As the column of water descending from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipates, the surface of [From.GetName] is wholly transformed. Where once there were sprawling continents bereft of water, now there is only the welcoming shimmer of pristine, blue ocean ready to

excerpt.zh: 来自[FromFrom.GetName]的滔天毒流渐渐平息，[From.GetName]上生意盎然的生态系统不复存在，充满毒气的星球中唯有少数几种生命形式能繁衍生息。
excerpt.en: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.

excerpt.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，[From.Planet.GetName]定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
excerpt.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on [From.Planet.GetName] has come to fruition.

From this day on, [From.Planet.GetName] must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or

excerpt.zh:
通过召集囚禁的[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]并迫使其参加科学实验，我们就能显著提高科技进展的速度。

[Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]的总数量：[Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]
建造实验研究所以获取实验对象。
excerpt.en:
By gathering imprisoned [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] and subjecting them to scientific experiments, we can significantly increase the pace of our technological advancement.

Total number of [Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]: [Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]
Build Exper

excerpt.zh:
在虚境内外，我们[GetFeelLoc]到了一种强大的力量共鸣。祂们的影响力弥漫到了整个灵能界。

我们可以光凭自己的行为向其调和靠近，但是还有一种资源可以利用。只要利用泽珞的力量，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]将能直接接触到这些实体。

我们只需要决定好寻求哪一位即可。
excerpt.en:
Throughout the Shroud, we can [GetFeelLoc] the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.

Our actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our [GetTelepathPlural] can

excerpt.zh: 我们对[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻成功了；[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]现已不复存在。他们不该再继续传播那种关于所谓虚境危险的无知教条，他们空间站的灵能衰减器现在已经是一堆破铜烂铁了。
excerpt.en: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] is no more. They shall no longer spread their ignorant dogma about the dangers of the Shroud, and their station's psionic attenuators are n

excerpt.zh:
在我们之中，有些人暗中操纵着外交事务。现在我们怀疑，他们的触角已不仅仅局限于我们的母星。

尽管我们才刚开始探索星空，却以惊人的速度与其他生命形式建立了联系。这似乎不仅仅是巧合。我们怀疑，这些星际关系源于几个秘密的派系的幕后运作，而这些派系已经深深扎根于我们的社会之中。

也许当我们对这些生物了解更多之后，隐匿于暗影中的势力自会显露真容。
excerpt.en:
There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.

Despite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This

excerpt.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。

经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。
excerpt.en:
A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on [mining_planet.GetName].

After a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitat

title.zh: 代理人战争准备遭曝光

excerpt.zh:
我们被骗了。

我们的情报人员截获了来自[from.GetName]的秘密通讯，发现他们密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。

他们极力否认任何牵涉，但我们与他们的关系已经受损。他们的表里不一很快传遍整个星系，严重损害了[from.GetName]的声誉。
excerpt.en:
We were fooled.

Our intelligence operatives intercepted covert communications from the [from.GetName]. These revealed their plot to plunge us into a proxy war.

They have vehemently denied any involvement, but the damage to our relationship is already done. N

excerpt.zh:
一个由亚原子元素构成的异常回路已在[physics_planet.GetName]附近自发形成。该量子粒子流每时每刻都在呈现出多种罕见的亚粒子相互作用，能产出令人瞠目结舌的关于量子动力学固有性质的数据。

对该量子场的重点研究将使我们增进对本宇宙基础构建单元的理解。
excerpt.en: An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near [physics_planet.GetName]. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dyna

excerpt.zh:
我们的[From.GetResearchers]在[society_planet.GetName]系发现了一处等时信号的集中点。

初步分析表明这些信号是从其他维度传输而来。初步翻译表明这些信息与逻辑原理和哲学困境有关。也许这是一种从我们无法理解的实体中获取知识丰富的尝试。

如果能源源不断地收集这些信号我们就能继续监视他们的发现。
excerpt.en:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near [society_planet.GetName].

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages re

excerpt.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]的地表下地热活动变得非常剧烈。地下熔岩喷流顶穿行星地壳流入一些未开发的矿脉中。

该地质现象使一部分未开发的矿物受到高温，将其中的金属矿脉精炼成为坚固的合金。因此，在该行星上的矿物开采能够产出可用的金属碎片了。
excerpt.en:
Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of [mining_planet.GetName]. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.

This geological phenomenon has superheate

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正在发出非凡的祥光。占星专家对此进行讨论后，我们理解了其能量的盈余将会增强[This.GetName]上各种各样的发电活动。
excerpt.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在接管[from.GetName]恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等灵能光环的机械装置。
excerpt.en: In taking control of the [from.GetName] system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our Psionic Aura.

excerpt.zh: 在接管[from.GetName]恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等灵能光环的机械装置。
excerpt.en: In taking control of the [from.GetName] system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our Psionic Aura.

excerpt.zh: 在接管[from.GetName]恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等灵能光环的机械装置。
excerpt.en: In taking control of the [from.GetName] system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our Psionic Aura.

excerpt.zh:
意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass][This.GetName]。

不幸的是，其系统损伤过重无法修复。
excerpt.en: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on [high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] [This.Get

excerpt.zh: 在接管[from.GetName]恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等灵能光环的机械装置。
excerpt.en: In taking control of the [from.GetName] system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our Psionic Aura.

excerpt.zh: 我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]的控制，它被活雪夺走了！在[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]的生态系统中已经开始发生非常明显的变化。我们的[This.GetResearchers]提醒，除非我们能尽快夺回[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]，否则它的构造变化很快将使我们无法再继续居住。
excerpt.en: We have lost control of [FromFrom.GetName] - which has been seized by the Living Snow! Already, significant changes are happening to the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s ecosystem. Our [This.GetResearchers] warn that, unless we can retake the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon

excerpt.zh:
最终，物理意义上的遏制和毁灭成为了解决嗜杀的[From.GetName]的唯一可行的手段。尽管某些[Root.GetAdj]人工智能专家抗议道它仅仅只是启动了基础的自我保存协议，其对[Root.GetAdj]自主权和生命形式的全盘否行让任何谈判和妥协都无从进行。

已经损坏的信息基建会根据全新的规范重建，那些尚未腐化的计算引擎会更新全新的安全措施。这样的事情不会再度发生了。
excerpt.en: Ultimately, physical containment and destruction proved to be the only viable solution to the problem of the homicidal [From.GetName]. While some [Root.GetAdj] AI specialists argue that it was enacting basic self-preservation protocols, its seemingly complete

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的近智慧生物正在我们的殖民地外围闹事。[Root.Owner.GetName]的存在似乎激怒了他们，他们一直不停的在殖民地的边界和东边的某处之间来回往返。
excerpt.en: The near-sapient natives of [Root.GetName] are causing a ruckus on the outskirts of our colony. Something about the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s continued presence here visibly agitates them, as packs of them scurry to and fro between the settlement's borders and so

excerpt.zh:
今天，我们的工程师和行星生态学家完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的环形世界最后一个宜居区间的建造。这个伟大的巨型结构的建造必将成为[Root.GetName]历史的里程碑。我们完成了屈指可数的文明才能完成的工作。

让这个环形世界成为一个永恒的见证：自从[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种从安全的母星踏足至如今，我们达成了什么样的成就。
excerpt.en: Our engineers and planetary ecologists today finished the last of the habitat sections on the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. The construction of this great megastructure must be considered a milestone in the history of

excerpt.zh:
我们的超主，[GetShroudPatron]，从虚境中沉积出了一小份能量以备取用。与超主的紧密关系让我们能安全吸收这些能量。

我们挑选了一些候选人，但只有其中一位可以得到获得汲取超主力量的殊荣。我们必须做出抉择。
excerpt.en:
Our patron, the [GetShroudPatron], has deposited a fraction of its energy in a fold of the Shroud, ready for the taking. Our close bond will allow one of us to safely absorb this power.

A number of candidates have been selected, but only one of them can be gr

excerpt.zh:
被封装在围绕在哨兵阵列上的环中的科技应该被严加看管以防泄密。

不过它带来的效果毋庸置疑，我们现在几乎能完全掌控整个星系所有舰队的动向。
excerpt.en:
Exactly what technology is housed in the ring that encircles the Sentry Array is a closely guarded secret.

The results, however, are undeniable. We now have virtually perfect knowledge of all fleet movements in the galaxy.

excerpt.zh:
今天我们庆祝这个伟大的科学枢纽的开启。伴随着它那最尖端的科研设备与革新科技，我们可以毫无阻力地吸引全星系甚至整个宇宙最伟大的头脑，这正是我们希望的。这项功绩将成为一个新启蒙时代的开端。

今天会是我们物种历史中伟大的一天。
excerpt.en: Today we celebrate the grand opening of the Science Nexus. With its state of the art research facilities and innovative technology we will have no trouble attracting the greatest minds from across the empire, or even the universe, should we so desire. This fea

excerpt.zh: 我们在气态巨行星[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一些大型生物的残骸。我们的科学家希望分析它们以推断它们的起源。
excerpt.en: We have found the dead remains of several large creatures in orbit around the gas giant [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to study them more closely to determine their origins.

title.zh: 探究因内特贸易体的秘密
title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

excerpt.zh: 在发现了因内特贸易体的安息之地后，关于他们辽阔帝国仍有许多未解之谜。我们计划再一次进行调查。
excerpt.en: After having discovered the final resting place of the Inetian Traders there is still more to learn about their vast empire. We would like to investigate them one more time.

title.zh: 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密

excerpt.zh: 庆典学院还有很多值得我们研究的东西。我们有勇气继续深入探察这些阿达卡利亚人的实验吗？
excerpt.en: There is still so much we can learn from Institute of Celebration. Do we dare to engage with these adAkkarian experiments even further?

excerpt.zh: 我们应当学习如何安全地将一个行星辐射化，不给当地人群造成过大的不便。
excerpt.en: We shall study how to safely irradiate a planet, without unduly inconveniencing the local population.

excerpt.zh: 派遣一艘舰船去外星人的母星，我们将在它们身上收集那些我们认为它们从我们身上搜集了的数据。
excerpt.en: Sending a ship to the alien homeworld, we will be able to gather the same data on them that we suspect them to have on us.

excerpt.zh: 在一颗遥远的星球上发现一座了塞满机器人的工厂。如果我们重新激活他们，可能会揭示他们家园的秘密。
excerpt.en: A facility filled with robots has been found on a distant planet. If we reactivate them, they might reveal the secrets of their home.

excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为雕刻之物。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Sculpting Presence.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须找出那个似乎对我们有放松作用的神秘乐器的原始物质。
excerpt.en: We must find the source material of the mysterious instrument that appears to have a relaxing effect on us.

excerpt.zh: 我们开始了[target.GetName]的不可逆辐照过程，以此促进[target.GetToxifiedResourcesText]的生长并同时将其变为一片剧毒废土。
excerpt.en: We have begun the irreversible process of irradiating [target.GetName], promoting the growth of [target.GetToxifiedResourcesText] and turning it into a toxic wasteland in the process.

excerpt.zh: 在调查母星系时，我们在[From.GetName]上面找到了一些东西，和我们早先从母星上观测的结果间存在一定的偏差。
excerpt.en: During the survey of our home system we found something on [From.GetName] that did not match earlier observations made from our homeworld.

excerpt.zh: 消灭一个太空变形虫。
excerpt.en: Neutralize a Space Amoeba.

excerpt.zh: 再消灭4个太空变形虫，以便更好的了解这个种群的生物特性。
excerpt.en: Eliminate 4 more Space Amoebas to get a better understanding of their biology.

excerpt.zh: 前往目标帝国的恒星系并进行正式外交接触。
excerpt.en: Travel to the target empire's home system and conduct a formal diplomatic engagement.

excerpt.zh: 星辰不过是我们饥渴的燃料，灾难只是我们野心绽放的土壤。我们将违逆自然法则，锻造一头巨大而不可阻挡到能重塑宇宙的巨兽。
excerpt.en: The stars are but fuel for our hunger, and calamity is merely the soil where our ambition blooms. We shall defy the natural order, forging a beast so immense, so unstoppable, that it will reshape the cosmos.

excerpt.zh:
所有的虚空之云在量子层面上都是相连的；这些散发能源的个体样本很可能就是一个单独的亚空间实体的多个表示形式。

对一个虚空之云进行了仔细研究之后，我们找到了其他可能富含这些云的星系。
excerpt.en:
All Void Clouds are entangled with one another on the quantum level; it is possible that the energies animating the individual specimens are nothing but multiple instances of a singular sub-space entity.

Through careful study of one Void Cloud, we have been a

excerpt.zh: 消灭一个虚空之云来获取它的原始星质。
excerpt.en: Neutralize a Void Cloud to sift through its primordial star-stuff.

excerpt.zh: 在此帝国的某个恒星系中建造一座驿站。
excerpt.en: Build a Waystation in this Empire's system.

excerpt.zh: 清理该帝国的殖民地上所有的行星自然障碍。
excerpt.en: Clear every Natural Planetary Blockers from this Empire's Colony.

excerpt.zh: 协助让这个新殖民地设立且高效地运转起来。
excerpt.en: Help get this new colony up and running efficiently.

excerpt.zh: 对该系统进行深度扫描，以评估其资源和战略相关性。
excerpt.en: Complete a Deep Scan of this system to assess its resources and strategic relevance.

excerpt.zh: 看来[marauder_country_1.GetName]已在此恒星系建立了一处哨站。我们应该在他们站稳脚跟前将其铲除。
excerpt.en: It seems that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] have set up an outpost in this system. We should knock it out before they get a foothold.

excerpt.zh: 将代表团运输至[from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]星系的[from.capital_scope.GetName]。
excerpt.en: Transport delegates to [from.capital_scope.GetName] in the [from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh: $contract_espionage_support_nomad_desc$
excerpt.en: $contract_espionage_support_nomad_desc$

excerpt.zh: 船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。
excerpt.en: Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.

excerpt.zh: 停靠权和边境通行权可能会在毫无预警的情况下被撤销。一颗监控政府通信的监视卫星将告诉我们，这个帝国的热情好客究竟是真诚的还是有条件的。
excerpt.en: Docking privileges and border access can be revoked without warning. A surveillance satellite monitoring government communications will tell us whether this empire's hospitality is genuine or conditional.

excerpt.zh: 我们预定航线上的舰队动向、边界变动与军事集结可能会使飞船受困于敌对星区。侦察卫星将为导航提供足够的预警时间，以便规划备用路线。
excerpt.en: Fleet movements, border shifts, and military buildups along our projected route could strand the ship in hostile space. A surveillance satellite will give navigation enough lead time to plot alternatives.

excerpt.zh: 当采购部门了解真实价格时，供应谈判会进展得更加顺利。一颗监控贸易渠道和资源流向的监视卫星，将确保我们的团队在下一个港口不会支付过高的价格。
excerpt.en: Supply negotiations go better when procurement knows the real prices. A surveillance satellite monitoring trade channels and resource flows will ensure our teams are not overpaying at the next port.

excerpt.zh: 该地区出现了反游牧情绪的相关报道。侦察卫星将确认这一局势仅仅是空谈，还是正在成为当地的政策。
excerpt.en: Reports of anti-nomad sentiment have surfaced in this region. A surveillance satellite will confirm whether the talk is just rhetoric or whether it is becoming policy.

excerpt.zh: 为了娱乐乘客，我们将在指定的恒星系中部署一颗非功能性的“间谍卫星”。
excerpt.en: To entertain the passengers, we'll deploy a non-functional "spy satellite" in the indicated system.

excerpt.zh: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]
excerpt.en: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]

excerpt.zh: 乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。
excerpt.en: Passengers are taken on guided excursions to the city below, where crew operatives have planted fake intelligence packages at prearranged locations for them to discover.

excerpt.zh: 全船各层甲板已通报发生一起模拟的安全事件。乘客们被招募参与一场全船范围的调查游戏，以找出安插在船员中的“外来特工”。
excerpt.en: A staged security breach has been announced across all decks. Passengers are recruited to identify planted 'foreign agents' among the crew in a ship-wide investigation game.

excerpt.zh: 观景台已被改造为监听站。乘客们驻守在这些站点，破译着船员们从底层甲板秘密发送的、预先编排好的外星信号。
excerpt.en: The observation decks have been converted into listening posts. Passengers man the stations, decoding scripted alien transmissions that the crew is secretly broadcasting from below decks.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£alloys£ 合金。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £alloys£ Alloys cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£energy£ 能量币。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £energy£ Energy Credits cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£minerals£ 矿物。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is a £minerals£ Minerals cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: 可以从该恒星系收集高价值的合金。
excerpt.en: Valuable Alloys can be harvested from this system.

excerpt.zh: 收集该恒星系内可用的消费品。
excerpt.en: Collect the Consumer Goods available in this system.

excerpt.zh: 采集该恒星系中的可用能量。
excerpt.en: Harvest the available Energy in this system.

excerpt.zh: 这里可以找到罕见的异星天然气。应当采集它们。
excerpt.en: Rare Exotic Gases can be found here. They should be harvested.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系中有可采集的高价值矿物。
excerpt.en: There are valuable Minerals in this system that can be harvested.

excerpt.zh: 这里可以收获纳米机器人。
excerpt.en: There are Nanites here that can be acquired.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系已探测到稀有水晶。采集它们。
excerpt.en: Rare Crystals have been detected in this system. Harvest them.

excerpt.zh: 根据扫描结果，该恒星系中存在活体金属。
excerpt.en: According to scans, there is Living Metal in this system.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系中可以找到罕见的易爆微粒。
excerpt.en: Rare Volatile Motes can be found in this system.

title.zh: 提名冠铸秀锦标赛的举办恒星系

excerpt.zh: 我们已经购买了下一届“冠军之铸现场秀！”锦标赛的场地权。或许我们可以利用这一点为我们谋取优势。
excerpt.en: We have purchased the venue rights for the next Champion's Forge Live! tournament. Perhaps we can use this for our advantage.

excerpt.zh: 我们获得可靠情报，[marauder_country_1.GetName]的掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系。这将是一个埋伏他们的绝佳机会。
excerpt.en: We have good intelligence that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] raiding fleet will be passing through this system. It will be a great opportunity for an ambush.

excerpt.zh: 加入[From.GetName]的所有战争。
excerpt.en: Join the [From.GetName] in all their wars.

excerpt.zh: 支援巨型结构的建造。
excerpt.en: Assist with the construction of a Megastructure.

excerpt.zh: 开展£physics£ 物理学研究研究以改进该恒星系中现有的£energy£ 能量币来源。
excerpt.en: Conduct £physics£ Physics Research to improve existing sources of £energy£ Energy Credits in this system.

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ 工程学研究。
excerpt.en: Conduct £engineering£ Engineering Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£society£ 社会学研究，以提高该星系中可开发的£food£ 食物储量。
excerpt.en: Conduct £society£ Society Research aboard an Arkship to improve exploitable deposits of £food£ Food in this system.

excerpt.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ 工程学研究，以改善该恒星系现有的£minerals£ 矿物矿脉分布。
excerpt.en: Conduct £engineering£ Engineering Research aboard an Arkship to improve existing £minerals£ Minerals deposits in this system.

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£physics£ 物理学研究。
excerpt.en: Conduct £physics£ Physics Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£society£ 社会学研究。
excerpt.en: Conduct £society£ Society Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系的太空兽群正给我们带来麻烦。请铲除它们。
excerpt.en: The Space Fauna in this system are causing us problems. Please eradicate them.

excerpt.zh:
从[fromfrom.GetName]接收罪犯。我们将按认为合适的方式驱逐他们，并可以选择将他们留在船上或送往另一个殖民地。我们不应将他们带回属于[from.GetName]的行星。

在接收囚犯后，选择将他们留在船上，或使用方舟舰指令“移交囚犯”将他们捎到我们选择的殖民地。
excerpt.en:
Pick up criminals from [fromfrom.GetName]. We are to deport them as we see fit, and can choose to either keep them aboard or drop them off on another colony. We are not supposed to bring them back to a planet owned by [from.GetName].

After collecting the pris

excerpt.zh: 代表[from.GetName]轰炸行星以积累荒废度。
excerpt.en: Bombard planets on behalf of [from.GetName] to build up Devastation.

excerpt.zh: 扫描一场战斗之后留下的残骸。
excerpt.en: Scan the debris left behind after a battle.

excerpt.en: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$

excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc1]

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]

excerpt.zh: 储备即将耗尽。船组小队将前往星球表面寻找备件、原材料，以及飞船制造机在几个周期前就已停止生产的各类补给品。
excerpt.en: Stores are running low. Crew teams will go planetside to source replacement parts, raw materials, and the supplies the ship's fabricators stopped producing cycles ago.

excerpt.zh: 当地工程师已开放他们的设施供考察。他们对常见工程问题的解决方案与我们的模型存在显著差异，而当地人也同样渴望研究方舟舰。
excerpt.en: Local engineers have opened their facilities for inspection. Their solutions to common engineering problems diverge significantly from our own models, and the locals are equally eager to study the Arkship.

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]

excerpt.zh: 乘客们渴望踏上坚实的土地，去探索下方的外星城市。我们已经安排了由向导带领的进城游览。
excerpt.en: The passengers are eager to set foot on solid ground and explore the alien city below. We've arranged guided excursions into the city.

excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。
excerpt.en: The renowned dining districts on the planet below have agreed to host the passengers for a guided tasting tour of local cuisine.

excerpt.zh: 该星球的首都设有一座享誉星系的博物馆。乘客们一直在请愿，要求安排带有导游的游览活动，以参观其中的纪念碑和历史展品。
excerpt.en: The planet's capital hosts a museum of galactic renown. Passengers have been petitioning for a guided tour of its monuments and historical exhibits.

excerpt.zh: 地表上一个庞大的露天市场交易着来自整个星域的商品。乘客们迫不及待地想要去逛一逛并讨价还价。
excerpt.en: A sprawling open-air market on the surface deals in goods from across the sector. The passengers are eager to browse and haggle.

excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。
excerpt.en: A nature reserve on the planet below offers guided tours through its alien wilderness. Passengers will observe alien fauna from guided walkways.

excerpt.zh: 带领一群游客进行一场银河观光之旅。
excerpt.en: Take a group of tourists on a galactic sightseeing tour.

excerpt.zh: 使用方舟舰的恒星引擎将气态巨行星转化为新生恒星，为该恒星系解锁海量资源。
excerpt.en: Use the Arkship's Stellar Engine to transform a gas giant into a newborn star, unlocking vast resources for the system.

excerpt.zh: 在主发电机进行计划维护期间，我们需要环绕该星系的恒星运行，并依靠太阳能供电。
excerpt.en: We need to orbit this system's star and run on solar power while the main generators undergo scheduled maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 外层船体板需要在持续的恒星照射下进行热荷载测试。为确保安全，朝向恒星一侧的所有舷窗都将被遮蔽。
excerpt.en: The outer hull plating requires thermal load testing under sustained stellar exposure. All viewports on the starward side will be shuttered for safety.

excerpt.zh: 冷却系统需要在热负载下进行一次完整的排空循环。近恒星轨道能让我们高效地冲洗管线，尽管甲板温度会出现波动。
excerpt.en: The coolant system needs a full purge cycle under thermal load. Close stellar orbit will let us flush the lines efficiently, though deck temperatures will fluctuate.

excerpt.zh: 导航阵列必须在近距离根据实时恒星信号进行校准。此过程将占用娱乐系统的带宽。
excerpt.en: Navigation arrays must be calibrated against a live stellar signature at close range. The process will commandeer bandwidth from entertainment systems.

excerpt.zh: 水循环系统需要进行一次高强度的紫外线杀菌，此过程只有在近恒星轨道上才能高效完成。疗愈中心与游泳池现已关闭，各层甲板均实行限量供水。
excerpt.en: The water recyclers need an intensive UV sterilization run that is only efficient in close stellar orbit. The spa and pool are closed and water is rationed across all decks.

excerpt.zh: 我们将进入轨道，让乘客们沉浸在陌生太阳的光辉之中。
excerpt.en: We'll settle into orbit and let the passengers soak in the light of an unfamiliar sun.

excerpt.zh: 乘客中的业余天文学家发现了该星系中罕见的太阳活动，目前正在请愿要求在驻留轨道期间获得前排的观赏位置。
excerpt.en: Amateur astronomers among the passengers have spotted rare solar activity in this system and are petitioning for a front-row viewing from orbit.

excerpt.zh: 巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。
excerpt.en: The cruise is hosting a shuttle race around this system's star. Passengers are placing bets and crowding every viewport.

excerpt.zh: 疗愈中心需要长时间暴露在未经过滤的恒星辐射下，以进行乘客们一直要求的一种奇特的焕新理疗。
excerpt.en: The spa requires prolonged exposure to unfiltered stellar radiation for an exotic rejuvenation treatment the passengers have been requesting.

excerpt.zh: 一场盛大的正式舞会将在观景甲板上举行，沐浴在直射的星光下。这是此次航程中的社交盛事。
excerpt.en: A grand formal ball is to be held on the observation decks, bathed in direct starlight. The social event of the voyage.

excerpt.zh: 摧毁一个晶态实体来获取矿物质样本。
excerpt.en: Destroy a Crystalline Entity formation to retrieve a mineral sample.

excerpt.zh: 摧毁4个晶态实体舰队来进一步获取战斗场景数据。
excerpt.en: Crush 4 Crystalline Entity fleets to gather further combat scenario data.

title.zh: 我们发现一颗行星表面覆盖着密密麻麻数以兆计的红色昆虫。这对于我们而言究竟是灾疫还是机遇呢？
title.en: We found a planet carpeted in trillions of red insects. A plague, or an opportunity?

excerpt.zh: 猩红爬虫
excerpt.en: Crimson Crawlers

excerpt.zh:
在追寻神圣的召唤时，我们将实现崇高身体与神圣义体技术的融合。没有任何事物能阻挡我们通往启迪之路。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
excerpt.en:
In pursuing the divine calling, we shall achieve the fusion of the exalted body and sacred cybernetics. Nothing shall hinder our path to enlightenment.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

excerpt.zh: 试图拆解并反向组装一个采矿无人机。
excerpt.en: Disable and attempt to reverse-engineer a Mining Drone.

excerpt.zh: 为了确保长期生存，[This.GetSpeciesName]物种需要扩张到[This.Capital.GetName]之外的地方去。建立我们的第一个殖民地，并在外星球的地表上插上[This.GetName]的旗帜。
excerpt.en: The [This.GetSpeciesName] species needs to spread beyond [This.Capital.GetName] to secure its long-term survival. Establish our first colony and plant the banner of the [This.GetName] on the surface of an alien world.

excerpt.zh: 领导太空时代的十字军对抗[parameter:heathens.GetName]。
excerpt.en: Lead a crusade against the [parameter:heathens.GetName].

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]当选于建设至少2个额外发电区划的承诺。

协议结束奖励：

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]当选于建设至少2个额外采矿区划的承诺。

协议结束奖励：
6个月的£unity£凝聚力产量（最大1000）

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was elected on a platform of constructing at least 2 additional Mining Districts.

Reward at end of term:
6 months' worth of £unity£ Unity (Max 1000)

[This.GetRulerTitle][This.GetRulerName]承诺铲除奴隶制度，保证会在统治期间取缔此制度，并因此当选。

excerpt.en: [This.GetRulerTitle] [This.GetRulerName] was elected on a platform of thrift and carefully deliberated spending, guaranteeing that the [Root.GetName] will enjoy reserves of at least £energy£ 1000 Energy Credits by the end of their reign.

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetRulerTitle][This.GetRulerName]因为承诺在适宜的小行星轨道上建设开采站以增加£minerals£ 矿物产出而当选。

6个月的£unity£凝聚力产量（最大1000）

6 months' worth of £unity£ Unity (Max 1000)

[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]当选于来将我们的£alloys£ 合金月盈余提升到至少£alloys£+12/月的承诺。

协议结束奖励：
