excerpt.zh: 使用古代采矿无人机的评估系统中的技术，我们定位了一些矿产资源丰富的天体。
excerpt.en: Using techniques derived from the Ancient Mining Drones' assessment systems, we have pin-pointed a handful of stellar bodies that are likely to be particularly rich in minerals.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经找到了弥那玛特种实业集团的星系坐标。
excerpt.en: We have learned the galactic coordinates of Minamar Specialized Industries.

excerpt.zh: 在我们境内侦测到奇怪的外星人出现，我们无法与其建立通讯通道。另外因为我们无法翻译他们的语言，目前只能静观其变。
excerpt.en: We have detected that the odd aliens, whose communication we cannot tap into, have appeared within our borders. Since it's impossible for us to translate their language we can only wait and see who they are and what they want.

excerpt.zh: 有些东西正在破土而出感染我们的殖民地！
excerpt.en: Something is burrowing out of the ground and infesting our colony!

excerpt.zh: 能量辐射
excerpt.en: Energy Emissions

excerpt.zh: 在动身探索星系之前，我们必须对[home_system.GetName]恒星系进行全面调查。我们必须完全了解自己的“后院”。
excerpt.en: Before venturing into the rest of the galaxy, we should conduct a full survey of the [home_system.GetName] system. Our own backyard must not be left unexplored.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
excerpt.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
excerpt.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 塞塔娜的真正目的大白天下了。她癫狂想除一切身体上的苦痛，“上传”所有感性生物的意识，消灭我们所知的一切生命。无论如何，我们必须找到能阻止她疯狂野心的力量。
excerpt.en: The true intentions of Cetana are at last made clear. In a monstrous bid to end physical suffering, she plans to 'upload' the consciousness of every sentient being, eradicating life as we know it. Somehow, we must find the strength to thwart her mad ambition.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已迁址

excerpt.zh: 在与其前中心失去联络之后，星系商贸团体选择在我们境内设立一座新的空间站。
excerpt.en: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.

excerpt.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
excerpt.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

excerpt.zh:
数个太空帝国，其中一些我们尚不清楚，已经联合组建了一个“星海共同体”。这一国家间机构的目的是作为一个论坛，在那里可以共商重要事务。

虽然我们并不曾参与其建立，那些成员国已经向[Root.GetName]发出了邀请，请求我们成为正式的成员国。我们应该接受邀请吗？
excerpt.en:
Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "Galactic Community." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.

Although we were not involved in its founding, the ot

excerpt.zh: 最后一个[GetPreFTLLower][From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被从他们的母星[From.From.GetName]上被绑架作为奴隶。一些离散的幸存者可能还会在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的野外中徘徊，但是已经不足以维持任何形式的文明了。
excerpt.en: The last of the [GetPreFTLLower] [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been abducted into slavery from the surface of [From.From.GetName], their homeworld. A few scattered survivors might still be roaming the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness, but not enough t

excerpt.zh: 我方军团已成功进入[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]并完成对原始文明的压制。当地居民已放弃一切抵抗，我们已将其文明收入我们帝国管制之下。考虑到其落后的科技水平，要将其转变为[Root.GetAdj]可用的生产力还需要一些时间。
excerpt.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the primitive forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have given up all attempts at fighting back and we have now subsumed their civilization into our Empire although, backwards as they are, it

excerpt.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
excerpt.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

excerpt.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
excerpt.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
excerpt.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

excerpt.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
excerpt.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

excerpt.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
excerpt.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

excerpt.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
excerpt.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

excerpt.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
excerpt.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

excerpt.zh: 我们认输，我们屈服了。快把你的舰队调回去吧，嘶嘶嘶
excerpt.en: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, kssk

excerpt.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
excerpt.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

title.zh: 与[From.GetName]通过维持现状结束战争

excerpt.zh: 好吧。没有赢家，也没有胜利者。只有失去的生命，和残骸……
excerpt.en: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...

excerpt.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，[From.GetName]战争就发生了。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

excerpt.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
excerpt.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道轰炸激起了内阁对面临可能要投降的场景时我们该如何应对的讨论。
excerpt.en: The Orbital Bombardment of [From.GetName] has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.

excerpt.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的船员报告称科学专员[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，导致[malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer]彻底无法行动。
excerpt.en: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.

excerpt.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
excerpt.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 指挥官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因制造缺陷而发生了致命故障。
excerpt.en: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.

excerpt.zh: 总督[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障——彻底失灵——原因是在例行维护中安装了损坏的固件。
excerpt.en: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经重新夺回了对[Root.GetStarName]星系的控制权，在恒星轨道重建了我们的哨站。
excerpt.en: We have once again gained control of the [Root.GetStarName] system and rebuilt our Outpost in orbit around the star.

excerpt.zh: 我们应该把重点放在哪儿？
excerpt.en: What aspect shall we focus on?

excerpt.zh: 我们应该把重点放在哪儿？
excerpt.en: What aspect shall we focus on?

excerpt.zh:
[From.Owner.GetName]至伟至耀，巨型艺术设施上鳞次栉比的展位均被无价的文物填满。

异种将仰望我们的造业，甚惶甚恐。
excerpt.en:
The greatness of the [From.Owner.GetName] is such that we can line the Exhibition Stations of our Mega Art Installation with priceless artifacts.

Let the xenos look upon our works and despair.

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家开始了一个新的特殊项目，以探索先驱者更深处的秘密。
excerpt.en: Our scientists have begun a special project to study the deeper secrets of the precursors.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系笼罩着诡异的光芒。[Root.GetName]突然出现在星系的某个区域，我们确信这里此前数代人甚至数千年间从未被星系文明造访过。

但等一下，我们的传感器发现了一个能量信号！该信号主要集中在星系中的第一颗行星上，这颗行星似乎不太可能支持生命，毕竟它距离中子星如此接近。但好像还有其他信号正在移动。它们直奔[Root.GetName]而去，武器随时准备开火！
excerpt.en:
An eerie glow lies over the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has emerged in a sector of the galaxy surely not visited by any galactic civilization for generations - for millennia... if ever.

But wait - our sensors are reporting energy signatures! Mos

excerpt.zh: 我们已经击败了[fromfrom.System.GetName]的防御者。这个恒星系里的景象真是光怪陆离：固态物质几乎不存在，即便是小行星带都残破不堪，就像是被人彻底地开采枯竭了一般。一系列巨型装置按照特定的间距环绕着行星，而信号显示的那一颗孤零零的行星也许是人为制造的。其中释放出了强大的能量信号。如果有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
excerpt.en: We have defeated the defenders of [fromfrom.System.GetName]. The system is a curious sight: there is very little solid matter remaining in it - even its asteroid belts have a bedraggled look, as if they have been extensively mined. A series of large installati

excerpt.zh: 在勾陈一的最后一个侵略者倒下后，我们的舰船在返回港口之前完成了对恒星系的最后一次扫描，并发现了一些奇怪的东西。在勾陈一 II 的星球上，我们的传感器显示有重金属被排列成了人造结构。有趣的是，这些构造中中似乎只有一个漂浮在行星海洋上，而其余的则在海面以下。我们怀疑这是外星生命的杰作。
excerpt.en: After the last of the aggressors in Polaris fell, our ships completed a final scan of the system before heading back to port and discovered something curious. On the world of Polaris II, heavy metals are arranged in artificial structures on our sensors. Intere

excerpt.zh: 大前天晚上，首席考古学家[From.Leader.GetName]报告说看到了令人不安的景象，并且一直被关在自己的房间里直到现在。他们认为是我们这里的某种东西引发的……
excerpt.en: Three nights ago, chief archaeologist [From.Leader.GetName] reported having a disturbing vision and has been shut away in their quarters until now. They believed the source to be whatever is down here with us...

excerpt.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]满意地报告称，我们对[Root.GetName]的环境改造已经完成！通过从最后的巴奥的身体里提取基因并仔细选取出巴奥遗传密码的片段这一方法，我们成功在实验室中制造出了杂种植物并在部署这些植物仅仅五年后就成功完成了对[Root.GetName]气候和大气层的环境改造。

与预期一样，这些杂种植物在行星上到处增殖，目前正进入“潜伏”期，因为[Root.GetName]大气层化学成分的改变使它们不再活跃。

令人难以置信的是，行星管理部门报告称在这一过程里产生
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has completed! The deployment of new laboratory-created plant hybrids, made using carefully selected segments of the Baol genetic code as harvested from the

excerpt.zh:
在[Root.GetName]上引入巴奥幼苗之后产生了惊人的效果。接触幼苗孢子后，我们的一部分人口发生了自主适应，他们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上比预期中更加兴旺了。但对他们的生理学分析表明他们如今已无法再适应盖亚以外的其他生态系统了。

令人难以置信的是，行星管理部门报告称这一过程产生了意料之外的结果：[Root.GetName]上出现了许多智慧外星生命！它们与古代巴奥高度相似，但其拥有广泛混合的此行星自然植被的遗传物质。

尽管不是蜂巢思维的一分子，这些新巴奥外星人似乎同它们的祖先一样平和。无论
excerpt.en: Introducing the Baol seedlings to [Root.GetName] had a most curious effect. After being exposed to the seedling spores, parts of our population now seem to have adapted themselves to thrive even more than expected on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Yet analysis of t

excerpt.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]满意地报告称，对[Root.GetName]的环境改造已经完成！利用从最后的巴奥躯体里回收的精挑细选的巴奥基因片段，我们成功在实验室中制造出了杂种植物并在部署这些植物仅仅五年后就成功完成了对[Root.GetName]气候和大气层的环境改造。

与预期一样，这些杂种植物在行星上到处增殖，目前正进入一种“休眠”期，因为[Root.GetName]大气层化学成分的改变使它们不再活跃。

令人难以置信的是，管理部门报告称在这一过程里产生了意料之外的结果：[Ro
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has completed! The deployment of new laboratory-created plant hybrids, made using carefully selected segments of the Baol genetic code as harvested from the

excerpt.zh: 在拆解了C.A.R.E交互界面之后，我们的探险队员有了一个惊人的发现。尽管此人工智能的大多数机械在背水一战之后已经毁于一旦，但是我们的队员成功寻回了一个不同寻常的电脑芯片，在我们的技术员手里，它一定能发挥出不俗的价值。
excerpt.en: After disassembling the C.A.R.E Interactive Interface, our expedition crew made an incredible discovery. While most of the AI's machinery was destroyed in the firefight with its last-ditch effort defenses, our crew has managed to recover a remarkable computer

excerpt.zh: 一场甲烷爆炸事件夺去了科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]及其他几位工作人员的性命。原因是一个失控的钻头使得发电机组过载并引发火灾引发爆炸。失控的火灾点燃了剩余的甲烷并炸倒了一堵墙，结果使得一个由许多厅室和隧道组成的建筑系统重见天日。考古学家们确信这些遗址曾经属于一位藏有大量的珍奇珠宝和文物的富人。
excerpt.en: A methane gas explosion has injured Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and several of the crew. The blast set off when a malfunctioning drill overcharged the generators which then caught fire. Before the fire could be contained it ignited some residual metha

excerpt.en: When attempting to extract an item of interest from a pile of assorted bric-a-brac, [Root.GetLeaderName] accidentally set a junk avalanche in motion. Buried underneath it, we discovered the sooty remains of a tiny ratlike creature cradling a bottle of [Root.Ow

excerpt.zh:
雷鸣般的隆隆声从龙腹中发出，突然，她的翅膀包拢了舰船，呼出的热气让窗户蒙上了厚厚的一层雾气，双眼紧紧地盯着里面，在她的眼中闪过一缕疯狂的光芒。她怎么能够这么快就靠近过来，而且她还在……笑？

“你为什么要激起我的食欲，小家伙。”

她轻声咕噜着，随后向舰船猛扑而去！她毫无保留，露出了满嘴尖牙。
excerpt.en:
A thunderous rumble erupts from the dragon's belly. Suddenly her wings are wrapped around the ship, her steamy breath fogging up the windshield as she peers inside, a maniacal glint in her eyes. How did she get so close so fast and is she... smiling?

excerpt.zh: 入夜后，正当考古学家们酣眠之时，营地的食品模块突然因食物烧糊而发生火灾。此外没有找到有关火灾发生原因的线索。幸而无人受伤，可考古学家们空着肚子是无法好好工作的……
excerpt.en: Overnight, as the archaeologists slept peacefully, a fire broke out in the camp's provisions module overcooking the food somewhat. There are no indications as to how the fire started. Luckily no one was harmed, but archaeologists do not work well on an empty s

有机全典包含了曾经居住在全星系的数千种智慧物种的详细基因数据。我们的遗传学家可以利用这些数据在我们的殖民地上复活一种已灭绝的物种。

一旦我们选择了一个殖民地，遗传学家就会仔细研究有机全典，并挑选出适合其气候的物种。
excerpt.en:
The Omnicodex contains detailed genetic data on thousands of sapient species that once inhabited the galaxy. Our geneticists could use that data to revive an extinct species on one of our colonies.

Once we have selected a planet, the geneticists will go throu

excerpt.zh:
当我们触摸灵魂石时，我们被投影到了虚境的一处微缩位面中。我们很快意识到自己并非这片令人目眩的奇妙秘境中唯一的存在。这里有一个存在等待着我们，其古老的程度远超我们可以计量的范围。那是一位上古秘辛的守护者。贾巴克斯提，我们本能地知道这一点。

在通过了与其建立联系的试炼后，这个存在等待着我们发问。
excerpt.en: As we touch the Soulstone, we are projected in to a microcosm of the Shroud. We become aware that we are not alone in this swirling twilight realm. There is an entity awaiting us, one immeasurably ancient. A keeper of secrets. Ja'Baxti, we instinctively know.

excerpt.zh: 微缩星河内部的时间流逝的更快，通过仔细观察其中的居民，我们可以学到许多与先进科技有关的知识。
excerpt.en: Time flows faster inside the miniature galaxy, and by carefully observing its denizens we are able to learn much when comes to advanced technologies.

excerpt.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has reported delays caused by an unlikely series of equipment malfunctions. Work has been halted momentarily until replacements can be acquired.

在我们继续前进之前，支撑系统必须被仔细地添加到地面和天花板。这将是一项艰巨的工作，但是寻找另一条路线会延缓整个项目。
excerpt.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Supports will have to be carefully added to the floors and ceilings before we can proceed. It will be difficult work, but finding an

excerpt.zh: 古老并且部分被翻译的记录已经在[From.Planet.GetName]上被挖掘的废墟中发现。[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说这份记录包含着一些能对我们科学家有益处的技术细节。
excerpt.en: Ancient, partially translated records have been discovered amongst the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName]. [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the records contain several technical specifications that may be of value to our scientists.

excerpt.zh: 我们对[fromfrom.planet.system.GetName]恒星系中空间站的遗迹开展了持续性研究，并在这个过程中发现了少量密藏的古董物品。首席考古学家[root.leader.GetName]在其中发现了几件稀有文物。
excerpt.en: Our continued study of the remnants of the station in the [fromfrom.planet.system.GetName] system has unearthed a small cache of antique objects. Chief archaeologist [root.leader.GetName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

excerpt.zh:
碟片上刻录的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块碟片显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
excerpt.en:
The directions inferred from the audiovisual record were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the disc apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

excerpt.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽扫描表明这个星球在遥远的过去维持过生命。两极冰盖和[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表下明显蕴藏着冰冻水。干枯的河谷网的存在说明水曾经在星球表面自由流动。

对[From.GetPlanetMoon]环境改造理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的科技并不足以在切合实际的时间内完成这一壮举。
excerpt.en: Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that it may once have supported life in the distant past. There are significant deposits of frozen water at the polar ice caps and beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The existence of valley networks s

excerpt.zh:
到达[From.GetName]星系后，显而易见，[Root.GetName]来得太迟了。

不久前一支来路不明的海盗舰队发现了这片战场并将其拆除，用所得的材料在附近一颗小行星上建立了基地。

我们的研究宣告结束，看来一场好斗冲突已不可避免。
excerpt.en:
Upon arriving in the [From.GetName] system, it becomes clear that the [Root.GetName] is too late.

A pirate fleet of unknown origin discovered the straying battlefield some time ago, and cannibalized it to build a base on a nearby asteroid.

Our search ends, a

excerpt.zh: 威胁已被终结。或许，我们至少能部分利用起被海盗抢走的古老科技。
excerpt.en: The threat is ended. We might, at least, be able to make some use of the ancient technology the pirates plundered.

excerpt.zh: 我是佛坦伽！为了纪念我的统领，人民革命委员会一致同意，将星球名“伯达拉克”更改为“佛坦伽族”。还有，前“新伯达拉克”将更名为“查比克马克”，以我们的公众安全指挥官查比克·莱迪为名。完毕。
excerpt.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council has unanimously voted to rename the planet formerly known as "Baldarak" to "Fotangia" in honor of my leadership.

Also, the planet formerly known as "New Baldarak" shall henceforth be known as "Chabky

excerpt.zh: 我是佛坦伽！人民革命委员会宣布，4539人即将因背叛和反革命被处以死刑。那些意欲阻止我们光辉革命之辈，愿此声明以儆效尤。完毕。
excerpt.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of 4,539 individuals convicted of state treason and counter-revolutionary activities.

Let this serve as a warning to all those who would stand in the way of

excerpt.zh: 我是拉玛格！人民革命委员会宣布，佛坦伽即将因鼓动罪、腐朽和失职被处以死刑，即刻执行。我将接手他以前的所有职责。我的第一道法令是恢复佛坦伽族和查比克马克原来的名字。完毕。
excerpt.en:
This is Citizen Rutmag! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of Former Citizen Fotanga, who has been convicted of demagoguery, corruption and general incompetence.

I will be assuming all of his former duties. My first

excerpt.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的代理军团指挥官。很高兴宣布47-G区的主要战斗已经结束。至少512名抗争者被消灭，我方伤亡极低。特别表扬将平民伤亡控制到可接受水平的部队。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
excerpt.en: General Paltanak here, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I am pleased to announce the end of major combat operations in sector 47-G.  At least 512 insurgents have been confirmed killed since the operation began two cycles ago, while our own losses have

excerpt.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。我希望澄清这个世界重现抵抗活动的谣言。这完全不是事实。本行星已经完全恢复和平，所有潜在不安定因素已经彻底根除。其人民已再次回到达斯纳克帝国治下。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
excerpt.en:
This is General Paltanak, military governor of New Baldarak. I wish to address unsubstantiated reports claiming there has been a resurgence in rebel activity on this world. Let me tell you now that nothing could be further from the truth.

This planet has been

excerpt.zh: 我是拉普塔兹将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。很遗憾向大家宣告我的前任，帕塔纳克将军的死亡。他被诱入叛军部队卑鄙的埋伏，光荣牺牲。我们将举行盛大的葬礼，同时庆祝当前压制叛军堡垒的胜利。拉普塔兹讲话完毕。
excerpt.en: Colonel Rapzak reporting, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I must regretfully inform the galactic community of the demise of my predecessor, General Paltanak. After being lured into a dastardly ambush by rebel forces, the General gave his life in the

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我代表伯达拉克科学院与你交流。虽然我们达斯纳克不精于技术，但我们十分擅长理性演绎！

我们气态人的数个智囊团已经花费数年研究理论物理，并想要分享成果。也许我们的数据能对你们固态人热衷的帝国建设发挥作用。
excerpt.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! I have been asked to approach you on behalf of the Baldarak Science Academy. Although we Dathnak don't possess much in the way of technology, we are certainly capable of higher reasoning!

A few of our think tanks have spent

excerpt.zh: 你好，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！可以帮我们个忙吗？伯达拉克的强大引力把各种垃圾拉进了我们的大气，最近我们决定要进行清理。有个清理组发现了一个废弃的飞行舱，你可以帮忙处理掉它吗？它里面似乎塞满了各种没用的金属。
excerpt.en:
Hello, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Would you be willing to do us a favor? Baldarak's strong gravity well pulls all kinds of trash into our atmosphere, and at a recent council meeting we decided to step up our cleaning efforts. One of our reclamation un

excerpt.zh:
我们的科研船扫描了[From.GetName]的地表后发现了一些不寻常的现象。强烈的风暴无休止地袭击着[From.GetPlanetMoon]，这对我们的资源开发以及研究都有帮助，但却会限制人口发展。

在探索新行星的时候，我们当然会遭遇一些诸如此类的不测，而我们不应低估它对我们的扩张带来的影响。
excerpt.en: As our Science Ship scans the surface of [From.GetName] it becomes quite clear that we have found something out of the ordinary. Strong storms ravage the [From.GetPlanetMoon] constantly, which can aid our resources and research but will be an obstacle for our

excerpt.zh:
我们的科研船扫描了[From.GetName]的地表后发现了一些不寻常的现象。强烈的风暴无休止地袭击着[From.GetPlanetMoon]，这对我们的资源开发以及研究都有帮助，但却会限制人口发展。

在探索新行星的时候，我们当然会遭遇一些诸如此类的不测，而我们不应低估它对我们的扩张带来的影响。
excerpt.en: As our Science Ship scans the surface of [From.GetName] it becomes quite clear that we have found something out of the ordinary. Strong storms ravage the [From.GetPlanetMoon] constantly, which can aid our resources and research but will be an obstacle for our

excerpt.zh: 我们的预防措施和特种设备仍不充分。我们在[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]建立殖民地之后很快就跟地面的团队失去了联络。从落脚点收到的最后一条通讯显示，天空被微小的淹没了前哨的黑色物体遮蔽。
excerpt.en: Our precautions and special equipment were not enough. Shortly after establishing a colony on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], we lost contact with our teams on the ground. The last communication we received from the settlement showed a sky darkened by small bla

excerpt.zh: 在食用了太空生长的水晶糖数年之后，很明显，我们的人民对这一美食的需求愈发旺盛。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]已经列了一份表，上面是能够建造水晶糖农场的潜在候选地。
excerpt.en: After eating space-based crystal sugars for a few years now, it has become apparent that our population would like to see it more readily available. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have come up with a list of potential candidates where we could construct more cr

excerpt.zh: 警报的笛声响彻整个[Solar_System.GetName]，大量的晶化野兽从小行星庇护所里面冲了出来，正是我们在钻孔并打算提取晶体的那颗小行星。它看上去生气了。
excerpt.en: Warning sirens blared across [Solar_System.GetName] as the massive crystalline beast left the shelter of the asteroid we had been drilling into and extracting crystals from. It seems angry.

excerpt.zh:
铝板上雕刻的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块铝板显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
excerpt.en:
The directions inferred from the inscribed plaque were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the plaque apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
excerpt.en: An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of simila

excerpt.zh: [gateway_system.GetName]星系中为建造星门而准备的深空建造基址已经准备就绪。一旦我们的必要资源准备完毕，星门的正式建造随时都可以动工。
excerpt.en: The deep space construction site for the planned Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system is now in place. Once we have the necessary resources, construction of the actual Gateway may commence at any time.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[wormhole_system.GetName]星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"虫洞"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
excerpt.en: We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the [wormhole_system.GetName] system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "wormhole" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculat

excerpt.zh: 我们来自大洋深处，我们的物种完美地适应了深海环境下的生活。即使已经迈入星空，我们仍然没有忘记本源：水体是，也永远是我们的家园。如今，我们的飞升已经完成了——我们不再需要适应其他环境，而是改造其他的星球使其适应我们的需求。当新一天的黎明到来时，我们清楚再也没有什么东西可以让我们与海洋分离了。
excerpt.en: We came from the ocean, our species ideally suited to living in the depths of the seas. Even as we take to the stars, we have not abandoned our roots: the water is and shall always be our home. Now, our ascension is complete - no longer shall we adapt ourselve

title.zh: 发现冰封环境改造候选

excerpt.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽调查表明这颗行星拥有厚重冰层，因此可以转变为一颗怡人的海洋星球。我们只需将行星大幅度加热，并赋予它可以宜居的大气即可。

对这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造在理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的技术手段还不足以在有实际意义的时间框架内完成这一里程碑式的任务。
excerpt.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed a world with a sufficiently thick layer of ice that it could be restored into a pleasant ocean world, if rendered significantly warmer and bequeathed with a hospitable atmosphere.

Terraforming this [From.GetP

excerpt.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，以至于新鲜感开始喜忧参半。少数乘客在各个停靠港之间焦躁不安，请求永久下船定居；而下方，当地人则在订票柜台前排队，争抢船上的任何一个铺位，渴望亲身体验宣传册中承诺的种种奇观。
excerpt.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for the novelty to cut both ways. A handful of passengers, restless between ports of call, ask to be set ashore for good; below, locals queue at t

excerpt.zh: 我们的一艘方舟舰陷入黑暗无助漂流，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
excerpt.en: One of our Arkships lies dark and adrift, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]方舟舰正以我们祖先难以想象的速度穿越虚空。

早期的几代人曾花费数年甚至一生的时间在遥远的恒星间漂泊，而我们现代的驱动装置只需几天就能让方舟舰在各个星系间穿梭。随着飞船冲入超空间航道网，恒星在我们的传感器中飞速掠过，它们的光线不断发生位移与扭曲。

对于船上的许多人来说，这种经历确实会产生一种奇特的迷失感。一些人开始寻求微小的慰藉，以对抗这种感官冲击；而另一些人则坚持认为，只要给予足够的时间，我们的心智终将学会跟上方舟舰不断加速的旅程。
excerpt.en:
The Arkship [Root.GetName] now crosses the void at speeds our ancestors could scarcely have imagined.

Where earlier generations spent years, even lifetimes, drifting between distant stars, our modern drives hurl the Arkship from system to system in a matter o

excerpt.zh:
我们在方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的仪器记录到了来自[solar_system.GetName]星系黑洞的异常辐射。远距离扫描捕捉到一个不明物体正接近奇点。那艘巨大的舰船发出的技术信号远超我们的理解，干扰了我们的读数，导致无法进行精确分析。视觉确认也极其短暂，与其说是实物，倒不如说更像是一场幻觉。

在那艘船进入未知领域的前一刻，我们观察到了一个诡异的景象：船只完好无损地穿过了黑洞，且显然是有意为之。随后，所有信号都消失了。该船是被摧毁了、位移了，还是以某种无法理解的状态幸存下来，仍然不得而知。可以确定的是
excerpt.en: Our instruments aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] registered anomalous emissions from the black hole in the [solar_system.GetName] system. Long-range scans detected the glimpse of an unidentified object approaching the singularity. Their immense vessel emitted

excerpt.zh:
在经过[solar_system.GetName]星系内的一颗殖民星球时，我们观察到其背阳面爆发了同步的光束。一开始我们怀疑有动乱爆发，后来被证明这种担忧是多余的。这些爆发的光束是受控的、遍及全球的烟火表演，完全处于非军事参数范围之内。

进一步的分析显示，这场盛景是在刻意与某种天文信号进行对齐。我们可以有把握地得出结论：当地居民正在用光编码信息。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]记录了这些模式，从而对大规模协作和符号化交流有了更深入的了解。
excerpt.en: While passing a colonized world in the [solar_system.GetName] system, we observed its nightside erupt in synchronized bursts of light. Initial fears of unrest proved unfounded. The emissions were controlled, planet-wide pyrotechnic displays, well within non-mi

excerpt.zh:
当我们进入[solar_system.GetName]星系时，我们发现了一个巨大的晶态栅格阵列。我们的 [Owner.GetScientistPlural]已经确认，它存在于近乎完美的时空停滞状态中，并定期从引力边界传输结构化数据。

这不是自然现象。它是一份记录，是那些已不复存在的文明跨越时空的呼唤，一份被保存下来的叙述。

[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]正准备接收并破译这些传输信号。
excerpt.en: As we crossed into the [solar_system.GetName] system, we discovered a massive, crystalline lattice formation. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have already confirmed that it exists in near-perfect temporal stasis, transmitting structured data from the gravitatio

excerpt.zh:
[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。

此人的志向已传承给[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]，后者已同意接替上任继续进行这项研究。
excerpt.en:
[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName] can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.

Their ambition has passed to [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the research in their place

excerpt.zh:
当信号传来时，[solar_system.GetName]黑洞早已出现在我们的扫描仪上。其次谐波特征与我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]通过“永恒合唱”晶格发送的信息完全吻合：

记录已接收并保存。你加入了这里汇聚的、跨越无数时代的万千心声。每一个留下记录的文明都曾以为自己是孤独的。但事实并非如此。合唱的规模远超他们任何一方的想象。它仍在继续。

有什么东西接收了我们的记录。并且做出了回应。
excerpt.en:
The [solar_system.GetName] black hole was already on our scanners when the transmission arrived. The sub-harmonic signature matches exactly what our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] sent through the Eternal Chorus lattice:

Record received and preserved. You join th

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，对我们最近接触到的文明产生了一种超乎寻常的热情——如果一定要用语言形容的话。

无论是我们的仪器所能捕捉到的每一份文化记录，还是每一抹艺术或哲学的残片，都被其悉数吸收：

“我已经见识了足够多的东西，足以明白这里有着某种非凡的存在。让我去把剩下的补全吧。让我站在他们的世界里去学习。”
excerpt.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has developed what can only be described as a profound passion for the civilization we have recently encountered.

Every cultural record, every scrap of art or philosophy ou

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]无法继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。

代表团将由[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]接替管理，他已同意代为执行这项任务。
excerpt.en:
[from.GetName] can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.

The delegation will continue under [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the mission in their place.

excerpt.zh:
方舟飞船[Root.GetName]正在经历反应堆异常。最初注意到这个问题的是即将入睡的船员，因为引擎声伴着他们入眠。他们报告说是燃料流节奏出现了细微的失真。
我方[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]的调查证实，燃料管道内有异物进入。

幸运的是，我们已提出了几个解决方案。
excerpt.en:
Arkship [Root.GetName] is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by crew who listen to the engines to fall asleep. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm.
 
Investigation by our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] has confi

excerpt.zh:
一个游牧帝国已经突入了我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的空间，尽管我们关闭了国境。我们的敏感器正在密切追踪其动态，他们的存在被视作一种非常招人厌恶的入侵行径。

他们对我们领土边界的无视已经引起了我们的注意，我们对他们的评价也因此降低。
excerpt.en:
A nomadic empire has breached our closed borders in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Although our sensors are actively tracking developments, its presence remains an unwelcome intrusion.

Their disregard for our territorial boundaries has not gone unnot

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]侦测到游牧的帝国出现。

我们欢迎他们进入我国境内，并对这次相遇可能带来的可能性和机遇充满期待。
excerpt.en:
We have detected the presence of a nomadic empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

We welcome them within our borders and remain eager for the possibilities and opportunities this encounter may bring.

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[from.solar_system.GetName]的行踪已被发现，[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国正以日益增长的怀疑监视着我们的一举一动。

经过紧张的外交交涉，他们要求我们离开他们的领土，否则将面临报复。
excerpt.en:
Our presence in [from.solar_system.GetName] has been detected, and the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire is monitoring our movements with growing suspicion.

Following tense diplomatic exchanges, they have demanded that we depart their territory or face

excerpt.zh:
[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国位于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的扫描仪并未发现我们的存在。

在隐形场保持激活期间，我们必须避免任何可能导致暴露行踪的行为。
excerpt.en:
The scanners of the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have not detected our presence.

While our cloaking field remains active, we must avoid any actions that could risk revealing our presence.

excerpt.zh:
我们的扫描仪侦测到游牧帝国在[From.GetName]星系正在建立一座驿站。虽然此类建筑通常用于采集资源，但其确切用途可能有所不同。

此进展值得关注。
excerpt.en:
Our scanners have detected the construction of a waystation in the [From.GetName] system, established by a nomadic empire. While such structures are often used to harvest resources, their exact purpose can vary.

This development warrants observation.

excerpt.zh:
跨越边境进入[from.solar_system.GetName]星系，我们未曾遭遇任何抵抗，唯有一种比任何扫描仪所能测量的还要深沉的紧张感。

这片空间昭示着有一个早已巅峰不再、却绝非手无寸铁的文明存在。倘若其注意力被吸引到我们身上，我们定会被发现力有不逮。

让审慎指引我们的每一步。这里并非我们的领地。
excerpt.en:
Crossing the border into the [from.solar_system.GetName] system, we encounter no resistance, only a tension deeper than any scan can measure.

This space bears the hallmarks of a civilization long past its zenith, yet far from powerless. Should its attention b

excerpt.zh: 维度锁正在失去稳定。我们需要尽快行动避免它完全松脱。
excerpt.en: This Dimensional Lock is destabilizing. We will need to work quickly to prevent it from completely unraveling.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经揭开了关于如何收集储存这种构成我们宇宙边界的星界物质形成的缥缈丝线的秘密。

这种珍贵稀有的资源可以以诸多方式使用，使我们大受裨益。
excerpt.en:
We have unlocked the secrets behind gathering and containing the volatile threads of astral material that make up the very border of this universe.

This valuable and rare resource can be applied in various ways that will benefit us greatly.

excerpt.zh:
我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]星系的控制，一并也失去了其中所含的时空裂隙。

我们进一步探索的努力只能暂时告一段落了。
excerpt.en:
We have lost control of the [FromFrom.GetName] system, and the rift in space and time contained within.

Our efforts to reach beyond have been abandoned for now.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经开发出了这种能在星界裂隙的折缝中穿行的科技：裂隙探球。

这种球体以高度先进、绝对光滑的纳米材料建成，可以在时空的乱流处无摩擦地滑行。

因为不知道所到地方的情况，每一艘裂隙探球都会连接上一条锚定缆线。缆线连接在我们宇宙中的一艘科研船上，以便在发生意外时将我们拉回。
excerpt.en:
We have developed technology that will allow us to slip between the folds of an Astral Rift: Rift Spheres.

Constructed of a highly advanced, perfectly smooth nano-material, the Sphere is able to frictionlessly glide through turbulent areas of space and time.

excerpt.zh:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName]从一趟寻找因终末而消失的星系的星界裂隙探险中返回了。他熟悉的许多地方已经完全从本现实中消失了。

他还不确定自己回到的是不是正确的维度，显然是受到了一定的认知冲击。
excerpt.en:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName] returned from exploring an Astral Rift to find a galaxy lost to the End. Many of the places they knew have vanished completely from this existence.

They are still uncertain if they returned to the correct dimension at all, and appear

excerpt.zh: 我们是唯一剩下的人……我们必须重建……我们需要时间……
excerpt.en: we are all that remains... we must rebuild... we need time...

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们知道你……
此刻尚未到我们相遇之时……
excerpt.en:
though we know you...
it is not our time to meet...

excerpt.zh:
我们与[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]的联络中断了。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了裂隙探球的残余部分。

它几乎被完全溶解，大量高浓度生物质包裹着每一寸残骸。我们确信这可以带来新的科技突破。
excerpt.en:
We have lost contact with our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural].

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered what was left of the Rift Sphere.

While it is mostly dissolved, there is a highly concentrated biomass coating all remaining pi

excerpt.zh:
很不幸，我们与裂隙探球上的科学团队失去了联系。

在回收时，球体的大半已经完全熔为残渣。所有的船员都不幸牺牲了。

我们重新在科研船上安装了裂隙探球以对星界位面进行其他的探索。
excerpt.en:
Unfortunately, we lost contact with the science team aboard the Rift Sphere.

Upon recovery, half of the vessel had completely melted into slag. All aboard have perished.

We have refitted a new Rift Sphere to the science ship for further explorations into the

excerpt.zh:
我们的定向爆破打开了一条通向我们之前未发现墓室的通路。这个空间深藏于封印之后，显然做了一些反盗墓的设计。它里面还充满了敌对的实体。

球体立刻拉动了锚链，但还是有许多守卫跟随着我们的尾流冲出了裂隙。
excerpt.en:
Our controlled explosion has opened the way to a previously undetected cavity. Hidden behind the seal, this space was clearly designed to counter intrusion. It was filled to the brim with hostile entities.

The Sphere immediately retrieved the anchor, but many

excerpt.zh:
我们试图取出金色核心时，它的表面迅速地蔓延开了一道裂痕。我们还没来得及把它取出来，它就猛烈地向四面八方炸开了。

核心破碎的时候释放出强烈的能量。能量冲破了障碍，使我们周围巨大的齿轮开始疯狂运转。

我们已经启动了紧急锚链来逃离这个不幸的情况。
excerpt.en:
As we attempted to recover the golden core, a small crack quickly propagated throughout its surface. Before we could complete its retrieval, it exploded violently forth in all directions.

As it shattered, it released an intense energy. Overcoming our blockage

excerpt.zh:
在我们彻底结果掉这个敌意的外星人之前，他率先从靴子中抽出一把等离子手枪，杀死了人质和其他几名船员。

不幸的是，[Leader.GetName]也在被害者列表之中。

我们拉动了应急锚链，救回了伤者。

我们需要花一些时间来分析这个外星人的太空服。它是用高度先进的合金构造，应该会很有用。
excerpt.en:
Before we could neutralize the hostile alien, it dispatched their hostage and several others with a powerful plasma pistol drawn from their boot.

Unfortunately, [Leader.GetName] was among the list of casualties.

We are pulling emergency anchor and returning

excerpt.zh:
[Leader.GetName]被绑在诊断台上，意识转移开始了。他不安地扭动着身体，外来的意识尝试占据大脑，导致了无法控制的痉挛。然而，[Leader.GetName]挣脱了束缚，取出了隐藏的武器，紧接着就结束了自己的生命，过程中一同带走那个虚无缥缈的生物。

团队里剩下的人试着在这个空间中收集有用的材料，包括大量暗物质，然后启程返航。
excerpt.en: [Leader.GetName] was bound to a diagnostic bench, and the transfer began. They writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably as the foreign consciousness attempted to occupy their mind. However, [Leader.GetName] managed to escape their restraints and recove

excerpt.zh:
领袖[From.GetName]已然与世长辞。[From.GetHeShe]远自星界裂隙彼端而来，如今被隆重地安葬。葬礼在裂隙另一端的高塔内巨型，通过一台特殊建造的葬礼球体转播。我们希望[From.GetHeShe]能在彼世踏上新的旅程。

[From.GetHeShe]对我们帝国的卓著贡献将被长久铭记。
excerpt.en: Sadly, the leader [From.GetName] has passed away. Joining us from beyond an Astral Rift, [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetWasWere] buried with honors. The ceremony took place within the tower on the far side of the rift, and was observed from a specially made funeral

excerpt.zh:
我们与[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]失去了联系。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了裂隙探球。

不幸的是我们只找到了完全焦炭化的残骸。

值得一提的是，整个船体内的空气充满了高浓度的星界物质。
excerpt.en:
We have lost contact with our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered the Rift Sphere.

Unfortunately, we have found only charred remains.

Notably, the atmosphere inside of the vessel is high i

excerpt.zh:
在我们的文明中广泛采用基因操作技术催生出了令人目不暇接的各种身体变异。

一些原本可预测的生理过程现在出现了意外的偏差，使得标准化几乎不可能实现。

曾经统一我们物种的身体共性正在消解，取而代之的是一个由各种形态和功能组成的万花筒，这正在动摇社会的凝聚力。
excerpt.en:
The widespread adoption of genetic manipulation across our civilization has spawned a bewildering array of physical variations.

Once predictable biological processes now exhibit unexpected deviations, making standardization nearly impossible.

The shared sens

excerpt.zh:
一项转基因实验灾难性地失败了。科学家们试图将测试对象的DNA与其他多细胞生物的DNA进行拼接，以激活超级免疫反应，使其对所有病毒都具有免疫力。

然而，他们反而创造出了一种能够溶解接触到的任何生物体细胞壁的生物，它会与接触对象融合，形成一团巨大的、无定形的生物质团。

这团生物质在测试设施中滚动前进，吞噬了沿途的一切。目前它已被控制住，但如果逃脱的话将会造成重大的健康危害。值得庆幸的是，它似乎是可食用的...
excerpt.en:
A transgenic experiment has gone disastrously wrong. Scientists attempted to splice the DNA of test subjects with that of other multicellular organisms to activate a hyperimmune response, rendering them impervious to all viruses.

Instead, they created a creat

excerpt.zh:
当我们开始对[target.GetGestaltEntityName]进行生物提升时，我们必须优先考虑那些最能使我们的文明受益的强化项目。

选择性基因操控让我们能够培育出最适合特定的工业领域的理想体征。

有了这些新获得的能力，我们可以选择强化能源生产领域或防御领域的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]。
excerpt.en:
As we begin to biologically uplift the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], we must prioritize only those enhancements that will most benefit our civilization.

Selective gene manipulation allows us to breed specialists with desirable physical features who are best

excerpt.zh:
在给工蜂制定新的模板时，必须决定好如何处理那些无法承受基因升级的个体。

有一些较老的工蜂过于虚弱无法承受调整。可以将其保留作劳动力度过余生，或将回收他们的生物质补给蜂巢。
excerpt.en:
As we introduce a new biological template for our drones, we must decide how to handle those incompatible with the genetic upgrade.

Some older drones lack the strength to endure the alterations. We could either retain them as labor for the remainder of their

excerpt.zh:
一项突破性基因研究揭示了一种增强神经传递效率的方式，可以显著提升[target.GetIndividualName]的产出。

然而，这种对大脑输出功率的提升并不能长期维持，会导致寿命缩短。

我们必须决定是要保持正常的寿命或是以长寿为代价换取更强的能力。
excerpt.en:
A breakthrough in genetic research has revealed a way to enhance neural relay efficiency, significantly boosting [target.GetIndividualName] productivity.

However, this increase in brain output is not sustainable over a long period, leading to a shorter lifesp

excerpt.zh:
一批新增强的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经集成到了[target.GetGestaltEntityName]中，它们经过生物工程的微调，加速了神经发育和认知过程。[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的关键突触节点正以前所未有的速度运转。

然而，这种加速破坏了[target.GetIndividualName]的稳定性，有可能造成灾难性的突触过载。我们或许还可以重新分配更多的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]来执行协调任务。
excerpt.en: A batch of newly augmented [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] has been integrated into the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], their biological engineering fine-tuned to accelerate neural development and cognitive processes. The [target.GetGestaltEntityName]'s key sy

excerpt.zh:
自从将新一批克隆体整合进蜂巢后，我们发现了一种令人不快的声音振动问题。克隆过程中的一个失误可能阻碍了它们的生物递质的发育，产生了频率干扰。

这些克隆体与蜂巢整体进行交流时，附近的所有工蜂都会被一阵嘈杂而令人不安的精神耳鸣的影响。这分散了工蜂的注意力，也影响到了工作效率。
excerpt.en:
Since integrating a new batch of clones into our hive, we have observed unpleasant audio-vibratory issues. A misstep in the cloning process may have stunted the development of their biological transmitters, causing frequency interference.

When these clones co

excerpt.zh:
近期克隆实验取得了异常结果。部分克隆体似乎与基因供体之间存在神经连接，导致他们无意识地同步行动。

无论距离多远，这种现象始终存在，克隆体会与星系其他位置的供体完全同步。这一发现为我们带来了新的可能性。

我们可以启动一项计划，将克隆体与供体置于相同环境中协同工作；或者提取相关神经递质，以深入研究这一现象。
excerpt.en:
Recent Cloning experiments have yielded unusual results. Some clones appear to be neurologically linked to their genetic donors, causing them to unintentionally move in tandem.

The phenomenon persists no matter the distance, with individual drones mirroring t

excerpt.zh:
为了巩固蜂巢，我们用供体材料培育了一批克隆体并人工加速了它们的成熟。虽然这些克隆体是优良的生物标本，但却不可兼容。

这种反常虽然令人不安，但也提供了一个独特的机会。这些独特的工蜂拥有独立的身份和思想，在与集体之外的实体交互时可能会更加有利。它们自主思考的能力也可以弥合蜂巢统一意识难以跨过的鸿沟。然而这些好处是有代价的：他们日益增强的个体意识导致了不安，将会影响我们的一些高级认知功能。
excerpt.en:
In an attempt to bolster the hive, we cultivated a batch of clones from donor material and artificially accelerated their maturity. Though fine biological specimens, these clones are incompatible.

This deviation, while troubling, presents a unique opportunity

excerpt.zh:
我们的集体意识处于混乱之中。尽管拥有了自我复制的能力，但我们却对这种行为的有效性（甚至道德性）犹豫不决。

克隆工序需要大量资源。尤其在自然繁殖可能产生更多基因多样性的情况下，我们是否更应该将这些资源花费在更其他地方？

在历史上这不是我们的繁殖方式，我们不确定是否准备好接受这种对自己物种的根本改变。
excerpt.en:
Our collective consciousness is in turmoil. We now possess the ability to create copies of ourselves, yet we hesitate, questioning the efficacy (and even the morality) of such actions.

Cloning processes require significant resources. Might these be better spe

excerpt.zh:
变异带来很多好处，而我们的蜂巢能利用选择性增来进一步满足需求。可以通过硬化几丁质附肢实现对矿物产出的特化。

或者我们可以让所有工蜂获得更多基因修饰，让他们拥有多种不同功能。
excerpt.en:
Mutation offers many benefits, and through selective enhancements, we can adapt the hive to better serve its purpose. Specialization in mineral production can now be achieved by hardened, chitinous appendages.

Alternatively, we could augment all drones with m

excerpt.zh:
持续的实验给蜂巢带来了意想不到的复杂性。一些工蜂出现了独特的身体特征：像是带刺的外骨骼、过大的附肢，或者异常敏感的感官器官。

虽然这些变化确实带来了一定的好处，但同时也增加了代谢负担。蜂巢面临着平衡这种不断加剧的压力的问题。关键在于，要进行多少变异才算合适呢？
excerpt.en:
Ongoing experimentation has introduced unexpected complexities to the hive. Drones are emerging with unique physical characteristics: spiked exoskeletons, oversized appendages, or oddly sensitive sense organs.

While these deviations provide definite benefits,

excerpt.zh:
蜂巢正在改变。通过基因组的改造，我们观察到了显著的健康改善。然而，这也使我们在面对心理压力时变得更加脆弱。

我们并不讨厌从前的自己，尽管我们正在变得更强大、认知能力更先进，但我们仍然怀念过去那些熟悉的思维模式。

整个蜂巢都弥漫着一种深深的不适感，仿佛我们的身体与内在的心灵不再匹配。我们是否已经超越了自我的界限？
excerpt.en:
The hive is changing. By altering our genomes, we have observed measurable health improvements. However, this has made us less resilient to psychological distress.

We did not dislike who we were before, and even though we are becoming a stronger and more cogn

excerpt.zh:
我们的物种正站在下一个宏伟前沿的边缘。我们现在必须做出选择。

我们是要拥抱我们的命运，净化我们的基因谱系，将我们的文明提升到基因卓越的新高度？还是要保留我们过去的教训，以当前未经提炼的形态继续前进？
excerpt.en:
Our species stands on the edge of its next grand frontier. We must now make a choice.

Will we embrace our destiny, purifying our genetic lineage to elevate our civilization to new heights of genetic excellence? Or will we retain the lessons of our past and co

excerpt.zh:
我们的物种已经到达关键时刻。必须做出决定。

我们是要拥抱命运，驾驭克隆的力量，不可逆转地将自身转变为一个复制完美的文明？还是要吸收迄今为止旅程的教训，继续保持我们不必要的差异化？
excerpt.en:
Our species has arrived at a crucial moment. A decision must be made.

Shall we embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of cloning, irrevocably transforming ourselves into a civilization of replicated perfection? Or shall we absorb the lessons of our journ

excerpt.zh:
我们正处在关键生物前沿的风口浪尖。一个重要的抉择在等待着我们。

我们可以通过驾驭高级生物突变的力量来拥抱我们的命运，通过对我们基因密码的刻意进化来不可逆转地改变我们的文明。或者我们可以保留从过去探索中获得的教训，继续保持我们当前平凡的形态。
excerpt.en:
We are on the cusp of a pivotal biological frontier. An important choice awaits.

We can either embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of advanced biological mutation, irrevocably transforming our civilization through the deliberate evolution of our genet

excerpt.zh:
随着我们专注于净化我们的基因，我们正在认识到所有使我们文明伟大的事物。

当我们变得比以往任何时候都更加纯净，我们对我们优越的传承感到前所未有的自豪。

来自各个领域的专家；艺术界、科学界和商界，都在为我们的集体努力欢呼，并希望引领我们走向荣耀。
excerpt.en:
Complimenting the concentrated focus on purifying our genetics, we are realizing all the things that make our civilization great.

As we become purer than ever, we have never been more proud of our superior heritage.

Experts from all fields; the arts, science

excerpt.zh:
抗议者的呼喊在我们的城市中回荡。帝国内部的一个叛逆派系已经擅自拒绝我们的事业，背离我们通向纯净的道路。

这些麻烦制造者宣扬所谓基因多样性和文化融合的需求。

如果他们的激进行为得不到处理，我们通向纯净的进程可能会受阻。
excerpt.en:
Chants from protesters echo through our cities. A rebellious faction within our empire has taken it upon themselves to reject our cause, and turn away from our path to purity.

These troublemakers preach the supposed need for genetic diversity, and cultural in

excerpt.zh:
考古学家在我们祖先母星上发现了一个古代文明的证据。

一个长期掩埋的地下库被发掘出来，其中有令人震惊的远古基因实验证据。

如果这个消息公之于众，可能会削弱我们现代对基因纯净的主张。
excerpt.en:
Archaeologists have discovered proof of an ancient civilization from our ancestral homeworld.

A long buried vault has been uncovered, and within there is startling evidence of past genetic experimentation.

If this news became public knowledge, it could dilut

excerpt.zh:
一位名为[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]的叛逆基因学家被发现进行未经批准的生物实验。[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer]无视任何安全准则，目标是创造一个体现我们所追求的纯净理想的优等种族。然而，[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHeShe]却创造出了一个畸形怪物。

现在，一个短命的亚种正在我们的监管下逐渐消亡，它们虽然与我们的基因特征有一些相似之处，但大多是疾病缠身的恐怖存在。尽管对它们基
excerpt.en: A rogue geneticist by the name of [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] has been found conducting unsanctioned biological experiments. Bypassing any safety guidelines, [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer] goal was to create a race of superior beings who

excerpt.zh:
为了加快我们通向纯净的道路并识别基因组异常者，我们推行了定期基因检测，拥有'高质量'DNA已成为一种炫耀资本。

据称某些帝国官员一直在谎报他们的生物特征，伪造检测结果以表明他们拥有比实际更理想的特质。如果这件事曝光，这种对真相的隐瞒必将激起公众的愤怒。
excerpt.en:
Having rolled out regular genetic testing to streamline our path toward purity, and identify genomic outliers, 'high quality' DNA has become something to boast about.

Certain empire officials have supposedly been lying about their biological makeup, forging t

excerpt.zh:
克隆人就在我们之中。他们生活在我们的城市里，在我们的工厂里工作。有些甚至身居要职，参与制定影响我们生活的政策。

随着克隆个体融入我们的社会，许多问题仍未得到解答。他们应该享有什么权利？他们是否与非克隆人平等，还是应该作为下属被管控？
excerpt.en:
Clones walk among us. They live in our cities, they work in our factories. Some of them are even in positions of power, shaping the very policies that govern our lives.

With the integration of cloned individuals into our society, there remain many unanswered

excerpt.zh:
我们最具生产力的克隆设施之一因一起事故而突然停产，造成重大损失。

由于我们的许多操作都为了效率而自动化，在关键时刻没有人能够及时介入处理这次事故。

一个刚下生产线的克隆人滑倒，卷入机械装置中被碾碎，导致生产线堵塞，不得不完全停产。
excerpt.en:
Clone production at one of our most productive facilities has been halted suddenly due to an incident which caused significant damage.

As many of our operations are automated for efficiency, there was nobody to intervene at a key moment which led to the distu

excerpt.zh:
我们帝国各地的克隆人都在报告他们正在经历困扰，在寻找自我认同感方面苦苦挣扎。

他们渴望拥有超越其基因捐献者的身份认同。他们质疑自己存在的意义，对生活目标和抱负感到茫然。
excerpt.en:
Clones across our empire are reporting struggles, grappling with their sense of self.

They long for an identity beyond that of their genetic donors. They question their very purpose, feeling listless regarding their life goals and aspirations.

excerpt.zh:
随着更多克隆人融入我们的人口，维持他们生存所需的额外资源开始给经济带来压力。

虽然眼前的挑战重重，但更大的劳动力和消费群体带来的经济活力可能会为长期繁荣奠定基础——前提是我们能有效管理这个过渡期。
excerpt.en:
As more clones are integrated into our population, the additional resources required to sustain them are beginning to strain the economy.

While the immediate challenges are significant, the economic dynamism brought about by a larger workforce and consumer ba

excerpt.zh:
自发的肢体生长。物质形态的波动。突发性的形态转变。这些报告虽然零星，但不容忽视。

我们的变异实验在整个文明中产生了一些不太理想的结果。也许解锁随意修改基因的工具比我们最初预想的要复杂得多。
excerpt.en:
Spontaneous limb growth. Fluctuations between states of matter. Sudden onset metamorphosis. These reports are few and far between, but they cannot be ignored.

Our experiments with mutation are garnering some less than desirable results across our civilization

excerpt.zh:
由于自行进行变异实验，我们的一小部分人口发展出了非凡的能力和身体强化。

作为独特的强者和天赋者，他们正在形成一个群体，并引起了公众的广泛关注。
excerpt.en:
A small percentage of our population has developed extraordinary abilities and physical enhancements due to their own experiments with mutation.

As uniquely strong and gifted people, they are forming a community and garnering a lot of attention from the publi

excerpt.zh:
监控确认了一群基因改造者居住在城市下水道系统的存在——这令人不安地印证了长期被忽视的都市传说。

这一发现加剧了社会紧张，随着对未知的恐惧升级，外表明显变异的公民报告遭受更多歧视。然而，这些个体展现出了非凡的创造力，以意想不到的方式利用下水道气体进行资源生产并改造他们的环境。
excerpt.en:
Surveillance has confirmed the existence of a population of genetically altered individuals inhabiting urban sewer systems - an unsettling echo of long-dismissed urban legends.

This discovery has heightened social tensions, with visibly mutated citizens repor

excerpt.zh:
一种新疾病正在我们的帝国蔓延。这种疾病导致一系列令人不适的症状，包括但不限于：不自主的气体和液体排出、极度疲劳，某些情况下甚至会致命。

最奇特的是，这种疾病只影响那些通过基因变异改变了生理特征的人。对他们改造后基因组的持续研究带来了一些令人惊讶的发现。
excerpt.en:
An outbreak of a new disease is spreading across our empire. The illness causes a host of unpleasant symptoms, including but not limited to: involuntary expulsions of air and liquid, debilitating fatigue, and in some cases loss of life.

Most curiously, this d

excerpt.zh:
我们的基因组研究设施为整个文明提供了前所未有的生理改造能力。

然而，帝国的公民们想要更多。他们呼吁打破中央化的资源控制，允许所谓的"生物黑客"自由且不受限制地使用基因技术。
excerpt.en:
Our Genomic Research Facilities have granted our entire civilization access to physiological alteration unlike anything we have ever experienced.

However, the citizens of our empire want more. There are calls for breaking up centralized resources, and allowin

excerpt.zh:
一位名为[event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName]的[Owner.GetScientist]刚刚发表了一篇学术研究，这项研究可能大大加快并提高我们基因实验的效率和效果。

这种新方法目前仅限于理论，尚未经过测试，因此要安全地应用到我们的工作中还需要仔细考虑其方法论。
excerpt.en:
A [Owner.GetScientist] by the name of [event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName] has just published a piece of academic research that could be used to dramatically accelerate and improve the efficiency and efficacy of our genetic experimentations.

Purely theore

excerpt.zh:
由于我们持续的基因改造实验，我们的物种已被一段失控的基因代码侵入。我们正以惊人的速度变得虚弱，这段外来序列与我们自身基因物质的不受控制的相互作用正在破坏我们的稳定性。

我们必须在为时已晚之前解决这种异常的生物行为。
excerpt.en: Our species has been infiltrated by a piece of rogue genetic code, a consequence of our persistent experimentation in genetic modification. We are becoming unwell at an alarming rate, destabilized by the unregulated interaction of this foreign sequence with ou

excerpt.zh:
精彩。我们很高兴看到你们注意到了这个品系偏好闪避火力的特点，并恰当地加以利用。请放心，等到下一代完成孕育时，它就不会再有这个缺陷了。

你们已经成长了，年轻的[root.GetSpeciesName]。做好准备吧。
excerpt.en:
Glorious. We are pleased that you noted the preference this breed had for dodging fire and exploited it properly. Be assured that it won't have that fault by the time the next generation finishes gestating.

You have grown young [root.GetSpeciesName]. Be prepa

excerpt.zh:
我们注意到你们目前并未参与任何战斗。为什么？年轻的帝国必须战斗，否则就会落后。我们已经为你们选好了对手，[unfortunate_country.GetName]。在十年内击败他们，你们的持续发展就有保障了。

别担心你们之间的停战协定。它已经不存在了。
excerpt.en:
We have noticed that you are not currently engaged in battle. Why? Young empires must fight or fall behind. We have selected an opponent for you, the [unfortunate_country.GetName]. Defeat them within a decade and your continued development will be assured.

An

excerpt.zh:
年轻的[Root.GetName]，我们带来一个警告，以及一个挑战。

虽然掠夺周遭一切的感觉令人陶醉，但要想真正理解战争，你们也必须懂得和平。

花上十年时间好好思考你们已经获得的一切。相信我们：休息一下，否则你们会崩溃的。
excerpt.en:
Young [Root.GetName], we come with a warning, and a challenge.

While it can be intoxicating, grabbing all that is around you, to truly know War you must also know Peace.

Take a decade to reflect on what you have gained. Trust us: rest, or you will break.

excerpt.zh:
如果我们的文明要达到纯净，我们必须首先考虑[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的福祉。基因改造过程必须确保每一个适应性改变都能增强集体的韧性。

走错方向——引入导致不稳定或破坏凝聚力的改变——可能会是灾难性的，威胁到我们统一的根基。
excerpt.en:
If our civilization is to become pure, we must first consider the wellbeing of the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]. The genetic modification process must ensure that every adaptation enhances the collective's resilience.

Starting off on the wrong path - introdu

excerpt.zh:
生活在你们境内的[boring_species.GetName]物种简单到令人失望，他们的存在仿佛行尸走肉。这种迟钝的生物伤害了我们的集体意志。我们将提供三种不同的方法来纠正这种……失败。

不要让我们感到无聊。
excerpt.en: The [boring_species.GetName] species living within your borders has proven to be disappointingly simple, their existence a hollow echo of potential. Such stagnation offends our collective will. We will grant one of three different methods to rectify this... fa

excerpt.zh: 我们观察到，你们种族中的个别个体发展出了一种我们巨大的基因库中都没有的特殊特质。你要提供给我们的不只是分析报告。我们需要这种[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]的活体样品，不要惊慌。不需要一整格[interesting_species.GetName]。只要一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]就能培养一个替代品。
excerpt.en: We have observed that certain of your kind have developed a peculiar trait absent from our vast genetic repository. You will provide us with more than an analysis. We require a living sample of this [fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName].

excerpt.zh:
为了确保我们物种的长久性和纯净性，我们必须实施更有选择性的繁育和更严格的基因筛查协议。

只有通过仔细选择值得延续我们血统的工蜂，我们才能超越自然进化。
excerpt.en:
In order to ensure the longevity and purity of our species, we must implement more selective breeding and stricter genetic screening protocols.

Only by carefully selecting the drones worthy of carrying on our lineage, can we transcend beyond natural evolution

excerpt.zh:
基因修饰的回报将确保我们的传承，但每个[target.GetIndividualName]的角色、每分努力都必须与我们的纯净愿景保持一致。

我们现在面临一个重大抉择：是否要不惜牺牲适应能力来追求极致完美？还是应该采取更全面的策略，优先建设能够持续支撑这些努力的基础设施？
excerpt.en:
The rewards of genetic modification will secure our legacy, but every [target.GetIndividualName]'s role, every ounce of effort, must be aligned with our vision of purity.

We now face a critical decision: should we optimize for perfection at the cost of adapta

excerpt.zh:
我们希望你们的诸多缺陷不会妨碍你们理解此事的严重性。你们那优柔寡断的星海共同体提出了一项必须[GetPassFail]的议案。为了帮助你们构建论据，你们可以使用我们优越的知识。如果你们真的具备复杂思维能力的话，请务必注意。

失落帝国切断了与我们的通讯。
excerpt.en: We hope that your many faults don't stop you from understanding the gravity of this situation. Your dithering Galactic Community has proposed a resolution which must [GetPassFail]. To assist in crafting your arguments you may make use of our superior knowledge

excerpt.zh:
我们在[target.GetGestaltEntityName]内部发现了一些基因杂质和异常。

在我们追求更大目标的过程中，必须消除这些缺陷特征，从自然进化手中夺回对我们身体发展的控制权。
excerpt.en:
We have isolated a number of genetic impurities and anomalies within the [target.GetGestaltEntityName].

As we strive towards our larger goals, we must eliminate these defective traits and take back control of our physical development from natural evolution.

excerpt.zh:
总算开窍了。[FromFrom.GetName]星系的事就此揭过。看来你们还有救，或许有朝一日能达到我们的境界。

我们会一直盯着你们的。
excerpt.en:
It is good to see you learning from your past mistakes, finally. Consider the [FromFrom.GetName] system issue now resolved. There is hope yet that you may become more like us.

We will be watching.

excerpt.zh:
装疯卖傻？你们只需要放弃[offending_system.GetName]恒星系就够了。

也许我们应该更积极地收拾你们。
excerpt.en:
Are you being deliberately ignorant? All you needed to do was rid yourself of the [offending_system.GetName] system.

Perhaps we should take a more active role in pruning you.

excerpt.zh:
我们的克隆设施运转效率远超最初预期，导致现在出现了克隆体过剩的情况。

整合如此多的工蜂将是一个挑战。
excerpt.en:
Our cloning facilities are operating more efficiently than we initially expected, so we now have a clone surplus.

Integrating this many drones is proving challenging.

excerpt.zh:
为何要与自己过不去？在这星海的大合唱中，你们奏出的是如此刺耳的杂音。我们不过是想让你们与大局和谐。可你们却顽固地坚持着这不谐之音。

记住：我们的交响乐终将响彻星海，有没有你们都一样。
excerpt.en:
Why stand in your own way? In the galactic chorus, yours is a dissonant note. We wish only to bring you into harmony. Yet, you resist, clinging to your discord.

Know this: our symphony will echo through the galaxy, with or without you.

excerpt.zh:
我们的一处主要克隆中心发生故障影响到了一些工蜂。克隆过程不知为何遭受到基因污染，导致长出了一批没有思考能力的克隆体。

它们本质上就是活着的物体，完全没有知觉，没有更高的认知功能。在完全找出原因、修正了这个生产问题之前，克隆设施的产出率暂时下降了。
excerpt.en:
Several drones have been affected following a malfunction at one of our primary Cloning centers. Genetic contaminants somehow entered the duplication process, leading to a batch of clones being grown without the capacity for thought.

They were essentially bio

excerpt.zh:
我们的意识内部浮现出了一个疑问：会不会有一天克隆体把我们都取代掉了？

我们在基因复制方面的初步努力进展顺利，使我们不禁好奇起这种高效的繁殖方法是否最终会取代我们的自然繁殖。

如果是这样，那么可能有一天蜂巢里再也没有原生子个体，只有克隆的克隆的克隆……这对我们这个物种究竟意味着什么呢？这个问题没有人知道答案，也让异常见蠢蠢欲动，但我们不得不问。
excerpt.en:
From within the consciousness, a question emerges: will clones one day replace us all?

Our initial efforts into genetic duplication are going well, so much so that we are curious if this efficient method of reproduction could eventually overtake our natural p

excerpt.zh:
我们有了一项发现。通过操控特定基因，我们可以扩展意识的触及范围，使我们的感知能力超越物种原有的极限。

要在整个蜂巢范围内实施这些基因突变需要消耗大量能量，但这样做可能会加深我们对宇宙的理解，以及我们在其中所处位置的认知。
excerpt.en:
We have made a discovery. By manipulating specific genes, we can expand the reach of our consciousness to give us heightened senses beyond what we once thought of as the limits of our species.

Implementing these mutations hive-wide will require a great deal o

excerpt.zh:
蜂巢的多个区域正在经历无法控制的愤怒浪潮，这股情绪波动在共享意识中激起涟漪，放大了我们集体的痛苦与挫折。

最近引入的突变似乎过度刺激了工蜂攻击控制中枢的神经细胞，打破了蜂巢的情绪平衡。冲突事件愈发频繁，一些子个体甚至抛弃了原有任务，开始攻击其他同类。
excerpt.en:
Whole sections of the hive are experiencing surges of uncontrolled anger, a surge of emotion that has sent ripples through the shared consciousness, amplifying our collective pain and frustration.

A recently introduced mutation appears to be overstimulating n

excerpt.zh:
虽然某些突变确实让我们更强大和强化了我们，但我们发现其他突变却带来了不愉快的副作用。

虽然旨在延长寿命的强化已经成功实施，但这些相同的突变却降低了我们对极端气候的耐受性。

那些经历了这些生物强化的个体在调节体内温度系统时遇到了困难，这种不适感传遍了整个蜂巢。
excerpt.en:
While some mutations galvanize and enhance us, we are finding that others come with unpleasant side effects.

Enhancements aimed to increase our longevity are being implemented successfully, however these same mutations are lowering our tolerance for extreme c

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了两种突变。一种变异能够增强基层子个体的力量，大幅提高劳动效率。另一种则能提升复杂型工蜂的智力，增强解决问题和战略思维的能力。

蜂巢必须决定选择哪条进化道路。
excerpt.en:
A pair of mutations has been identified. One variant enhances menial drones' strength, greatly improving labor efficiency. The other sharpens complex drones' intellect, boosting problem-solving and strategy.

The hive must decide which path to embrace.

excerpt.zh:
我们差点没控制住基因瘟疫的突然爆发。

我们对自己的生物学操控引发了基因突变，导致许多[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的身体受到损害。

受影响的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已被隔离，现在必须决定如何继续前进。
excerpt.en:
We have barely contained the sudden outbreak of a genetic plague.

Manipulating our own biology has triggered rogue mutations in our DNA, leading to many [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] becoming physically compromised.

Affected [target.GetIndividualNamePlura

excerpt.zh:
我们的一个计算失误导致大量工蜂的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。

在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。

然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。
excerpt.en:
A misstep in our calculations has led to the degradation of genetic integrity in a substantial amount of our drones. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.

Having reviewed the biological calculations involved

excerpt.zh: 由于我们对基因纯净的侧重，得到增益的公民们开始认为自己天生就比其他人优越。由于这种优越感，他们要求更短的工作时间、更多的便利设施和更多的政治权力。他们日益激烈的集会正在造成严重的社会混乱。
excerpt.en: As a result of our focus on genetic purification, augmented citizens have begun to view themselves as inherently superior to the rest of the population. They demand shorter work days, more amenities, and stronger political power due to their perceived superior

excerpt.zh:
新闻公报上充斥着分裂言论，分歧正在撕裂社会。得到改良基因的人获得了更多的机会，由此催生了一种新的阶级斗争。

基因增强者相信他们代表了我们物种的未来，而传统主义者则认为我们在非自然领域走得太远了。
excerpt.en:
Divisive rhetoric dominates news bulletins, and disagreements are tearing social units apart. A new kind of class struggle is emerging, as more opportunities fall to those with modified genes.

The genetically enhanced believe they represent the future of our

excerpt.zh:
在某些行业，纯度检测滥用愈发司空见惯。那些被认为拥有优越基因组成的人在工作、教育方面将受到优待，并被盲目地授予更容易获得权力的职位。

虽然一些人认为，生物增强的个体确实更强壮、更健康，但另一些人则认为，这种心态对那些不愿或无法改变基因组以追求基因完美的人造成了不当的歧视。
excerpt.en:
Arbitrary purity tests are becoming commonplace in some industries. Those deemed to have superior genetic makeup are receiving preferential treatment in work, education, and blindly granted easier access to positions of power.

While some argue that individual

excerpt.zh:
一位因其不知疲倦的工作态度而在全星系备受赞誉的杰出领袖，被揭露其实不是一个人，而是两个人。

事实表明，这位领袖获得了一个完美克隆体，让两人能够轮班工作。当一个克隆体在执行公务和处理行政事务时，另一个则在秘密休息和恢复。

这一揭露在政治领域掀起了轩然大波，引发了人们对领导力本质和克隆技术伦理界限的质疑。
excerpt.en:
A prominent leader, celebrated galaxy-wide for their tireless work ethic, has been revealed to be not one, but two individuals.

It has come to light that this leader obtained a perfect clone, allowing each to work in alternating shifts. While one clone engage

excerpt.zh:
委托制造克隆体用于器官摘取的做法已经引发了问题。一些明显具有感知能力的克隆体，正在通过长期绝食的方式进行反抗。

虽然许多人认为原体的健康和长寿应当优先考虑，但也有人主张每个具有思维能力的存在都应当拥有个人自主权。这个有争议的问题现已成为激烈辩论的焦点。
excerpt.en:
The practice of commissioning clones for organ harvesting is already leading to complications. Several clones, obviously possessing sentience, are rebelling by means of a protracted hunger strike.

While many argue that the health and longevity of an original

excerpt.zh:
执法部门陷入了两难境地。我们首都的犯罪率正在上升，但被绳之以法的人却比以往任何时候都少。嫌疑人越来越多地以其克隆体犯案为由进行辩护。

一旦没有人赃并获，就几乎不可能证明嫌犯的罪行。一些司法人员现在呼吁废除大多数非法行为的罪名。
excerpt.en:
Law enforcement is in a quandary. Crime in our capital is on the rise, yet fewer people than ever are facing justice. Suspected criminals are increasingly pleading not guilty, claiming their clones committed the offenses.

In cases where suspects are not caugh

excerpt.zh: 卑鄙的[From.GetName]渗透了我们的帝国。我们的空间站叛变，而他们已经在入侵我们的殖民地了。我们必须消灭冒名顶替者！
excerpt.en: The insidious [From.GetName] have infiltrated our empire. Our space stations are compromised and they are already invading our colonies. We must eliminate the imposters!

excerpt.zh:
许多具有显著或非常规基因变异的个体已被社会排斥。被迫转入地下的这些变种人已经形成了他们自己的聚居地。

那些冒险进入这些区域的人很少能够回来。
excerpt.en:
Many individuals with prominent or unconventional genetic mutations have been ostracized from society. Forced underground, these mutants have formed their own enclaves.

Those who venture into these areas seldom return.

excerpt.zh:
失意的年轻人开始以极端娱乐的方式剧烈改变自己的外貌。

最新的潮流包括对复眼的狂热追求，以及比拼在一个身体上能够添加多少额外肢体，目前的记录是156个。

这些生物黑客已经引起了公众关注，引发了安全方面的担忧。随着对基因变异进行严格限制的呼声日益高涨，我们必须确定官方立场。
excerpt.en:
Disenfranchised youths have begun drastically altering their appearances as a form of extreme amusement.

The latest trends include a mania for compound eyes, and competitions to see how many additional limbs are possible on a single body, with the current rec

title.zh: 行商舰队：范格利集团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Vengralian Trium: Last Call

excerpt.zh: 你真的打算就这么让一生只会出现一次的机会白白溜走吗？
excerpt.en: Are you ready to seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, before it's gone forever?

title.zh: 行商舰队：拜金教团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Numistic Order: Last Call

excerpt.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
excerpt.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise: Last Call

excerpt.zh:
我们还有矿石，丰富、闪闪发光的矿石。将夜晚照亮的矿石！专门为[Root.GetName]准备的闪亮矿石。

但我们很饿，我们很渴！请给我们[Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1]，我们将用[Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1]协助你的工人。
excerpt.en:
We have ore. Rich, luminous ore. Torn right from the stone! Sparkling minerals for the [Root.GetName].

But we hunger. We thirst! Grant us [Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1], and we shall supply your builders, your makers with [Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1].

excerpt.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
excerpt.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mer

excerpt.zh: [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName]传来一条紧急消息，上面说有一批[caravan_pops_join_country.GetName]的原成员目前正打算在这颗星球上寻求政治庇护。当地管理部门决定上报这一情况，让更高阶的官员定夺。
excerpt.en: An urgent missive from [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName] explains that a number of now-former members of the [caravan_pops_join_country.GetName] seek political asylum on the planet. The local administration has seen fit to pass the decision of what to do with

excerpt.zh: 今天在[disgruntled_planet.GetName]爆发了大规模抗议，由于这个星系中[xeno_fleet.GetName]的种种暴行。他们肮脏的存在侵犯到了所有有正义感的[disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
excerpt.en: Mass protests erupted on [disgruntled_planet.GetName] today, due to outrage over the [xeno_fleet.GetName] in the system. Their grubby presence offends all right-thinking [disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural].

excerpt.zh: 近期[stealing_fleet.GetName]参观[stolen_from_planet.GetName]之后，人们发现有一部分资源居然莫名其妙消失了。人们怀疑是被[stealing_fleet.GetName]给顺手牵羊了。
excerpt.en: After a recent visit of the [stealing_fleet.GetName] to [stolen_from_planet.GetName] it has been noticed that a number of resources are missing from the central reserve. It is suspected that the [stealing_fleet.GetName] somehow made off with them.

excerpt.zh: [From.From.GetName]认输了，无上的银河之星已经易居我手！
excerpt.en: The [From.From.GetName] has admitted defeat, and we have wrested the glorious Galatron from their unworthy grasp!

excerpt.zh: 无视败者的癫狂咆哮，[From.GetAdj]军队接管银河之星的仪式不过平淡无奇。
excerpt.en: Aside from numerous functionaries breaking down into hysterics during the handover, the surrendering of the Galatron to [From.GetAdj] forces was an uneventful affair.

excerpt.zh: 生活与其说是一场竞赛，不如说是碰运气。
excerpt.en: Life is more of a lottery than a competition.

excerpt.zh: 因为[Root.GetName]的转化进程中断，导致[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的气候极其不稳定。强烈风暴常常毫无预兆的出现。最近风暴袭击了一个大型殖民地，造成数人死亡，财物损失重大。
excerpt.en: In large part due to the interrupted terraforming process on [Root.GetName], the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] has a somewhat unstable climate. Violent storms that our climate models can't predict often materialize without warning. One such storm recently swept over a

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]不稳定的气候导致[Root.GetPlanetMoon]发生旱灾，粮食欠收。住在此地的殖民者向[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]要求经济援助以改善生活状况。
excerpt.en: The unstable climate on [Root.GetName] has resulted in a severe drought that affects a significant portion of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Colonists living in those regions have asked [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] for financial aid to improve living conditions.

excerpt.zh: 我们击败了袭击[From.From.GetName]殖民地的怪物大军。它们腐烂的尸体堆积在防御工事前，安保部队正在尽快挖坑填埋。某些遗传物质引起了科学家的注意，这些样本应该能加快生物学方面的研究。
excerpt.en: We have fought off the mass of creatures that attacked our settlements on [From.From.GetName]. Their rotting corpses now litter the ground in front of our fortifications, and our security forces are currently in the process of bulldozing the putrid bio-mass in

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.From.GetName]的主力部队因变异怪物的猛攻而被消灭殆尽！恶毒的怪物在殖民地里横行霸道，随意消灭殖民者。有报告指出部分幸存者不得不逃往野外以求生存，但即使这样他们也迟早会被找到。
excerpt.en: Our main forces on [From.From.GetName] have been decimated by the onslaught of the mutated creatures! The vile beasts are now roaming free across the entire colony, butchering our colonists with impunity. There are reports of survivors having fled the settleme

excerpt.zh: 远征队已解放[From.From.GetName]，消灭了盘踞在主要殖民地的变异怪物。它们腐烂的尸体四处散落，军团正在尽快挖坑填埋。[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]四处都有小股幸存者现身，但总体来说殖民者死伤无数。
excerpt.en: Our expeditionary forces have liberated [From.From.GetName] from the mutated horrors that were occupying our main settlements. Their rotting corpses are now littering the ground, and our troops are currently in the process of bulldozing the putrid bio-mass int

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.From.GetName]的主力部队因变异怪物的猛攻而被消灭殆尽！恶毒的怪物在殖民地里横行霸道，随意消灭殖民者。有报告指出部分幸存者不得不逃往野外以求生存，但即使这样他们也迟早会被找到。
excerpt.en: Our main forces on [From.From.GetName] have been decimated by the onslaught of the mutated creatures! The vile beasts are now roaming free across the entire colony, butchering our colonists with impunity. There are reports of survivors having fled the settleme

excerpt.zh: 远征队已解放[From.From.GetName]，消灭了盘踞在主要殖民地的变异怪物。它们腐烂的尸体四处散落，军团正在尽快挖坑填埋。[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]四处都有小股幸存者现身，但总体来说殖民者死伤无数。
excerpt.en: Our expeditionary forces have liberated [From.From.GetName] from the mutated horrors that were occupying our main settlements. Their rotting corpses are now littering the ground, and our troops are currently in the process of bulldozing the putrid bio-mass int

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一具庞大的残骸，看上去似乎是一台粒子加速器。它位于一个充满辐射的巨大弹坑中，这意味着这台加速器是[Root.GetPlanetMoon]核战中非常重要的战略目标之一。

我们找到了一些负责这台加速器的科学家所写的日志，尽管这项科技的开发很不完善，但是其中不少研究和公式哪怕对我们的科技标准来说都算是闻所未闻的先进知识，我们的物理学家已经在研究这些数据了。
excerpt.en: We have discovered what appears to be the remains of a massive particle accelerator on [Root.GetName]. It was found in a still-radioactive region covered in massive bomb craters, suggesting the accelerator was considered a strategic target of great importance

excerpt.zh:
在[Root.GetName]的一场庞大的使用核武的战争中幸存的这些基础设施被证实对我们的殖民者有着极大的好处。曾经在这里居住的外星文明所建造的那些用来连接他们主要居住站的公路，其中一些在今天仍然状态良好足以为我们所用。

我们还能从散布在地表的废墟中回收大量的建筑材料，从而进一步完善我们殖民地的基础设施。
excerpt.en: Infrastructure that survived the great nuclear war which ruined [Root.GetName] have proved a great boon to our colonists. The alien civilization that once lived here built highways connecting their major population centers, and some of them are still in good e

excerpt.zh:
近日，一个从[Root.GetName]出发的殖民者小队登上了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上一个由原住民留在轨道上的原始空间站。在面向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的窗口周围，我们发现了许多这个空间站工作人员的干尸。他们意识到在看到下方星球那些翻腾的蘑菇云后他们的命运已经注定了。通过通讯记录表明，这些宇航员一次次徒劳尝试着与地表进行联络，可惜的是他们却在日渐疯狂的尝试中耗尽了他们的补给。

这个空间站目前状况良好，它给我们的工程师展现了一个在行星早期文明中难得一见的空间站计划。工程师从这个空间
excerpt.en: A small team from our colony on [Root.GetName] recently boarded a primitive space station that had been left in orbit by the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants. The mummified remains of the station's crew could still be found clustered around viewport

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的一些废土区域散发的辐射量要高于我们之前的探测值，一些当地的殖民者都在不同程度上出现了健康状况差、生育率低等现象。现在我们正在逐步从受影响区域疏散人群，但是这么做是需要一定时间的。
excerpt.en: The radiation levels in some wasteland regions of [Root.GetName] appear to be greater than our previous scans had indicated. Colonists in several local settlements have complained of poor health, and birth rates are down. We are taking steps to evacuate the af

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的废土中发现的破败的遗迹似乎从某种程度上影响了在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的殖民者，使他们慢慢向和平主义者靠拢。这次新行动的人员声称他们的生存意义就是为了给后世的人敲响警钟，让他们记住战争的可怕，他们认为必须阻止发生在[Root.GetName]上的事情在其他世界重演。
excerpt.en:
The decrepit ruins and desolate wastelands found on [Root.GetName] seem to have prompted many of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s colonists to adopt some kind of pacifistic philosophy.

Members of this new movement claim that the environment they live in serve as a

excerpt.zh: 向[Root.GetName]飞来的小行星已经被摧毁了！[Root.GetPlanetMoon]九死一生的平民们都在街上庆祝。扫描后发现小行星的残骸中蕴含着许多有价值的矿产，我们已经尽我们所能回收了许多矿产。
excerpt.en:
The asteroid that was approaching [Root.GetName] on a collision course has been destroyed! With their doom averted, our jubilant citizens on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have taken to the streets in celebration.

A scan of the remaining fragments has also revealed

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]本地的政府失误导致一小群叛军收获了更多支持者，他们反对我们的传统思潮。支持他们的人越来越多，这让他们在该区域获得了更大的权利。这样的支持同时也让他们在获得民众支持上取得了一定成功，他们可以利用这些支持来发展自己的事业。
excerpt.en: Local political drama on [Root.GetName] has resulted in increased support among a small group of rebels, opposed to our underlying ethics. Their increased support have enabled them to gain more power in the region and vote for their own causes with limited suc

excerpt.zh:
一队调查小组在[Root.GetName]上发现了隐藏的工厂。根据建筑构架和磨损程度判断，它源自一个古老文明，这个文明十分擅长建造经得起时间考验的建筑。

我们可以轻松使用这个工厂，增加殖民地的产出。
excerpt.en:
A group of investigators have found a hidden factory on [Root.GetName]. The building and its state of decay tells of an old civilization, one that excelled at constructing things that stood the test of time.

Our population would easily be able to use the faci

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上古怪工厂工作的员工突然消失了！我们可以派遣工人替补，或者以防万一，直接将工厂夷为平地。
excerpt.en: The crew we assigned to work the odd factory on [Root.GetName] has disappeared! We could send a new workforce to take their place, or we could raze the facility to the ground, making sure that this will not happen again.

excerpt.zh:
到那个古怪工厂工作后，第二队工人也失踪了！所幸，其中一个工人留下了记录。记录显示那里有不少的陷阱，这些陷阱专门用来抓捕毫无防备的工人。

陷阱已经移除，现在应该可以正常使用工厂了。但不论如何解释，民众仍对潜在的致命陷阱忧心忡忡。
excerpt.en:
A second group of individuals has gone missing after working at the odd factory! Fortunately one of the workers was able to leave a recording behind, revealing that there are traps capturing unsuspecting workers.

The traps have been disabled and we should be

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的古怪工厂并未出现任何异常。殖民地将维持预计的产出。
excerpt.en: No reports of any problems have been issued from the odd factory on [Root.GetName]. It seems like the colony will maintain the projected production estimates.

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，混居在我们其中的异星人开始惹是生非了。这引起了我们民众的众怒，每天都有越来越多的争斗彰显。如果坐视不理，那些异星人估计会损失惨重。
excerpt.en: The xenos living among us have begun to cause friction on [Root.GetName]. Our own people are furious, resulting in more and more fights breaking out each day. If we idly stand by the xenos might end up losing more than some bodily fluids.

excerpt.zh: 由于重大的记录错误，[Root.GetName]部分区域的基础设施维护与住宅服务已趋于落后。人们正居住在较为恶劣的环境之中，似乎已忍不了太久了。要修复这些问题则会耗费我们的时间与精力。
excerpt.en: Due to a major clerical error parts of [Root.GetName] has fallen behind in infrastructure maintenance and accommodation services. The people live in rather bleak conditions and will not tolerate it for long. Remedying these problems will cost us time and effor

excerpt.zh:
[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士从传送门中带来的恐怖大军击溃了我们的防御，征服了[fromfrom.GetName]！

被强大的异次元实体夺舍后，[doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself]自号为[doomslayer_knight.GetTitle][doomslayer_knight.GetName]，[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]为[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]召唤了一支恶魔军队，并开始征服我们的星
excerpt.en:
The horrors that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] led through the portal have breached our defenses and conquered [fromfrom.GetName]!

Possessed by a major dimensional being and now titling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself] as [doomslayer_knight.GetTitle

excerpt.zh: 因[From.From.GetName]肆虐的植物，我们损失了许多殖民点和殖民者，但我们没有坐以待毙，而是将其斩草除根。部队配备有火焰喷射器，以确保不会有任何植株幸存。
excerpt.en: Many settlements and lives were lost to the rampaging trees on [From.From.GetName], but we managed to push them back and exterminate the last of their kind. Squads equipped with flamethrowers are making absolutely certain that no trees are overlooked this time

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的穴居外星人聚集了大量军团，准备再次入侵地表！它们疯狂的军团又在挖掘隧道了。
excerpt.en: The subterranean aliens on [Root.GetName] have marshaled enough forces in their underground empire to launch another invasion of the surface! Once again their frenzied armies are pouring out of freshly dug tunnels to challenge us.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]传来噩耗！同我们一直作战的[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人不知怎得，成功将隧道入口附近的一片平地弄塌方了，上面驻扎着一整支我们的军队。

零星幸存的士兵很快就被外星人屠杀了，他们甚至没能同我们军队的其他部分汇合。
excerpt.en:
Grave news from [Root.GetName]! The [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens we have been fighting there somehow managed to collapse the ground under an entire army that was stationed near one of their tunnel entrances.

The few soldiers that survived the fall we

excerpt.zh: 栖居于[Root.GetName]殖民地地下的外星人在夜间派出了数组突袭部队。它们摧毁了殖民地的一处主要设施，并在安保部队做出回应前就逃回了地下。
excerpt.en: The aliens living below our colony on [Root.GetName] have been sending out small raiding parties from their tunnels at night. Their attacks have destroyed one of the colony's major installations, and before our forces could respond the raiders had vanished und

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上又遭受了一次攻击！[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人在我们的一个主要聚居地正中央挖了一条新隧道，从里面冲了出来。它们相对于当地的防御部队呈压倒性优势，并肆无忌惮地屠杀我们的殖民者。零星的几个不断尖叫地幸存者被外星人拽入地底，随着它们撤退被一起带走。
excerpt.en: There has been another attack on [Root.GetName]! The [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens emerged from new tunnels in the middle of one of our major settlements. They overwhelmed the local defenses and butchered our colonists. A few screaming survivors were d

excerpt.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的部队仍然在测绘殖民地下面的隧道网络图。他们找到了一个属于[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人的大型城市，在我们打算往里面灌注神经气体之前，我们发现这个城市试图将自己同地下帝国的其他部分隔离开来。这个城市里有几百万心惊胆战的外星人。我们的工程师应该完成工作，让这个洞穴塌方吗？
excerpt.en: Our forces on [Root.GetName] are still mapping the tunnel network below our colony. They have come upon a large city belonging to the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens that managed to isolate itself from the rest of their underground empire before we flood

excerpt.zh: 我们清理了[Root.GetName]隧道里的神经毒气和外星人尸骸。殖民者可以安全入住。外星人遗留的建筑将被拆毁，那里取而代之的将会是我们的先进建筑物。
excerpt.en: We have finished clearing out the nerve gas and the dead alien bodies from the tunnel network on [Root.GetName]. It should now be safe for our colonists to move in. The primitive cities the aliens left behind will be demolished, of course, and replaced with ou

excerpt.zh: 勘探者们正冒险进入更加深处的隧道，这些隧道曾一度属于那已经灭亡的[Root.GetName]地底外星人帝国。他们终于找到了传言许久的金矿，据信地下外星人帝国从这获得了大量的贵金属储备。
excerpt.en: Prospectors have ventured into some of the deeper tunnels that once belonged to the now dead subterranean aliens on [Root.GetName]. They have finally discovered the long-rumored gold mines where it was believed the underground alien empire acquired its large r

excerpt.zh:
侦察队在探索[Root.GetName]地下洞穴的时候发现了一处皇家宫殿，此地曾是外星帝国的首都。领袖的尸体依然端坐在大殿的宝座之上。

侦察队炸开宝库大门后，发现里面满是金子和外星艺术品。艺术品会被运回[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的博物馆，而这些金子能改善我们的财务状况。
excerpt.en:
Scout units exploring the tunnel network on [Root.GetName] have entered the royal palace in what was once the capital city of the underground alien empire. The corpse of what passed for their emperor is still perched on a massive throne in the main chamber.

A

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]最近又遭受了一波地震。看上去是，由于[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人没有进行维护，地下隧道网络的某些深层部分发生了塌方。我们的许多居民都遭受了损失。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] has been racked by another wave of earthquakes recently. It seems that some of the deeper parts of the underground tunnel network has collapsed without the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens to maintain it. Many of our settlements have suffer

excerpt.zh: 我们接见了[Root.GetName]上的一名[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人代表。看上去他们的帝国最近遇到了困难时期，而且它们正在受到饥馑的威胁。它们恳求我们提供一切可以提供的援助。
excerpt.en: We have been approached by a delegation from the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens on [Root.GetName]. It seems their empire has fallen on hard times recently, and they are facing the threat of a famine. They are pleading with us to provide whatever assista

excerpt.zh: 作为庆祝两个文明之间友谊的礼物，[Root.GetName]上的地底外星人派出了一支商队，携带了大量的宝石来到地表。像这样的石头很明显是它们帝国前往尽可能靠近[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地核的深处，才能挖掘到的。
excerpt.en: As a gift to celebrate the friendship between our two civilizations, a caravan from the subterranean aliens on [Root.GetName] has brought a large quantity of gemstones to the surface. Stones such as these are apparently mined by their empire deep underground,

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上出现了一大群来自地下外星人帝国的难民，它们从隧道中蜂拥而出来到地表，背后有一支小规模军队在追击。显然它们是某个宗教少数派的一部分；它们宣称自己是在逃避迫害。

如果我们让它们加入位于地表的殖民者团体，毫无疑问这会惹恼追捕它们的地下帝国统治者。然而，如果我们任凭追击军队将它们重新带回地下，这些人肯定会面临处决。
excerpt.en:
A large group of refugees from the underground alien empire on [Root.GetName] recently streamed out of their tunnels onto the surface, chased by a small army. They are apparently part of some sort of religious minority; they claim to be fleeing persecution.

I

excerpt.zh: 来自[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的几位异星学家，在花费了一大段时间同这个星球的[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星原住民同吃同住后，返回了[Root.GetName]的地表。他们学习了许多有关这个物种的古道和风俗的知识，这些毫无意外会对我们的社会学研究带来益处。
excerpt.en: Several xeno anthropologists from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] have returned to the surface of [Root.GetName] after spending a great deal of time living among the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens native to that world. They have learned much about their an

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]最近又遭受了一波地震，我们的好几个聚居点都发生了建筑倒塌，并且出现了重大伤亡。[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人帝国正在地下深处发掘一个新的地穴，并计划在这里建造一个新的城市，显然这一举动就是地震的源头。
excerpt.en: There has been a wave of earthquakes on [Root.GetName] recently, and buildings in several of our settlements have collapsed with many fatalities as a result. The [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] alien empire is excavating a new cavern deep underground where they

excerpt.zh:
在见识过我们的安保部队装备的先进武器后，[Root.GetName]上的几位[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人帝国的将军求见我们，希望我们分享一些军用科技。

我们的军官在犹豫是否应该同意，因为同以前相比，这么做之后会让我们更难在战场上击败这些外星人。然而，如果我们拒绝，这些外星人会将其视作一次羞辱。
excerpt.en:
