Our efforts have paid off, and we can now interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]:

"Ah, the fine art of flattery. It is nice indeed to meet another species that appreciates

excerpt.zh: 我们的传感器检测到[This.ContactCountry.GetName]正在发送不断重复的清晰信号，似乎为我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]编码他们语言的工作提供了绝佳的材料。有了这份天降的幸事，语言学家们心态十分乐观，坚信很快就能有重大的进展。
excerpt.en: Our sensors have detected a particularly clear repeating signal from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] that seems to offer our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] excellent material for codifying their language. They are optimistic that we will be able to make some sign

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]日渐沮丧，因为我们没能提供给他们充分的材料用于解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]使用的语言，他们的进度十分有限。似乎这些外星人正使出浑身解数，防止不怀好意的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]窃听到他们的信号！
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are becoming increasingly frustrated at our failure to provide them with sufficient material to make progress on decoding the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. It seems these particular aliens are doing their utm

excerpt.zh: 似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在翻译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用的语言时遇到了重大挫折。不幸的是，他们认为的语言根本就不是一种语言。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的报告中指出，在几天内他们从多个角度的探讨，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最终得到结论，这可能只是种试作音乐……
excerpt.en: It seems our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have suffered a major setback in their attempts at codifying the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Unfortunately, what they had taken to be their language quite simply was not a language. In [This.Leader

excerpt.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们对该行为出现了不同意见的分歧：我们是应该把这次冲击视为与外星文明建立更紧密的联系的跳板，或者是被认为一种警告，我们必须确保舰队准备万全，以免为时已晚。
excerpt.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Opinion is divided on whether we should treat this shock as a spr

excerpt.zh: 我们已经辨识出了先前我们在[This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName]恒星系扫描的殖民地其实是[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的首都。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]通过调查从扫描中获取的资料发现许多关于他们的有价值的线索。
excerpt.en: We have identified the colony we recently scanned in the [This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName] system to be the capital of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have found many valuable clues about them by investigating the

excerpt.zh: 我们现在已经有一段时间没有获取到来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的视听资料了。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]发现他们似乎没有什么新的信息值得获取，并担心这条路似乎行不通了。
excerpt.en: We have caught neither sight nor sound of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for some time now. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] find they have little information to go on and worry that the trail may have gone cold.

excerpt.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。他们的外表令[This.Owner.GetAdj]的公众感到兴奋，大家已经迫不及待想要和这些外星人进一步接触了。
excerpt.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has proven delightful to the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public,

excerpt.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass]”威胁……
excerpt.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has provoked widespread dismay amongst our populace, who

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经在大量收集来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号取得了稳步的进展。然而，随着我们对他们语言的知识储备越来越丰富，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]却越来越感到迷惑。很明显他们不得不对先前工作的翻译进行数次重新评估，因为他们发现先前认定文字的含义事实上极度不准确。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的整体面貌和我们极度相异——比我们能够想象的差的更多！
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have been making steady progress gathering together a large collection of signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, as our knowledge of their language has grown, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have become ever more

excerpt.zh: 随着我们收集到更多有关[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的资料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们对于整个星系具有大量相同的看法。
excerpt.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

excerpt.zh: 我们对来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的语言解析工作遇到了挫折。似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]对翻译中的关键假设已经被证伪。尽管这意味着我们许多的进展不得不被推倒重来，但至少我们未来的努力很可能会被建立在更可靠的基础之上。
excerpt.en: Our attempts to decode the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]  have hit a setback. It seems that a key assumption our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] had been relying on in their translations has been conclusively disproven. While th

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最近在解析来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号所用的语言取得了明显的进展。很明显他们现在坚信自己已经对该语言的基础有了坚实的把控，并且承诺他们能够很快报道进一步的发现。
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have recently made significant progress towards decoding the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Apparently they now believe themselves to have a solid grasp of its fundamentals and promise that th

excerpt.zh: 我们历经艰辛以在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]足够的信息从而让我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]推进进程，但是现在我们的努力终于获得了一个极大的推动：我们的传感器收集到了他们数艘船只之间颇具长度的交流。我们只能猜测是他们的戒备突然松懈了一下，或者是他们的科技并没有我们怀疑的那么先进，他们只是自己觉得通信通道是安全的……
excerpt.en: We had struggled to gather enough information on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to have much to go, but now our efforts have received a major boost: our sensors have picked up a lengthy exchange between several of their shi

excerpt.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言看似包含了数百万看似冗余的音节，似乎仅仅只是他们古代语言残留下来约定俗成的东西。在翻译的时候，这些不必要的填充性词汇唯一的作用看起来只是用来补充语法的完整性，或者最多有一些微不足道的上下文提示作用。

幸好，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经缩减了他们语言中这些过时的部分，制定出了简化版辞典，这样一来我们就能与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进行高效的沟通。
excerpt.en: The language of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] contains millions of seemingly redundant sounds, apparently dialectic hangovers from their precursor civilizations. When translated, these apparently superfluous filler words seem to serve no purpose other than

excerpt.zh: [Leader.GetName]返回报告说，没有来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的人接见[Leader.GetHimHer]。
excerpt.en: [Leader.GetName] returned to report that no one from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] met [Leader.GetHimHer].

excerpt.zh: 单方面的沟通让外交团队遭受巨大的挫折。他们渴望成功的第一次接触，为此他们在没有任何事实基础的情况下，制定了分支预测策略来指导剩余的接触流程。
excerpt.en: The one-sided communication greatly frustrated the diplomatic team. Eager for a successful first contact, they created branching prediction strategies for the remaining procedure without any factual information to inform the approach.

excerpt.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]返回了！尽管伤痕累累，但却载誉而归。

从一个隐藏的门中，一名外星战士突然现身并开始同我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]展开搏斗，直到筋疲力尽。在最后一丝力量的召唤下，[Leader.GetName]设法制服了[Leader.GetHisHer]的对手。

不到一个小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发送了一条信息：

“[Leader.GetName]将被记录在我们的史册中，作为一位伟大的战
excerpt.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle injured, but victorious.

From a hidden door, an alien fighter emerged and proceeded to batter our [Owner.GetEnvoy] to the point of exhaustion. Summoning a last surge of strength, [Leader

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了来源不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循着某种重复的句法，证明其来源应为智慧生物。我们应进一步研究它。它们似乎集中在一个空间站附近，但尚不清楚这个空间站是不是一个更大的太空文明的一部分。
excerpt.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single space station, though it is unclear whet

excerpt.zh: 长程扫描仪获取了[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的数据，对其的解析几乎说明它是一个巨大热源。这非常值得研究。
excerpt.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的舰队与我们此前在此区域见到的任何东西都不一样。它没有表现出攻击性，但我们眼下只能猜测它的起源或目的。我们最有把握的猜测是，该舰队代表的派别与任何地方当局或文明都没有正式联系。
excerpt.en: The fleet we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system is unlike any we've seen in this region of space before. It does not appear to be aggressive, but we can only speculate as to its origin or purpose here. Our best guess is that the fleet represents a

excerpt.zh:
我们与这支自称是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的舰队陷入了僵局。这个不寻常的来客对我们大部分的外交姿态置之不理，但我们可以推断它代表一个独立于星系文明的中立实体。

我们推测，若舰队有传统意义上的所有者，则需要采取非常措施才能接近他们。考虑到这一点，我们总结了目前的发现，供未来的[this.owner.GetScientistPlural]团队使用（如有必要）。
excerpt.en: We have reached an impasse with the fleet identifying itself as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. This unusual presence ignored most of our diplomatic overtures, but we can infer that it represents a neutral entity which stands apart from galactic civiliz

excerpt.zh:
当我们进入[This.System.GetName]时，传感器获取了一个奇怪的数据。一开始把它们当成发光的小行星而忽视了，但后来当发现它们会对太空中的移动物体哪怕距离很远都会做出一定的进攻性反应，事情就变得有趣了起来。

建议最好从安全的距离上观察这些东西。
excerpt.en:
Upon entering [This.System.GetName] our sensors picked up strange readings. Dismissed at first as glorified asteroids, things quickly changed when it was discovered that these entities reacted aggressively to movement in space - even at great distance!

Observ

excerpt.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体看起来一定程度上由晶态物质组成。有趣的是，它们可以在虚空中推进，并能在必要的时候保护自己，说明他们应该是具有生命的。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在做进一步的调查。
excerpt.en: The irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appears to be made of some sort of crystalline material. Curiously, it seems to be able to propel itself across the void and protect itself when necessary, indicating that it may be alive. Our

excerpt.zh:
我们在[This.System.GetName]发现了一种新的生命形式，虽然称之为“生命”可能不太准确。这些实体看起来完全是一种完全出于未知的工业用途的全自动无人机器人。

我们会继续观察，但由于这些机器有自我保护的编码，所以最好谨慎行事。
excerpt.en:
We have discovered a new lifeform in [This.System.GetName], although calling it a "lifeform" may be incorrect. The entities appear to be fully automated, mechanical drones built exclusively for some unknown industrial purpose.

Observations will continue, but

excerpt.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的独立空间站建立了通讯。
excerpt.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the independent space station of the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

excerpt.zh:
尽管他们生活在居住站上的事实暗示了他们很可能是一个先进的社会，然而[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]不能肯定我们是不是真的在和一种智慧生命形式打交道：他们似乎无时不刻在展现敌意，这对于一个稳定的社会而言是不可想象的：即便在我们短暂的调查期间也展现了数次纯粹的野蛮行为。

他们看起来具有语言，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]仍在努力解析当中，以便我们在未来能够理解他们的行为。
excerpt.en: Although their dwellings on habitat stations would suggest an advanced society, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] is unsure whether we are indeed dealing with an intelligent lifeform: they seem unremittingly hostile, so much so that a stable society

excerpt.zh: 我们完成了对他们使用语言的破译，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]将[encountered_marauder.GetName]识别为一种游牧文明，称为[encountered_marauder.GetRealName]。他们在[marauder_system.GetName]恒星系附近占据了数个大型空间站，其大量的人口都居住在拥挤而肮脏的环境之中。尽管如此，或许正因如此，他们似乎发展出了一种非常尚武的文化。生活在冰冷虚空中成了他们的第二天性，因而高度擅长太空作战。
excerpt.en: Having decoded what counts as a language among them, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] has identified the [encountered_marauder.GetName] as a nomadic civilization known as the [encountered_marauder.GetRealName]. They occupy a number of large space st

excerpt.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]遇到的舰船似乎有点过时，但仍然武装到了牙齿。这些舰船应该是有人驾驶的，但对任何靠近的物体都展现了敌意。有必要谨慎应对……
excerpt.en: The vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be somewhat outmoded, but nevertheless armed to the teeth. They seem to be piloted by sentient crews but respond with hostility to any approach. We will have to treat them with caution.

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们仍然无法与他们建立联络，主要是因为他们并不想理我们，但我们已经可以确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是海盗。视觉指示器表明他们的文化很大程度上是生长于太空的，我们观察到的一些表现形式不符合任何一种居住于行星的文明。

不幸的是，他们的船员似乎对民事交流没有任何兴趣。我们从截获的舰见通讯也表明他们主要以海盗活动为生，偶尔也会招募部分文明边缘的元素到他们的贼船上。
excerpt.en: Although we have been unable to establish communications with them - mainly because they are unwilling to communicate with us - we have been able to identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as pirates. Visual indicators point to their culture being largely s

excerpt.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]星系中探测到的舰船似乎正在进行某种横跨星系的远征，这种生活方式对我们自己的族群而言并不陌生。他们没有表现出任何敌意，而是不断向我们方向重复广播信号。

看到一个族群将家园安于星海之间而非任何星球之上，这种景象令人感到几分莫名的亲切。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]迫切希望能够进一步了解这些同为旅人的族群。
excerpt.en:
The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be on some kind of expedition across the galaxy, a way of life our own people know well. They have made no hostile moves, broadcasting repetitive signals in our direction instead.

There is som

excerpt.zh: 我们已经成功地破译了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]向我们发送的令人困惑的重复信息，我们发现这些信息是一些……商业广告！显然他们自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，是一个以向偶遇的任何文明提供最优惠的交易谋生的星际商团的一部分，至少他们自称是最优惠的。一如既往，他们似乎正在尝试联系我们。
excerpt.en: We have managed to decipher the confusing, repetitive messages the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] were sending us, and it turns out that they were... commercial advertisements! Apparently they call themselves [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and are part of a

excerpt.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体可能是一种有机生物，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]仍在努力验证这一假说。尽管它看起来就是一些随机的星际物质组成的团簇，但毋庸置疑地它们可以在虚空中推进，并展现出了一定程度的自主智能。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]为这种现象困惑，并正在努力验证获得的数据。
excerpt.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is still working to confirm the hypothesis that the irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is in fact a living organism. While it seems to be made up of a cluster of random star dust, it i

excerpt.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系远航舰队的一部分。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器。然而他们似乎完全缄默不语，我们无法从他们当中获取任何信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们可以从我们拾获的只言片语中翻译他们的语言，当然这可能要花好长时间。
excerpt.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence. However, they have been fairly clos

excerpt.zh: 我们成功地破解了神秘的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]被难住了好长时间，直到一次他们开始向我们的大致方向上广播时才取得了突破。广播的内容是一条欢迎讯息，其中他们自称为“那马里安”。看来他们现在愿意与我们交流了。
excerpt.en: We have managed to decipher the language of the mysterious [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remained stumped for quite some time, and a breakthrough was only made once they began broadcasting what turns out to be a welcome message i

excerpt.zh:
闯入者！注意：

我们是扎娜姆的守护者。你们在[From.GetName]星系的存在是对我们造物主的羞辱。我们的程序驱使我们将你们摧毁。化作尘埃成为广阔宇宙的一部分吧。
excerpt.en:
INTERLOPER! Heed this message:

We are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.

excerpt.zh:
在[From.From.From.GetStarName]星系的舰队被全灭后，那里的虚空之云从碎屑中聚集了足够的物质开始进行某种宏观上的有丝分离，也就是无性繁殖。

现在追杀[From.From.From.GetStarName]的虚空之云又多了一个。
excerpt.en: Following the destruction of our fleet in the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system, the local Void Cloud appears to have gathered enough material from the debris to undergo what can best be described as a form of mitosis on the macro level - asexual reproductio

excerpt.zh:
[tiyanki_system.GetName]主序星旁，四颗于低轨道环绕的气态巨行星被笼罩在等离子场中。充能的等离子场深入气态巨行星大气内部，这种独特的环境是许多太空生物繁殖的温床。

这些生物大都微乎其微，但有一个显著的例外——巨型缇扬奇。这个恒星系一定就是它们起初进化了千百万年的地方，随后它们开始在整个星系中漫游。由于这个恒星系的等离子场性质极为罕见，这里很可能是星系中缇扬奇唯一的繁殖地。
excerpt.en: Four gas giants enshrouded by a vast plasma field share a close orbit around the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system's primary. The charged plasma field extends well into the atmospheres of these gas giants, and this unique environment serves as a breeding ground

excerpt.zh:
一大群[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]聚集在一个行星的周边，上面遍布某种外星生命体的尸体。

由于我们对于这些外星实体没有任何信息，我们只能对它们的行为进行猜测。
excerpt.en:
A large number of [tiyanki_no_contact.GetName] are clustered around a planet covered in the carcasses of some alien life-form.

Having no information on those alien entities, we can only speculate on their behavior.

excerpt.zh: 在肃清停留在[FromFrom.System.GetName]的缇扬奇之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以安全地接近墓地，进一步开展研究。
excerpt.en: Having eliminated the Tiyanki stationed in [FromFrom.System.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] can now safely approach the burial ground to conduct their research.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.From.From.GetName]星系内遭遇了某种极为强大的亚空间实体。它似乎没有敌意，对传统飞行器或许甚至没有完全察觉，但它的存在使得[From.From.From.GetName]整个恒星系中出现了强烈的亚空间扰动。

这些扰动位于实体自身周围，在它离开恒星系后应该也会消失。它对我们的致意没有回复，但这个实体一直在发射模式复杂，似乎是某种语言的快子流。如果我们的翻译软件正确的话，它一遍又一遍说的是：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”
excerpt.en: An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing

excerpt.zh:
在与[vluur_system.GetName]星系中我方军队交战时，亚空间实体“弗雷尔”提高了其发送快子流的频率，但不停重复的信息与之前一样：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”

在受到致命一击的同时，这个实体自爆了，大爆炸使得整个恒星系中撒满了暗物质。
excerpt.en:
Throughout its battle with our forces in the [vluur_system.GetName] system, the subspace entity "VLUUR" increased the frequency at which it was emitting tachyon pulses, but the endlessly repeating message remained the same:

"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."

When t

excerpt.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但是，有一种生命体在这种环境下顽强地繁衍生息，那就是太空变形虫。它们放弃了原本相当孤独的生活方式，成群结队地聚在一起，在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，这似乎是精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向[Root.GetName]，公然对其施加威胁。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one lif

excerpt.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的领地，出于天性，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们的哨站。
excerpt.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, entering our territory in the [FromFrom.GetName] system. As is the norm with these creatures, they seem unable to

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体已通过太空变形虫保护法案议案，要求帝国与太空变形虫和平共处。

我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Community has passed the Space Amoeba Protection Act resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with Space Amoebas.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

excerpt.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
excerpt.en: A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders

excerpt.zh:
缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽。任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

不幸的是，我国境内就有缇扬奇存在。直至它们被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
excerpt.en:
The Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests. Any member of the Galactic Community with Tiyanki inside their borders are legally obliged to see to the immediate euthanization of the creatures.

Unfortunately, there are Tiyanki present within our sp

excerpt.zh: 星海共同体的官员注意到[Root.GetName]境内有缇扬奇存在。由于缇扬奇害兽管制议案已经生效，这使得我国处于违反星系法状态，直至这些生物被消灭或是自行主动离开为止。
excerpt.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have observed the presence of Tiyanki within the borders of the [Root.GetName]. With the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution having been enacted, this leaves us in Breach of Galactic Law until the creatures are euthanized or l

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

excerpt.zh:
数个太空帝国，其中一些我们尚不清楚，已经联合组建了一个“星海共同体”。这一国家间机构的目的是作为一个论坛，在那里可以共商重要事务。

虽然我们并不曾参与其建立，那些成员国已经向[Root.GetName]发出了邀请，请求我们成为正式的成员国。我们应该接受邀请吗？
excerpt.en:
Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "Galactic Community." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.

Although we were not involved in its founding, the ot

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体的各个成员国已经投票决定设立星系理事会。这一受人尊敬的实体只允许社群中三个实力最强、最具影响力的帝国成为其成员。到下一轮议会被选出为止，这三个国家将是[council_member_1.GetName]，[council_member_2.GetName]和[council_member_3.GetName]。

共同体期望理事会成员国可以领导和保卫整个星海共同体。他们获得了提权，可以跳过那些时常在大型政治机构中阻碍决策流程的繁文缛节。
excerpt.en: The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are

excerpt.zh: 传感器检测到[This.System.GetName]星系中存在一个向整个星系发出原始信号的物体。这些相同的信号模式也曾在来自未知区域的长程扫描仪上被记录到。虽然目前尚不清楚这些信号是否具有意图，但需要进一步调查。
excerpt.en: Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals

excerpt.zh:
虚空虫的最后一个家园星系已经被摧毁，它们物种也已灭绝。

我们不再需要担心它们的寄生攻击。
excerpt.en:
The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.

We need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

excerpt.zh:
一支虚空虫舰队已进入[from.GetName]星系内的我们的空间。作为[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员，我们有法律义务立即处决在我们边界内的任何虚空虫。

[this.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直到虚空虫离开我们的空间或被消灭。
excerpt.en:
A fleet of Voidworms has entered our space in the [from.GetName] system. As a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member, we are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Voidworms present within our borders.

The [this.GetName] will be cons

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有虚空虫不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[this.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Until they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in Breach of

excerpt.zh: 虚空虫一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重违反了星系法中关于虚空虫灭绝决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[this.GetName]实施制裁。
excerpt.en: The continued Voidworm presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant Breach of Galactic Law under the Voidworm Eradication resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanc

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]正在遭受攻击。

一大群虚空虫正在殖民地轨道上，用寄生囊肿进行轰炸。

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。
excerpt.en:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates in

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了一只躲在小行星中的巨型生物。收获它的尸体也许对我们很有价值。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed a massive creature hidden inside an asteroid. Harvesting its remains could prove valuable to us.

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内发现了一只岩居兽。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将其指定为危险害兽之后，成员国有法律义务立即处决在边界内的所有岩居兽。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直到岩居兽离开我们的星系或被消灭为止。
excerpt.en: A Cutholoid has been discovered in the [from.GetName] system. Following their designation as a dangerous pest, all [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Cutholoids present within their bord

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Once discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law

excerpt.zh: 岩居兽一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重违反了星系法中关于岩居兽灭绝决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[Root.GetName]实施制裁。
excerpt.en: The continued Cutholoid presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant Breach of Galactic Law under the Cutholoid Eradication resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sa

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[from.GetName]内的博物天枢被摧毁了。

我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。

我需要在另一个恒星系中重建博物天枢让标本展览得以继续。
excerpt.en:
Our Grand Archive in [from.GetName] has been destroyed.

Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive state.

We'll need to rebuild the Grand Archive in another system to continue our Specimen exhibiti

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[from.GetName]内的博物天枢被摧毁了。

我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。

我需要在另一个恒星系中重建博物天枢让标本展览得以继续。
excerpt.en:
Our Grand Archive in [from.GetName] has been destroyed.

Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive state.

We'll need to rebuild the Grand Archive in another system to continue our Specimen exhibiti

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢在我们获得该星系后被拆除。

它所占据的空间如今物归原主。
excerpt.en:
The Grand Archive owned by [from.GetName] in [fromfrom.GetName] has been dismantled upon our acquisition of the system.

The space it occupied has been returned to us.

excerpt.zh:
新的博物天枢业已在[from.GetName]建成，我们有机会重建在生态园所失去的大部分东西。

我们从之前养育的太空兽群物种身上采集的基因物质都有妥善保存，只要有足够的资源就可以克隆出新的幼体。
excerpt.en:
Now that a new Grand Archive has been established in [from.GetName], we have an opportunity to restore much of what was lost from our Vivarium.

Genetic Material from each Space Fauna species we have previously raised has been preserved, and with enough resour

excerpt.zh: 在击溃了投机取巧的海盗之后，我们可以自由地索取[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的宝藏了。
excerpt.en: Having routed the opportunistic pirates, we are now free to claim the treasure trove on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
我们之前研发的虚空诱饵吸引了一群来自其他恒星系的太空鲸鱼，这些恒星系类似[This.Capital.System.GetName]，均含有气态巨行星。

看来我们的设备必须在这些环境中建造才能正常工作。如果我们发现其他野生动物，我们应该也能在它们的自然栖息地附近建造虚空诱饵。
excerpt.en:
The Voidlure we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with Gas Giants akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].

It seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna,

excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功捕获了第一批野生太空兽群，我们相信只要投入足够的科学资金，就可以克隆出更多这样的生物。
excerpt.en: With our first successful capture of wild Space Fauna in [from.solar_system.GetName], we believe it possible to clone more of these creatures with the proper scientific investment.

excerpt.zh:
星系熔炉底盘可部署导管群可引导并强化恒星的熵能，一旦发送，它们就会回收并强化恒星的能量输出。使其演化为红巨星，从而将恒星系加热至支撑帝国扩张基础设施的水平。

此类导管群能够定期生产并自主运作，目前仅限于我方领土，但未来有望扩展至整个星系，推动帝国持续增长。

可升级的巨型结构如下：星系熔炉核心
excerpt.en: The Galactic Crucible Chassis is now ready to deploy Conduits: automated systems designed to channel and amplify stellar entropy. Once dispatched, they'll recycle and intensify a star's energy output, converting it into a Red Giant, heating entire systems to s

excerpt.zh:
我们对导管群的持续研究以及将恒星转化为红巨星的研究表明，我们或许能够扩大行动规模，直接使银河系核心过热，从而在整个银河触发热级联，把它改造成对我们更为适宜的环境。

我们已确定六个核心周边星系，可作为此计划的作业枢纽。这些星系位于星系超空间航路网络之外，但相关稳定虫洞的构建工作正紧锣密鼓进行。
excerpt.en: Our ongoing research into Conduits and transforming stars into Red Giants suggests we may be able to scale up our operations to overheat the Galactic Core itself, triggering a thermal cascade across the entire Galaxy, thus transforming it into a much more hosp

excerpt.zh:
随着[crucible_system.GetName]恒星系被占领，我们的军团夺取了那座环绕恒星建造的星系熔炉。

这座巨型建造物的沦陷，宣告了其缔造者以武力称霸星系的美梦破碎。
excerpt.en:
With the capture of the [crucible_system.GetName] system, our forces have also taken control of the Galactic Crucible that was being built around the local star. 

The loss of this megastructure shatters any remaining hope its creators had of taking over the g

excerpt.zh:
占领[crucible_system.GetName]系统揭露了[crucible_builders.GetName]的阴谋，他们企图通过前所未有的烈焰风暴彻底毁灭整个银河系。

目前，那台可能引发大规模灭绝的机器已被暂停。战争一旦结束，我们应动用剩余资源与兵力，将这座巨型建筑彻底摧毁。
excerpt.en:
Capturing the [crucible_system.GetName] system unveiled the sinister plans of the [crucible_builders.GetName], which included the complete annihilation of the entire galaxy by an unprecedented storm of fire. 

For now, the machine that holds the potential to c

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]地表崩裂，地壳破碎，难以承受的热浪从地底涌上。转变来得迅猛而彻底：群山崩溃，海洋沸腾，天空余烬弥漫。

曾经繁盛的生物群系已不复存在，唯有极端生命体仍栖息于此。
excerpt.en:
The surface of [from.GetName] has ruptured, its crust fracturing as unbearable heat surged from below. The transformation was swift and absolute: mountains collapsed, oceans boiled, and the sky was a veil of embers.

No trace remains of the planet's once-thriv

excerpt.zh:
随着[planet.GetName]殖民地的不断扩张，越来越多证据显示有一个使用活体金属的已灭绝文明曾在此活动，尽管至今未发现他们获取这种材料的任何线索。

最近出现了一个答案：一个被力场包裹、闪烁着奇异光芒的球体，从深层核心的熔岩流中缓缓升起。 其最初用途与构造尚不明朗，但在极高温度下，它会持续滴落出活体金属。这一发现虽巧妙地解开了那桩考古谜团，却也让我们面临新的抉择——该如何处置它。
excerpt.en:
As the colony on [planet.GetName] grew, so too did evidence of an extinct civilization that made use of Living Metal, though there was no trace of where they acquired this material.

An answer has recently surfaced, in the form of a strange shimmering sphere e

excerpt.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
excerpt.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]已被提升至[GetLeaderStatusAdjCap]地位，因在[ship.GetName]最近于[system.GetName]恒星系的交战期间观测到其高度的响应能力。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] was elevated to [GetLeaderStatusAdjCap] status following observations of their heightened responses during the [ship.GetName]'s recent engagement in the [system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
excerpt.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

excerpt.zh: 发生在[system.GetName]星系的战斗令[officer.GetName]产生了行为异常。
excerpt.en: The battle in the [system.GetName] system has caused behavioral anomalies within [officer.GetName] to subside.

excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

excerpt.zh: 根据我们最近做出的宣布人工智能非法的政策调整，所有拥有智慧人工智能助手的[Root.GetAdj]科学官都被命令放弃他们的助手并将它们回收利用。
excerpt.en: As per our recent policy change outlawing artificial intelligence, any [Root.GetAdj] Scientists in possession of Sapient AI Assistants have been forced to relinquish them for recycling.

excerpt.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
excerpt.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
excerpt.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
excerpt.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
excerpt.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 发生在[system.GetName]星系的战斗令[officer.GetName]产生了行为异常。
excerpt.en: The battle in the [system.GetName] system has caused behavioral anomalies within [officer.GetName] to subside.

excerpt.zh:
从[Root.GetStarName]恒星系中的恒星深处浮现出一个巨型生物，这个生命体比一般的卫星还要大。它的躯体辐射着热量，能量的波长和恒星系中恒星所产生的一致……

它正在吞噬恒星！

这个生命体正肆意地啃噬恒星黑子，吞噬着耀斑，而我们的出现打断了它的进食。这头巨兽发射出光波并以极高的频率闪烁着，仿佛它在用强光发出愤怒的咆哮一般。
excerpt.en:
From deep within the star of the [Root.GetStarName] system emerges a gargantuan being, larger than a typical moon. Its body radiates heat, the same wavelength of energy as the one produced by the system's star...

It's eating it!

The creature feasts on sun sp

excerpt.zh:
欢迎光临雪拉企业！

我们是在[trader_system.GetName]恒星系对外运营的商业联合企业，主营贸易——我们雪拉企业坚信，贸易是文明的基石。

如果您想进行贸易的话，请联系我们，我们会尽量满足您的一切需要。
excerpt.en:
Welcome to XuraCorp!

We are a business conglomerate operating out of the [trader_system.GetName] system, specializing in trade - the very building blocks of civilization, as we like to say here at XuraCorp.

Please, do not hesitate to contact us if you're int

excerpt.zh: 很抱歉，根据公司规定，我们不能和海盗进行贸易。
excerpt.en: I'm afraid it's against company policy to do business with pirates.

excerpt.zh: 你们的人全是强盗和恶徒，我们将和你们彻底撇清关系。
excerpt.en: You are a nation of bandits and cutthroats. We will have nothing to do with you.

excerpt.zh: 你们这群破坏分子！我们是不会忘记你们的残酷行径的。
excerpt.en: You are terrorists! Do not think we will forget your aggression against our people.

excerpt.zh: 随着我们能源储备的消耗殆尽，以能源为支付手段的贸易已无法继续进行，因此所有与商人城邦之间的与能源相关协定都已取消。
excerpt.en: With our energy reserves depleted, we can no longer maintain our trade agreements that depended on this resource. All such agreements with Trader Enclaves have been canceled.

excerpt.zh:
对脉冲星的研究让我们的科学家收获了无数的灵感和见解，并且通常不会发现什么明显的危险现象。这让最近从[From.GetName]传来的报告更加让人担忧。

初步的扫描结果显示，在脉冲星本身的电磁脉冲束之外，其还在独立发射一束波长仅在本星系可见的电磁波，而且其发射的时间间隔在不断降低。根据我们的初步计算，发射间隔将在日期[GetMidGameDate]完全变为零。人们仍然在猜测那个时候会发生什么，但对这神秘脉冲找不到科学解释的现实已经让研究这一现象的科研人员抱有了一丝超自然的恐惧。
excerpt.en:
The study of pulsars seems to be an endless source of insights for our scientists, but rarely exhibit any signs of overtly dangerous phenomena. This makes the recent reports on [From.GetName] all the more concerning.

An initial scan revealed that the pulsar,

excerpt.zh:
即使是对[From.GetName]最漫不经心的业余天文学家今天也报告说看到了绮丽的灯光表演。一系列速度极快、色彩斑斓的闪光最后变成了电磁辐射爆发，随之而来的是一阵诡异的寂静。很多人提出了疑问，我们很担心不能给出一个答案。

有东西从脉冲星里出现，闪烁着白矮星不祥的光芒。一个幽灵般的实体开始在星系里游荡。
excerpt.en: Even amateur astronomers who directed their gaze towards [From.GetName] today report seeing a spectacular light show. A series of colorful, rapid flashes culminated in a sudden burst of electromagnetic radiation, followed by a ghostly silence. Many people are

excerpt.zh:
这种诞生于光脉冲之中的魑魅魍魉终于被消灭了。尽管它直到最终依然像是飘荡在星际之间的一只鬼魅，其身上仍有许多谜团没有揭开，但之前那群叫嚣着我们的办法不可能成功的悲观科学家还是亲眼目睹了我们的舰船将其消灭的全过程。

为了理解击败他们的原理，科学家们一丝不苟地记录下了之前从未发现的光学特性，以及幽魂今天所展现的力量。
excerpt.en: The haunting creature born from light pulses is finally neutralized. Although it remained until the end a ghost among the stars and in many ways a mystery, the process by which our ships managed to destroy it was observed by the most pessimistic of our scienti

excerpt.zh:
我们的探测器探测到了一个幽灵般的实体。它似乎在恒星系间漫游，无差别地毁灭其周边的一切。早期的观测显示其由光构成，又有能力对光进行操纵，这使得它极难被瞄准，但我们在探索星系的旅途中学到的一点就是，即使是光自身也是可以被弯折和消灭的。

我们只需找到这样做的方法。
excerpt.en: A spectral entity has been detected by our sensors. It seems to be roaming from system to system, destroying matter around itself indiscriminately. Early observations suggest its composition and manipulation of light may make it extremely difficult to target,

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一些静静漂流在[fortress_system.GetName]恒星系的十分巨大的太空建筑。尽管初步扫描显示它们已经很古老了，但是能量识别特征还是非常强烈。在主体建筑周围还能看到漂浮着的几个较小的建筑，所有这些似乎都是全副武装。

如果我们想要了解这个古代遗迹的真实面目，或许我们需要以武力突破其防御…
excerpt.en: We have detected some kind of utterly massive space installation drifting quietly at the edge of the [fortress_system.GetName] system. Although preliminary scans show it to be very old, the structure has an intense power signature. Several smaller structures c

excerpt.zh:
我们在[horror_system.GetName]附近遇到巨型实体，它似乎只是部分地存在于我们的宇宙，这个生物的身体大部分还困在它所来自的噩梦般的位面。

有一个恶质的智能在此工作，古老程度远远超出我们的时间概念，设计也极其异类。我们只能猜测它的目的。
excerpt.en:
We have encountered some kind of vast entity near [horror_system.GetName]. It appears to exist only partially inside our own universe, with the bulk of the creature still trapped in whatever nightmarish realm it spawned from.

There is a malevolent intelligenc

excerpt.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息。

建议小心为上。
excerpt.en: A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond

excerpt.zh:
快速移动的攻击机正在袭击我们位于[hiver_system.GetName]星系内的开采站！这些身份不明的攻击者从一些此前在环带中休眠着的小行星中蜂拥而出，这些小行星现在正散发出强烈的能量信号。

我们只能推测，这些小行星是一种未知的太空生命形式的蜂巢。不管它们是什么，我们不断扩大的采矿活动似乎已经激怒了它们！
excerpt.en:
Fast-moving attack craft are hitting our mining stations in the [hiver_system.GetName] system! These unidentified aggressors swarmed out of several previously dormant asteroids in the belt that are now displaying huge power signatures.

We can only surmise tha

excerpt.zh: 在摧毁艺术家联盟的空间站后，我们发现残骸中有大量可供回收的资源。舱室中储存的捐赠物、礼品与作品现在漂浮在太空之中，可供我们随意回收取用。
excerpt.en: After having destroyed the Artisan Troupe's station we found many resources to salvage from the wreckage. Donations, gifts and creations stacked in its halls now drift in space, ready for the taking.

excerpt.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你已经涉足了自己无法理解的力量。谨言慎行，学会安于当下，因为在你选择的道路上，未来只会带来痛苦。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
excerpt.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"You have meddled with powers you cannot possibly comprehend. Tread carefully, and take wha

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]星系遇到的这种生物不同于[Root.GetName]以往遇见的任何其他生物。

它们具有极强的攻击性与攻击能力，守护着一颗初步扫描发现蕴藏有大量资源的小行星。
excerpt.en:
The creature observed in the [From.GetName] system is unlike anything the [Root.GetName] has previously encountered.

Highly aggressive and with destructive capabilities to match, it guards a planetoid that initial scans indicate is exceptionally resource-rich

excerpt.zh:
我们收到了舰队全灭前发出的最后一则信息。其中提到，这个硕大的敌人似乎盯上了舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果这种怪兽记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
excerpt.en:
We received one last transmission from our fleet before it was destroyed. It mentions their gigantic foe seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast has our scent, we should be prepared for savage retaliation.

excerpt.zh:
我们收我们接收到了来自[Root.GetName]的在进行紧急跃迁之前发出的最后的信号。其中指出他们所遇到的巨大的生物能跟踪舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果让那东西记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
excerpt.en:
We received one last transmission from the [Root.GetName] before the fleet engaged emergency FTL protocols and went dark. It includes mention of the gargantuan creature they had been fighting seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast ha

excerpt.zh:
宣泄派发出的烦人嗡嗡声被噤声了，其消退之快，正如这帮子反动人士起事时一般。某些被我们约谈的行动人士宣称，他们的动机十分复杂，从纯粹的讽刺到有意识、有目的的反对都有。

尽管在画廊和博物馆的活动热度还是前所未有的高，但是公众的注意力已经移动到了新的、更具有争议性的艺术团体身上。我们在继续筛选他们在这一次[root.GetAdj]文化历史上的古怪时刻收集到的数据。
excerpt.en:
The buzz surrounding The Manifesti faction has quietened, fading as quickly as the arrival of protests which started it. Some activists we spoke to claimed their motivations ranged from pure satire to conscientious objection.

Attendance at galleries and museu

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]的弱者们，我们的战士们正准备去进攻你们的星系，要么勇敢的面对他们、要么像懦夫一样躲起来眼睁睁的看着我们的战士抢走你们的财富。

当然了，你们也可以现在就进贡，如果贡品价值足够的话，我们可以考虑不攻击你们……
excerpt.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName] weaklings, our warriors are on their way to plunder your systems. Face them in battle if you can muster the courage, or cower in fear until they have had their fill of your riches.

You can, of course, offer tribute now to spare yourselve

excerpt.zh:
外来者们。我们是[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。不像星系中的其他“文明”的星际帝国，我们没有统治者，但作为被所有氏族选中的代表，我在此正告各位：

不要妄图用你们那软弱无力的威胁来挑战我们。你们尽管将自己的舰队派往[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName]看看，千万不要期望它们能安然返航，我们的战士不介意进行些消遣。

当然，你们要是想进贡，那我们希望你们能常来坐坐……或在你们需要佣兵并能支付足够酬金的时候。
excerpt.en:
Outsiders. We are the [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Unlike the "civilized" star nations of the galaxy, we have no single master to lord over us, but I have been chosen to convey this message to you on behalf of all of the Houses:

Do not try to

excerpt.zh:
我们与[Root.GetName]的雇佣兵契约已经到期了。他们的领袖————指挥官[Root.Leader.GetName]立刻提出与我们续约，让目前听命于[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的那些舰船再为我们服务五年…… 当然必须另付费用。

如果我们拒绝，这些雇佣兵就会离开我们，去找其他的雇主。
excerpt.en: Our contract with the mercenaries in the [Root.GetName] has come to an end. Their leader, Commander [Root.Leader.GetName], has offered to immediately extend the services of the ships under [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] command to us for another five years... at an e

excerpt.zh:
数月间，我们零星收到了少量外星佣兵与海盗在我们边境活动的报告。他们自称为[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并且似乎是一群流放者，来自[marauder_system.GetName]恒星系的拥挤空间站上的一个游牧战士文明。

他们平安无事地路过我们的边境，但警告我们不要冒犯[marauder_system.GetName]。[From.GetSpeciesName]没有所谓的集中政体，但他们有着不同的派系，相互之间不断争斗，并经常攻击相邻的恒星系。鉴于其庞大的成员数量与空间站造船能力，如果他们
excerpt.en: For several months now, we have received scattered reports of small numbers of alien mercenaries and privateers operating on the frontiers of our space. They call themselves the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and are apparently exiles from a nomadic warrior cult

excerpt.zh: 在击溃了[conquered_planet.GetName]的守军后，[From.GetName]的地面部队以大可汗之名占领了[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]！他们在[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表上的主要定居点高高升起这个新兴帝国的旗帜。现在，[From.GetSpeciesName]的殖民者们被赶出了他们已被摧毁的居住地，装进了运输舰中。
excerpt.en: After defeating the brave defenders of [conquered_planet.GetName], ground forces from the [From.GetName] have claimed the [conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon] in the name of their Great Khan! They have raised the banner of their new empire over every major settlem

excerpt.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]的前任指挥官意外身亡，[marauder_species.GetNamePlural]派遣指挥官[new_leader.GetName]接替前任指挥官的职务。
excerpt.en: Following the untimely demise of the former commander of the [Root.GetName], the [marauder_species.GetNamePlural] have dispatched Commander [new_leader.GetName] as a replacement.

excerpt.zh:
我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！

悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。
excerpt.en:
We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!

Grief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers

excerpt.zh:
世世代代以来，[Root.GetName]上冰冷空寂的废墟始终蛰伏于此，静静诉说着千百万年前那陡然告终的黄金时代。

一切从此改变。这座覆盖整颗星球的城市重获新生，那些年久失修的废墟又一次充满了活力。凡是可以修复之处，现存的建筑和基础设施均已被修缮并重新规划用途。至于那些损坏太过严重的区域，其上的瓦砾和废墟也已清理干净，为建造新建筑腾出了空间。
excerpt.en:
For untold generations, the cold and empty ruins of [Root.GetName] have stood dormant, as quiet symbols of a golden age that came to an abrupt end eons ago.

No longer. The planet-wide city has at last been reborn, and those same dilapidated ruins are once mor

excerpt.zh: 打造巨型艺术设施的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。
excerpt.en: The first stage of constructing a Mega Art Installation combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priori

excerpt.zh: 我们巨型艺术设施的第二阶段已经完成，填满保险库的工作已经开始。一只专门的运输舰队将会持续不断地将我们帝国的瑰宝运送到它们的新家来。同时，可供工作人员居住的住所以及更多的展览空间等其他建筑也正在建造。
excerpt.en: The second stage of our Mega Art Installation is complete and the process of filling the Vault has begun. A dedicated fleet of transport ships operates constantly to transport the treasure of our empire to its new home. Meanwhile, additional structures are bei

excerpt.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展出来自星系各国的艺术臻品以彰显不同物种的多样性。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
excerpt.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will show samples of art from every race to celebrate the diversity of the galaxy. The firs

excerpt.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地抓捕奴隶的计划服务。
excerpt.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to capture the

excerpt.zh: 强大的通信阵列已被加入到战略指挥中心之中，这样我们的舰船无论在哪都可以收到来自于我们的战略指令了。这些目前最为先进的通信阵列能够克服一切干扰，并且它量子纠缠的信号完全无法被破解。
excerpt.en: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue orders to our ships throughout the galaxy. These state-of-the-art arrays are powerful enough to burn through any possible jamming, and the qua

title.zh: 战略指挥中心：全面运行

excerpt.zh: 战略指挥中心最后的附加部分是一些分离的"敌方军队"模拟堡垒。这些堡垒差不多就是战略指挥中心的微缩版，而且完全独立运行。精英指挥官和他的手下们在其中能够完整地沉浸在敌人的文化与传统之中，通过学习他们的艺术，能更好地理解并模拟他们的军事思想。当完全沉浸之后，他们会与战略指挥中心的工作人员开展一场场虚拟战争，使得我们能够模拟任何可能的冲突，并能从两边学习到所有的细节，我们便能够在实战当中拥有比敌人更加卓越的战术。
excerpt.en: The final additions to the Strategic Coordination Center are several detached "Hostile force" simulator bastions. These bastions contain much of the functionality of the Strategic Coordination Center on a smaller scale, but are completely independent of the ma

excerpt.zh:
星际集会第一阶段最关键的特征的就是基座了。一个复杂的黑洞全息影像，它被用来召唤星系中心潜伏的引力深渊：那整个星系旋转的支点。

等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。
excerpt.en: The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the Locus. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy tur

excerpt.zh: 星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。
excerpt.en: The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.

title.zh: 星际集会：会议广场模块

excerpt.zh: 星际集会的外环将会配有大量最先进的隐私保护会议室（当然，只有[Root.GetAdj]能够进行监控）。这座空间站正在迅速成为非现场谈判方面无可辩驳的星系枢纽。
excerpt.en: The Interstellar Assembly's outer ring is populated with vast, state-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with privacy filters (penetrable only by [Root.GetAdj] surveillance, of course). The station is quickly becoming the de-facto galactic hub for off-site ne

excerpt.zh:
星际集会已全力运作，目前正在招待星际间几股大势力的重要人物们，无论他们是政界还是商界的。

我们的外交官们在跟进空间站内传出的那些国家利益与政治羞辱的信息流时受了不少累。不过至少我们的客人对我们的监控并不关心，只要我们一直为他们提供这种同竞争对手角力的理想环境就好了。
excerpt.en:
The Interstellar Assembly is now fully operational, and plays host to a number of embassies from the galaxy's major powers, be they political or corporate.

Our diplomats are having a hard time keeping up with the steady flow of information on national interes

excerpt.zh: 为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。
excerpt.en: To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, w

excerpt.zh: 建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。
excerpt.en: Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.

excerpt.zh: 从黑洞提取物质的关键就在于究极精致的重力重定向系统：在某个区域集中生成一片引力扭曲的区域，然后打造出一个专门用来应对重力情况下的大型重定向钻头。
excerpt.en: The key to extracting matter from the black hole is the ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system: Forming a focused area of twisted gravity, in effect creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

excerpt.zh: 物质解压器的最后一步看上去十分单调，但也有他最令人震撼的一面。一大堆自动化的冶炼厂以及处理器开始将采取自[From.GetName]的物质分解，解压缩并分离为实用的矿物，再装入连续不绝的机械驳船舰队中，送往帝国各地。
excerpt.en: The final stage of the Matter Decompressor is the most mundane, but in its own way the most impressive. A vast automated array of smelters and processors break down, decompress, and separate the material of [From.GetName] into useful minerals which are decante

excerpt.zh: 我们在[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]的视界线上不可思议地存在着某种采矿装置。我们的科学家认为这可能是一个“物质解压器”——用于从黑洞中开采矿物的巨型结构。尽管它已无法正常运转，但某些阻止它被意大利面条化的装置一定仍在运作。
excerpt.en: Impossibly perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is some kind of mining apparatus. Our scientists theorize that this may be a "Matter Decompressor" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no lo

excerpt.zh:
伴随着吱呀声，物质解压器：锚定细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。

看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。
excerpt.en:
The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the Matter Decompressor: Anchor sputter to life.

The spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]

excerpt.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它破碎的残骸中包含了大量的战斗计算机、模拟器、以及通讯阵列，因此我们的科学家认为这一定是某种“战略指挥中心”。
excerpt.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been s

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的废弃战略指挥中心已被完全修复，并由[Root.GetName]最有才华的军事人员掌管。这座巨型结构将恢复其原本的功用，指挥我们整个星系中的军事力量。
excerpt.en: The abandoned Strategic Coordination Center in [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the most brilliant military minds of the [Root.GetName]. True to its original purpose, the megastructure will be put to use coordinating our military might thr

excerpt.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]中发现了三座被毁的空间站。它们被一团碎片所环绕，其中某些仍可辨识出是艺术品，虽然是非常异星的艺术品——看来这里曾是一座“巨型艺术设施”。
excerpt.en: A trio of wrecked space stations have been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. They are surrounded by a cloud of debris, some of which is still vaguely recognizable as works of art, albeit of a very alien nature. It seems that this was at one

title.zh: 被毁的巨型艺术设施已修复

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的被毁巨型艺术设施已被修复完毕。除了[Root.GetName]最伟大的艺术品之外，它也陈列了一小部分从原本的巨型结构中回收并修复的外星艺术品。
excerpt.en: The once-ruined Mega Art Installation in [From.GetName] has been restored to operation. Fully repaired and stocked with a selection of the greatest artworks of [Root.GetName], it also contains a small selection of exhibits which were recovered and restored fro

excerpt.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大的被毁空间站。从大量办公空间以及一座配有各种不同类型生命维持设施的论坛看来，我们的科学家认为这是一座“星际集会”的残骸。
excerpt.en: The remains of a vast space station have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. Judging by the amount of what seems to be office-space and a vast forum outfitted with dozens of different types of life-support systems, our scientists suspect that

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的星际集会已经再次上线了。它已准备好再次迎接星系中的外交官们，共同商讨当前太阳周期中的问题。
excerpt.en: The Interstellar Assembly in [From.GetName] is online again. Once more it is ready for the diplomats of the galaxy to gather in one place to debate the great issues of the current solar cycle.

excerpt.zh:
愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚一直伴你左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们是[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。我们代表游牧舰队，逐浪者舰队上所有的纳马里安之魂发声。

你不必对我们心存恐惧，我们的舰队无意对天体进行争夺。我们只要求受到尊重，旅程不受到妨碍。
excerpt.en:
Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.

You have nothing to fear from u

excerpt.zh: 愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。
excerpt.en: Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle].

excerpt.zh: 逐浪者舰队上的游牧船员们给我们发来了信息。他们说他们正在从星系边缘离开并向下一个目的地进发。他们将会去哪？他们会找到他们正寻觅的东西吗？
excerpt.en: The galactic nomads aboard the Pursuing Waters fleet have sent us a parting message. They are leaving our galaxy from the outer rim and setting sail towards their next destination. Where will they end up next? Will they ever find what they are searching for?

excerpt.zh: 死灵机师协议的成功安装使我们得以将被击溃的特定星神兽复活。相比机械升级，有机组件是劣等的。我们可以改造肉体，制造出有机生命的复制品。
excerpt.en: The successful installation of Mechromancy protocols will enable us to reanimate certain deceased Leviathans. Organic components are inferior to mechanical upgrades. We can engineer the flesh and produce a facsimile of organic life.

excerpt.zh:
一股可感的寂静降临在[root.GetName]各处。远近各处的朝圣者踏上旅途，前往选定好的礼拜场所；一路上结识新友，重温故交。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者们据传对此悲喜交加。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长领头作了一番温暖人心的布道，号召信徒们好好培养、呵护他们之间的关系，在互惠互利中繁荣兴旺。

随着[mortal_initiate.GetName]向祭献堂进发，群众们以叹息
excerpt.en:
A palpable hush descends across the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims have journeyed from near and far to their chosen places of worship, forming new friendships and rekindling old ones along their way.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newl

excerpt.zh:
兴奋的低语在[root.GetName]上传开。朝圣者们在选定好的礼拜场所等待，纵然旅途劳顿，依旧激动非常。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者向他们礼貌地致以谢意。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长领头作了一番兴高采烈的布道，号召信徒们把握好分分秒秒中的欢愉。随着仪式最高潮的时刻到来，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们在狂热的掌声中向着祭献堂进发。他们于此刻迎接终结，为
excerpt.en:
Excited murmurings ripple over the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims await at their chosen places of worship, buoyed by an excitement quite at odds with any physical weariness they may have endured.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newly-em

title.en: A Sacrifice Made: Bounty for the [root.GetName]

excerpt.zh:
富足感洋溢在[root.GetName]各处，朝圣者在选定好的礼拜场所聚集。他们间或献上祭品；许多人藉此从为圣地服务的无数小摊小贩和街边店铺中获利。

这一轮的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]遵行并参与了各式各样的仪式，他们的队列饰以多姿多彩的花环，不发一言地前行。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长做了一番意味深长的布道，许诺所有人都会有多产而舒适的时代。

布道结束后，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们向着祭献堂进发，在那里迎接自己的终结，为
excerpt.en:
A sense of wellbeing can already be felt throughout the [root.GetName] as pilgrims gather at their chosen places of worship. Sometimes they make offerings; many take advantage of the myriad stalls and street sellers which serve our holy sites.

Various rituals

excerpt.zh:
我们的首席执行官们刚刚聚集在一起，召开全息会议讨论丧尸卫生产品销售的增长，这时，复活资产公司某个辅助机构的负责人突然闯进了会议大厅。“[debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName]上的一个丧尸已经成功地偿还了债务！”其他人还没搞懂什么情况，负责人就脱口而出。会议暂时停顿，随后陷入一片混乱。每个与会的执行官都要求知道，这可能会如何影响对他们的复活工人的供应。

经过更多的分析，结果是这只是一个极其罕见的案例。只有那些身体维持了整整一个世纪的死者能够偿还他们的债务——就大局而言，这个数字微不足道。如
excerpt.en: Our chief executives had all just gathered for a holo-meeting to discuss the growth of zombie hygiene product sales when one of the heads of Animated Assets' aids burst into the conference hall. "One of the Zombies on [debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName] has mana

excerpt.zh:
索林原虫尝试进入我们！

这个系外入侵者迅速捕获我们的[root.GetNecromancersLower]。从中其他的虫群开始收集更多附近的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。我们需要清除整个感染仓以确保[Root.GetName]的安全。
excerpt.en:
The Prethoryn tried to enter us!

The extragalactic invader immediately seized our [root.GetNecromancersLower]. From there, the alien entity began collecting additional [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] from nearby. We had to eliminate the entire infiltration pod

excerpt.zh:
转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。

新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。
excerpt.en: The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic p

excerpt.zh:
敌方舰队在我们的攻击下溃败。他们的信号逐渐没入静默。

奥伦·维斯注视着监视屏，沉默不语。这场胜利中没有喜悦，只有清算。那个奉行大清洗的帝国的旗帜在虚空中燃烧，但在随后的死寂中，他们的誓言依然回荡。

“每击倒一个这样的敌人，都会磨炼我们的意志。我们将继续打击那些推行灭绝政策的人，永不言弃。”
excerpt.en:
The enemy fleet breaks against our assault. Their signals fade into static.

Watching on the view screen, Orun Veyth does not speak. There is no triumph in this victory, only reckoning. The banner of a purge-committing empire burns in the void, but in the sile

excerpt.zh:
我们最近对[FromFrom.GetName]开展调查，探测到了微弱的生命迹象，发现了一个此前未被记录的未开智物种。

小塞罗坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。

塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。
excerpt.en:
Our recent survey of [FromFrom.GetName] detected faint traces of life, revealing a previously unrecorded pre-sapient species.

Sero the Younger insisted on limited collection for study, emphasizing care and enrichment. A small group will now reside within our

excerpt.zh:
萨尔·哈斯克古戎露出笑容，小心翼翼地放下了一个物件。其形状难以辨认：部分是金属，部分是骨头，还有一部分完全是某种别的东西。无论它是什么，身上都带着明显的战斗痕迹。

“每场战斗都会留下些什么，但只有一部分值得保留。不如我们把它好好展示出来，如何？反正我们的空间多得是！”

他爆发出一阵肆无忌惮的响亮狂笑，仿佛这件战利品是他与星辰之间心有灵犀的一个私人笑话。
excerpt.en:
Th'aal Hask'Guron grins as he sets an object down with surprising care. Its shape is hard to read: part metal, part bone, part something else entirely. Whatever it is, it bears the unmistakable scars of battle.

"Every good fight leaves something behind, but o

excerpt.zh:
塞拉伦涅又浮现出了一段记忆。她想起了一座大厅，里面坐满了衣着考究的人，他们低沉而深思熟虑的语调中透着惯于发号施令者的自信。

“他们在争论，”她低声说道。“声音不大，但措辞犀利……是关于一项任务。关于一次必须保密的发射。还有其他的，还有两艘飞船和我们一起出发了。但为什么？我们到底在逃离什么？”
excerpt.en:
Another memory has surfaced for Seralune. She remembers a hall of impeccably dressed figures, their hushed, deliberate tones carrying the confidence of those used to command.

"They were arguing," she murmurs. "Not loudly, but sharply... about a mission. About

excerpt.zh:
随着塞拉伦涅的离去，她所承载的脆弱记忆之迹也已归于沉寂。她曾追寻的真相，如今再也无法找回。

她的故事在此终结，虽未完结，但并未被遗忘。
excerpt.en:
With Seralune gone, the fragile trail of memories she carried has faded into silence. Whatever truths she sought can no longer be recovered.

Her story ends here, unfinished, but not forgotten.

excerpt.zh:
索拉斯单元认为，从我们最近完成的合约中学到的教训，提供了一个独特的教育机会。孩子们聚集在他耐心的指导下，不仅学习字母和逻辑，还学习共情与合作。

他儿子的笑声在走廊里回荡，提醒着即使是最年长的旅行者：欢乐是一种任何技术都无法取代的力量。
excerpt.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique educational opportunity. The young gather beneath his patient instruction, learning not only letters and logic, but empathy and cooperation.

His son's laughter carr

excerpt.zh: 来自[pickup_planet.GetName]的外交使团已经登上了方舟舰，并正以符合[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]大使身份的礼遇规格受到接待。我们规划了一系列活动，包括方舟舰参观和关于我们生活方式的宣讲，以便让他们在前往[dropoff_planet.GetName]的旅途中过得愉快。
excerpt.en: The diplomatic delegation from [pickup_planet.GetName] has boarded the arkship and are being accommodated with all the respect due to ambassadors from the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName]. We have planned a schedule of activities including arkship tours and prese

excerpt.zh: 来自[diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName]的代表团已经抵达目的地。他们的外交访问现在可以正式开始了，我们祝愿他们的和平事业取得成功。
excerpt.en: The delegates from the [diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName] have arrived at their destination. Their diplomatic visit can now officially begin, and we wish them success in their peaceful endeavors.

excerpt.zh:
为了解决[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。

我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。
excerpt.en: Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName] have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at on

excerpt.zh:
一个旅行团在[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。

我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。
excerpt.en:
A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.

We have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now

excerpt.zh: 游客欣赏着[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的美景，惊叹于身边的种种奇景。当踏上归途时，他们将再也不同往日了，因为对宇宙之广阔的一手认知将会重塑他们。
excerpt.en: The tourists enjoyed the sights in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, marveling at the wonders around them. They will return home changed, carrying with them first-hand knowledge of the vastness of the universe.

excerpt.zh:
我们遇到的[From.GetName]是一个游牧文明。他们似乎愿意承担我们发布的合约工作，以换取微薄的费用。

这可能为我们之间的协作提供有趣的契机，我们可以利用他们在轨道开发和探索方面的专业知识来为我们谋利。
excerpt.en:
The [From.GetName] we met are a Nomadic civilization. They appear to be willing to pick up Contract work on our behalf in exchange for a modest fee.

This could present interesting opportunities for collaboration between us, and we could leverage their experti

小塞罗坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。

塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。

面对这种无视我们主权的行为，我们绝不会坐视不理。只要我们下定决心，就能迅速集结舰队，驱逐这些游牧民，并将他们彻底封锁在我们的星域之外。

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
excerpt.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.

excerpt.zh:
自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是[capital_scope.GetName]。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。

我们要让他们失望了。
excerpt.en:
Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the [capital_scope.GetName] in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.

We will have to disappoint them.

excerpt.zh: “住手！你的驾驶机动水平已经证明了你确实是个真正的掠夺者，被放逐又如何。今天我们不会为所谓的荣誉而付出更多代价。开个价，饶我们一命吧。”[Root.GetSpeciesName]在[From.GetName]上喊道，身边是毁坏的舰桥。
excerpt.en: "Stand down! Your piloting makes you a true Marauder, exile be damned. We will not trade more plating for pride today. Name the fee to spare us." The [Root.GetSpeciesName] on the [From.GetName] hails from a ruptured bridge.

excerpt.zh:
从[From.solar_system.GetName]星系传来一束紧急优先呼叫；我们的屏幕被追兵占满了。

“舞跳得真不错嘛，但你们很快就要死在我们前面，那就跳不了了。[GetHeirsBargain]
excerpt.en:
A priority hail pings us in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system; our pursuers fill the viewscreen.

"You danced well, for a time. Pity it ends with you dead in our sights. [GetHeirsBargain]

excerpt.zh: 在代表[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]执行合同期间，我们偶然发现了一批古老的集装箱。它们被冰块包裹着，我们差点把它们误认为是普通的陨石。虽然从打捞权的角度来看，这些物品在技术上属于我们，但考虑到它们是在为他们工作时发现的，我们应该考虑将它们移交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]。扫描这些箱子后，发现里面……

excerpt.zh: 我们方舟舰上的一些老旧模块在一次严重的冷却故障后受损，已经显得老态龙钟。损坏程度很大，好在飞船的完整性受到威胁之前已经进行紧急关停。我们该如何应对？
excerpt.en: Some older modules on our Arkship have begun to show their age after a critical cooling failure left them damaged. The damage is extensive, but an emergency shutdown was triggered before the Arkship's integrity could be compromised. How should we proceed?

我们荣光加身的汗王[From.GetName]于近日驾崩。根据传统，我们现在必须交出随王座而来的权力。我们的掠夺者盟友已经停止派遣增援舰队来支援我们的事业了。

现在我们必须决定如何处置星系的其余部分。许多并不熟悉我们传统的文明都以这样或那样的原因接受了我们的统治，但他们已经从我们的统治中察觉到了软弱。

Our glorious Khan [From.GetName] passed away recently, and as tradition dictates we must now give up the power that came with the throne. Already our Marauder allies have stopped sending reinforcing fleets to aid our cause.

Now we just have to decide what to

尤利西斯计划的一个中继浮标漂浮在这个星系中——破损不堪，勉强运转，但仍在发送广播。

除了最初的宣告外，浮标还载有两条后来的通讯。第二条的日期大约在第一条的十年后。

殖民地人口：二十六万。农业已建立。基础设施正在扩建。

第三条通讯的日期是第9182天——大约在登陆后的第二十五年。“我们还在这里。联合星的环境比最初的调查显示的更具挑战性。我们失去了一些同伴。如果有任何尤利西斯计划的飞船收到此广播，请回复。我们在这里。我们仍在坚持。”

联合星位于天津四星系，距离这里仅有几次超空间跳跃的航程。
excerpt.en:
A Ulysses Initiative relay buoy is drifting in this system - battered, barely functional, but still broadcasting.

excerpt.zh:
大功告成了。今天，我们骄傲地向星系交出我们最伟大的成绩单：我们的超空间中继器网道与我们的亲密友邦[from.GetName]紧紧相连了起来。

在[root.GetName]各地都在举行盛大的庆典，一致宣布这个我们共同引以为豪的新网道。据说就在此刻，我们冰释一切前嫌；放下了一切傲慢与成见。我们期盼在未来的日子里能够继续共享这份骄傲和与豪情。通过亲密无间的协作，我们打破了曾经一度认为不可逾越的壁垒，开启了友谊、共荣的新时代。
excerpt.en:
It is done. Today, we present the galaxy with one of our grandest accomplishments yet: the joining of our Hyper Relay network with that of our friends, the [from.GetName].

Lavish ceremonies have been held throughout the [root.GetName], unanimously heralding t

excerpt.zh:
在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场。我们的科学家分析称，在残骸场内部最密集的区域所残存的部分完整结构似乎通过某种方式驾驭了恒星的力量，有将物体传送至极远距离的能力。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识，我们将能够修复这座量子弹弓。
excerpt.en: A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system. Our scientists theorize that the partially intact structure in the densest portion of the field somehow harnessed the power of the star to launch objects incredible di

excerpt.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系内的被毁的量子弹弓已被修复到可以运作的状态，现已能传送我们的舰队跨过星海。我们对它的科技有了全新的理解，在经过几轮测试之后，我们有信心能够安全地使用。
excerpt.en: The Ruined Quantum Catapult in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system has been restored to operational status, and can now transport our fleets across the stars. We have developed a new understanding of its technology, and after a few test runs, we feel

title.zh: 量子弹弓双排扭力透镜

excerpt.zh: 量子弹弓的第二个扭力透镜装置已经就位，并同第一个装置进行了平衡。射程和准确度都提高了。
excerpt.en: A second arrangement of Quantum Catapult torsion lenses is now in position, diametrically balancing the first. Range and accuracy are increased.

excerpt.zh: [beholder_planet.GetName]上的金字塔已不复存在，原地留下了一个巨大的空洞。当地的未开智生物满脸困惑地站在空洞的峭壁边上。
excerpt.en: The Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName] has vanished, leaving a giant crater in its wake. The pre-sapient inhabitants line the precipice, seemingly confused.

excerpt.zh: [beholder_planet.GetName]上的金字塔已不复存在，原地留下了一个巨大的空洞。当地的未开智生物满脸困惑地站在空洞的峭壁边上。
excerpt.en: The Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName] has vanished, leaving a giant crater in its wake. The pre-sapient inhabitants line the precipice, seemingly confused.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。

如果我们能驾驭他们的雄心壮志，这些著名领袖可能会愿意加入我们的事业。
excerpt.en:
We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shake the foundations of galactic power.

If

excerpt.zh: 我们的人员一直在努力促进与斯克兰德和他的船员的关系。这种跨文化交流的努力已经取得初步成效：刚刚斯克兰德同意提供他们高效舰载机的设计。这可能会大大提升我们对太空作战的理解。
excerpt.en: Our personnel have worked hard to foster relations with Skrand and his crewmates. This effort in cross-cultural exchange is already bearing fruit: Skrand has just agreed to hand over the designs for their highly efficient strike craft. This could lead to a gre

excerpt.zh:
尽管无人机群被击败了，但是它们的制造者也留了一手，让摧毁它们的人也捞不到什么好处。无人机在回应我们的攻击时，启动了自毁程序。残余的东西难以被打捞。

不过，我们现在可以自由地探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
excerpt.en:
Despite the drones' defeat, whoever created them made sure that no one could benefit from their destruction. The drones initiated self-destruct protocols in response to our attack. What little remains is hardly salvageable.

Still, we are now free to explore t

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告说，舰队在[From.GetName]星系发现了很多海盗。

扫描发现海盗船和空间站的数目非常庞大，所以这应该是个历史悠久的海盗港口。这些海盗从很久以前就开始在这里进行抢劫活动，且没有遭遇过任何打击行动。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the fleet has encountered a significant pirate presence in the [From.GetName] system.

Judging by preliminary scans of the immense ships and the stations harboring them, this is a historical pirate port. It has likely been in un

excerpt.zh:
[root.GetName]代表：暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]外部关卡和所得军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成ECA配额。

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放心，我们会将正式占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocrac
excerpt.en: Representatives of the [root.GetName]: a temporary blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Processing and transportation of food and minerals through this system are now subject to seizure by External Customs and Acquisitions office

excerpt.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系的海盗私掠船已经被摧毁了。虽然附近恒星系中还有一些零零散散的海盗船，但从目前来看，星际海盗已经成为了过去……至少今天如此。

我们从他们丰厚的储存室里设法缴获了一批来历不明的赃物，这批宝藏我们可以纳入国库，另有他用。
excerpt.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a

excerpt.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
excerpt.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

excerpt.zh: 超空间规划委员会报告，将太阳系的第三行星从重力井移除后，一个天然虫洞形成了。这个虫洞也许能逐渐缓解附近超空间通路的超光速交通拥堵。
excerpt.en: The Hyperspace Planning Council reports that the removal of the third planet in Sol from the system's gravity well has allowed a natural wormhole to form. This wormhole may eventually reduce FTL traffic congestion in the nearby hyperlanes.

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的灵能的嗡声逐渐淡去，一瞬间万物寂静。[From.GetName]上的人群目瞪口呆（如果他们有眼和鼻的话），灵能射线从他们心智絮网中发散着，每个人都着迷于其强大和强烈的个人信仰。

如果他们之前不明白的话，现在他们知道了：我们都只是某个更伟大事物的一部分。
excerpt.en: The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters f

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]已完成纳米同化机器人的部署，其数量经计算足以义体化支配[From.GetName]上所有智慧有机生命。

我们没有在[From.From.GetName]上布置任何传感器或器械以证明我们的成功，但我们知道已经成功了。当我们将目光投于[From.GetName]上时。我们见到了自己，也经由自己所见。

在[From.GetName]表面上，只有我们自己。
excerpt.en:
The [From.From.GetName] has completed deployment of the assimilation nanobot payload, calculated to be sufficient to cybernetically dominate all sapient organics on [From.GetName].

We did not build the [From.From.GetName] with any sensors or instruments to me

excerpt.zh: 随着[FromFrom.GetName]发出的意识清除光束的能量逐渐消散，[From.GetName]的人口几乎都已经退化到了未开智状态。幸免遇难者面对那些曾经认识的人们做出动物般的举动只能束手无策。
excerpt.en: As the energies of the mind wiping beam from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipate, [From.GetName]'s population has almost entirely regressed to the pre-sapient stage. Those who were spared can now only watch in horror as those they once knew return to animalistic

excerpt.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在[Root.GetName]上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，[Root.GetName]定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
excerpt.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on [Root.GetName] has come to fruition.

From this day on, [Root.GetName] must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy.

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了平等相待法案议案，禁止任何帝国继续施行不予干涉或侵入性干涉政策。

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Equal Standing Act resolution, forbidding empires from holding the Non-Interference or Aggressive Interference policies.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we chan

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了不予干涉法案议案，禁止任何帝国继续施行除不予干涉以外的前超光速文明干涉政策。

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Non-Interference Act resolution, forbidding empires from holding any Pre-FTL Interference policy except for Non-Interference.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经获悉我们对[pre_ftl_country.GetAdj]母星的入侵。他们正式告知我们这一行为违反了不予干涉法案。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
excerpt.en:
Our invasion of the [pre_ftl_country.GetAdj] homeworld has been noted by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Non-Interference Act.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经获悉我们对[pre_ftl_country.GetAdj]母星的轰炸。他们正式告知我们这一行为违反了不予干涉法案。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
excerpt.en:
Our bombardment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetAdj] homeworld has been noted by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Non-Interference Act.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Bre

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了开发利用法案议案，禁止任何帝国继续施行不予干涉政策。

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Exploitation Act resolution, forbidding empires from holding the Non-Interference policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compli

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]共享科技数据。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了开发利用法案，无论我们的本意如何。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
excerpt.en: Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our sharing of technological data with the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Exploitation Act, regardless of our i

excerpt.zh:
我们的一位在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上工作的关键特工有点……迷恋上了当地的文明，并拒绝了许多已下达的任务。相反，这位过于独立的特工开始进行独立的异种学研究，并提交了许多请求，要求将其正式发布。

这些行为让[from.GetName]行动遭受到推延的风险，但我们必须承认，那个不守规矩的特工的工作事实上对我们相当有用。否认这一努力反而才会减缓我们的进展。
excerpt.en: One of our key operatives working on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has become... enamored with the local civilization, and has been refusing many of their assigned tasks. Instead this overly-independent agent has taken up independent xenological study, a

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的工作遇到了一个很怪的难题：[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢正在镜像模仿我们的行为。一开始我们以为不过是当地工蜂的古怪行为，但许多这些新的习惯毫无疑问本质上就是[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的。

这不仅暗示了我们在[from.GetName]行动缜密设计的范围之外影响到了当地的蜂巢，更提醒了我们自己的失败融入正在被倒映回给我们。目前没有迹象表明这个蜂巢意识到了我们的行动，但也许我们的暴露与
excerpt.en: Our work on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has met with an unusual complication: the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive is mirroring our behavior. At first we thought the local drones had simply turned eccentric, but many of these new habits are unmistakeab

excerpt.zh:
[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上一个大型定居点的子个体们今天意外地爆发了一场冲突。我们的特工在伪装成当地低级子个体时误用了错误的信息素，并引发了拥挤踩踏事件。[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢似乎对我们提前准备的信息素格外敏感。但如果继续在当地定居点之间编排这样的爆炸性交互，我们应该会学到不少东西。

显然，我们的存在本身正危害到[from.GetName]行动的进行。我们下次再发送任何信号都必须做到万无一失。
excerpt.en: The drones of a major colony on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] were unexpectedly roused for battle today. Our agents mistakenly applied the wrong pheromone when trying to pass off as local menial drones, which lead to a stampede. The [from.target.GetSpeci

excerpt.zh:
一个[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]子个体设法将自己的[from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural]放到了我们的测量装置上。它已经开始把我们的装置拆开了，如果它理解了什么，这股意识蔓延到当地的蜂巢思维只是一个时间问题。

如果我们希望避免干扰它们的自然发展，就必须迅速采取行动。
excerpt.en: A drone on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has managed to get their [from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural] on one of our measuring devices. It has already started to take our device apart; it's only a matter of time before the understanding spreads to the

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到和[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]完全不一样的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery

excerpt.zh: 我们的降临对[planet.GetName]无异于一场大灾变。一股巨大的冲击波冲刷了这片没有生命的大陆，由于数百万吨的碎片被抛入大气层，[planet.GetName]的宜居性显著的下降了。我们的殖民者—被安全地包围在陨石的岩石核心—将很快从庇护处走出，并开始安装预制殖民地基础设施。
excerpt.en: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased

excerpt.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesName]难民。他们被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
excerpt.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying [Root.GetSpeciesName] refugees from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from thei

excerpt.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesName]难民。他们被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
excerpt.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying [Root.GetSpeciesName] refugees from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from thei

excerpt.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
excerpt.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

excerpt.zh:
随着人群开始肿胀，受苦者克罗南变得愈发狂躁。他们的声音因紧绷而颤抖，形体抽搐、波动，血肉在剧变中翻腾，发出挫败的嘶吼。

那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？
excerpt.en:
As our population swells, Kronen the Afflicted grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.

The strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How

excerpt.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已通过一项议案，将我方列为军事目标。所有[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员如今都与[this.GetName]处于战争状态。我们必须准备好随时迎接他们的舰队进攻。
excerpt.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed a resolution declaring us a military target. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are now at war with the [this.GetName]. We can expect their fleets to strike

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的灵能光环正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。

理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。

这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。
excerpt.en: Our Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced th

excerpt.zh:
我们初次涉入虚境导致其中的能量影响了可观测宇宙。这种影响尽管相当显著，但也相对零星孤立。“灵能光环”是将这种影响转变成持续流的一种方法。

随着我们的行为在虚境中回荡，与力量强大实体的距离也在缩短。如果我们获得了祂们的青睐，就能将祂们的灵能能量传导到现实世界中。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为，由此产生的“光环”可以强化我们的帝国，还能削弱对手——类似我们此前观察到的现象一样。
excerpt.en:
Our forays into the Shroud have caused its energies to affect observable space. Though significant, these effects have been intermittent and isolated. 'Psionic Auras' present a way to turn this influence into a constant flow.

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro]

人们发现这个幻象出现在一处富矿洞穴系统的入口。
excerpt.en: A number of our [Owner.GetCitizenPlural] have perceived uncanny apparitions at various locations on [Owner.Capital.GetName]. In most cases, these have been chance sightings without repetition, but one site has drawn attention for frequent visitations. [Owner.G

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.Capital.GetName]上发生了一次意外的气候事件——一场类似风暴的扰动横扫了一片灵能水平极高的地区。随后我们在其途径之地发现一些当地的动物感染了奇怪的寄生虫，它们会钻入大脑器官并将其慢慢吃掉。

随着这种寄生虫感染的加剧，宿主动物会暂时获得基本的念动力，很多便开始将其用于狩猎和进食，直至被寄生虫杀死。

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]
