excerpt.zh:
在实验新的灵能科技的过程中，我们在集体冥想时观察到了意料之外的具现化现象。将我们的集体注意力聚焦在空间中的一个点上时会短暂出现一些怪异但值得注意的物体。

所耗费的精神力非常巨大，但我们有可能将这些努力转化为合意的具现化对象。这些物体从何而来，以及可能导致什么后果我们不得而知。
excerpt.en:
While experimenting with new psionic techniques, we observed unexpected materializations during group meditation. Narrowing our collective focus on a single point in space resulted in the fleeting appearance of strange and remarkable objects.

关于灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]有二重身能力的传言沸沸扬扬，据信这是一种可以同时以肉身出现在两个地方的能力。我们派出了[Owner.GetResearchers]去调查这种不太可能的说法；结果这种现象竟然是真的。[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]

目前，只有很小一部分人口具有这种强大的能力，进一步研究也许能找到训练方法。

[Owner.GetAdjective]的一小部分人身上出现了一种奇妙的灵能能力：心灵遥感，一种从超出正常感知范围的距离感知实体的能力。这些千里眼无需经过任何专门训练，就能非常精确地描绘出远处物体的细节。

如果这种能力可以加以控制和增强，[Owner.GetName]就能获得可观的回报。利用我们最强大的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]的能力，就可以尝试磨练这项技术，将其应用在重要的事情上。

excerpt.zh:
我们的原材料正在以危险的速率减少。储存在工厂和仓库里的无机材料正在以超过常理的速度消耗，[Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]。这些地区的损失也与灵能活动增加有关。

为此我们可以减少在物资仓库附近区域的灵能活动，但也将拖慢灵能研究的步伐、限制其工业应用。我们还可以按照建议开发灵能场衰减器来抑制这种物灭现象。如果什么都不做，我们的灵能研究能力也会被削弱。
excerpt.en: We are losing raw materials at an alarming rate. Stores of inorganic matter in factories and warehouses are depleting faster than they are being used, [Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]. These losses correlate with increased psionic activity in the affected location

excerpt.zh:
我们的大众对灵能日益增长的好奇心催生了一种奇怪的活动：私下储存死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]并试图与之交流。

参与者相信在[Owner.GetDeathName]后意识信息仍可以保留，这是一种衍生兹科学理论的观念，认为心灵是一种能量——它可以转化但不能凭空消失。尽管总数不多，但还是有越来越多人相信灵能[Owner.GetIndividualName]去世时会产生一个无穷小亚空间裂隙，通过这扇窗户就能一瞥其他维度。

创新研究固然值得赞扬，但对我们部分[Owner.GetDecea
excerpt.en:
Our population's increasing curiosity about psionics has led to the emergence of a strange activity: privately storing expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] and trying to communicate with them.

Practitioners believe that cognitive information can survive [Own

excerpt.zh:
我们的灵能人口中有很大一部分都长出了奇怪的、有关节附肢，其设计深不可测。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]称，他们的外观变化是由大规模自发[Owner.GetGeneticMutationName]导致的。现在很清楚灵能活动可能导致使用者发生身体变化。尽管我们无法抑制这种附肢增生，但也发现可以用灵能来控制其生长率。

尽管一开始导致了一些[Owner.GetDistressName]，这些额外的肢体其实还是很有用的。如果高效利用起来，其它们的作用应该能弥补增加的认知负担。
excerpt.en: Swathes of our psionic population have sprouted strange, jointed appendages of unfathomable design. According to our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], their appearance was caused by spontaneous [Owner.GetGeneticMutationName] at mass scale. It is now clear that psion

excerpt.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]开发出了一种将灵能力转化为动能的可靠方法，现在正在与[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]合作将这种技术放大并投入生产。

尽管这种技术非常有工业应用前景，其社会影响还是个未知数。如果一小帮技术高超的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]就能运作复杂的机械，那么就会有大批的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]就要面临失业。[Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra]我们还在逐渐掌
excerpt.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have developed a reliable method for converting psionic power into kinetic energy, and are now working with [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on scaling the technology for practical use.

While the industrial applications are promising,

excerpt.zh:
突然爆发的[Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural]席卷了我们的帝国。虽然严重程度各不相同，但这种情况已经影响了相当一部分人口，对[Owner.GetName]造成了广泛的破坏。

一小部分特别强大的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]也是受影响最严重的，初步的统计分析也表明灵能能力和症状强度之间存在相关性。[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]
excerpt.en:
A sudden outbreak of [Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural] has befallen our empire. While severity ranges widely, the condition has already affected a significant proportion of the population, causing widespread disruption across the [Owner.GetName].

我们收到报道称，[This.GetName]的特定区域发生了突然的环境变化。

大气中充满着的凝胶状蒸汽，在地面覆盖上一层油性沉淀物，灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]将其称为“虚境落雾”。据报道，附近地区出现了严重的灵能紊乱。

虚境落雾区内的环境对[This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]。除非我们能投入资源修复环境，不然当地居民就需要去适应这种恶劣的环境。

We have received reports of sudden environmental changes in a particular sector on [This.GetName].

The atmosphere is heavy with a gelatinous vapor, coating the ground in an oily precipitation that psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] refer to as 'shroudfal

有些人开始行为异常，观念、习惯和各种日常行为都发生了突然转变。许多[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]停工，而且[Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra]。

受影响者声称自己是在听从一个无名实体的命令，它居住在意识的边缘，指导着他们的一举一动。我们正在追寻着灵能的未来，因此必须小心考察这种异次元力量对[Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche]造成的影响。
excerpt.en:
Some among us have started to behave abnormally, exhibiting sudden changes in opinions, habits, and general conduct. Many [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] have ceased labor, and [Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra].

Those affected claim to be doing the bidding of a namele

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.Capital.GetName]遭受到一连串当地野生动物的攻击。这它们袭击了我们的人口和建筑，消耗了宝贵的库存。

通过武装巡逻和宵禁来保护大众并未取得实质成效。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]们认为，是现实和虚境之间的微小穿孔出现在了[Owner.Capital.GetName]上的一个地方，泄露的灵能力将一些无害的野兽转变成了残暴掠食者。为了应对威胁，这里可能是我们汇聚能量的最佳地点。

[Owner.Capital.GetName] has experienced a rash of attacks by local wildlife. These creatures have attacked our population, raided our buildings, and depleted valuable stockpiles.

Attempts to protect the populace with armed patrols and curfews have had limited

灵能能力在我们人口中的不均衡分布正在引发新的社会矛盾。

那些对新获得的能力控制得更好的人开始认为自己高人一等，因此理应享有各种政治和经济特权。他们的分裂言论越来越激进，并有可能演变成暴力。
excerpt.en:
The uneven distribution of psionic abilities among our population is causing new forms of social conflict.

Those with better control over their newfound powers have come to view themselves as superior and thus deserving of various political and economic privi

一场反对我们探索接纳灵能潜能的活动正在愈演愈烈。这些异见团体主张对灵能个体进行更严格的监督，全面否定在这一领域进行任何进一步的研究。

如果继续默许他们的活动，可能会威胁到我们理解和利用新兴灵能力量的进程。
excerpt.en:
A growing rebel movement is voicing opposition to continued efforts to explore and embrace our psionic potential. These dissident groups advocate for stricter oversight of psionic individuals and a wholesale rejection of further research in this area.

If thei

excerpt.zh:

愤怒的受害者们要求全面修改现有法律，加强对灵能犯罪的打击。

黑市[owner.GetMentalUpgrade]的使用急剧增多。不受管控的[owner.GetMedicalFacility]出售各式用来最大化个体灵能能力的不可靠服务。这些冒险行为的后果难以预料。

As our population adjusts to their newfound powers, some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun taking considerable risks in an effort to accelerate their psionic development.

The use of black market [owner.GetMentalUpgrade] has increased dramatically. Unreg

[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能子个体时常聚集在一起，甚至疏远[owner.GetHiveEntity]的其他部分。

尽管这些子个体还在集体中保持[owner.GetMentalAdj]存在，但无法解释的身体行为引起了关于进一步发展灵能可能带来后果的担忧。
excerpt.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic drones clustering together physically, sometimes away from the rest of the [owner.GetHiveEntity].

Although these drones remain [owner.GetMentalAdj] present within the colle

[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能个体被社会排斥，以至于开始自我放逐形成离群索居的小社群。

据报道，非灵能者造访这些地区的后身体虽然未受损伤但是他们的精神以难以描述的方式遭到了干扰。
excerpt.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic individuals being socially ostracized to the point that they are withdrawing and forming their own remote communes.

Those without psionic powers who visit these areas have

excerpt.zh:
一种新型疾病在[owner.GetName]上爆发，对我们人口的神经器官造成了无法解释的损伤。

这种疾病只出现在最有灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且很多时候会危及生命。

然而对这种异常灵能现象的后续研究表明，有多种方式可以操作该过程。
excerpt.en:
A new disease is sweeping through the [owner.GetName], with our population forming inexplicable lesions within their neural organs.

The outbreak is exclusively affecting [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with the most significant psionic capabilities and is, in

excerpt.zh:
[owner.GetName]上一种无法解释的硬件故障大规模爆发，我们人口体内的神经处理器开始毫无征兆地失效。

奇怪的是，这种问题只出现在拥有强大灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且在很多情况下，这种故障不仅会带来干扰，更会造成破坏。

然而对这种异常灵能现象的后续研究表明，有多种方式可以操作该过程。
excerpt.en:
A surge of inexplicable malfunctions is sweeping across the [owner.GetName], as neural processors within our population begin to fail abruptly, and without warning.

Curiously, only [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] exhibiting strong psionic signatures are affec

[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]对灵能潜力的初步试验失败了，多数实验个体产生了大量记忆损失。

尽管这些结果也并非没有实验价值，但这种工作对我们进一步理解羽翼未丰的灵能而言是否是最佳方式值得怀疑。
excerpt.en:
Initial experiments on [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with psionic potential have ended in failure, with most subjects being left with significant memory loss.

Although these outcomes are not without research value, it is questionable whether continuing such

excerpt.zh:
探索新获得的灵能能力对[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的共情能力造成了根本性的转变。

很显然，我们现在能对其他意识的观点、思维模式和情感进行比以前复杂得多的建模。这些变化对[owner.GetName]究竟意味着新的优势还是劣势，还有待观察。
excerpt.en:
The exploration of our newfound psionic abilities has resulted in fundamental changes to [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] empathetic capacities.

It is already clear that we are now capable of much more sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns

随着我灵能能力的发展，我们中的有些人开始难以承受新力量之重。受影响的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]在从集体重断连中遭受到重度反常行为的影响。

我们的研究表明这种不稳定不是缺陷，而是由于这些受影响的[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]具有极高的灵能效率。通过正确的训练，这些[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以成为我们灵能进化的下一步。但利用这些新能力的尝试必然潜藏着风险。
excerpt.en: As our psionic abilities develop, there are those among us who have begun to struggle under the weight of our emerging powers. The [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] in question are suffering from concerning levels of deviant behavior as they disassociate from th

excerpt.zh:
随着心智漂向虚境的更深处，我们发现自己来到了熟悉的抟土之塑师面前。

脑海中浮现时钟般的节奏。无言的话语齐声响起；潜藏在舰队里的幽灵开始蠢蠢欲动了。它们可以进一步强化物理形体，释放心智的负担，让我们专注于重要的事务。

虽然它们不是活物，但于我们并不陌生。它们的形式由设计塑造，存在充满了历史和目的。它们汇聚一堂，满怀期待地探来。

现在我们不再仅仅是这些飞船的操纵者，而是由集体意志推动着的齐心共战的伙伴。
excerpt.en:
As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of the Animator of Clay.

Clockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir

excerpt.zh:
位面之外客哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。

祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。

有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。

我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！

我们认得祂。我们以前遇见过这个泽珞族人，也就是“先知”。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
excerpt.en:
The mournful essence of the Outsider seeps into our minds.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

Some things you cann

excerpt.zh:
我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着黄金之幻梦安宁的律动。

我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

我们意识到自己正在黄金之幻梦的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。
excerpt.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of the Golden Dream.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to

excerpt.zh:
思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了无尽之潮汐粗粝的面孔。

祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。

祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。
excerpt.en:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of the Endless Tide.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvena

excerpt.zh:
一座令人头晕目眩的高峰在我们的思绪中若隐若现；祂正是苍茫之层峦。有一种视觉压倒了所有的感官，这让我们的精神紧张起来。

我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。

倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。

舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。
excerpt.en:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is the Pale Mountain itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and

excerpt.zh:
空洞之点尖的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。

我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。

空洞之点尖的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。
excerpt.en:
The serenity of the Hollow Point fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The

excerpt.zh:
虚境的沸腾搏动在我们面前。一个强硬的存在逼近了；祂是空置之御座。

随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。

某种东西在我们心灵的最深处形成：一种对秩序的深远渴望。
excerpt.en:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is the Vacant Throne.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom wi

excerpt.zh:
一种不可能的精神加速淹没了我们的感官。我们辨认出这是幽黑之长河出现了。

我们以难以理解的速度奔向无法掌握的终局。它是有与无之间的界限；是既定之事和永不可能分离之处；是任何自然法则都不能逾越的极限。

当自我最终回归时，我们对什么是真正的运动有了新的认识。
excerpt.en:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of the Black River.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has

excerpt.zh:
将意志投射在虚境中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

[this.GetName]已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
excerpt.en: By projecting our will into the Shroud, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess

excerpt.zh:
此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种称为“灵能光环”的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。

这种光环现在也在[from.GetName]恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。
excerpt.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Termed 'Psionic Auras', on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sourc

excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
excerpt.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你最近对灵督城邦的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.
excerpt.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territ

excerpt.zh:
你好。我谨代表[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

我们最初对与你们“物现引擎”有关的消息感到担忧。然而，经过进一步的分析，我们认为这种装置是在对所谓“虚境”的非灵能开发方面颇具潜力的新发展。

我们鼓励你们继续部署这项技术，并期待在未来一同合作。
excerpt.en:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

We were initially concerned by reports of your 'Materiality Engines'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising developme

excerpt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The End of the Cycle has materialized a Gaia World in our [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleet

excerpt.zh: 我们领先机构在富有前景的新研究中取得了意想不到的突破。这纯属意外收获，我们在仪器例行标准化过程中证明了一个长期被认为是误算的理论。现在该重新审视这个曾经被认为是边缘科学的东西了。
excerpt.en: Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was on

excerpt.zh: 一艘渔船在[This.GetName]的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
excerpt.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of [This.GetName]. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

excerpt.zh:
虚境。它潜藏于我们已知的现实之下，如同黑暗投下的阴影。

虽然我们早已涉足这个灵能领域，但早期的尝试只是试探性的。现在，经过多年用我们集体的意志消磨维度之间的帷幕，我们已经能够清晰地感知到它，从而有目的地探索。

在帷幕的另一侧，我们的努力并非无人知晓。[GetChosenPatron]正等待着我们。

舒展。包裹。拓展。

在这无数实体的漩涡中，它的清晰是一种承诺。
excerpt.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined min

excerpt.zh:
在一场[This.GetName]上的地质活动后，有一处大型地下水库之下打开了一道裂口。行星地幔的热量加热着其中贮藏的水，在地表形成了地热喷口。

该自然现象让我们有机会用地热发电站和热泵来拓展殖民地的能源基础设施。
excerpt.en:
Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on [This.GetName]. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.

This natural phenomenon provides u

[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。
excerpt.en:
A derelict ship has appeared in [lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

We have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctione

excerpt.zh:
你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！

你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“虚境封印”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
excerpt.en:
You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!

These 'Shroud Seal' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will h

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。

在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。
excerpt.en:
A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the [From.GetName] system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.

After an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEn

excerpt.zh: [This.GetName]正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
excerpt.en: The [This.GetName] is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的三个天体排列成了完美的三位一体构型；即[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]、[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]和[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]。

这种有利天象为我们在[This.GetName]的殖民地带来了宁静与和谐。
excerpt.en:
Three celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a favorable trine; [favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName], [favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName] and [favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName].

This beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of

excerpt.zh:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]在[root.capital_scope.GetName]的夜空中升上吉位，入主天回星宫。

该天象代表[root.GetName]内在循环的新开端，是增长和发展的重大机遇。
excerpt.en:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName] is occupying an auspicious position in the skies above [root.capital_scope.GetName], residing in the astrological House of Celestial Return.

This represents the commencement of a new internal cycle for the [root.GetName] a

所有定量占星矩阵都表明[This.GetName]目前处于完美的元素平衡。

利用精确的能量线管理可以将这种有益平衡维持很长时间，为我们领袖的繁盛提供理想的形而上环境。
excerpt.en:
All quantifiable astrological metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in perfect elemental balance.

With precise ley line management this beneficial equilibrium can be maintained for an extended period, providing an ideal metaphysical environment in which

excerpt.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]和[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]发现他们的占星结果高度互补。

因此，他们的政治伙伴关系在以尊重和效率为名将我们的政府凝聚了起来，加快了各种立法程序的推进。
excerpt.en: Two of our council members, [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName] and [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName] recently discovered that their astrological signs are perfectly complementary.

excerpt.zh:
在一次例行编目中，一个没固定好的的标本掉在了博物天枢的地上，随后被及时送到保管员那里进行进一步检查。

因为这场事故我们意外得发现，该标本中的一个秘密隔间松动了。里面藏着各种各样的有趣的文物可以丰富我们的馆藏，而此事之前完全未被注意到。
excerpt.en:
During a routine cataloging exercise, an unsecured specimen was dropped on the floor of the Grand Archive and was swiftly delivered to a conservator for closer examination.

Surprisingly, a secret compartment was found to have been loosened in the accident. Pr

excerpt.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着[This.GetName]。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
excerpt.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the [This.GetName]. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

excerpt.zh:
在位于[This.System.GetName]的例行海军演习中因为通讯失误导致[This.GetName]的多艘战舰发生高速碰撞事故。

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader]通报，对这次事故负主要责任的[From.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经按条例处分。
excerpt.en:
A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the [This.GetName] in [This.System.GetName].

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader] has confirmed that the [From.GetIndividualNamePlural] responsible

excerpt.zh:
[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
excerpt.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on [silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName] resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored withi

一位我方的[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]代表无意中做出了与地位不相称的行为。在发表旨在为我们的利益争取支持的演讲时，所使用的翻译设备故障导致了其对[diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]进行尖酸刻薄的羞辱。这场意外事件很快通过星系媒体广为传播，让我们一时臭名远扬。

虽然这种事情不至于立即解雇，但我们在[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的地位也因此受到了影响。
excerpt.en: One of our representatives in the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vit

excerpt.zh:
[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。

这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。
excerpt.en:
An unprecedented solar flare from [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName] has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.

This aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial b

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetName]地表上出现了巨大的陷坑，严重损坏了当地的基础设施。其中一处裂沟出现在一座建筑物的地基下，导致建筑部分倒塌。所幸受灾地区都已成功撤离。

我们无法得知这种突发的地陷具体是什么引起的，但已开始进行进一步维护检查，检测地表裂损情况。

excerpt.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在[This.GetName]殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
excerpt.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the [This.GetName] colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

excerpt.zh: [This.GetName]上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。
excerpt.en: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of [This.GetName], infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的四个天体排列成了预兆灾难的四连星；即[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]和[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]。

这种灾难性天象在[This.GetName]殖民地播下怀疑的种子，让[FromFrom.GetDissent]得以在人群中制造分歧
excerpt.en:
Four celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; [calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName] and [calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName].

T

excerpt.zh: [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]上的居民发现[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]正在发生退行。是时候重新斟酌我们的行为，对[This.GetName]不完美表示遗憾。愿这段时间的沉重反思让我们可以在未来更靠近理想。
excerpt.en: Inhabitants of [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName] have observed that [planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName] is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome p

excerpt.zh:
很不幸，所有的定量矩阵均表明[This.GetName]上的元素已经完全失衡了。

尝试重新组织精妙的平衡需要许多时间也颇为困难。在当前的混沌状态下，我们的领袖无法获得形而上学冥想环境，阻碍了他们的发展。
excerpt.en:
Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.

Attempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正异常地变暗了。占星专家对此进行讨论后，这种发光减少预计将会影响[This.GetName]上的能源基础设施。
excerpt.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]和[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]近来发现他们的占星结果相冲。

因此，他们的政治敌手关系在我们的政府中形成了紧张和怨恨的氛围，例行的立法程序都因此频繁延期。
excerpt.en: Two of our council members, [discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName] and [discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName] recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompati

excerpt.zh:
我们一个管理单元关于其他帝国未经过滤的陈述意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，通讯单元未能关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
excerpt.en: One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [carele

excerpt.zh:
一个行政过失导致我们一件珍贵的文物不见了踪影。尽管进行了广泛的搜索，但它似乎要么消失在我们迷宫一般的博物天枢中，要么就是被转移到没有记录的地方去了。

因此，对展出标本的跟踪手续正在进行彻底改革。
excerpt.en:
An administrative error has led to the misplacement of one of our precious cultural artifacts. Despite extensive search efforts, it is seemingly either lost in the labyrinth that is our Grand Archive or transferred to an unrecorded location.

The procedures in

excerpt.zh:
万华镜寄生虫盘附在了我们提供的改版戴森球上，吞食着一整个恒星的能量，其不断延展的、色彩缤纷的花瓣包覆了整个恒星系。根据我们的数据，这个噬能生命体现在处于一种恒定的、可控的超载状态，在一个类似于死亡和重生的无尽循环中，不断地长出新芽，再不断地爆裂。

我们不知道这个生命体是否有思考能力，但我们希望它的存在本身现在和它产生的光图案一样令人愉快。
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope has latched onto the modified Dyson Sphere we provided, consuming the energy of a star and extending its colorful petals to encompass the whole system. According to our data, the energy being is now in a state of constant, controlled overload,

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]观测到大量晶状生命体的出现。这很明显是某种巢穴——或者至少是晶状生命体的聚集地，就如在[From.GetName]有一个我们从未见过的晶状结构。

这个结构展现出了很多类似晶状生命体的性质，但它的体积大得吓人。
excerpt.en:
We see significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. Evidently some kind of den - or at least a hub of crystalline activity, such as it is - [From.GetName] is home to a crystal construct unlike any previously encountered.

This construct exhib

excerpt.zh: 我们成功摧毁了[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]的晶态结构。过程比我们想象中更加艰难，并在期间回收了一些碎片供研究之用。这样一来，我们应该就能模仿战斗中遭遇的晶体矩阵展现出的再生特性了。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the crystalline construct in the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system. It proved hardier than expected, and some shards have been recovered for study. We should be able to emulate the reconstructive properties of the crystal matrix observed

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]星系发现了大量的古代采矿无人机。看来这里是一个巨大的采矿与矿石处理中心，甚至可能是整个星系中最后一个类似的存在。
excerpt.en: We have encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.

title.zh: 已摧毁采矿无人机基地

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了采矿无人机基地，并成功取回了其中储存的大部分经过加工的矿产和珍贵的合金。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the Mining Drone base, and managed to recover most of its stores of processed minerals and precious alloys.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经用勘探器遗珍的强力扫描光束扫描了我们的领土，并且在[chosen_planet.GetName]上发现了一个以前不为人知的资源储藏！
excerpt.en: We have swept our space with the strong scanning beam of the Surveyor relic, and a previously unknown resource deposit has been identified on [chosen_planet.GetName]!

excerpt.zh:
由于轨道上存在着许多太空垃圾和小型轨道碎片，我们在[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的环境改造工程师正在面临着危险的工作环境。其极大的数量给穿梭机在地表和轨道间往回航行带来了危险。

由于这些物体的密度极高，我们起早了一份，将其中最大的一些碎片进行磁化，使其在轨道上吸引其他的碎片，最后逐渐整合成一个更便于管理的整体。我们任务应该能制造出一颗人工卫星。

虽然这将增加环境改造的时间，但它将大大方便穿梭车进入地表，并消除大型轨道碎片频繁进入行星大气的风险。
excerpt.en: Our terraforming engineers on [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] are facing hazardous working conditions due to various pieces of space junk and minor debris orbiting the planet. The high volume of these objects pose a navigational danger for shuttles tra

excerpt.zh:
将环绕[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的太空垃圾进行整合的工作成功了。

通过将许多大型碎片磁化后，我们逐渐将所有的物体集合成一个巨大的废金属团块。它的密度上升至足以产生自身引力的可观水平。这颗新形成的卫星随后被送入了稳定的轨道。

摆脱了这些危险的轨道碎片之后，前往[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的表面容易多了，我们再也不用担心这些东西掉入大气层。不仅如此，我们的工程师也确信这颗新的卫星甚至可以承载自己的开采站。
excerpt.en:
Efforts to consolidate the space junk orbiting [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] were successful.

By magnetizing many of the larger pieces, we gradually gathered everything into a massive single body of scrap metal. Its density has risen to the point wh

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的居民正在经历严重的身体突变，细胞和重要器官的功能遭到了破坏。虽然在某些情况下，这些变化提高了代谢效率，但更常见的结果是死亡。

这些副作用与万能巨噬细胞原始研究笔记中描述的完全吻合。尽管我们做出了努力，但由配方引起的致命突变似乎是不可避免的。这项技术不能再被信任了。我们正在销毁所有剩余的配方并将停止使用。
excerpt.en:
Citizens on [Root.GetName] are experiencing severe physical mutations that disrupt the functioning of cells and vital organs. While in some instances these changes have enhanced metabolic efficiency, more commonly they are causing fatalities.

These side effec

excerpt.zh:
随着[Root.GetPreFTLLower][event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]社会的发展，我们停止了从观测站与他们进行的资源交换。

尽管这是一个很有趣的实验，继续影响他们的社会只会让我们过早地暴露在他们面前。
excerpt.en:
As the [Root.GetPreFTLLower] [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] society advances, we have discontinued our exchange of rations for minerals from our observation post.

Despite being an interesting experiment, the continued interference with the

excerpt.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的调查单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因为无意之中长时间暴露在高压电缆下而停止工作。
excerpt.en: Survey Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning due to unintended and prolonged exposure to unshielded high-voltage cables.

excerpt.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的舰队指挥单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因非战斗原因停止工作。
excerpt.en: Fleet Commander Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning for reasons unrelated to battle.

excerpt.zh: 星域管理单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因严重的模式缓存故障而停止工作。
excerpt.en: Sector Governing Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has ceased functioning due to a severe pattern buffer issue.

excerpt.zh:
“微聚变模组能让我举起一辆水柜！”这是一条来自消费者的热评。这并不是夸大其词：微聚变技术的最新发展确实有望显著改进我们的机器躯体。

尽管有一定的风险，但安装微型的个人反应堆可以实现爆发式的能量转化、提高速度。当然，这会迫使我们重新评估生产时间表，因为这样的反应堆大大地扩展了项目的规模。
excerpt.en:
"Microfusion mods lets you lift a tank!" crows a major consumer review service. This is not hyperbole: recent developments in microfusion technology promise to significantly improve our machine bodies.

While somewhat risky, installing tiny, personal reactors

excerpt.zh:
一部大受欢迎的新剧吸引了公众的想象力。故事围绕着一个合成劳工逐渐与新身体发生的解离展开。

随着主人公逐渐失去控制，他们的朋友和家人只能惊恐地看着。这部剧集的悲剧结局被视为对我们计划向机器身体过渡的一种毫不掩饰的批评。

围绕这部轰动一时的影片的公众讨论产生了相当大的能量，最终可能会减缓我们的进展。
excerpt.en:
A massively popular new drama has captivated the public imagination. The story centers on a synthetic worker who disassociates from their new body.

As the protagonist spirals out of control, their friends and family can only look on in horror. The drama's tra

excerpt.zh:
一位怀有严重反合成思想的名人遭遇了一场严重的事故，目前已经陷入深度昏迷。无数的人为失去一位敬爱的人而陷入悲痛时，我们支持合成技术的顾问发现了一个好机会。

将这位名人的思维合成化可以给予其第二次生命，这样毫无疑问可以将一部分粉丝转化为坚定的数字化支持者。这个流程是完全合法的，唯一的问题是需要获得许可：在同等情况下，这位名人显然是不可能同意的。如果处理不当，这一公关机遇可能会变成风评灾难。
excerpt.en:
A celebrity holding strong anti-synth views has suffered an accident, and currently lies a vegetative state. While the population laments the loss of a beloved personality, our pro-synth advisors see an opportunity.

Digitizing the celebrity's mind, offering t

excerpt.zh:
将构成生物体意识的、数以兆计的突触连接进行数字化的实验以灾难性的失败告终。一个简单的句法错误导致受试对象的神经通路被擦除。有的人将这称为谋杀。

参与项目的都是志愿者，但他们悲伤的家属正一边痛哭着向我们讨要说法。使问题更加复杂的是，这场失败也使得寻找新的研究对象变得更加困难。
excerpt.en:
Experiments to digitize the trillions of synaptic connections that comprise a biological consciousness have ended in catastrophic failure. A simple syntax error resulted in the instant erasure of our subjects' neural pathways. Some are calling it murder.

The

excerpt.zh:
21,386,732,184个存储单位：这是一个[root.owner.GetSpeciesName]大脑的平均容量。然而，并不是每个灵魂都生来平等。

随着合成化流程的继续，有些人认为并不是每个思想都值得配上一个人工躯体。但是让谁优先也是一个棘手的问题。或许那些不那么理想的人在数字化以后可以……改进一下。或者说，重编程。
excerpt.en:
21,386,732,184 units of memory: that's the average capacity of a [root.owner.GetSpeciesName] brain. Yet, not all minds are created equal.

As the synthesization process continues, some argue not all minds are worthy of an artificial body. However, the question

excerpt.zh:
为了提高[roboticist.GetNamePlural]们的工作效率，管理人员批准了不安全的无线人格软件更新。其目的是将最佳工作流程的知识补上，但不幸的接受者的却丢失了部分个性和记忆。

管理团队认为，在应用人格补丁之前对其进行全面测试太慢，而重新分配那些失去记忆的员工会更容易。
excerpt.en: To increase the productivity of [roboticist.GetNamePlural], managers have approved unsafe over-the-air identity software updates. The intent was to patch in knowledge of optimal work processes, but instead the personality and memories of the unfortunate recipi

excerpt.zh:
合成化技术带来的根本性社会变化已经开始显现。由于我们不再受肉体形态的限制，性别、种族和身体自主权的类别已经有了新的定义。这虽然对一些人来说充满了自由，但更传统的一些人并不愿意放弃旧的框架；他们希望有一个预先设定的身份以便进行操作。

为了安抚他们，我们可以在合成形体中保留部分有机遗产。或者，我们也可以选择允许人们更自由地表达自己的身份。
excerpt.en: The fundamental social changes brought on by synthesization are beginning to be felt. No longer limited by corporeal forms, we have radically redefined categories of gender, race, and bodily autonomy. While freeing for some, more traditional elements are reluc

excerpt.zh:
有些人对合成化兴趣平平，反而对自己的有机过往深感怀念。他们认为，有限的寿命和与生俱来的“自然身体”的不完美才能让生命更有意义。

有一群强硬派声称他们的合成、虚拟复制品只能感受到空洞和自我迷失，发展出了一种对有机身体的崇拜。

我们要为它们提供一个不那么完美的生存模拟环境，还是给他们不那么完美的躯壳呢？
excerpt.en:
Unenthusiastic about synthesization, some people look back with longing to their organic past. They argue that shorter lifespans and the innate imperfection of a "natural body" made life more meaningful.

Claiming that their synthetic or virtual facsimiles fee

excerpt.zh:
整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的合成化也意味着我们的住房实践发生了巨大的变化；大脑可以轻松地栖息在庞大的服务器群中，而合成的身体则可以储存在架子上。虽然这是一个具有成本效益的解决方案，但一些倡导团体提出了一些非常现实的担忧。

往日利润丰厚的房地产市场可能会完全崩溃，给我们的经济造成相当大的打击。至少从心理角度来看，更大的潜在伤害是，人们将不再有一个可以称之为家的物理场所。
excerpt.en: Synthesization of the entire [root.GetSpeciesAdj] species has also meant a drastic shift in our housing practices; with minds resting easy in massive server farms, synthetic bodies can be stored in shelves. While this represents a cost-effective solution, some

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]现在清除了[Root.GetName]上的最后一点地形改造残余物。尽管清除工作十分痛苦、还黏黏糊糊，但这一切并非没有价值。对造成这一事故的原因和后果进行分析，使我们对地形学有了更加深远的理解。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have now cleared the final Terraforming Residue on [Root.GetName]. While the cleanup was painful and quite sticky, it was not all for naught. Analysis of the cause of this issue and the fallout has led to furthering our underst

title.zh: 发现剧毒环境改造候选

excerpt.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详细调查得出了结论，尽管由于其大气层内充满剧毒气体，现阶段生命不适合栖居，但是它具有维持可支持生命的大气层的潜质。通过合作筹划，我们或许能够将[From.GetPlanetMoon]的有毒物质降解成为毒性更加轻微的化合物。

对这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造理论上是可能的，但是我们目前还没有积累足够的技术手段，在合理的时间框架内完成这项壮举。
excerpt.en: Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that although it is currently unsuitable for life due to the noxious gases present in its atmosphere, it is capable of sustaining a hospitable atmosphere. Through a concerted effort, we may be able to break th

excerpt.zh:
我们对克兰尼克斯恒星系进行的初步扫描显示，巴洛瑞兹已经被核武器所摧毁。居民们使用了威力强大的星球级武器相互毁灭，甚至连卫星都被震碎了。

我们想要知道发生了什么，就只能通过目前还在恒星系中巡航的一艘舰船，但它正在用导弹攻击我们。
excerpt.en:
Our initial scan of the Xraneax system revealed that the planet Baloryz was destroyed by nuclear weapons. The inhabitants annihilated themselves using planet-based weapons so powerful that they even shattered their moon.

Our only chance to learn more about wh

excerpt.zh:
在船上未探测到生命迹象，因此这艘船明显是一艘人工智能，但它在战斗中一直将保全自身而非战斗效果最优化置于第一优先级。这意味着巴洛瑞兹上那次可怕冲突的唯一幸存者是这位智慧人工智能。

舰船在被摧毁前发送了一条简短的信息：

"为什么"

我们不知道这究竟是询问巴洛瑞兹居民自我毁灭的原因，还是对我们摧毁它的原因进行质疑。

虽然这些技术在我们的科技水平下较为原始，但我们可以通过拆解残骸来获取一些见解。或者出于对它勇敢履行了自己的职责的敬佩，我们可以用它的名字来命名这颗星球，以此来纪念这位智慧人工智能。
excerpt.en:
No life signs were detected aboard the vessel, so while clearly an AI, the ship repeatedly prioritized self-preservation over optimal combat effectiveness. This means that the only survivor of the horrible conflict on Baloryz was sapient.

The ship sent a brie

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]一进入到[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，发现许多无人机在广播着以下消息：

欢迎来到星达广场。

我们的自动无人机随时待命，协助您到达我们的轨道停泊区。你的飞船一熄火，我们的穿梭车就会带你去星达广场体验。明亮的水疗中心，完美的营养庭院，以及超大规模的产品和服务等着你！

在这个星系的唯一一颗气态巨行星附近，废弃的星达广场居住站孤独地漂浮着。看来已经很久没有人前往此处消费了。
excerpt.en:
As the [Root.GetName] entered the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system, several drones broadcast the following message:

Welcome to Star Mall.

Our automated drones are standing by to assist you to one of our orbital parking zones. Once your vessel is powered do

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]发现有个体型智慧生命居住在[from.GetName]。考虑到缺乏共生智能的指导，这种[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种已经达到了对环境的显著控制程度。

我们会继续密切关注这种生物的发展，也许有一天将其并入我们。这些生物的出现预示着[from.GetName]觉醒的潜质。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered individualistic, presapient life dwelling on [from.GetName]. This [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species has achieved a remarkable degree of mastery over its environment already, considering the lack of a Mutualistic Int

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的一批未开化物种不知为何进入了我们殖民地外围的安保隔离区域，尽管他们在不久之后就被赶出去了，但他们已经对我们专门负责运输货币的几条星际上行运输线造成了严重的破坏。

恐怕我们要失去几百能量币。
excerpt.en: A number of individuals belonging to the pre-sapient, native population of [From.GetName] somehow got into a secure compound on the outskirts of our colony. They were chased off within hours, but not before severely damaging several interstellar uplinks dedica

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的外星生物研究员发表了一封公开信，要求当地立法部门解除对接近智慧生物进行实验的限制。

他们从科研角度出发阐述了自己的观点，警告称如果法律得不到修改，[Root.GetName]的整个科研团体的实验效率都会下降。

其中涉及的伦理问题仍有争议。
excerpt.en:
Xeno-researchers on [Root.GetName] have published an open letter demanding that the local legislation restricting experiments on near-sapient alien species be relaxed.

They make a convincing case for the scientific benefits, and warn that the output of the en

excerpt.zh:
我们现在准备开始这项史诗工程，环绕[From.From.GetName]星系的恒星来建造未来环形世界的初始框架。

这个框架所需的资源与矿物是史无前例的，我们成百上千最优秀的工程师准备好开始拆解恒星系内的行星，将这些物质用于环形世界建造。
excerpt.en:
We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.

The amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hund

excerpt.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]已着手在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系建造一个史诗级项目。他们旨在建造一个巨大的环形世界以环绕恒星系的恒星，作为项目的第一步他们开始将星系所有行星转换为巨型结构的金属骨架。
excerpt.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has undertaken a construction project of monumental proportions in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system. They intend to build a massive Ring World around the system's primary, and as a first step they have started t

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]星系建设的环形世界框架现以完成。虽然还有很多后续工作，这个周长近十亿千米的金属骨架的完成必将是工程界的一项壮举。

我们准备好建设真正意义上的宜居地了。
excerpt.en: The skeletal frame of the Ring World we are building in the [From.From.GetName] system has finally been completed. Although there is still much left to do, the mere completion of this metal skeleton, which has a circumference of nearly a billion kilometers, mu

excerpt.zh:
我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个巨型结构的残骸，包围着这个恒星系的恒星。我们的科学家初步判断这曾是个“戴森球”——一个用于彻底利用恒星能量的巨型结构。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受到了来自未知的能量武器的致命打击。

值得注意的是这个戴森球残骸周围同时也漂浮着许多舰船残骸。这个戴森球的本体很古老，但其周围的残骸云明显来自于更近的年代。这些残骸似乎大多来自两支舰队之间的一场激烈交战，这场战斗很可能因为争夺这个废弃戴森球的归属权而爆发。
excerpt.en: We have encountered the remains of an enormous space structure in [dyson_system.GetName], encompassing the system's primary. Our scientists theorize that this may have once been a functional "Dyson Sphere" - a megastructure designed to harness the power of a s

excerpt.zh:
我们成功修复了位于[From.GetName]星系内的废弃戴森球。星系内庞大的碎片云被收集起来用于修复工程，这样既减少了我们资源的消耗，又为工作人员消除了一个潜在的航行风险。

这个巨型结构现已恢复正常运作，在沉寂了千百年后再次产出巨额的能源。
excerpt.en: We have successfully repaired the ruined Dyson Sphere in the [From.GetName] system. The large debris fields present in the system were gathered for use in the repair effort, reducing both material costs and removing a potential navigational hazard for the work

excerpt.zh: 我们在[nexus_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大太空装置的残骸。该巨型结构似乎曾是一个巨大的科学枢纽。尽管其已废弃数千年，但其主体结构依然完好。
excerpt.en: The broken remnants of a colossal space installation have been found near the [nexus_system.GetName]. This megastructure appears to have once served as some kind of massive Science Nexus. Although the installation has obviously been abandoned for millennia, it

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近的废弃科学枢纽已被完全修复了，并配备了[Root.GetName]的精英科学家。这个巨型结构仍然保持着设计师当初建造它时的初衷，在这个时代继续帮助我们解决更多的科学问题。
excerpt.en: The abandoned Science Nexus near [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the brightest minds of the [Root.GetName]. As was no doubt its original purpose, the megastructure will now be put to use in answering the scientific questions of our time.

excerpt.zh:
在星系历史上的某个时间点，[sentry_system.GetName]星系曾建有过一个体积异常巨大的轨道设施，后来被有组织地拆毁。此星系大部分天体的行星同步轨道上都弥漫着大量的残骸，当中不乏大型空间站的外壳。

残骸中以一个庞大的哨兵阵列为最。经过我们初步的扫描结果推测，这个阵列强大到足以实时监控整个星系。
excerpt.en: At some point in galactic history, the [sentry_system.GetName] system evidently supported a vast orbital infrastructure of unusual proportions which has since been systematically demolished. There are large concentrations of debris in geostationary orbits arou

excerpt.zh:
虽然十分困难，我们的工程师还是设法修复了位于[From.GetName]恒星系的废弃哨兵阵列，并在过程中回收利用了散布在周围的空间站残骸。

时隔亿万年，哨兵阵列在轰鸣中再次投入运作，列阵之中能量充盈，借助它强力的信号，整个星系一览无余。
excerpt.en:
It wasn't easy, but our engineers have managed to restore the ruined Sentry Array in the [From.GetName] system. The other station hulks and the debris that surrounded them were converted into building material during the restoration effort.

For the first time

excerpt.zh:
这些环绕着[ring_system.GetName]星系中央恒星的残骸，来自一个古老的环形世界。任何曾经存在于这个恒星系的行星体，都在这个庞然大物的修建工程中被作为建筑材料而使用。

没有证据能够指明这个工程奇迹最初是被谁修建的，但这一定是一个高度先进文明的杰作。
excerpt.en:
The shattered remnants of an ancient Ring World encircle the star of the [ring_system.GetName] system. Any planetary bodies that may once have existed here must have been used as building material during this megastructure's construction.

No evidence hinting

excerpt.zh: 基于[From.GetName]星系的环形世界废墟，我们的工程师成功地将它的一个区段恢复运转。全新的环形世界生态结构几乎是由我们的行星学家从零开始规划，但现在它已经足够稳定，可以居住了。
excerpt.en: Building on what remains of the ruined Ring World in the [From.GetName] system, our engineers have managed to fully restore one of its sections. The new biosphere had to be created more or less from scratch by our leading planetologists, but it is now consider

excerpt.zh:
我们对自己超主的理解与日俱增。我们对于祂来说只不过是茶余饭后的闲思遐绪。房室内的虫子。然而，是祂对我们降下了恩宠，而且非常偶然地，它对我们施予了又一汪能源之滴露。

我们的灵能使现在和超主愈发地协调，受到鼓舞我们计划建立一座纪念碑来铭记我们的刻印，在这里我们最为杰出的灵能使可以尝试与[GetShroudPatron]进行沟通。
excerpt.en:
Our understanding of our patron grows. We are no more than an afterthought to it. Insects in its home. Yet, it has taken a liking to us and on this occasion, it has bestowed another drop of power upon us.

Our telepaths are now more closely attuned to our patr

excerpt.zh: 虚境的神秘对于我们来说异乎寻常，难以消弭，但是我们和[GetShroudPatron]的协调更加融顺了。无论我们去往哪里，我们都能感受到它在我们思绪的背后，它的能量渗过心灵的缝隙进入我们的现实。
excerpt.en: The mysteries of the Shroud are too alien for us to dispel, but we have become more attuned to the [GetShroudPatron]. Everywhere we go, we can sense it at the back of our minds, and its power seeps into our reality from the cracks of our psyche.

excerpt.zh:
灵能使密会在研究如何利用超主[GetShroudPatron]的力量方面取得了突破性进展。在从前，只有激发了灵能的个体可以完全领悟契约的内涵，我们已经开发了一种能让这股力量贯穿整艘星舰的方法，这是此前从未达到过的程度。

只要我们想，[GetShroudPatron]的力量能将我们的舰船推进得比以往更远。
excerpt.en: The Conclave of Telepaths has made a breakthrough in harnessing the powers of our patron, the [GetShroudPatron]. Where previously only psionic individuals could fully grasp the extent of the Covenant, we have devised a way to let power flow through entire star

excerpt.zh: 掌控恒星的能量一直是[Root.GetAdj]工程师们的梦想，从粗劣的燃烧到拙劣地模仿恒星聚变，而现在我们要实现这个梦想。在[From.From.GetName]星系坐落着我们的脚手架，而我们即将在那建造戴森球，将[From.From.GetName]包裹并独占恒星强大的能量。
excerpt.en: Harnessing the power of the stars has been a dream of [Root.GetAdj] engineers throughout history - from crude combustion to the pale imitation of solar fusion - and we now stand ready to realize this dream. In the [From.From.GetName] system sits the scaffold u

excerpt.zh:
[dyson_system.GetName]星系的剧烈活动泄露了[From.GetName]在建戴森球的情况。

虽然还在早期阶段，完全建造的戴森球将完全阻隔[dyson_system.GetName]的光照，光照将转变为[From.GetAdj]能量储存。
excerpt.en:
Frenetic activity in the [dyson_system.GetName] system betrays the construction of a Dyson Sphere by the [From.GetName].

Still in its early stages, the completed sphere will eventually blot out the light of [dyson_system.GetName], its radiance diverted to [Fr

excerpt.zh:
随着框架已被安置，这个项目的庞大是显而易见的。

[From.From.GetName]在纤细的笼子里燃烧，但她将最终被[Root.GetAdj]太阳能板完全包围。
excerpt.en:
With the frame now in place, the awesome scale of the project is evident to all.

[From.From.GetName] burns in a spindly cage, but will eventually be completely surrounded by [Root.GetAdj] solar panels.

excerpt.zh:
虽然没有完全完成，随着先进的太阳能收集器的安装，我们现在开始收获位于[From.From.GetName]恒星系的戴森球带来的利益。

随着建造继续，能量收入会继续增长，最终戴森球完成时我们将获得完全的运转能力。
excerpt.en:
While not yet complete, with the installation of advanced solar harvesters we have begun to reap the benefits of the Dyson Sphere being built in the [From.From.GetName] system.

The energy gains will only continue to increase as construction continues, eventua

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]星系的主星已被[Root.GetAdj]戴森球完全包裹。

我们的工程师们庆祝着这一胜利，而也理应如此。我们做到了只有少数星系帝国敢于尝试的壮举——完全俘获一颗恒星。
excerpt.en:
The [From.From.GetName] system's primary has now been completely enveloped by a [Root.GetAdj] Dyson Sphere.

Our engineers celebrate this as a great victory, and rightly so. We have achieved what only a handful of star empires in the history of the galaxy dare

excerpt.zh:
群星的光芒暗淡，虚空的黑暗消失，只有我们学会超越光速之后，我们才知道光揭示的只是真相的一角。

今天我们将终结我们的黑朦，我们准备在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系建造的哨兵阵列将成为坚实的全景监狱，我们的双眼将紧盯着每一颗恒星。
excerpt.en:
The light of suns blinds and the darkness of the void hides; only when we learned to travel faster than light did we learn just how little the light reveals.

Today, we begin to end this amaurosis of ours. The Sentry Array we prepare to build in the [From.sola

excerpt.zh: 我们收到消息，[From.GetName]开始在[spy_system.GetName]星系建造一个庞大，长程传感阵列。虽然还在早期阶段，完全完成的阵列将提供给他们全星系完全的星际活动动向。
excerpt.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has begun the construction of a vast, long-range sensor array in the [spy_system.GetName] system. While still in its early stages, the completed array is set to give them unfettered insight into interstellar travel i

excerpt.zh:
哨兵阵列中心本身就代表着目前的最高技术水平，其将监听站和太空望远镜合二为一。

但这只是这一伟大工程的第一块里程碑。
excerpt.en:
The hub of the Sentry Array is a state-of-the-art installation in its own right, half listening post and half space telescope.

However, it marks but the first milestone in this grand undertaking.

excerpt.zh:
我们已开始着手庞大的科学枢纽的建设。基座已就位，主轴已准备。对突破性科技的允诺以及对大胆设想的超越都将等待着我们。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。

宇宙无尽的谜团最终都能被我们所掌控吗？
excerpt.en: We have now begun the massive undertaking of constructing a Science Nexus. The foundation is in place and preparations are underway to add the main hub. The promise of new groundbreaking technologies and the realization of ideas beyond our wildest imaginations

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]开始挑战科学枢纽的建设——一座科技极其先进的科研设施，足以让科学进程产生革命性颠覆。

[think_tank_system.GetName]星系热火如荼，工程师们正在组装建筑初始平台。无论他们成功与否，单纯这次尝试就足以让他们成为我们这一时代的先行者。
excerpt.en:
The [From.GetName] have taken on the challenge of building a Science Nexus - a research institute, so technically advanced, that it could revolutionize the scientific process completely.

The [think_tank_system.GetName] system is bustling with activity as engi

excerpt.zh: 科学枢纽的中央核心已就位，这个核心安装了一个最新工艺水平的奇点反应堆。我们的工程师准备加装下一个，也是最有挑战的设施片段——四个研究辅翼，足够承载极端炎热，极端的压力波动，以及外星病原体。辅翼也能为研究者提供很多住房。
excerpt.en: The Science Nexus central hub is now in place, equipped with a state of the art singularity reactor. Our engineers are preparing to add the next, most challenging segment of the facility - the four research wings. They will be fitted with pioneering technology

excerpt.zh: 第一个模组——四个研发辅翼已就位，研究者与工作人员已前往他们的生活分区。下一步也是最后一部我们将延展辅翼，添加四个实验室区间以支持我们最危险的研究。我们已采取进一步的安保来保证工作人员的安全。
excerpt.en: The first module of the four research wings is now in place and researchers and staff are already moving into the living quarters. The next and final step of construction will extend the wings, adding four sections of laboratories equipped to support our most

excerpt.zh:
解码已完成。栅格中保存着数十个文明的记录。每一份记述的结尾都如出一辙：向后来者的致意，以及一份加入其中的邀请。

然而，现在显而易见的是，这些传输并未在事件视界处终止。彼端的某种存在一直在接收这些记录。

合约依然有效。[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]打算按约定将我们的事迹铭刻在他们之中。我们必须决定是履行这一承诺，还是关闭发射器并就此离开。
excerpt.en:
The decoding is complete. The lattice holds records from dozens of civilisations. Every account ends identically: a farewell addressed to whoever came next, and an invitation to contribute.

However, it is now obvious that the transmissions do not terminate at

excerpt.zh: 我们必须在该星系部署一颗间谍卫星，以履行我们的合约。
excerpt.en: We must deploy a Spy Satellite in this system to fulfill our contract.

excerpt.zh: 我们被委派走私关键任务物资，以支援间谍网络。
excerpt.en: We have been tasked with smuggling critical mission supplies to support the Spy Network.

excerpt.zh: 我们需要协助潜入该星系的一个恒星基地。
excerpt.en: Our assistance is required to infiltrate a Starbase in this system.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]为着同一个目标汇聚一堂。

我们要深入虚境之中，让心声强大的力量可以认可我们，并与我们沟通。

我们称之为大灾。而其他人则叫祂清算。现在，祂将向我们揭示祂的真名，得知之后我们将成就伟业。
excerpt.en:
We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.

We will reach deep within the Shroud and force the staggering power of the Voice to acknowledge and commune with us.

We have known it as the Cataclysm. Others called it the Reckoning. Now,

excerpt.zh:
我们需要进一步了解我们将其编码命名为[Prev.From.GetName]的神秘外星种群。如果他们也拥有语言，那我们必须对其进行破译并且建立交流。

奖励：£influence£ 影响力或特殊项目
excerpt.en:
We need to learn more about the mysterious aliens we have code-named [Prev.From.GetName]. If they possess a language, we must decipher it and establish communications.

Reward: £influence£ Influence or Special Project

excerpt.zh: 一切事物，包括所有星球，都注定要融入我们的集体，成为我们的一部分。
excerpt.en: Everything, including entire worlds, is destined to be assimilated into our collective, to become a part of us.
